hero.sub: Kuzindikira & kutsimikizira kwa Vortex intaneti ya anzawo. Tsegulani. Zosungidwa. Zosaimitsidwa.

network.label: NETWORK
network.body: Mnzake aliyense ali ndi chizindikiritso chosainidwa. Makasitomala amatsimikizira asanalumikizidwe, ma node amatsimikizira umwini pakulembetsa. Palibe akuluakulu omwe anganamizire zomwe cryptography yatsimikizira kale.
network.dual_body: Olembetsedwa ndi owongolera AND osindikizidwa pa unyolo kudzera pa Solana. Mboni ziwiri zodziyimira pawokha zimatsimikizira code hash ndi pubkey. Otetezeka ku magawo ovuta.
network.ctrl_body: Siginecha imatsimikizira kuti node ili ndi kiyi yake yachinsinsi, koma kukhulupirika kwa ma code sikumangika pa unyolo. Zabwino kwa magawo ambiri; chiopsezo = khulupirirani woyang'anira.
network.unverif_body: Zodziwika kuchokera ku config kapena miseche. Palibe umboni wa cryptographic panobe. Gwiritsani ntchito kungoyambira mndandanda wa anzanu - osakhala ngati chandamale cha magawo amoyo.

security.label: SECURITY
security.body: Makiyi anayi odziyimira pawokha a Ed25519, iliyonse ili ndi ntchito imodzi yopapatiza. Kuphwanya makiyi aliwonse sikuphwanya enawo.
security.controller_verified: Makasitomala - kuchokera ku SNS kapena pini yomanga
security.user_signs: Zizindikiro za gawo, ma envulopu a mauthenga
security.step1_d: Werengani vortexx.sol pa tcheni. Zolemba zosainidwa ndi chikwama cha Solana - sizingatheke DNS-kuba.
security.step2_d: Makasitomala amayimba /v1/integrity. Imakana kuyankha kulikonse kupatula status: verified kuchokera pa kiyi yotulutsa yosindikizidwa.
security.step3_d: Kuyimba kulikonse API kumabwerera {payload, sig, signed_by}. Makasitomala amatsimikizira siginecha ya Ed25519 asanakhulupirire.
security.step4_d: Malo osindikizidwa: kasitomala amawerenga code_hash kuchokera ku registry ya Solana. Divergence from controller = oletsedwa kwamuyaya.
security.check_auth: Kutsimikizika kwa mayankho - zosatheka kupanga /v1/nodes popanda kiyi yachinsinsi ya woyang'anira.
security.check_integrity: Code integrity - mafayilo owongolera amafulumizitsidwa ndikuwunikiridwa poyambira kulikonse. Kusokoneza kumabweza 503 magalimoto asanaperekedwe.
security.check_identity: Node identity — ma nodi ayenera kusaina kulembetsa ndi kiyi yawoyawo. Wowukira sangathe kulembetsa m'malo mwa pubkey ya node ina.
security.check_dns: DNS chitetezo cha hijack — .sol records amakhala pa Solana. Mdani ayenera kusokoneza chikwama, osati DNS olembetsa.
security.check_handoff: Chitetezo cha Handoff - Kusamutsidwa kwa gawo kumanyamula ma tokeni osainidwa ndi Ed25519 okhala ndi anti-replay, ndi mphindi 5 zokha. Cholinga chikukana komwe sikudziwika.
security.check_transport: Zinsinsi zamayendedwe - kulumikizana URL kumawonekera kwa ISP / Cloudflare yanu. Gwiritsani ntchito galasi la Tor ngati metadata ikufunika.
security.check_content: Zinthu zauthenga — NOT kukhudzidwa ndi wowongolera. Kumapeto-kumapeto kwachinsinsi pakati pa ogwiritsa ntchito. Wolamulira sangawerenge chilichonse ngakhale atasokonezedwa kwathunthu.
security.check_host: Host OS / kernel - ngati VPS yazika mizu, makiyi amatha kubedwa. Gwiritsani ntchito kusaina kwa Hardware potumiza paranoid.

access.label: ACCESS
access.body: Malo ambiri olowera akutanthauza kuti palibe gulu limodzi lomwe lingaletse mwayi wanu. Masamba agalasi amakhala ndi zomwe zasainidwa zomwezo kuchokera kuzinthu zodziyimira pawokha.
access.tunnel_body: Adilesi yaulere *.trycloudflare.com. Palibe akaunti yofunika. URL zimasintha pomwe ngalandeyo iyambiranso - zikhala ngati zachikale.
access.tor_body: .adiresi ya anyezi, imapezeka kokha kudzera mu Tor. Umboni wotsimikizira ndi metadata-zachinsinsi, koma pang'onopang'ono. Imafunika kasitomala wa Tor.
access.ipfs_body: Kope loyankhidwa ndi zinthu za static frontend. Chipata chilichonse cha IPFS chitha kuyigwiritsa ntchito - palibe seva imodzi yoletsa.
access.direct_body: Dongosolo lokhazikika + TLS. Yachangu njira. Zotsekeka pamlingo wa DNS/IP - bwererani kwa ena ngati mwawunika.
access.mirrors_body: Othandizira ena omwe akupereka zomwe zasainidwa ndi wowongolerayu. Kalilore aliyense amafufuzidwa nthawi ndi nthawi - dontho lobiriwira limatanthawuza kupezeka mkati mwa mphindi zisanu zapitazi. Magalasi a Tor .onion sangayang'anitsidwe ndi thanzi popanda woyimira wa Tor wakomweko.

start.label: GET STARTED
start.step1: Ikani Vortex pa chipangizo chanu — foni yam'manja kapena pakompyuta.
start.step2: Sankhani Global network mode mu wizard yokhazikitsa.
start.step3: Matani chowongolera URL (chosinthidwa zokha kudzera SNS) kapena cholowa chilichonse URL kuchokera patsamba la Zolemba.
start.step4: Tsimikizirani pubkey mu pulogalamu yanu ikugwirizana ndi chala chowongolera chomwe chili pansipa. Kusagwirizana kumatanthauza kusokoneza.
start.step5: Mwalumikizidwa. Mndandanda wamanode, siginecha, ndi njira zimagwiridwa automatically.
start.fingerprint_note: Lembani kiyi iyi mwa kasitomala wanu musanakhulupirire yankho lililonse.

treasury.label: TREASURY & REWARDS
treasury.transparency_body: Ndalama zonse za protocol - ndalama zolembetsera node ndi kudulidwa kwa 20% kwa zolembetsa - zimapita ku chikwama cha Treasury pa Solana. Ntchito iliyonse imatsimikiziridwa ndi aliyense.
treasury.rewards_body: 70% ya gawo lililonse la premium limapita ku dziwe lamalipiro, kugawidwa kwa pro-rata kwa ogwiritsa ntchito node. 20% imathandizira chitukuko choyambirira. 10% amawotcha kapena amakhala ngati inshuwaransi.

gravitixDocs.title: Gravitix Chiyankhulo cha Chiyankhulo
gravitixDocs.subtitle: Chilankhulo cholemba bwino kwambiri chomangira bots. 96 mawonekedwe. Dzimbiri kumbuyo.
gravitixDocs.introDesc: Gravitix ndi chiyankhulo chachindunji (DSL) chopangidwa kuchokera pansi mpaka polemba ma Vortex bots. Kumene zilankhulo zina zimafuna malaibulale, ma callbacks, ndi boilerplate, Gravitix imakupatsirani zowongolera zochitika, mayendedwe amakambirano, komanso zomangika - zonse m'mawu oyera, owerengeka owuziridwa ndi Rust.
gravitixDocs.goalReadable: Zowerengeka - khodi imawerengedwa ngati cholinga, osati makina
gravitixDocs.goalSafe: Safe - mitundu yokhazikika imagwira zolakwika nthawi isanakwane
gravitixDocs.goalExpressive: Zowoneka bwino - zoyenda, alonda, ndi mafananidwe amapangidwe amamangidwa
gravitixDocs.goalMinimal: Zochepa - palibe makalasi, palibe cholowa, palibe ndondomeko yoti muphunzire
gravitixDocs.whoDesc: Gravitix ndi ya aliyense amene akufuna kupanga Vortex bot mwachangu - kaya simunalembepo kachidindo, kapena ndinu katswiri wodziwa ntchito yemwe watopa ndi Python boilerplate. Bukuli limaphunzitsa Gravitix kuchokera ku mfundo zoyambirira: palibe chidziwitso choyambirira chofunikira.
gravitixDocs.howToReadDesc: Gawo lirilonse limamanga pa zam'mbuyo. Ngati ndinu watsopano ku mapulogalamu, werengani kuchokera pamwamba mpaka pansi. Ngati mumadziwa kale chinenero china, gwiritsani ntchito mndandanda wa zomwe zili mkati kuti mudumphire pazomwe zimakukondani.
gravitixDocs.quickStartDesc: Njira yothamanga kwambiri kuchokera ku zero kupita ku bot.
gravitixDocs.whatHappenedDesc: pa /kuyamba {... } - imatanthawuza chothandizira chomwe chimayenda pamene wogwiritsa ntchito atumiza /kuyamba. emit "..." - imatumiza uthenga kwa wogwiritsa ntchito. {ctx.first_name} - imamasulira dzina loyamba la wosuta mu chingwe.
gravitixDocs.runningDesc: Mu Gravitix IDE, dinani Thamangani batani mu bar pamwamba. Lowetsani Chizindikiro chanu cha Vortex Bot mukafunsidwa. Bot imayamba nthawi yomweyo - palibe sitepe yomanga yofunika.
gravitixDocs.syntaxDesc: Pulogalamu iliyonse ya Gravitix imapangidwa kuchokera ku midadada itatu yomanga: othandizira, mawu otulutsa, ndi malingaliro.
gravitixDocs.typesDesc: Mtengo uliwonse mu Gravitix uli ndi mtundu wake. Mtundu wamtunduwu ndi wosasunthika: mitundu imawunikidwa panthawi yophatikiza, bot yanu isanayambe.
gravitixDocs.operatorsDesc: Othandizira amaphatikiza mfundo kuti apange zatsopano.
gravitixDocs.stringsDesc: Zingwe mu Gravitix ndizolemba za UTF-8. Amathandizira kutanthauzira kolemera komanso mndandanda wazinthu zomangidwira.
gravitixDocs.matchDesc: Fananizani mtengo motsutsana ndi mapatani angapo. Ganizirani izi ngati mawu osinthira amphamvu.
gravitixDocs.functionsDesc: Ntchito ndi midadada reusable wa code. Amakuthandizani kuti musabwereze kubwereza komanso kupanga code kukhala yosavuta kumvetsetsa.
gravitixDocs.eventHandlersDesc: Handlers ndiye mtima wa Gravitix bot. Wothandizira aliyense amamvetsera mtundu wina wa chochitika ndipo amathamanga chochitikacho chikachitika.
gravitixDocs.guardDesc: Alonda amakulolani kuti muwonjezere chikhalidwe kwa wothandizira. Wogwira ntchitoyo amangothamanga ngati mlonda akuwunika kuti ndi zoona.
gravitixDocs.contextDesc: Chinthu cha ctx chimapezeka mosavuta mkati mwa aliyense wogwira ntchito. Lili ndi zambiri zokhudza uthenga wamakono komanso wogwiritsa ntchito amene watumiza.
gravitixDocs.stateDesc: State imalola bot yanu kukumbukira zinthu pakati pa mauthenga. Popanda boma, uthenga uliwonse ndi wodziyimira pawokha ndipo bot ilibe kukumbukira.
gravitixDocs.flowsDesc: Mayendedwe amakulolani kuti mulembe zokambirana zamasitepe angapo motsata mzere, mawonekedwe owerengeka. Kuthamanga kumatha kuyimitsa ndikudikirira uthenga wotsatira wa wogwiritsa ntchito.
gravitixDocs.emitDesc: Kutumiza mauthenga ndiko kutulutsa koyambirira kwa bot.
gravitixDocs.schedulingDesc: Thamangani khodi mokhazikika pa ndandanda - palibe ntchito za cron, osafunikira ntchito zakunja.
gravitixDocs.atSpecificTime: pa - kuthamanga pa nthawi yeniyeni ya tsiku
gravitixDocs.pipeDesc: Woyendetsa chitoliro |> amadutsa mtengo ngati mkangano woyamba ku ntchito yotsatira. Zimapangitsa kuti maunyolo aziwerengeka, kuchokera kumanzere kupita kumanja.
gravitixDocs.errorDesc: Gravitix imapereka kuwongolera zolakwika ndikuyesa / kugwira / pomaliza kutsekereza.
gravitixDocs.structsDesc: Mapangidwe amakulolani kuti mugawane deta yokhudzana ndi mtundu womwe watchulidwa. Enums amatanthauzira mitundu yotsekedwa.
gravitixDocs.mathDesc: Gravitix imatumiza laibulale yamasamu yathunthu yokhala ndi ~180 ntchito.
gravitixDocs.complexDesc: Gravitix ili ndi mtundu wovuta wachilengedwe - zoyandama za 64-bit zomwe zimayimira magawo enieni komanso ongoyerekeza.
gravitixDocs.calculusDesc: Gravitix imaphatikizanso mawerengedwe a manambala: zotengera ndi zophatikizika zomwe zimawerengedwa pa ntchito zosagwirizana.
gravitixDocs.linearAlgebraDesc: Linear algebra ndi masamu a ma vectors ndi matrices.
gravitixDocs.numberTheoryDesc: Chiphunzitso cha manambala chimaphunzira za ma integers. Maziko a cryptography yamakono.
gravitixDocs.statisticsDesc: Ziwerengero zimapereka zida zofotokozera, kusanthula, ndi kuzindikira zomwe zili mu data.
gravitixDocs.specialDesc: Ntchito zapadera ndi njira zothetsera ma equation ofunikira.
gravitixDocs.fftDesc: Kusintha kwa Fourier kumawola chizindikiro mumayendedwe ake.
gravitixDocs.bp3: Gwiritsani ntchito alonda m'malo mwa unyolo ngati zilolezo
gravitixDocs.bp5: Gwiritsani ntchito kubwerera mwamsanga kuti muchepetse zisa
gravitixDocs.bp8: Gwiritsani ntchito state kuti mupewe spam
gravitixDocs.keepLearningDesc: Njira yabwino yophunzirira Gravitix ndikumanga. Yambani ndi echo bot yosavuta, kenaka yonjezerani dziko, kenaka yonjezerani maulendo. Lingaliro lililonse latsopano lomwe mumaphunzira limatsegula mwayi wochulukirapo.

builtins.p1: Gravitix imaphatikizapo laibulale yolemera kwambiri. Ntchito zonse zomangidwira zimapezeka nthawi zonse - palibe zolowa kunja zomwe zimafunikira.
builtins.p2: Imalembanso mawu olumikizirana ndi njira zoyitanira kuwonjezera pa ntchito zoyimirira:
builtins.p3: Werengani mfundo zochokera m'malo a OS — zothandiza zinsinsi monga API makiyi:
builtins.p4: Osalemba API makiyi kapena ma tokeni mwachindunji mufayilo yanu .grav. Gwiritsani ntchito env("KEY_NAME") ndikukhazikitsa zosinthika m'malo omwe mumatumizira.
builtins.p5: Ntchito izi zimasindikizidwa ku seva ya seva - yosawoneka kwa ogwiritsa ntchito, yothandiza pakukula:
builtins.td29: Sinthani kukhala chiwerengero chokwanira (mafupipafupi float, magawo str)
builtins.td33: Nambala yamtundu wokhala ndi zolekanitsa zikwi (1000 → "1,000")

error.p1: Manga khodi iliyonse yomwe ingalephereke mu block try. Ngati cholakwika ndi thrown - mwina ndi Gravitix nthawi yothamanga kapena momveka bwino ndi code yanu - kudumphira mpaka pa catch block. Mtengo womwe wagwidwa umagwirizana ndi zomwe mwatchula catch.
error.p2: finally imayenda mopanda malire - kaya try yapambana kapena catch yathetsa vuto. Gwiritsani ntchito kumasula zothandizira, kulemba, kapena kutumiza uthenga womaliza.
error.p3: Gwiritsani ntchito kuwongolera zolakwika pamachitidwe omwe amadalira kulowetsa kwakunja: kuyika mawu a ogwiritsa ntchito, kuyimba ma API, zosintha zamalo owerengera, kapena kupanga masamu ovuta pomwe zolakwika za domain (sqrt of negative, log of zero) ndizotheka. Pazolakwa zamalingaliro amkati, sankhani guard ndime zoyambira returns.

intro.p1: Gravitix ndi chilankhulo chodziwika ndi domain (DSL) chopangidwa kuchokera pansi mpaka pansi kuti chilembedwe Vortex bots. Kumene zilankhulo zina zimafuna malaibulale, ma callbacks, ndi boilerplate, Gravitix zimakupatsirani zowongolera zochitika zapamwamba, zokambirana flows, ndi zomangidwa state — zonse mu mawu oyera, owerengeka owuziridwa ndi Rust.
intro.p2: Gravitix ndi ya aliyense amene akufuna kupanga Vortex bot mwachangu - kaya simunalembepo, kapena ndinu katswiri wodziwa ntchito yemwe watopa ndi Python boilerplate. Bukuli limaphunzitsa Gravitix kuchokera ku mfundo zoyamba: palibe zomwe zidachitika kale.
intro.p3: Gawo lirilonse limamanga pa zam'mbuyo. Ngati ndinu watsopano ku mapulogalamu, werengani kuchokera pamwamba mpaka pansi. Ngati mumadziwa kale chinenero china, gwiritsani ntchito mndandanda wa zomwe zili mkati kuti mudumphire pazomwe zimakukondani.
intro.p4: Munthawi yonseyi, → amatanthauza "kuyesa ku" kapena "kupanga", ndipo // ... akutanthauza ndemanga zomwe sizimanyalanyazidwa ndi wolemba.

math_special.p1: Ntchito ya Gamma Γ(n) ndikuphatikiza kosalekeza kwa factorial: Γ(n) = (n−1)! kwa manambala abwino. Imafikira manambala enieni komanso ovuta.
math_special.p2: Vuto la zolakwika erf(x) = (2/√π)∫₀ˣ e^(−t²)dt ndi gawo la Gaussian. Imakhudzana mwachindunji ndi CDF yodziwika bwino ndipo imawoneka m'magawo a kutentha ndi chiphunzitso cha kuthekera.
math_special.p3: ζ(s) = Σ 1/nˢ kwa n=1,2,3,… (pamene Re(zi)>1). Imalumikizana ndi kugawa koyambirira kudzera pamtundu wa Euler. Lingaliro la Riemann Hypothesis (losanathe!) limakhudza ziro za ζ mu ndege yovuta.
math_special.p4: Ntchito za Bessel Jₙ(x) ndi Yₙ(x) ndi njira zothetsera kusiyana kwa equation ya Bessel: x²y'' + xy' + (x²−n²)y = 0. Amawoneka pofalitsa mafunde, kutentha kwa masilinda, ndi quantum mechanics.
math_special.p5: Ai(x) ndi Bi(x) ndi njira zothetsera y'' = xy. Amawoneka mu quantum tunneling (WKB pafupifupi) ndi optics (diffraction).
math_special.p6: Mabanja a polynomial awa amakhala ngati eigenfunctions of opareshoni ofunikira ndipo amagwiritsidwa ntchito munjira zowonera, quadrature, ndi quantum mechanics.
math_special.p7: K(k) ndi E(k) ndi zophatikizika zamtundu woyamba ndi wachiwiri. Amawerengera nthawi ya pendulum yopanda mzere komanso kuzungulira kwa ellipse.
math_special.td5: Pₙ(x): orthogonal pa [-1,1]. Angular gawo la hydrogen wavefunctions.
math_special.td6: Hₙ(x): orthogonal w.r.t. e^(−x²). Quantum harmonic oscillator.
math_special.td8: Lₙ(x): orthogonal pa [0,∞) w.r.t. ndi^(−x). Hydrogen radial wavefunctions.

types.p1: Nambala yosainidwa ya 64-bit. Imathandizira kuyambira pafupifupi −9.2 × 10¹⁸ mpaka +9.2 × 10¹⁸.
types.p10: Mfundo zina sizingakhalepo. Malo osasankha mu ctx (monga ctx.username) akhoza kukhala null. Yang'anani nthawi zonse musanagwiritse ntchito:
types.p11: Powonjezera ? pambuyo pa mtundu walemba kuti optional - mtengo ukhoza kukhala null. Umu ndi momwe magawo amagwirira ntchito ndi state minda imafotokozera "izi zitha kukhalapo kapena sizingakhalepo":
types.p12: Ngati mtengo sungakhalepo nthawi zonse, fotokozerani T? ndipo nthawi zonse fufuzani != null musanagwiritse ntchito. Kupeza gawo la null sikugwetsa bot - returns null mwakachetechete.
types.p3: 10 / 3 yokhala ndi int mikhalidwe iwiri imapereka 3 (yodulidwa). Gwiritsani ntchito 10.0 / 3.0 pazotsatira za decimal.
types.p4: Ili ndi zikhalidwe ziwiri ndendende: true ndi false.
types.p5: Chingwe cholemba cha Unicode. Zingwe ndi zikhalidwe zosasinthika.
types.p6: Mndandanda wamtengo wapatali, zonse zamtundu womwewo T.
types.p7: Kupeza mlozera wakutali (mwachitsanzo, nums[99] pomwe mndandanda uli ndi zinthu 5) returns null m'malo mowononga bot yanu.
types.p8: Kutolere kwa magulu awiri amtengo wapatali. Makiyi onse akhale amtundu wofanana, zikhalidwe zonse zikhale zamtundu womwewo.
types.p9: Mtundu wa return wa magwiridwe antchito omwe alibe return mtengo. Nthawi zambiri simumalemba void mosapita m'mbali - ndiyosakhazikika pomwe palibe mtundu wa return watchulidwa.

architexDocs.title: Chilankhulo cha Architex
architexDocs.subtitle: Chilankhulo cholengeza UI cha Vortex Mini Apps. Mawonekedwe okhazikika, masanjidwe ophatikizika, sitepe yomanga zero.
architexDocs.introDesc: Architex ndi chilengezo chaching'ono DSL chopangidwira kutumiza UI mkati mwa Vortex messenger. Mumalongosola momwe chophimbacho chiyenera kuonekera; nthawi yothamanga imasunga ma pixel kuti agwirizane ndi boma zokha. Palibe zenizeni DOM, palibe bundler, ayi JSX - fayilo ya `.arx` ndiyo pulogalamu.
architexDocs.goalDeclarative: Kulengeza - mumalemba UI yomwe mukufuna, osati njira zopangira
architexDocs.goalReactive: Reactive — `~ count += 1` ndipo chizindikiro chilichonse chomwe chimachiwerenga chimasinthidwa m'malo mwake
architexDocs.goalPortable: Yonyamulika — `.arx` yomweyo imagwira ntchito pa intaneti, iOS, ndi Android popanda zosintha
architexDocs.goalTiny: Sitima yaying'ono - yopalasa + yochepera 30 KB, kotero Mini App imatsegulidwa nthawi yomweyo
architexDocs.goalReadable: Zowerengeka - indentation ndi kapangidwe; zosintha zimamangidwa ndi `::`; palibe msonkho wa zopumira
architexDocs.whoDesc: Aliyense amene akufuna kutumiza sikirini yolumikizana mu Vortex — mafomu a kasitomala, ma dashboards, masamba ovota, Telegram-style Mini Apps. Ngati mudalembapo HTML+CSS+JS, Architex azimva kuti ndizodziwika koma mwachangu kulemba. Ngati simunatero, Architex ndiwoyambitsanso pulogalamu yokhazikika chifukwa chilankhulocho chimapangitsa kuti pang'ono pang'onopang'ono.
architexDocs.howToReadDesc: Gawo lirilonse limamanga pa lomwe lidalipo kale. Yambani pa Quick Start, kenako werengani Syntax, State, Layout, Modifiers, Actions, ndi gawo lapamwamba lomaliza. Lumphani kuzungulira zomwe zili mkati ngati mukudziwa kale React kapena Svelte - malingaliro amapu bwino.
architexDocs.quickStartDesc: Njira yayifupi kwambiri kuchokera pafayilo yopanda kanthu kupita pakuyenda Mini App.
architexDocs.firstScreenExample:
@screen Hello

  ~name = "dziko"

  col :: pad(24) gap(12) center

    mutu "Moni, {~name}!" :: kukula kwakukulu (28)

    input ~name :: pad(8) radius(6) malire(#ccc)

    lemba "Lembani dzina pamwambapa - mawuwa akusintha pamene mukulemba."
      :: kukula(12) mtundu(#888)
architexDocs.whatHappenedDesc: `@screen Hello` amalengeza muzu. `~name = "dziko"` imapanga kusintha kosinthika. `col`, `header`, `input`, `text` ndi zigawo zomangidwira. `::` amamata zosintha (zopalasa, mitundu, kukula). Wogwiritsa ntchito akalowetsa zolowetsa, `{~name}` zosintha zilizonse - palibe waya, osalembetsa, osapereka pamanja.
architexDocs.runningItDesc: Tsegulani tabu ya Architex mu situdiyo ya Vortex bot, matani kachidindo, dinani Run. Nthawi yogwiritsira ntchito imawonekera pagawo lowoneratu ndikuwonjezeranso zotentha pakusunga. Mukasindikiza, ogwiritsa ntchito amatsegula pulogalamuyi kuchokera pamacheza aliwonse - osayika.
architexDocs.syntaxDesc: Pulogalamu iliyonse ya Architex imapangidwa ndi zinthu zinayi: zilengezo zomwe zimayamba ndi `@`, zosinthika zosinthika zokhala ndi `~`, zida zolembedwa ngati zozindikiritsa, ndi zosintha zomwe zimayikidwa pambuyo pa `::`.
architexDocs.anatomyDeclDesc: `@screen Name`, `@theme`, `@import "./lib.arx"`, ndi `@for item in ~list` zonse zimayambira mgawo 0. Chilichonse chomwe chili pansi pake ndi cha block imeneyo.
architexDocs.anatomyCompDesc: Zigawo zimakhala pamzere wawo: `zolemba`, `batani`, `chithunzi`, `mutu`, `lebulo`, `baji`, `divider`, `col`, `row`. Mtsutso wawo umabwera pambuyo pa dzina: `mawu ~message`, `batani "Sungani"`, `chithunzi "/logo.png"`.
architexDocs.anatomyModifierDesc: Pambuyo `::` mutha kusuntha zosintha zambiri momwe mukufunira. Iliyonse imatenga ziro kapena zotsutsana zambiri m'makolo: `:: pad(24) gap(16) center bold size(20) color(#4f8ef7)`. Zosintha ndizokhazikika, osati mawu osafunikira - dongosolo lilibe kanthu kupatula olemba omaliza omwe apambana ngati `color`.
architexDocs.anatomyActionDesc: `=>` pa batani (kapena chigawo chilichonse) imayendetsa ntchito kapena kuyimba komwe kumatsatira. Angapo `=>` unyolo mbali ndi mbali: `batani "Submit" => ~busy = zoona => kutumiza(zochita: "sunga", data: ~form)`.
architexDocs.reactiveVarsDesc: Dzina lililonse lolembedwa ndi `~` ndi selo yogwira ntchito. Lembani `~ count = 0` kulengeza, `~ count = 5` kuti mugawirenso, `~ count += 1` kuti musinthe. Nodi iliyonse ya UI yomwe imawerenga selo - mwachindunji kapena kudzera mu kumasulira - imapanganso selo likasintha.
architexDocs.computedVarsDesc: Gwiritsani ntchito `:=` m'malo mwa `=` kulengeza mawu owerengeka: `~ total := ~ count * ~step`. Mbali yakumanja imawunikanso nthawi iliyonse kudalira kulikonse kukusintha. Palibe kulembetsa pamanja ndipo palibe cholakwika chamtengo wapatali - ngati muwerenga `~a` penapake m'mawuwo, mumangodalira.
architexDocs.typeAnnotationsDesc: Mawu ofotokozera ndi osankha koma amathandiza pomaliza ndi mauthenga olakwika: `~ count: number = 0`, `~name: string = ""`, `~ok: boolean = false`, `~items: array = []`, `~user: object = {}`. Ngati muwadumpha mtunduwo umatengedwa kuchokera kwa woyambitsa.
architexDocs.supportedTypesList: `nambala`, `chingwe`, `boolean`, `array`, `object`, `null`. Madeti ndi mabulogu amadutsidwa ngati zingwe ndi zinthu motsatana. Nthawi yothamanga imagwiritsa ntchito malamulo okakamiza a JavaScript pansi pa hood, kotero `~ count + 1` imagwira ntchito ngakhale `~ count` inayamba moyo ngati chingwe.
architexDocs.stringInterpolationDesc: Chingwe chilichonse chikhoza kuyika mawu ndi `{...}`: `"Moni, {~user.name}!"`, `"Total: {~count * ~price}"`. Kutanthauzira kumakhala kokhazikika nthawi zonse.
architexDocs.layoutDesc: Architex ili ndi zotengera ziwiri zophatikizika ndi zigawo khumi ndi ziwiri zamasamba. Ikani zisa ndi indentation - palibe ma tag otseka.
architexDocs.containersDesc: `col` amaunjika ana molunjika, `mzere` chopingasa. Onse amavomereza `gap(n)`, `pad(n)`, `center`, `kukula`, ndi chosinthira m'lifupi/kutalika. Amalozerani ana mulingo umodzi wozama mpaka pachisa.
architexDocs.containerExample:
mzere :: gap(8) pad(16) pakati
  chithunzi "/avatar.png" :: w(40) h(40) radius(20)
  Col :: kukula gap(2)
    text ~name :: molimba mtima
    zolemba ~bio :: kukula(12) mtundu(#888)
architexDocs.leafComponentsList: `cholemba` - buku lililonse. `mutu` - mwamaganizidwe ndi mutu. `lebulo` - mawu ofotokozera ang'onoang'ono. `batani` - kutha kuwongolera. `zolowetsa` - gawo la mawu lomwe limamangidwa ku var reactive. `chithunzi` - chithunzi chochokera ku URL. `baji` - chizindikiro chooneka ngati piritsi. `wogawanitsa` - mzere woonda wolekanitsa. 'chofufumitsa' - snackbar ephemeral. `ma tabu` / `tabu` - tabu switcher.
architexDocs.componentTextDesc: ``mawu akuti "Moni"` amatanthauza chingwe chokhazikika. `text ~message` imapangitsa kuti ikhale yotakataka. Phatikizani ndi kumasulira: `malemba "Total: {~ count}"`.
architexDocs.componentHeaderDesc: Mutu wamutu. Zosasintha kukhala zazikulu, zolimba kuposa `mawu`. Mtsutso wapamalo womwewo: `mutu "Zokonda"`. Miyezo ya kukula yokhala ndi skrini - pitilirani ndi `size(n)`.
architexDocs.componentButtonDesc: Chinthu chokhoza kuponyedwa. Chingwe chokhazikika ndi chizindikiro; `=>` zochita zimayenda pa mpopi. `batani "Sungani" => ~draft = null`. Zoyaka zambiri `=>` mu dongosolo.
architexDocs.componentInputDesc: Gawo la mawu anjira ziwiri. Kusintha kosinthika pambuyo pa dzina lomwe lili ndi mtengo wapano: `zolowetsa ~imelo`. Zosintha: `chosungira ("…")`, `debounce(300)` pazosintha zosinthidwa.
architexDocs.componentImageDesc: Zonyamula kuchokera panjira HTTPS URL kapena `/zokweza/...`. Zosintha `w(px)`, `h(px)`, `radius(px)` chepetsa bokosilo. Imagweranso ku silhouette yokhala ndi malo ngati URL 404s.
architexDocs.componentDividerDesc: Cholekanitsa tsitsi, 1px, chimalemekeza mtundu wamutu womwe ulipo. Palibe zotsutsana.
architexDocs.componentBadgeDesc: Piritsi lomwe limakumbatira zomwe zilimo: `baji ~ count`, `baji "yatsopano"`. Gwiritsani ntchito zowerengera zosawerengeka ndi tchipisi ta tag.
architexDocs.componentLabelDesc: Mawu ofotokozera/wothandizira — ochepetsedwa. Gozabwino kwa mayina amitundu.
architexDocs.componentToastDesc: Chidziwitso chosatsekereza. `chotupitsa ~ chowoneka "Wopulumutsidwa!" :: nthawi(2000)` ziwonetsero kwa 2 s nthawi iliyonse `~zowoneka` ndi zoona, ndiyeno kudziletsa. Palibe ma modal stacking, palibe z-index nkhondo.
architexDocs.componentTabsDesc: Chidebe chomangika ku chingwe choyambiranso: `tabs ~activeTab`. Mkati mwake, tabu iliyonse ya "Lembani" "kiyi"` imalengeza tabu imodzi; thupi lomwe lili pansi likuwonetsedwa pamene kiyi ikufanana.
architexDocs.modifiersDesc: Zosintha ndiye njira yokhayo yosinthira chigawocho. Alowetseni pambuyo pa `::`. Amabwera m'mabanja asanu: kagawo, kukula, mtundu, typography, ndi machitidwe.
architexDocs.modSpacingDesc: `pad(n)` - kuponda mbali zonse. `padi(x, y)` - yopingasa + yopingasa. `padi(pamwamba, kumanja, pansi, kumanzere)` — CSS-kukonza. `gap(n)` - danga pakati pa ana a `col` / `row`. `margin(n)` - kusiyana pakati pa abale.
architexDocs.modSizingDesc: `w(px)` - m'lifupi mwake. `h(px)` - kutalika kokhazikika. `kukula` — lembani malo otsala mumzere/col. `pakati` - pakati pa mtanda olamulira; mu `col` imakhazikika mopingasa, mu 'mzere' imakhazikika molunjika.
architexDocs.modColourDesc: `color(#rrggbb)` - kutsogolo. `bg(#rrggbb)` - maziko. Onse awiri amavomereza zizindikiro zamutu: `mtundu (~ choyambirira)` amawerengedwa kuchokera pa block ya `@theme`. Opacity imadutsa mu hex ya manambala 8: `#00000080` ndi 50 % yakuda.
architexDocs.modTypographyDesc: `kukula(px)` - kukula kwa mawonekedwe. `bold` / `italic` - kulemera ndi kalembedwe. `kulunzanitsa(kumanzere|pakati|kumanja)` - kusanja mawu.
architexDocs.modVisibilityDesc: `chobisika(~ mbendera)` - amatsitsa mfundo pamene mbendera ili yowona. `zowoneka (~ mbendera)` - chosiyana. Ma node osakwera amakhetsa DOM, kotero zokhazikika UI ndizotsika mtengo.
architexDocs.modBehaviourDesc: `debounce(ms)` pa `input` throttles zosintha. `chosungira ("…")` akuwonetsa chingwe chowunikira. `mawonekedwe(mtundu, arg)` pa `mawu` akupanga nambala: `mawonekedwe("ndalama", "USD")`, `mawonekedwe("peresenti")`, `mtundu("compact")`.
architexDocs.modRadiusDesc: `radius(px)` makona ozungulira. `malire(#rrggbb)` amajambula 1 px sitiroko. `malire(px, #rrggbb)` imayikanso makulidwe.
architexDocs.actionsDesc: Zochita zimasintha dziko kapena kuyankhula ndi anthu akunja. Amathamanga molumikizana ndi tap/keypress chogwirizira.
architexDocs.actionAssignDesc: `=> ~ count = 0`, `=> ~ busy = zoona`, `=> ~list = []`. Zosintha zilizonse zosinthika zimatha kulembedwa.
architexDocs.actionIncDecDesc: `+= n`, `-= n`, `*= n`, `/= n`. `=> ~ count += 1` ndi mawu ophiphiritsa a zowerengera.
architexDocs.actionMultipleDesc: Angapo `=>` pamzere womwewo moto kuchokera pamwamba mpaka pansi mu tiki yomweyi, kotero UI imasintha kamodzi kumapeto: `batani "Buy" => ~busy =zoona => kutumiza(kuchita: "kugula") => ~busy = zabodza`. Pa ntchito ya async, sankhani `@reaction` yowerengedwa.
architexDocs.actionSendDesc: `send(action: "name", ...args)` ndiye mlatho wobwerera ku bot. Wothandizira (Vortex nthawi yothamanga) amalandila ngati uthenga JSON RPC ndipo akhoza kuyimbira nambala ya bot yanu. Igwiritseni ntchito polowera, API zotengera, zolipira - chilichonse chomwe DSL sichingathe kufotokoza.
architexDocs.actionNavigateDesc: `goto("ScreenName", arg: value, ...)` imakankhira `@screen` ina pa stack; `kumbuyo()` pops. Nthawi yothamanga imayenda mokhazikika.
architexDocs.actionHostBuiltinsDesc: `copy(~text)`, `share(~text)`, `haptic("light" | "medium" | "heavy")`, `vibrate(ms)`, `alert("…")`, `confirm("…") => ~ok = it` — chidule cha `it` ndi mtengo wobwereza wa mawu oyamba.
architexDocs.themeDesc: Lengezani phale kamodzi, gwiritsani ntchito paliponse. Zizindikiro zimakhala zosinthika nthawi zonse kotero kuti pulogalamu yanu imatha kutumiza zosinthira zamdima m'mizere itatu.
architexDocs.importsDesc: `@import "./shared/ui.arx"` imakoka `@component` ndi `@screen` kuchokera pafayiloyo kupita komwe kuli pano. Njira zimagwirizana ndi fayilo yotumiza kunja; zozungulira zotuluka kunja zimazindikiridwa ndikufotokozedwa munthawi yake.
architexDocs.componentsDesc: Tanthauzirani kamodzi, gwiritsani ntchito nthawi zambiri: `@component Ulalo wa avatar\n ulalo wa chithunzi :: w(size) h(size) radius(size / 2)`. M'kati mwa chigawocho magawo omwe atchulidwa ali pagulu ngati zizindikiritso zomveka (popanda `~`).
architexDocs.forLoopsDesc: `@for item in ~list` imapangitsa mzere umodzi pachinthu chilichonse. `@for item, idx in ~list` imamanganso ziro-based index. Nthawi yothamanga imatsata chizindikiritso kudzera pa chinthucho chokha, kotero kuwonjezera zinthu pamwamba pa mndandanda wa mizere 10 000 kumawononga O(1) DOM ntchito.
architexDocs.forExample:
@chinthu, idx mu ~items
  mzere :: gap(8) pad(4)
    baji ~idx
    text ~chinthu :: kukula
architexDocs.ternaryDesc: `kondi? a : b` imagwira ntchito paliponse pomwe mawu amavomerezedwa. Nest for enums: `~status >= 10 ? "mkulu" : ~status >= 5 ? "mid" : "low"`.
architexDocs.slotsDesc: M'kati mwachidziwitso, `slot` imayika pomwe thupi la woyimbayo likulowa. Ganizirani izi ngati React children / Vue default slot.
architexDocs.reactivityDesc: Iliyonse `~ var` ndi chizindikiro. Mukawerenga mkati mwa computed, modifier mkangano, kapena interpolation, nthawi yothamanga imalemba zomwe zawerengedwa mu graph yodalira. Mukalemba, mfundo iliyonse yomwe imawerenga imawunikidwanso - kamodzi, kumapeto kwa microtask yomwe ilipo.
architexDocs.reactivityBatchingDesc: Zolemba zambiri mu chogwirizira chimodzi zimaphatikizidwa. `=> ~a = 1 => ~b = 2` imayambitsa chiphaso chimodzi.
architexDocs.reactivityEqualityDesc: Mwachikhazikitso nthawi yothamanga imagwiritsa ntchito kufanana kokhazikika (`===`). Kulemba mtengo womwewo sikumayendetsanso kanthu. Pangani chinthu chatsopano / gulu kuti mukakamize kusintha; kusasinthika kumalimbikitsidwa koma osafunikira.
architexDocs.examplesDesc: Mapulogalamu anayi ovomerezeka, chilichonse chili ndi mizere yochepera 40. Lembani aliyense wa iwo mu Architex tabu ndikusindikiza Thamangani.
architexDocs.exampleCounter: Counter - state reactive, computed, mabatani, kumanga mawu.
architexDocs.exampleTodo: Todo - mndandanda wakupereka, onjezani / chotsani, kusintha kwapaintaneti.
architexDocs.exampleProfile: Mbiri - chithunzi, mabaji, mawonekedwe okhazikika, kuyenda.
architexDocs.exampleKiller: Zopha - mitu, zolowa kunja, ma tabo, toast, manambala ojambulidwa, ma ternaries, ma vars otayidwa.
architexDocs.errUnknownName: `dzina losadziwika ~foo` - mudagwiritsa ntchito mawu osinthika musanalengeze. Onjezani `~ foo = ...` pamwamba pa chotsekera `@screen`.
architexDocs.errIndent: `kulowa mosayembekezeka` — ana ayenera kuzama mulingo umodzi kuposa kholo lawo. Architex amagwiritsa ndendende mipata iwiri pa mlingo; ma tabo amakanidwa kuti apewe nsikidzi zosawoneka-zoyera.
architexDocs.errModifier: `zosintha zosadziwika` - mudalemba `:: shadow` koma nthawi yothamanga siyigwirizana nazo. Onani mndandanda wa zosintha pamwambapa; Architex ndiyokhazikika pamazina osadziwika kuti ateteze kuyenderana patsogolo.
architexDocs.errType: `mtundu wosagwirizana` - mwachitsanzo. mwadutsa chingwe pomwe nambala ikuyembekezeka. Tchulani zosinthika zosinthika (`~ count: number`) ndipo wofotokozerayo adzakuuzani komwe mtengowo umachokera.
architexDocs.errDebug: Kuti muthetse vuto pa nthawi yothamanga, kulungani mawu omwe akukayikira kuti `debug(...)` - nthawi yothamanga imalowetsa kuwunika kulikonse ku console popanda kukhudza mtengo wake.
architexDocs.compatWeb: Webusaiti - imapanga vanila DOM yokhala ndi CSS zosinthika zama tokeni amutu. Palibe React / Vue / Svelte kudalira.
architexDocs.compatIOS: iOS - yemweyo `.arx` amagawidwa ndikuperekedwa ku SwiftUI mawonedwe kudzera pa Vortex iOS host host. Chilichonse chosintha chimayika masitayilo a SwiftUI.
architexDocs.compatAndroid: Android - wolandirayo amaperekedwa ku Jetpack Compose. Zosintha za manja (`:: onTap`, `:: onLongPress`) amamasulira kuti Compose ofanana.
architexDocs.compatVersions: Ndondomeko ya mtundu - Architex imatsimikizira kuti mafayilo a `.arx` azitha kugwira ntchito m'mafayilo ang'onoang'ono. Fayilo ya `.arx` yolembedwa motsutsana ndi 0.1 ikugwirabe ntchito pa 0.9.
architexDocs.nextStepsDesc: Werengani buku lophikira la mapulaneti (mndandanda wopandamalire, mafomu, malipiro), kalozera wa zida za pulogalamu yowonjezera ya CLI ndi VS, ndi kalozera wothandizira ngati mukufuna kuwonjezera zina zomangidwira. Gwero lonse lili pa github.com/vortex/Architex.

architecture.title: Zomangamanga mwachidule
architecture.subtitle: Njira zitatu - kasitomala, node, controller - ndi protocol imodzi yomwe imawamanga.
architecture.intro: Vortex ndi mesenjala wokhazikika. M'malo mwa njira imodzi yakumbuyo yomwe ili ndi kampani imodzi, imagwirizanitsa mauna otseguka a ** node **, opezeka ndikutsimikiziridwa ndi **wowongolera ** omwe amasindikiza chizindikiro chosainidwa cha nambala yomwe yatsimikizira. **Makasitomala ** gwiritsani makiyi achinsinsi ndikupereka UI. Mutu wonsewu ukuyenda njira zitatu, malire awo, ndi deta yomwe imayenda pakati pawo.
architecture.h1p1: Amithenga apakati ndi mfundo imodzi yokakamiza. Chigamulo cha khothi, kutsekedwa kwa opereka mtambo, kapena kupeza zinthu mwankhanza zonse zimamasulira kuti "ogwiritsa ntchito ataya mwayi". Vortex imasiyanitsidwa ndi kulola aliyense kuyendetsa njira ndikulola makasitomala kuyenda pakati pa ma node osalembetsanso.
architecture.h1p2: Kugawikana kwa mayiko kuyenera kusunga chinsinsi komanso kukhulupirika. Chigwirizano cha ma seva osadalirika chimagwira ntchito pokhapokha ngati ma seva sangathe kuwerenga mawu osamveka komanso sangathe kupanga mauthenga. Vortex imakakamiza onse kudzera pakubisa-kumapeto ndi umboni wa Ed25519 pa uthenga uliwonse wodutsa.
architecture.h1p3: Wowongolera ndiye chidutswa chimodzi chapakati, koma ndi chaching'ono. Amangosindikiza `INTEGRITY.sig.json` ndi mndandanda wa malo odalirika olowa. Aliyense akhoza kudzipangira yekha galasi, kotero kuti ngakhale wolamulirayo si vuto limodzi chabe - gwero limodzi lachowonadi la "zomwe pubkey imasainira kumasulidwa".
architecture.h1l1: Palibe kutsekera kwa ogulitsa: makasitomala amatha kusamutsa zomwe ali pakati pa node nthawi iliyonse posayina X25519 pubkey ndi JWT yatsopano.
architecture.h1l2: Palibe kulumikizana kwakunja: node imodzi ikatsikira, ogwiritsa ntchito pamfundo zina samazindikira.
architecture.h1l3: Palibe ulamuliro umodzi: ogwira ntchito amasankha nyumba yawo yovomerezeka, ndipo ogwiritsa ntchito amasankha wowagwiritsa ntchito.
architecture.h1l4: Palibe UI: iOS, Android, intaneti ndi anzawo apamwamba - palibe nsanja yomwe imakhala yopyapyala kuposa ina.
architecture.h2p1: Makasitomala amayendetsa pa chipangizo cha wosuta. Awo ndi malo okhawo mauthenga osamveka bwino, makiyi achinsinsi, ndi mafayilo-omveka bwino. Node samawawona konse.
architecture.h2p2: Pulatifomu iliyonse yothandizira imagwiritsa ntchito ma waya omwewo (HTTPS + WebSocket + WebRTC). SOLID-split part modules (`maprotocol a`api/`, `impl/` code, `ui/` view) sungani kontrakitiyo kukhala yolimba komanso khodi yapapulatifomu kuti ikhale yodziwika bwino.
architecture.h2p3: Kusungirako pazida: Keychain / EncryptedSharedPreferences / HttpOnly cookie ya zizindikiro; SQLite (GRDB pa iOS, Room on Android, IndexedDB wrapper pa intaneti) pa cached ciphertext + the FTS index.
architecture.h2l1: iOS - Phukusi la Swift lomwe lili ndi ma module a 30+. Min deployment chandamale iOS 17.
architecture.h2l2: Android - Kotlin + Compose + Hilt. minSdk 26, targetSdk 34.
architecture.h2l3: Webusaiti - vanila JS PWA, wogwira ntchito, palibe sitepe yomanga yopitilira ES kumanga ma module.
architecture.h2l4: Desktop - Chovala cha Tauri kuzungulira kasitomala wapaintaneti; mtolo womwewo, mbadwa ya Chrome renderer.
architecture.h3p1: Node ndi njira ya Python (`python -m app.main`, kapena `run.py`) yomvera pa 9000 mwachisawawa. Imalimbikira zolemba, mafani akutulutsa zochitika za WebSocket, imakhala ndi zidziwitso TURN, ndi mgwirizano wa broker ndi ma node ena.
architecture.h3p2: Node wosanjikiza ndi woonda dala. Imawonetsa njira pafupifupi 120 kudutsa mumtengo wa `/api/*` kuphatikiza `/ws` pakutulutsa zenizeni zenizeni. Kukweza kolemetsa (crypto, kupezeka, kukonza) kumasinthidwa kukhala `app/chitetezo/`, `app/transport/`, `app/peer/`.
architecture.h3p3: Node imodzi mumayendedwe okhazikika a SQLite imagwira ~ 50 ogwiritsa ntchito nthawi imodzi bwino pa M1. Ndi ma Postgres ndi Redis athandizidwa, ma code omwewo amakula mozungulira - node iliyonse imakhala yosawerengeka kuposa DB ndi fan-out.
architecture.h3l1: Malo olowera: `/api/*` HTTPS, `/ws` WebSocket, `/v1/integrity` ndi `/health` kwa moyo.
architecture.h3l2: Zodalira: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.x, uvicorn, cryptography (OpenSSL), pqcrypto (liboqs), python-multipart, Pillow, Rust extension `vortex_chat` kwa crypto-path crypto.
architecture.h3l3: Mwachidziwitso: Redis (kukhalapo kwa fan-out muma node angapo), Postgres (kupanga DB), coturn (TURN relay), motsogola (kutumiza kwa chipika).
architecture.h3l4: Kukula kwa binary: ~60 MB Python deps + ~10 MB Rust kukulitsa. Chithunzi cha Docker pafupifupi 400 MB chisanachitike sikwashi.
architecture.h4p1: Wowongolera ndi njira ina ya Python (`vortex_controller`) yokhala ndi cholinga chocheperako: kusindikiza ndi kutsimikizira `INTEGRITY.sig.json`, tulutsani ma URL olowa, ndikutsata thanzi la anzanu omwe achita nawo mgwirizano.
architecture.h4p2: Poyambitsa wowongolera amayenda pamtengo woyambira, amathamangitsa fayilo iliyonse, ndikufanizira motsutsana ndi chiwonetserocho. Ngati hashi iliyonse ikusokonekera wowongolera amakana kuyambitsa. Izi zikutanthauza kuti fayilo yosinthidwa pa disk silingagwire `status:"zotsimikizika"`.
architecture.h4p3: Makasitomala adagunda `/v1/integrity` asanakhulupirire mfundo. Ngati awona `status != "zotsimikizika"` amakana kupereka ziphaso, nthawi. Ndiye nangula wa trust.
architecture.h4l1: Kusaina ndi `makiyi/release.key` (Ed25519). Hafu yapagulu yophikidwa muzotulutsa zamakasitomala.
architecture.h4l2: Zolemba zowonetsera: `{path, sha256, size}` pafayilo iliyonse yomwe sinanyalanyazidwe.
architecture.h4l3: Manganinso: `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_tool`. Zotulutsa `INTEGRITY.sig.json` mu repo mizu.
architecture.h4l4: Kuzungulira: Othandizira akufota Vortex m'malo mwa `release.key`. Makasitomala opangidwa ndi pubkey yawo ndiye amadalira folokoyo.
architecture.h5p1: Yendani pazomwe zimachitika Alice akatumiza "hi" kwa Bob:
architecture.h5p2: 1. Makasitomala amayang'ana chinsinsi chazipinda mu sitolo yake yapafupi. Ngati palibe, imatenga envelopu yatsopano kuchokera ku `/api/rooms/{id}/keys` ya kiyi yakeyake. Ma DM oyamba amayendetsa Diffie-Hellman wozungulira kamodzi pa makiyi.
architecture.h5p3: 2. Makasitomala amakonza zolipirira monga CBOR `{v:1, mawu akuti:"hi", reply_to:null, sent_at:...}`, amapanga 96-bit nonce, zosindikiza ndi AES-256-GCM, ndi POSTs `/api/rooms/{id}/messages` with `{hexdo: nonder_text hex}`.
architecture.h5p4: 3. Node imasunga mzerewo ndipo mafani atulutsa `{type:"m", room:..., msg:{id, ct, nonce, sender_pseudo, sent_at}}` kwa aliyense wolumikizidwa WebSocket wolembetsa kuchipinda.
architecture.h5p5: 4. kasitomala wa Bob amalandira chimango, decrypts ndi muzu fungulo yomweyo, kutsimikizira wotumiza pseudo akufanana membala woyembekezeka, ndi kutulutsa thovu.
architecture.h5p6: 5. Makasitomala a Bob amaika `POST /api/rooms/{id}/read` ndi id yomaliza yomwe wawerenga. Izi zimabweretsa `{mtundu:"r"}` kuwulutsa kotero kuti kuwira kwa Alice kumawonetsa tiki.
architecture.h6p1: CBOR (RFC 8949) ndiyokhazikika, yaposachedwa, komanso yachangu pakubisa. Poyerekeza ndi JSON imadula kuchuluka kwa malipiro ndi ~ 30 % pamacheza amtundu uliwonse ndikuchotsa kusamveka bwino kwapang'onopang'ono.
architecture.h6p2: Poyerekeza ndi Protobuf sizifuna jenereta ya schema ndipo sizimayimitsa manambala am'munda. Izi ndizofunikira chifukwa Vortex imasinthika — tawonjezera `thread_id`, `reply_to`, `reactions_count`, `kind` pa zotulutsidwa popanda kuswa makasitomala akale.
architecture.h6p3: CBOR ndi zomwe Signal, Matrix, ndi NIP-29 amagwiritsa ntchito pazifukwa zofanana kwambiri. Kufananiza kusankha kwawo kumatanthauza kuti protocol yathu ndiyosavuta kuwunika ndi ofufuza zachitetezo omwe amadziwa kale encoding.
architecture.h7p1: Fungo lililonse limanyamula `v:<int>`. Mtundu wamakono ndi 1. Chimango chokhala ndi mtundu wosadziwika chimagwetsedwa; makasitomala alemba chenjezo ndikupitiriza ndi chimango chotsatira.
architecture.h7p2: Kugwirizana kwam'mbuyo kumatsimikizika pa chimango chilichonse chomwe chili ndi `v:1`. Kulumikizana kwapatsogolo ndikochita bwino kwambiri: minda yatsopano imawonjezeredwa kumapeto kwa lamulo, makasitomala akale amawanyalanyaza.
architecture.h7p3: Kusweka kolimba kumasungidwa pakusintha kofunikira pachitetezo (monga kusinthana HKDF zingwe). Zikatero mtunduwo umagunda ku 2 ndipo zenera lakusamuka limasindikizidwa.
architecture.h1_a: Netiweki ya Vortex imagawika m'njira zitatu. Iliyonse imadziyendetsa yokha, imalankhula ndi ena kudzera pama protocol odziwika bwino a waya, ndipo imatha kusinthidwa paokha. Palibe monolith - gawo lililonse limalumikiza gawo limodzi mwa magawo atatu.
architecture.h1_b: Makasitomala amakhala ndi makiyi ndikupereka UI. Node imapitilira mawu achinsinsi, mafani amatulutsa zochitika pa WebSocket, ndi ma broker WebRTC siginecha. Woyang'anira amasindikiza mawonekedwe osainidwa ndi ma URL olowera. Amalankhulana pa HTTPS + WebSocket pogwiritsa ntchito CBOR-zolipidwa zolembedwa mkati mwa AES-GCM maenvulopu.
architecture.h1_c: Kugawanikako kunayambika mu v0.0.3 pambuyo poti mtundu woyambirira wa monolith udakumana ndi mavuto awiri: umboni womasulidwa unkalumikizidwa ku node yothamanga (kotero kuti node yosokoneza imatha kunama za code yake), ndipo chitaganya sichinali kotheka chifukwa chigawo cha node ndi dziko lokhulupirira zimakhala m'magome omwewo. Kugawa umboni m'njira yakeyake kunapatsa aliyense wogwiritsa ntchito kiyi imodzi kuti apachike ndipo tilole kuti chitaganya chikhale chosagwirizana ndi N.
architecture.h2_a: Kugawanika kwa node/controller kumapatula chinthu chotetezedwa kwambiri (chiwonetsero chosainidwa) kuchokera pamalo owukira kwambiri (seva ya API).
architecture.h2_b: Wowongolera amasunga SQLite yaying'ono DB: ma pubkey odalirika, ma URL agalasi, ndi zambiri zaumoyo. Ikukana kuyamba ngati INTEGRITY.sig.json sikufanana ndi mtengo wapa disk — fayilo yosokonezedwa siitha kukhala ndi `status:"yotsimikizika"`. Node imayenda pa Postgres/SQLite yake ndipo sakhala ndi kiyi yotulutsa.
architecture.h2_c: Njirayi imachokera ku magawo a sitolo a Chrome (ma cert amakhala pa tsamba lomasulidwa la osatsegula, osati chiyambi cha intaneti) ndi Debian's Release.gpg (zowonetseratu zasaina, phukusi losasainidwa). Zavomerezedwa chifukwa mapangidwe onsewa adapulumuka zaka makumi ambiri akuwunikiridwa ndi adani.
architecture.h3_a: TLS 1.3 pa hop iliyonse, zolipira zosungidwa kumapeto mpaka kumapeto mkati. TLS imagwira zoyendera; AES-GCM imagwira zomwe zili.
architecture.h3_b: Pakati pa kasitomala ndi mfundo: HTTPS (`/api/*`) ndi WSS (`/ws`). Pakati pa ma node: HTTPS (`/federation/*`). Pakati pa node ndi controller: HTTPS (`/v1/*`). Zonse zimagwiritsa ntchito TLS 1.3 yokhala ndi zidindo za zala za Chrome 120 kukana DPI.
architecture.h3_c: Kumayambiriro Vortex adagwiritsa ntchito yaiwisi TCP ndi kugwirana chanza kwa phokoso-protocol. Anasinthira kukhala TLS 1.3 mu v0.0.4 atazindikira kuti ma protocol amawonetsa "zosangalatsa" kwa ongowonera chabe. TLS 1.3 ndiyotopetsa, imapezeka paliponse, ndipo ECH-yakonzeka - katundu atatu omwe timafuna.
architecture.h3_f:
gawo la zoyendera: TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446) + kusankha ECH (RFC 9460)
zosanjikiza: AES-256-GCM zosindikizidwa mkati CBOR
architecture.h4_a: Uthenga umodzi wotuluka umadutsa masitepe anayi: chimango → encrypt → post → fan out.
architecture.h4_b: Makasitomala amawerengera makiyi akuchipinda (X25519 + HKDF), amakonza uthengawo ngati CBOR, amasindikiza ndi AES-256-GCM pogwiritsa ntchito 96-bit nonce, POSTs to `/api/rooms/{id}/messages`. Node imasunga mizere ya ciphertext ndi mafani kwa aliyense wolumikizidwa WebSocket adalembetsa kuchipinda. Makasitomala a wolandila amatsitsa ndi kiyi yomweyo. Kuchedwerako kopita ndi kubwera kumunsi kwa 50 ms pazapafupi LAN, ~120 ms WAN.
architecture.h4_c: Mapaipi a masitepe anayi ndi omwewo Chizindikiro chomwe chimagwiritsidwa ntchito mu 2014; tidangosintha zoyendera (WebSocket m'malo mwa Signal's TCP) ndi encoding (CBOR m'malo mwa protobuf). Kufananiza kamangidwe kotsimikizirika kumapambana kupanga yatsopano.
architecture.h5_a: Tidasankha CBOR kupitilira JSON ndi Protobuf titafanizira kukula kwa malipiro, kusinthika, ndi kukonza zolakwika pazantchito zenizeni zochezera.
architecture.h5_b: CBOR imapanga ~ 30% zolipirira zazing'ono kuposa JSON pa mauthenga olemera a unicode, alibe kumveka bwino kwapang'onopang'ono, ndipo imathandizira kuwonjezera magawo popanda majenereta a schema. Proto ingafunike fayilo ya .proto pa kumasulidwa ndipo imayimitsa manambala am'munda.
architecture.h5_c: Signal idasinthidwa kuchoka pa protobuf kupita ku CBOR-ngati mawonekedwe mu 2017 pazifukwa zomwezi. Matrix imagwiritsa ntchito CBOR mugawo lake logwirizana ndi boma. CBOR ndi IETF mulingo (RFC 8949) ndipo chilankhulo chilichonse chomwe timakonda chimakhala ndi laibulale yokhwima.
architecture.h5_f:
CBOR kukula: ~0.7 × JSON pa mix utf-8
          ~ 1.05 × protobuf pa schema yomweyo
Kuwonjezera munda = kuwonjezera kumapeto. Makasitomala akale amanyalanyaza.
architecture.h6_a: Chifukwa CBOR - gawo la mutu wa zomangamanga. Ichi ndi chimodzi mwamakina ofunikira omwe akufotokozedwa muzolemba zonse za Vortex. Werengani mutu wozungulira kuti mumve zambiri; gawoli likuwonetsa machitidwe enaake.
architecture.h6_b: Kufotokozera mwachidule kwa "Chifukwa chiyani CBOR". Makinawa akugwiritsidwa ntchito mugawo lolingana ndi `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, kapena `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README imatchula njira zenizeni zamafayilo.
architecture.h6_c: Makina a "Why CBOR" adasinthika pa Vortex zotulutsidwa. Mapangidwewa amachokera ku kafukufuku wofalitsidwa ndi machitidwe opanga a amithenga am'mbuyomu. Mbiri yakale mu `CHANGELOG.md` imalemba nthawi yomwe chidutswa chilichonse chidatera komanso chomwe chidachipangitsa.
architecture.h7_a: Kusintha kwa Protocol - gawo la mutu wa zomangamanga. Ichi ndi chimodzi mwamakina ofunikira omwe akufotokozedwa muzolemba zonse za Vortex. Werengani mutu wozungulira kuti mumve zambiri; gawoli likuwonetsa machitidwe enaake.
architecture.h7_b: Kufotokozera mwachidule kwa "Protocol versioning". Makinawa akugwiritsidwa ntchito mugawo lolingana ndi `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, kapena `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README imatchula njira zenizeni zamafayilo.
architecture.h7_c: Makina a "Protocol versioning" adasintha pa Vortex zotulutsidwa. Mapangidwewa amachokera ku kafukufuku wofalitsidwa ndi machitidwe opanga a amithenga am'mbuyomu. Mbiri yakale mu `CHANGELOG.md` imalemba nthawi yomwe chidutswa chilichonse chidatera komanso chomwe chidachilimbikitsa.

crypto.title: Zoyamba za Cryptographic
crypto.subtitle: Ma algorithm aliwonse mu stack, cholinga chake, magawo ake, ake RFC.
crypto.intro: Vortex amangogwiritsa ntchito zakale zowunikiridwa ndi anzawo. Palibe zilembo za block block, palibe ma KDF okulira kunyumba, palibe masiginecha atsopano. Mutuwu umalemba zachikale zonse zomwe timagwiritsa ntchito, magawo enieni, ndi zifukwa za chisankho chilichonse.
crypto.h1p1: Curve25519 (RFC 7748) mu mawonekedwe ake a Montgomery, omwe amagwiritsidwa ntchito pa Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman. Makiyi achinsinsi a 32-byte, makiyi apagulu a 32-byte, ma 32-byte omwe adagawana nawo chinsinsi.
crypto.h1p2: Amagwiritsidwa ntchito ngati: chizindikiritso cha chipangizo chokhazikika, makiyi a gawo la ephemeral, maenvulopu osindikizidwa, makiyi achipinda, maenvulopu a federal.
crypto.h1p3: Kukhazikitsa kwa iOS: `Curve25519.KeyAgreement.PrivateKey` kuchokera ku CryptoKit. Android: `x25519-dalek` kudzera JNI. Node: `cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.x25519` pa OpenSSL.
crypto.h1p4: Onse atatu interop bit-for-bit. Ulendo wobwerera woyesedwa motsutsana ndi RFC 7748 ma vector oyesa Alice/Bob pamapangidwe aliwonse.
crypto.h1p5: Kachitidwe: ~100 µs pa Diffie-Hellman pa iPhone 2020, ~30 µs pa 2020 Mac. Kumangirira kwa makiyi a chipinda kwa gulu la mamembala 200 kumatenga pafupifupi 10 ms wall-clock.
crypto.h1p6: Nthawi zonse: inde, mu masamu apakatikati ndi njira yosinthira ma curve-byte.
crypto.h1p7: Maonekedwe am'mbali: Makwerero a Montgomery sangagwirizane ndi gulu la kuukira kwanthawi komwe kumagunda ma curves a Weierstrass; OpenSSL ndi Swift CryptoKit onse amagwiritsa ntchito.
crypto.h1p8: Kusintha kofunikira: 32-byte pang'ono-endian. Makiyi apagulu amamangiriridwa pazolowera kuti zolowetsa zolakwika zisapangitse kutayikira kocheperako.
crypto.h1l1: Chifukwa chiyani X25519 osati P-256: yachangu, yaying'ono, ayi NIST-zodetsa nkhawa.
crypto.h1l2: Chifukwa chiyani kutulutsa kwa 32-byte osati 64: kufananiza HKDF-SHA256 kutalika kolowera ndendende.
crypto.h1l3: Chifukwa chiyani Montgomery osati Edwards: timangofunika DH, osati siginecha, pazofunikira izi. Edwards amafunikira sitepe yotembenuka nthawi zonse.
crypto.h2p1: EdDSA (RFC 8032) kupitilira edwards25519. 32-byte public key, 64-byte siginecha.
crypto.h2p2: Amagwiritsidwa ntchito pa: maumboni a node pa mauthenga a federation, siginecha za makiyi otulutsa pa chiwonetsero cha kukhulupirika, kusaina kwa bot deploy, chidziwitso cha nthawi yayitali cha Double Ratchet.
crypto.h2p3: Determinism: mtundu wa RFC 8032 womwe timagwiritsa ntchito umatulutsa siginecha yomweyo kawiri pa uthenga + womwewo. CryptoKit ya Apple pa iOS 17+ imagwiritsa ntchito RFC 8032bis zosintha mosasintha - zonse ndi zovomerezeka ndipo zonse zimatsimikizira ndi zotsimikizira zilizonse.
crypto.h2p4: Mtengo wotsimikizira: ~200 µs pa CPU yamakono. Kutsimikizira gulu (`batch_verify([msg,sig,pk]*N)`) ndi ~10× mwachangu pa siginecha iliyonse.
crypto.h2p5: Mtundu wa siginecha: `R || S`, 32 byte iliyonse, pang'ono-endian.
crypto.h2l1: Kuyimilira kwa makiyi pagulu: 32-byte compressed point. Nthawi zonse ndizovomerezeka - palibe vuto la "point at infinity".
crypto.h2l2: Kuyimira kwachinsinsi kwachinsinsi: 32-byte mbewu. Kukula kokulirapo kumachokera pa ntchentche kudzera pa SHA-512.
crypto.h2l3: Bwanji ECDSA: ECDSA ikufunika RNG yapamwamba pa siginecha iliyonse; kukondera RNG kutulutsa kiyi yachinsinsi. Ed25519 ndiyotsimikiza, palibe RNG yofunikira panthawi yosayina.
crypto.h3p1: AES mu Galois/Counter Mode (NIST SP 800-38D). 256-bit makiyi, 96-bit nonces, 128-bit tags kutsimikizika.
crypto.h3p2: Amagwiritsidwa ntchito ngati: envelopu ya uthenga, ma envulopu a chunk, ma envulopu osungidwa osungidwa, zolipiritsa zosindikizidwa.
crypto.h3p3: Kumanga kwa Nonce: uthenga uliwonse umapanga 96-bit yatsopano mwachisawawa. Node imatsata 10 yomaliza ^ 6 nonces pachipinda chilichonse ndikugwetsa zobwerezedwa modzitchinjiriza - kasitomala sayenera kupanga zobwereza poyamba, koma lingalirani-palibe chotsika mtengo.
crypto.h3p4: Chifukwa chiyani 96-bit nonces osati 128-bit: 96 bits ndiye GCM-standard "deterministic" nonce length, ndipo zimatipatsa 2^32 nonces mwachisawawa zisanachitike kugunda kwa tsiku lakubadwa kukhala nkhawa. Kiyi yachipinda chimodzi imazunguliridwa kalekale izi zisanachitike, kotero ndi zotetezeka.
crypto.h3p5: Kukula kwa tag: zonse 128 bits. Sitichepetsa - ndalama zosungirako ndizochepa ndipo kuchepetsedwa kumawonjezera mwayi wabodza.
crypto.h3l1: Kuthamanga kwa Hardware: AES-NI (x86), ARMv8-A crypto extensions, ma crypto blocks odzipereka pa Apple Silicon. Encryption throughput ~3 GB/s.
crypto.h3l2: Pazida zakale ARM zopanda zowonjezera za crypto: ~300 MB/s kudzera pa mapulogalamu. Kuthamanga kwambiri kuposa disk IO.
crypto.h3l3: Zogwirizana nazo: mutu wa chimango (`{v, room_id, sender_pseudo}`) wadutsa ngati AAD kotero kuti mutu wabodza usatsimikize.
crypto.h4p1: HKDF (RFC 5869) ndi SHA-256. Imapeza makiyi angapo ang'onoang'ono a 32-byte kuchokera pamalowedwe amodzi a 32-byte.
crypto.h4p2: Amagwiritsidwa ntchito pa: kugawa X25519 zotuluka mu kiyi yobisa + MAC kiyi + fungulo lamutu; kutenga kiyi ya ratchet kuchokera ku Diffie-Hellman kuzungulira; kupanga makiyi a fayilo pa chunk kuchokera muzu wa fayilo.
crypto.h4p3: Zingwe zazidziwitso nthawi zonse zimakhala ASCII: `"v1:encryption"`, `"v1:mac"`, `"v1:header"`, `"v1:backup"`. Kusintha kumatilola kutembenuza maulamuliro onse ofunikira kudzera pakusintha kwa zingwe.
crypto.h4p4: Mchere ndi wosankha. Mu Vortex timagwiritsa ntchito id yakuchipinda ngati mchere potengera makiyi amchipinda kuti zipinda zosiyana zisagwiritsenso ntchito makiyi otengedwa mwangozi ngakhale X25519 zotulutsa zomwezi zikuwonekera.
crypto.h4l1: Chifukwa chiyani SHA-256 osati SHA-512: nsanja zonse zili ndi zida SHA-256 kuthamangitsa; SHA-512 imathamanga pang'ono pa 64-bit CPUs koma osati pama foni.
crypto.h4l2: Bwanji osakhala KMAC-based KDF: KMAC ndi niche. HKDF ili mu library iliyonse ya crypto yomwe timagwiritsa ntchito.
crypto.h5p1: Argon2id (RFC 9106). Zigawo: m=64 MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32.
crypto.h5p2: Amagwiritsidwa ntchito ngati: hashi yapambali ya seva (`users.password_hash`), kiyi yotsekera zosunga zosunga zobwezeretsera zakomweko, mawu otengera mawu ambewu.
crypto.h5p3: Chifukwa chake magawo awa: OWASP 2023 malingaliro. 64 MiB + 3 iterations imatenga ~ 0.5 s pa iPhone X - chipangizo chathu chochepa kwambiri chothandizira. Wowukira ASIC wokhala ndi 100× bandwidth yokumbukira foni ikufunikabe ~ 5 ms pakuyesa. Mawu achinsinsi aatali (entropy> 40 bits) amakhala osatheka kusweka pamlingo.
crypto.h5p4: Mtundu wosungira: `argon2:<encoded>` pomwe pali khodi ya RFC-chingwe chophatikiza mchere, kukumbukira, kubwereza, ndi hashi.
crypto.h5l1: Chifukwa chiyani Argon2id osati Argon2i kapena Argon2d: 2id ndi wosakanizidwa - kupita koyamba kumatsutsa njira zam'mbali (i-mode), zodutsa zotsatila zimatsutsa GPU/ASIC (d-mode). Signal imagwiritsa ntchito zomwezo.
crypto.h5l2: Kuyerekeza kwa Dummy-hash: ngakhale wogwiritsa ntchito kulibe, timayendetsabe Argon2 yotsimikizira ndi hashi yokhazikika. Izi zikufanana ndi nthawi yolowera kuti owukira asathe kuwerengera mayina olowera ndi nthawi yoyankha.
crypto.h5l3: Rehash pakulowa: ngati woyang'anira seva akumana ndi mtengo wa kukumbukira, ma hashe akale amasinthidwanso pakulowa kotsatira kopambana. Zowonekera kwa wogwiritsa ntchito.
crypto.h6p1: FIPS 203 (NIST, 2024). ML-KEM-768. 1184-byte public key, 1088-byte ciphertext, 32-byte chinsinsi chogawana.
crypto.h6p2: Amagwiritsidwa ntchito pa: makiyi a hybrid post-quantum session. Anzawo onse akamalengeza Kyber thandizani kiyi ya gawoli ndi `HKDF(x25519_output || kyber_output)`.
crypto.h6p3: Chifukwa chiyani wosakanizidwa: ngakhale Kyber itasweka pambuyo pake (ndi yachichepere), gawo la X25519 limatitetezabe. Kuphatikiza kumapereka zabwino koposa zonse.
crypto.h6p4: Chifukwa chiyani Kyber osati enawo NIST ofuna: ndi omwe adasankhidwa kuti akhazikitsidwe. Kupezeka kwa ma code ndikofalikira (liboqs, pqcrypto).
crypto.h6l1: Magwiridwe: m'badwo wofunikira ~ 100 µs, encapsulation ~ 30 µs, decapsulation ~ 50 µs. Zocheperako poyerekeza ndi kuchedwa kwaulendo wobwerera.
crypto.h6l2: Mtengo wa bandwidth: 1088 byte pa gawo lililonse, 1184 byte pa kiyi ya anthu onse. Gawo limalipidwa pakulumikizana koyamba; pambuyo pake ndi zero.
crypto.h6l3: Mbali ya seva: `pqcrypto` Python phukusi ndi `kem.ml_kem_768`. Mbali yamakasitomala: ma liboqs kudzera pamapulatifomu.
crypto.h7p1: Signal's Double Ratchet (monga tafotokozera mu 2016 public spec). Amaphatikiza ratchet ya Diffie-Hellman yokhala ndi unyolo wamakiyi ofananira.
crypto.h7p2: Amagwiritsidwa ntchito pa: mauthenga achindunji pakati pa zida ziwiri. Zipinda zamagulu zimagwiritsa ntchito chiwembu chosavuta cha "sender key" chochotsa muzu wachipindacho.
crypto.h7p3: Katundu: chinsinsi chamtsogolo (kusokoneza chipangizo kumangowonetsa mauthenga omwe adalandira kale, osati amtsogolo), chitetezo cham'mbuyo (kubwezeretsanso kuchiritsa pambuyo pavuto lalikulu), kutumiza kunja kwadongosolo (mpaka mauthenga a 1000 odumpha).
crypto.h7l1: Kutalika kwa unyolo: Mauthenga 1000 pa unyolo uliwonse musanakakamizidwe kuyambiranso. Imaletsa kuwonongeka kochokera ku kiyi yabedwa.
crypto.h7l2: Cache-makiyi odumphira: mpaka makiyi 1000 omwe sanatumizidwe omwe amasungidwa pamtima pa unyolo uliwonse. Kupitilira apo, uthengawo umakanidwa ngati wakale.
crypto.h7l3: Kubisa kwamutu: kumangochitika mwachisawawa. Mutuwo umanyamula metadata ya ratchet ndipo umabisidwa ndi kiyi yamutu yodzipatulira yochokera muzu kudzera HKDF.
crypto.h8p1: Fayilo yosadziwika bwino imagwiritsa ntchito BLAKE3 chifukwa imathamanga 10× kuposa SHA-256 pamabulogu akulu.
crypto.h8p2: Amagwiritsidwa ntchito ngati: gawo la fayilo `sha256` mu DB (dzina la mbiriyakale; kwenikweni BLAKE3 pansi pa hood kuyambira v0.1.2), chophatikizira dedup, cheke-kukweza kukhulupirika kwa fayilo.
crypto.h8p3: Kaimidwe kachitetezo: BLAKE3 ndi yamphamvu mobisa (256-bit); timatcha gawoli `sha256` kuti zigwirizane ndi kusamuka kokha.
crypto.h9p1: Nonces zonse, makiyi oyambira, zovuta zimapangidwa kudzera pa OS RNG: `SecRandom` pa iOS, `java.security.SecureRandom` pa Android, `secrets.token_bytes` pa Python (kukuta `/dev/urandom).` kapena zofanana).`
crypto.h9p2: Osati `mwachisawawa()`, osati `Math.random()`, osati `randi()`. Malamulo a Lint amaletsa kugwiritsa ntchito kwawo ma module a crypto.
crypto.h10p1: HMAC kufanizitsa, kutsimikizira siginecha, kutsimikizira mawu achinsinsi - zonse zimagwiritsa ntchito zoyambira nthawi zonse kuteteza njira zanthawi.
crypto.h1_a: X25519 ndi elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman over Curve25519 mu mawonekedwe ake a Montgomery. Makiyi a 32-byte, chinsinsi cha 32-byte chogawana. Kiyi iliyonse yachinsinsi / chizindikiritso cha chipangizo / kiyi yagawo mu Vortex imagwiritsa ntchito.
crypto.h1_b: Alice ndi Bob aliyense ali ndi makiyi achinsinsi a, b ndi makiyi apagulu A = a·G, B = b·G pomwe G ndiye poyambira pamapindikira. Amawerengera s = a·B = b·A. Chinsinsi chogawidwa cha 32-byte chimapita ku HKDF-SHA256 kuti apeze makiyi a symmetric AES-GCM. Masamu pamapindikira amachitidwa nthawi zonse pogwiritsa ntchito makwerero a Montgomery; palibe nthambi pazinsinsi zachinsinsi.
crypto.h1_c: Curve25519 idasindikizidwa ndi Daniel J. Bernstein mu 2005 ndikusankhidwa ndi IETF mu RFC 7748 (2016). Adatengedwa ndi Signal, WhatsApp, OpenSSH, WireGuard. Vortex imaigwiritsa ntchito chifukwa ndiyothamanga kuposa P-256, ili ndi makiyi olimba a 32-byte, imapewa NIST zodetsa nkhawa, ndipo nsanja iliyonse imatumiza mwamphamvu.
crypto.h1_f:
Kiyi wachinsinsi: a ∈ [0, 2²⁵⁵) (32 bytes pang'ono-endian)
Kiyi yapagulu: A = a · G (32-byte wothinikizidwa mfundo)
Chinsinsi chogawana: s = a · B = b · A (32 byte, →HKDF zolowetsa)
crypto.h2_a: Ed25519 ndiye siginecha m'bale wa X25519, pogwiritsa ntchito mphira womwewo mu mawonekedwe ake opotoka-Edwards. 32-byte makiyi onse, 64-byte siginecha, deterministic mwa kusakhulupirika.
crypto.h2_b: Kusaina uthenga m ndi kiyi yachinsinsi d: compute r = SHA-512(d, m), R = r·G, c = SHA-512(R, A, m), S = r + c·a. Siginecha ndi (R, S). Kutsimikizira: fufuzani R + c·A = S·G. Kusaina motsimikiza kumapewa chiopsezo chosagwiritsanso ntchito kwathunthu - siginecha ziwiri za uthenga womwewo wokhala ndi kiyi yomweyo ndizofanana pang'ono.
crypto.h2_c: Ed25519 (RFC 8032) adatuluka mu pepala la Bernstein la 2011 ndi Duif, Lange, Schwabe, ndi Yang. Adalandiridwa kwambiri pambuyo pa 2013. Apple's CryptoKit, Google's Tink, libsodium, OpenSSH onse amagwiritsa ntchito. Vortex amasaina envulopu iliyonse ya federal ndi umboni uliwonse wa Ed25519.
crypto.h2_f:
Chizindikiro(d, m): r = SHA-512(d∥m);  R = ndi G
              c = SHA-512(R∥A∥m);  S = r + ca
              kubwerera (R, S)

Tsimikizani: c = SHA-512(R∥A∥m);  R + c·A ≟ S·G
crypto.h3_a: AES mu Galois/Counter Mode. Makiyi a 256-bit, 96-bit nonces mwachisawawa, ma tag otsimikizika a 128-bit. Chida chilichonse chosungidwa mu Vortex chimagwiritsa ntchito GCM.
crypto.h3_b: GCM imayendetsa AES mu CTR mode ndikuwerengera GHASH pamwamba pa ciphertext + AAD pogwiritsa ntchito kiyi ina yochokera ku kiyi ya encryption. Tag = GHASH(AAD, ciphertext) ⊕ AES-CTR(0). Kumasulira kumawerengeranso GHASH ndikufanizira - kutembenuza kumodzi kulikonse sikutsimikiziranso. Zida zamakompyuta zimafulumizitsa pa CPU iliyonse yamakono kudzera pa AES-NI kapena ARMv8-A crypto extensions.
crypto.h3_c: AES adapambana mpikisano wa NIST AES mu 2001. GCM idasinthidwa kukhala NIST SP 800-38D mu 2007 ndipo ndiyosakhazikika AEAD mu NIST NIST SP 800-38D mu 2007 ndipo ndiyosakhazikika AEAD mu TLS. Vortex imasankha makiyi a 256-bit ngakhale 128-bit ingakhale yokwanira motsutsana ndi adani akale - kulumphira ku 256-bit kumatipatsa pafupifupi ma bits 128 achitetezo cha post-quantum pansi pa algorithm ya Grover.
crypto.h3_f:
Encrypt(k, n, aad, pt): ct = AES-CTR(k, n, pt)
                          tag = GHASH_h(aad∥ct∥lens) ⊕ AES(k, n∥1)
                          kubwerera ct∥tag
Osagwiritsanso ntchito ⇒ chinsinsi + kusweka.
crypto.h4_a: HKDF (HMAC-based KDF, RFC 5869) amasintha kiyi imodzi kukhala yambiri. Imatengera kulowetsa kwapamwamba komanso chizindikiro cha nkhani; imatulutsa ma byte 32 pa chizindikiro chilichonse.
crypto.h4_b: Njira ziwiri: Chotsani ndi Kukulitsa. Kutulutsa = HMAC-SHA256(mchere, IKM) → PRK. Kukula = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, info∥counter) yolumikizidwa ndi ma len byte. Timagwiritsa ntchito izi kugawa X25519 zotulutsa mu kiyi yobisa, kiyi MAC, ndi kiyi yapamutu yokhala ndi zingwe "v1:encryption", "v1:mac", "v1:header".
crypto.h4_c: HKDF idasindikizidwa ndi Hugo Krawczyk ku EUROCRYPT 2010 ndipo idakhazikika ngati RFC 5869 mu 2010. Yogwiritsidwa ntchito ndi TLS 1.3 pandandanda yake, ndi Signal for Double Ratchet, ndi WireGuard pamakiyi agawo. Kusintha kwa zidziwitso kumatilola kutembenuza makiyi onsewo ndikugunda "v1" → "v2".
crypto.h4_f:
PRK = HMAC-SHA256(mchere, IKM)
T(i) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, T(i-1) ∥ zambiri ∥ i)
OKM = T(1) ∥ T(2) ∥ … kudulidwa ku ma len byte
crypto.h5_a: Argon2id ndi mawu achinsinsi osakumbukira omwe adapangidwa kuti asakane GPU ndi ASIC owukira. Zosintha m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32.
crypto.h5_b: Argon2id imasakaniza Argon2i (imakana njira zam'mbali mwa kusagwiritsa ntchito mawu achinsinsi) ndi Argon2d (imadzaza kukumbukira mosayembekezereka kotero kuti zida zofananira sizingadutse ngodya). Theka loyamba lapita ndilopanda deta (i-mode); chotsalira chimadalira deta (d-mode). Masekondi 0.5 a compute pa iPhone X pazigawo zathu, pafupifupi 5 ms pa ASIC - the ~100× speedup ndi yaying'ono poyerekeza ndi SHA-256-based hashes komwe ASICs imapambana ndi 1 000 000×.
crypto.h5_c: Argon2 adapambana Mpikisano wa Password Hashing wa 2015 wokonzedwa ndi Dmitry Khovratovich ndi Alex Biryukov. Yokhazikika ngati RFC 9106 mu 2021. Yogwiritsidwa ntchito ndi 1Password, Bitwarden, LastPass. Magawo a Vortex amachokera ku malingaliro a OWASP 2023, omwe asinthidwa kuti alowetse pa chipangizo chathu chochepa kwambiri chothandizira (iPhone X) pansi pa sekondi imodzi.
crypto.h5_f:
mtengo(m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) ≈ 0.5s pa iPhone X
mtengo wowukira: m × t × (p / attack_parallelism)
Pa 10¹⁰ zongoyerekeza/s ndi 40-bit password entropy:
  10¹² masekondi = 32 000 zaka
crypto.h6_a: Kyber-768 (ML-KEM-768) ndi NIST-standarded post-quantum key encapsulation mechanism. Amapereka makiyi a gawo lotetezeka la quantum ophatikizidwa ndi X25519.
crypto.h6_b: Alice amapanga (pk, sk). Bob amatcha Encapsulate(pk) → (c, ss); amatumiza c kwa Alice. Alice amayimba Decapsulate(sk, c) → ss. Mbali zonse ziwiri tsopano zikugawana ss, chinsinsi cha 32-byte. Chitetezo chimachepetsa ku Vuto la Module-LWE, lomwe amakhulupirira kuti ndizovuta kwambiri. Timaphatikiza ndi X25519: session_key = HKDF(x25519_output ∥ kyber_output). Ngati theka lililonse lipulumuka, gawolo lipulumuka.
crypto.h6_c: Kyber adasankhidwa ndi NIST mu Julayi 2022 pambuyo pa mpikisano wazaka 6. Yokhazikika ngati FIPS 203 mu Ogasiti 2024. Vortex imatumiza Kyber ngati mukufuna chifukwa imawonjezera ~2 KB pagawo lililonse kugwirana chanza; zimayatsidwa mwachisawawa pamagawo olipidwa, lowani kwina. Njira yosakanizidwa idalimbikitsidwa ndi Signal mu 2023 ndikuvomerezedwa ndi Chrome mu 2024.
crypto.h6_f:
KeyGen(): (pk ∈ Zq^k, sk ∈ Zq^k) pk = 1184 B, sk = 2400 B
Encaps(pk): (ct ∈ Zq^k, ss ∈ {0,1}²⁵⁶) ct = 1088 B
Decaps(sk,ct): ss ∈ {0,1}²⁵⁶
gawo losakanikirana = HKDF(x25519_out ∥ kyber_out, info="session-v1")
crypto.h7_a: Signal's Double Ratchet imapereka chinsinsi chamtsogolo komanso chitetezo cham'mbuyo pamacheza a 1: 1.
crypto.h7_b: Maunyolo awiri: unyolo wotumiza ndi unyolo wolandila. Uthenga uliwonse umapititsa patsogolo unyolo wake kudzera pa HKDF. Nthawi zambiri ratchet ya Diffie-Hellman imakulitsa mizu, ndikuyikanso maunyolo onse awiri. Compromise of chain key imangowonetsa mauthenga omwe adawalemba mwachindunji. Pambuyo pa DH ratchet, mauthenga amtsogolo amakhala otetezeka ngakhale wowukira atabera kiyi ya unyolo.
crypto.h7_c: Zopangidwa ndi Trevor Perrin ndi Moxie Marlinspike ku 2013, zotumizidwa ku Signal 2014, zotengedwa ndi WhatsApp (2016), Facebook Messenger Secret Conversations, Skype Private Conversations. Zolinga zapagulu mu 2016. Vortexkukhazikitsa ndi doko lolunjika; interop ndi makasitomala ena a Signal-protocol ali pamseu wa v0.4.
crypto.h7_f:
kutumiza: CK = HKDF(CK, "site");  MK = HKDF(CK, "msg")
landirani: CK' = HKDF(CK', "step"); MK' = HKDF(CK', "msg")
DH ratchet: RK, CK = HKDF(DH(wathu_eph, wawo_eph), RK_prev)
crypto.h8_a: BLAKE3 hashing yamafayilo - gawo lamutu wa crypto. Ichi ndi chimodzi mwamakina ofunikira omwe akufotokozedwa muzolemba zonse za Vortex. Werengani mutu wozungulira kuti mumve zambiri; gawoli likuwonetsa machitidwe enaake.
crypto.h8_b: Kuwunikira mwachidule kwa "BLAKE3 hashing yamafayilo". Makinawa akugwiritsidwa ntchito mugawo lolingana ndi `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, kapena `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README imatchula njira zenizeni zamafayilo.
crypto.h8_c: Makina a "BLAKE3 hashing for files" adasinthika pa Vortex zotulutsidwa. Mapangidwewa amachokera ku kafukufuku wofalitsidwa ndi machitidwe opanga a amithenga am'mbuyomu. Mbiri yakale mu `CHANGELOG.md` imalemba nthawi yomwe chidutswa chilichonse chidatera komanso chomwe chidachipangitsa.
