cryptoWire.title: Mitundu ya Crypto waya
cryptoWire.subtitle: Masanjidwe enieni a byte pa blob iliyonse yosungidwa.
cryptoWire.intro: Mutuwu ukufotokoza ma byte pa waya. Aliyense amene akugwiritsa ntchito kasitomala wina kapena chida cha forensics akhoza kuwerenga.
cryptoWire.h1p1: Kapangidwe: `{v:1, nonce:<12-byte hex>, ciphertext:<variable hex>, sender_pseudo:<32-hex>, sent_at:<unix_ms>}`. Atumizidwa ku HTTPS (POST) ndi WebSocket (mtundu wa chimango `m`).
cryptoWire.h1p2: `ciphertext` zitatha AES-GCM kumasuliridwa: CBOR `{v:1, mawu?:<string>, attachments?:[<file_id>, ...], reply_to?:<msg_id>, edits?:[<prior_text>, ...], amatchulidwa?:[<user}`id.>, …
cryptoWire.h1p3: Tag ikutsatira: `ciphertext` byte string ndi (encrypted payload || 16-byte tag). Makasitomala amagawanika kutalika.
cryptoWire.h1p4: AAD: ID yachipinda chocheperako imaperekedwa monga momwe zimalumikizirana. Kumanga chizindikiritso cha chipindacho kumalepheretsa kusewereranso kwachipinda.
cryptoWire.h2p1: Fayilo root key ndi 32 byte mwachisawawa. Kiyi pa chunk: `HKDF(muzu, zambiri: "file:chunk:" + <offset>, len: 32)`.
cryptoWire.h2p2: Chunk ciphertext: AES-GCM yokhala ndi kiyi ya chunk, mwachisawawa 96-bit nonce, AAD: `<file_id> || <offset>`. Kukula kwakukulu kwa chunk 512KiB.
cryptoWire.h2p3: Kukhulupirika kwa fayilo yonse: kasitomala amawerengera BLAKE3 pamawu osamveka bwino ndikutumiza ngati `plain_blake3` kwa wolandira kudzera mu meseji yakuchipinda. Wolandira amawerengeranso akatsitsa ndikutsimikizira.
cryptoWire.h3p2: Kukankha kukafika, node imapanga kiyi ya ephemeral X25519, DH yokhala ndi `p256dh_pub`, imatulutsa kiyi AES-GCM kudzera pa HKDF.
cryptoWire.h3p3: Chisindikizo chosindikizidwa: `{endpoint, p256dh: kasitomala's pub, auth: 16 bytes, data: ciphertext||tag}`. Ma APN/FCM amangowona `data` yokha.
cryptoWire.h3p4: Makasitomala amadekha polandila pogwiritsa ntchito kiyi yake yachinsinsi ndi `p256dh` (yomwe kwenikweni ndi ephemeral pub ya node mu envelopu).
cryptoWire.h4p1: Mawu achinsinsi amapeza kiyi yosunga zobwezeretsera kudzera pa Argon2id (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, mchere=<mwachisawawa 16B>, hashLen=32).
cryptoWire.h4p2: Blob: `{mchere, nonce, ciphertext}`. Ciphertext ndi CBOR ya `{v:1, zipinda:[{id,key,ct_refs}...], mbiri:{...}, contacts:[...]}`.
cryptoWire.h4p3: Kusungidwa kwanuko (iCloud / Google Drive) kapena pa node m'chipinda chachinsinsi cha ogwiritsa ntchito.
cryptoWire.h5p1: Uthenga wodutsa: `{source_node: <pubkey>, target_user: <id>, mkati: {... mofanana ndi envelopu yachipinda ...}, sig: <64-byte Ed25519>}`.
cryptoWire.h5p2: `sig` imakwirira `{source_node, target_user, internal}'. Zolinga zimatsimikizira motsutsana ndi `source_node` pubkey kuchokera ku `trusted_node`.
cryptoWire.h1_a: Mauthenga a chipinda chimodzi pawaya ndi mawu CBOR okhala ndi malipiro obisika, nonce, pseudonym yotumiza, ndi sitampu yanthawi. Envelopuyo ndi yofanana ngakhale imakwera HTTPS (POST) kapena WebSocket (mtundu wa chimango `m`).
cryptoWire.h1_b: Makasitomala amasanjikiza gulu la uthenga `{v:1, mawu, yankhani_kwa, kutumiza_pa}` monga CBOR → `pt`. Amapanga chisawawa cha 12-byte. Kuwerengera `aad = hex(room_id)`. Imbani `ct = AES-GCM-256-Encrypt(room_key, nonce, pt, aad)`. Amangirira mu `{v:1, ciphertext: hex(ct), nonce: hex(nonce), sender_pseudo: hex(pseudo), sent_at: unix_ms}` ndi kutumiza. Wolandira amatsimikizira GCM tag panthawi ya decrypt, kenako CBOR-amafotokozera mwachidule.
cryptoWire.h1_c: Mawaya amapangidwa ndi mtundu kuyambira v0.0.4 pambuyo pa kutulutsidwa kwa v0.0.3 komwe kunalibe gawo la `v` - tinayenera kuphatikizira mtundu wonsewo titawonjeza `thread_id` chifukwa makasitomala akale adagunda pa kiyi yosadziwika. Phunziro: waya aliyense wam'tsogolo amanyamula `v:N` m'gawo lake loyamba kotero kuti kuyan'ana kutsogolo kumawonekera.
cryptoWire.h2_a: Mafayilo amagawika m'zigawo zazikuluzikulu zokhazikika, iliyonse ili ndi kiyi yake yochokera muzu wa fayilo ndi chunk offset. Kubisa kwa chunk kumapangitsa wotumiza kuyimitsa/kuyambiranso pamalire aliwonse.
cryptoWire.h2_b: Fayilo root key ndi 32 byte mwachisawawa. Kiyi pa chunk ndi `HKDF(root, info="file:chunk:" + str(offset), len=32)`. Chigawo chilichonse chimakhala AES-GCM chosungidwa ndi kiyi yakeyake, 96-bit nonce, ndi `aad = file_id ∥ offset`. Chunks osasintha kukhala 512KiB; 4 MiB kapu. Fayilo yathunthu BLAKE3 imatumizidwa ngati `plain_blake3` mu uthenga wakuchipinda womwe umalozera pafayiloyo kuti olandira atsimikize atachotsa.
cryptoWire.h2_c: Chunked E2E encryption yokhala ndi makiyi a per-chunk idapangidwa upainiya ndi Mega.nz mu 2013 ndikuyengedwa ndi thandizo la mafayilo akulu a Signal mu 2019. Vortex's 512 KiB ndi kukula kwake komwe TCP control flow imapangitsa chitoliro chodzaza popanda 4G yakutali patali. Tidayesa 256/512/1024/4096 KiB ndipo 512 anali malo okoma mumiyezo yathu.
cryptoWire.h3_a: Envulopu yosindikizidwa yosindikizidwa imabisa zidziwitso zolipidwa kuchokera ku Apple / Google / Mozilla mwa kubisa ndi kiyi ya X25519 yokhudzana ndi chipangizo.
cryptoWire.h3_b: Makasitomala amalembetsa `p256dh_pub` ndi `auth` pamfundo. Kukankha kukafika, node imathamanga ephemeral-ECDH yokhala ndi p256dh_pub, imapeza key + nonce kudzera HKDF yokhala ndi chinsinsi cha auth ngati mchere. Imabisa `{mutu, thupi, room_id, message_id}` ndi AES-GCM. Imatumiza mbiriyo ngati gawo la `data` losawoneka bwino kwa wopereka kukankha. Kutulutsanso kwachipangizo, kumasulira, kumasulira.
cryptoWire.h3_c: Kukankhira kosindikizidwa ndi Web Push Message Encryption spec (RFC 8291, 2017). Apple adachilandira mu Zidziwitso Zachidziwitso cha iOS 16. Kukankhira kosindikizidwa kusanakhale kothandizidwa, Signal ndi WhatsApp zidatumiza "chinachake" chachete "chidafika" chopanda zomwe zili ndipo pulogalamuyo idatenga uthengawo podzuka - yomwe idachedwa. Kukankhira kosindikizidwa kumatipatsa zinsinsi zakutha mpaka kumapeto komanso kumasulira pompopompo.
cryptoWire.h4_a: Blob yosungidwa yosungidwa imalola wosuta kubwezeretsa makiyi achipinda + mbiri + masiku 90 apitawo pa chipangizo chatsopano kuchokera pachinsinsi chokha.
cryptoWire.h4_b: Kiyi yosunga zobwezeretsera imachokera ku mawu achinsinsi kudzera pa Argon2id yokhala ndi mchere wa 16-byte. Malipiro ndi CBOR: `{v:1, zipinda: [{id, key, msg_ref_ids}], mbiri, contacts}`. Yolembedwa ndi AES-GCM pansi pa kiyi yochokera. Zosungidwa kwanuko (iCloud / Google Drive) kapena ngati fayilo mchipinda chamtambo chachinsinsi cha ogwiritsa ntchito. Bwezerani: lowetsani mawu achinsinsi → Argon2id → decrypt → bweretsaninso makiyi ndi maumboni.
cryptoWire.h4_c: Mtunduwu umatengera OPVault ya 1Password (2013) ndi kutumiza kunja kwa Bitwarden (2017). Onse amagwiritsa ntchito KDF-ndiye-AEAD yokhala ndi metadata yokhala ndi mchere. Vortex adawonjezera kudula kwamasiku 90 chifukwa zosunga zobwezeretsera mbiri yakale zinali 100 MB+ pakuyesa; zobwezeretsa zambiri zimangofunika mauthenga aposachedwa, ndipo zakale zimatha kupezekabe kudzera pa seva ciphertext pomwe wogwiritsa ntchito ali ndi kulumikizana.
cryptoWire.h5_a: Uthenga wa cross-node federation umakutira envelopu yamkati yomwe yalembedwa kale mu envulopu yakunja yosainidwa yotsimikizira komwe kwachokera.
cryptoWire.h5_b: Node A imasanjikiza `{source_node, target_user, inner_ct, inner_nonce, sent_at}` monga CBOR. Zizindikiro ndi kiyi yake yotulutsa yachinsinsi ya Ed25519 → `sig`. POSTs `{envelopu, sig}` to node B's `/federation/deliver`. B amatsimikizira `sig` motsutsana ndi pubkey ya `source_node` mu `federations`, imayang'ana chidindo chanthawi mkati mwa zenera la mphindi 5, kenako ndikulemba mawu amkati ku tebulo lake la `mauthenga` kwa wogwiritsa ntchito.
cryptoWire.h5_c: Maenvulopu akunja osainidwa adabwereka kuchokera ku Matrix's federation spec (2015) ndi ActivityPub's HTTP Signatures (2018). Zenera la mphindi 5 limagwirizana ndi malingaliro a SMTP's RFC 5321 ndikuletsa kuwukira komwe wowukirayo agwire bungwe limodzi POST ndikulibwereza maola angapo pambuyo pake. Vortex anasankha Ed25519 kuposa RSA-PSS chifukwa ma siginecha a Ed25519 ndi ma byte 64 vs RSA-PSS-2048's 256 byte - nkhani zikakhala kuti federation ndi macheza.
cryptoWire.h2_f:
file_root = rand(32)
chunk_key(o) = HKDF(file_root, "file:chunk:" + o, 32)
chunk_ct(o) = AES-GCM(chunk_key(o), rand(12), mawu osavuta, aad=file_id ∥ o)
full_hash = BLAKE3(plaintext_bytes_of_full_file) // yotumizidwa monga plain_blake3
cryptoWire.h3_f:
ephemeral = (priv, pub);  ikm = ECDH(ephemeral.priv, p256dh_pub)
prk = HMAC-SHA256(auth, ikm)
key = HKDF-Onjezani(prk, "Content-Encoding: aes128gcm\0", 16)
nonce = HKDF-Onjezani(prk, "Content-Encoding: nonce\0", 12)
ct = AES-GCM(kiyi, nonce, CBOR{mutu, thupi, room_id, message_id})
waya = mchere(16) ∥ rs(4) ∥ idlen(1) ∥ ephemeral.pub(32) ∥ ct
cryptoWire.h4_f:
mchere = rand(16)
key = Argon2id(password, salt, m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, len=32)
nonce = rand(12)
ct = AES-GCM(key, nonce, CBOR{zipinda, mbiri, contacts}, aad="vortex-backup-v1")
file = {v:1, mchere, nonce, ct}

auth.title: Kutsimikizira
auth.subtitle: Register, lowani, tsitsimutsani, chotsani. JWT + X25519 + chiphaso chosankha / mbewu / 2FA.
auth.intro: Vortex imatulutsa ma JWT akanthawi kochepa (kufikira kwa mphindi 15, kutsitsimula kwa masiku 30) ndi makiyi a anthu onse a wogwiritsa ntchito X25519 yomangidwa. Pamapeto aliwonse okhudzidwa JWT + amatsimikizira kuti kiyiyo sinathetsedwa. Mutu uwu umakhudza zotuluka zonse kumapeto mpaka kumapeto.
auth.h1p1: Makasitomala amayamba ndikupanga kiyi yachinsinsi ya 32-byte X25519 ndi OS RNG. Imapeza kiyi yapagulu, imasungidwa ngati 64 hex chars.
auth.h1p2: Makasitomala amalemba `POST /api/authentication/register` ndi `{username, password, x25519_public_key, display_name, foni, imelo, avatar_emoji, kyber_public_key?}`.
auth.h1p3: Node imatsimikizira: dzina lolowera likufanana ndi `^[a-z0-9_]{3,30}$` (zocheperako kuti mupewe ma homograph squats); mawu achinsinsi amadutsa mphamvu yamtundu wa zxcvbn (min score 2); foni ikufanana ndi E.164 ngati yaperekedwa; imelo ikufanana RFC 5322 basic regex ngati itaperekedwa.
auth.h1p4: Node imayang'ana `x25519_public_key` yapadera - pubkey iliyonse imatha kulembetsa akaunti imodzi. Izi zimayimitsa ziwopsezo zolembetsa zambiri zomwe zimagwiritsanso ntchito pubkey yomweyo.
auth.h1p5: Node imayendetsa Argon2id pa mawu achinsinsi (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) ndikusunga `argon2:$...$` mu `users.password_hash`.
auth.h1p6: Node imapanga ma JWT awiri: kupeza (15 min, `jti:<device_id>`) ndikutsitsimutsa (30 d). Zofuna: `{sub: user_id, jti: device_id, typ: access|tsitsimutsani, exp: ...}`. Yasaina HS256 pachinsinsi cha seva ya 64-byte yokwezedwa kuchokera ku `.env`.
auth.h1p7: Node imapanga mzere wa `user_devices`: `{user_id, device_id, user_agent, created_at}`. Kutsitsimula kulikonse kumangiriridwa ndi chipangizo chake_id; kubweza chipangizo kumapha mtsinje wokhawo.
auth.h1p8: Yankho: `{ok, user_id, username, access_token, refresh_token, x25519_public_key, kyber_public_key, display_name, avatar_url, foni, imelo}`.
auth.h1p9: Makasitomala amasunga ma tokeni mu Keychain (iOS) / EncryptedSharedPreferences (Android) / HttpOnly SameSite=Macookie okhwima (webu).
auth.h1l1: Malire: olembetsa 5 pa masekondi 60 pa IP. TESTING=zoona zimalepheretsa izi.
auth.h1l2: Kuyitanira: ngati `REGISTRATION_MODE=itana`, bungwe liyenera kukhala ndi `invite_code` yovomerezeka. Ma code amapangidwa kudzera pa admin API.
auth.h1l3: Chotsekera: `REGISTRATION_MODE=chatsekedwa`. Woyang'anira mbewu yekha ndi amene angalembetse. Otsatira amafika kudzera pamalumikizidwe oitanira muzipinda zinazake.
auth.h2p2: Mafunso a node `users` ndi dzina lolowera laling'ono. Ngati sichipezeka, imayendetsabe dummy Argon2 kutsimikizira motsutsana ndi hashi yokhazikika kuti ifananize nthawi (~ 0.5 s mwanjira iliyonse).
auth.h2p3: Ngati Argon2 tsimikizirani bwino ndipo akauntiyo siyiyimitsidwa, node imabweza envulopu yomweyi ngati yolembetsa. Mzere watsopano wa `user_devices` wapangidwa; mizere yomwe ilipo yasiyidwa yokha kuti wogwiritsa ntchito alowe pazida zingapo.
auth.h2p4: Kutsimikizira kukanika, node imabweretsa 401 ndi `{error:"zidziwitso zosavomerezeka"}`. Palibe kusiyana pakati pa "lolemba lolakwika" ndi "password yolakwika" poyankha.
auth.h2l1: Malire: 10 kuyesa kulephera pamasekondi 60 pa IP. Kupyola kumabweretsa 429 ndi mutu wakuti `Yesaninso Pambuyo`.
auth.h2l2: Kutseka kwa akaunti: 20 kuyesa kulephera mkati mwa 24 h kuyika akaunti kuti iwunikenso kwa admin. Ogwiritsa ntchito Legit amangosintha mawu achinsinsi kuti alowe.
auth.h2l3: Kutsata gawo: `/api/authentication/devices` imatchula magawo onse omwe akugwira; wogwiritsa akhoza kuletsa chilichonse.
auth.h3p1: Chizindikiro cholowa chikatsala pang'ono kutha (makasitomala akutsata `exp` kwanuko) kapena pempho likabweranso 401 ndi `chizindikiro chatha', kasitomala amalemba `POST /api/authentication/refresh` ndi `{refresh_token}`.
auth.h3p2: Node imasankha zotsitsimula, imayang'ana kuti `jti` ikadalipo mu `user_devices` (yosachotsedwa), imayang'ana `exp`, ndikuyika chizindikiro chatsopano.
auth.h3p3: Kutembenuza kotsitsimutsa kumakhala kozimitsa. Yambitsani ndi `ROTATE_REFRESH=true` kuti mutulutsenso mwatsopano.
auth.h3p4: Ngati kutsitsimula kutha, kuthetsedwa, kapena kupangidwa mwachinyengo, node imabwezeretsa 401. Wothandizira amalowa m'deralo ndikuwuza kuti alowenso.
auth.h4p1: Makasitomala apaintaneti amatha kulembetsa chotsimikizira papulatifomu (Kukhudza ID, Nkhope ID, Windows Hello, Android biometric). Seva imasunga `{credential_id, public_key, counter}`.
auth.h4p2: Lowani: `POST /api/authentication/passkey/start` → vuto limabwezera seva; zikwangwani za kasitomala ndi kiyi yachinsinsi (yomwe ili mu Secure Enclave / TPM); `POST /api/authentication/passkey/finish` → seva imatsimikizira ndi zovuta JWT.
auth.h4p3: Chekeni chotsutsana ndi monotonicity: kutsimikizira kulikonse kuyenera kuwonjezera kauntala. Ngati sichoncho, chiphasocho chimatengedwa ngati chopangidwa ndikukanidwa.
auth.h5p1: Monga njira yobwezera tsoka, wogwiritsa ntchito amatha kutumiza mbewu ya mawu 24 BIP-39. Kuzilowetsa pachida chilichonse kumapanganso chizindikiro cha X25519 (mbewu → HKDF → kiyi yokhazikika) ndikutsimikizira kukhalapo kwake kudzera muvuto losaina.
auth.h5p2: Mbewu sichichoka pa chipangizocho. Node imangowona X25519 kiyi yapagulu ndi siginecha pazovuta za seva.
auth.h5p3: Entropy: 256 bits (32 bytes). BIP-39 checksum ndi yokhazikika, kotero typos amagwidwa asanafike pa seva.
auth.h6p1: TOTP (RFC 6238) yokhala ndi masitepe 30 ndi ma code 6. Zosankha pa wogwiritsa ntchito.
auth.h6p2: Kulembetsa: `POST /api/authentication/2fa/setup` imabweza chinsinsi + otpauth URI + QR. Wogwiritsa amasanthula ndi Google Authenticator / Authy / 1Password. Wogwiritsa atumizanso chitsanzo cha nambala 6 kuti atsimikizire kuti pulogalamuyi ikugwira ntchito.
auth.h6p3: Lowani ndi 2FA: mawu achinsinsi akadutsa, nodi imabwerera `{needs_2fa: true}`. Makasitomala akupempha nambala ndi zolemba ku `/api/authentication/login/2fa`.
auth.h6p4: Malire: 5 TOTP kuyesa pa mphindi 5 pa wogwiritsa ntchito. Kupitilira kumayambitsa kuzizira kwa masekondi 60 ndi chenjezo la imelo.
auth.h6p5: Zizindikiro zosunga zobwezeretsera: 12 × 10-manajiti 10 amawonetsedwa kamodzi polembetsa. Khodi iliyonse itha kugwiritsidwa ntchito ndendende kamodzi.
auth.h7p1: Foni yomwe yalowetsedwa imatha kulowa pakompyuta yatsopano yokhala ndi QR code. Zolemba za Chipangizo A `POST /api/authentication/qr/begin` → seva imabwezera nonce ndi TTL.
auth.h7p2: Chipangizo A chikuwonetsa QR yomwe ili ndi `nonce + user_id + server_url`. Chipangizo B chimayang'ana ndikuyika `POST /api/authentication/qr/verify` ndi nonce.
auth.h7p3: Seva imatsimikizira kuti nonce ikadalipobe (TTL 60 s, chithunzi chimodzi), imalumikiza kiyi yachida B yatsopano X25519 ku akaunti ya wosuta A (mzere wa `user_devices`), ndikubwezeretsa JWT ku chipangizo B.
auth.h7p4: Chipangizo A chimalandira chidziwitso cha WebSocket `{mtundu:"n", chochitika:"chatsopano_chida"}` kuti wogwiritsa athe kutsimikizira / kubweza munthawi yeniyeni.
auth.h8p1: Timabwezera dala zolakwika zomwezo za "lolowera losadziwika" ndi "password yolakwika". Malire olembetsa amabisa mayina olowera omwe alipo.
auth.h8p2: Mapeto a mbiri (`/api/users/{username}`) amafuna auth. Wowukira sangathe kuwerengera mayina olowera popanda chizindikiro chovomerezeka.
auth.h8p3: Mulingo wochepera `/api/authentication/login` umapangitsa kuti munthu azitha kukwawa mwamphamvu.
auth.h1_a: Kulembetsa kumapanga chizindikiritso chatsopano: X25519 makiyi pa chipangizocho, hashi yachinsinsi ya Argon2id pa seva, JWT awiri operekedwa pakupambana.
auth.h1_b: Khwerero 1: kasitomala akuyendetsa `crypto.randomBytes(32)` pa X25519 kiyi yachinsinsi, ipeza kiyi yapagulu (~100 µs pa foni). Khwerero 2: POST /api/authentication/register with `{username, password, x25519_public_key, display_name, foni, imelo, avatar_emoji}`. Khwerero 3: node imatsimikizira kudzera pa Pydantic (dzina lolowera regex, mawu achinsinsi ≥ 8 chars, foni E.164, imelo RFC-5322-lite). Khwerero 4: node imayenda ndi Argon2id(password) → `argon2:...`, sungani mu `users.password_hash`. Khwerero 5: node imatulutsa mwayi JWT (15 min) + refresh JWT (masiku 30), ikupitilira mzere wa `user_devices`.
auth.h1_c: Kuyenda ndi kusinthika kwamakono kwa PHP's mysql_real_escape_string era. Zolemba zilizonse zamakono - Auth0, Firebase, Supabase - zimakhala ngati izi. Kupindika kwachindunji mu Vortex ndikutumiza X25519 pubkey pakuyimba foni: zikutanthauza kuti akauntiyo imalumikizidwa ndi chizindikiritso chanthawi yayitali E2E kuchokera ku chimango choyamba, osawonjezedwa pambuyo pake. Kulimbikitsidwa ndi kapangidwe ka protocol ka Signal ka 2013.
auth.h2_a: Kulowa kumatsimikizira mawu achinsinsi motsutsana ndi Argon2 hashi yosungidwa ndikutulutsa JWT yatsopano ngati ikugwirizana.
auth.h2_b: POST /api/authentication/login ndi `{username, password}`. Mafunso a node `users` ndi dzina lolowera laling'ono. Ngati yapezeka, imatsimikizira Argon2id nthawi zonse motsutsana ndi `users.password_hash`. Ngati sichipezeka, imayendetsabe dummy Argon2 kutsimikizira motsutsana ndi chingwe chokhazikika kuti mufanane ndi nthawi. Success → watsopano JWT awiri + watsopano `user_devices` mzere (mmodzi pa chipangizo cholowetsedwa). Kulephera → 401 yokhala ndi "zidziwitso zosavomerezeka" - palibe kusiyana pakati pa dzina lolowera loyipa ndi mawu achinsinsi, kukana kuwerengera.
auth.h2_c: Kutsimikizira kwanthawi zonse komanso kusokoneza kwa ogwiritsa ntchito omwe kulibe ndiye chizindikiro chomwe chidatengedwa mu 2014 pambuyo poti ofufuza awonetsa kuwerengera kwanthawi pazomwe amalowa. Kuyambira pamenepo yavomerezedwa kwambiri - django-axes, authelia, Keycloak onse amagwiritsa ntchito. Mchitidwewo umawonjezera ~ 0.5 s pakuyesera kulikonse komwe sikulephera, zomwe zili bwino; timayika malire olowera pa 10/min/IP mulimonse.
auth.h2_f:
dummy_hash = Argon2id("__timing_equalizer__", mchere = wokhazikika, ...)

kulowa (u, p):
  mzere = users.find(username=u.lower())
  ngati mzere palibe:
      Argon2Verify(dummy_hash, p) // kufananiza nthawi
      kuwonjezera 401
  ngati sichoncho Argon2Verify(row.password_hash, p):
      kuwonjezera 401
  bweretsani nkhani_jwt(mzere)
auth.h3_a: Zizindikiro zofikira zimatha pakadutsa mphindi 15. Tsitsaninso kusinthana chizindikiro chotsitsimutsa kwanthawi yayitali kuti mupeze chizindikiro chatsopano popanda kufunsanso wogwiritsa ntchito mawu achinsinsi.
auth.h3_b: Makasitomala amatsata `exp` kwanuko. Pamene `tsopano + 30s > exp`, kapena pempho likabweza 401 ndi `token_expired`, kasitomala POSTA chizindikiro chotsitsimutsa ku `/api/authentication/refresh`. Node imazindikira, imayang'ana kuti `jti` ili mu `user_devices` osati `revod_at`, imayang'ana `exp`, ndikuyika chizindikiro chatsopano cha mphindi 15. Kutembenuza kotsitsimula ndikulowetsamo kudzera mwa `ROTATE_REFRESH=zoona` - kuzimitsa mwachisawawa chifukwa ma tokeni otsitsimutsa pamtundu uliwonse wotsitsimula kumapangitsa mpikisano pamene makasitomala awiri amatsitsimutsa nthawi imodzi.
auth.h3_c: OAuth 2.0 (RFC 6749, 2012) adayambitsa mwayi wopatukana + wotsitsimula. Nthawi yofikira mphindi 15 ndiyomwe imagwira ntchito pamakampani onse — Google imagwiritsa ntchito ola limodzi, Auth0 imasinthidwa kukhala maola 24, Okta mpaka ola limodzi. Tidasankha mphindi 15 kuti tichepetse zenera pomwe chizindikiro chabedwa chimakhala chothandiza. Kutsitsimula kwa masiku 30 kumagwirizana ndi zomwe mapulogalamu ambiri am'manja amafunikira kuti ogwiritsa ntchito alowe mkati mwa mwezi umodzi osachita chilichonse.
auth.h4_a: WebAuthn / makiyi olowera amagwiritsa ntchito chotsimikizira papulatifomu (Kukhudza ID, Nkhope ID, Windows Hello, Android biometric) m'malo mwa mawu achinsinsi.
auth.h4_b: Kulembetsa: seva imayika zovuta; wotsimikizira kasitomala amapanga makiyi atsopano mkati mwa malo ake otetezedwa ndikutumizanso kiyi yapagulu + umboni. Seva imasunga `{credential_id, public_key, counter}`. Lowani: `POST /api/authentication/passkey/start` → seva imabwezera zovuta; zikwangwani za kasitomala ndi kiyi yachinsinsi ya wotsimikizira (yomwe ili mu Secure Enclave, samasiya chip); `POST /api/authentication/passkey/finish` → seva imatsimikizira siginecha motsutsana ndi kiyi yapagulu yosungidwa. Kauntala ya monotonic imazindikira zotsimikizira zopangidwa.
auth.h4_c: FIDO2 / WebAuthn idakhazikitsidwa ndi W3C mu 2019 patatha zaka zantchito ndi FIDO Alliance. Apple anawonjezera chithandizo chotsimikizira nsanja mu iOS 16 (2022); Google, Microsoft, 1Password yotsatiridwa. Vortex adatengera WebAuthn mu v0.0.8. Ndizosasankha koma zimalimbikitsidwa kwambiri - ogwiritsa ntchito ma passkey samawona kulandidwa kwa akaunti chifukwa chachinsinsi chachinsinsi sichidutsa malire a chipangizocho.
auth.h5_a: Kubwezeretsa kwa mawu a mbewu kumamanganso X25519 chizindikiritso pa chipangizo chatsopano kuchokera ku mawu 24 BIP-39 mongoganizira. Simafunikanso kuti seva ikhale ndi zinthu zobisika.
auth.h5_b: Wogwiritsa ntchito amalemba mnemonic poyambitsa koyamba (posankha, nthawi imodzi). Kuti achire: pa chipangizo chatsopano, wosuta amalowa mnemonic; kasitomala amathamanga PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512(mnemonic, "mnemonic", 2048 rounds) → 64 byte za mbewu. Ma 32 byte oyamba a mbewu amakhala X25519 kiyi yachinsinsi; public key yachokera. Seva imauzidwa kiyi yatsopano yapagulu yokha; imatsimikizira kukhala nayo ndi Ed25519 Challenge-response (yosaina nonce), kenako imatulutsa ma JWT.
auth.h5_c: BIP-39 (Bitcoin Improvement Proposal 39, 2013) ndiye njira yovomerezeka yolembera zinsinsi zachinsinsi ngati mindandanda ya mawu osaiwalika. Mtanthauzira mawu wachingerezi wa 2048 wokhala ndi cheke cha 4-byte kumapeto. Vortex imagwiritsa ntchito mawu a 24 chifukwa muyeso wamakampani wama wallet otetezedwa kwambiri (Trezor, Ledger) ndi 24. Mawu a 12 angakhale okwanira pachitetezo cha 128-bit koma samawoneka ofunikira kwa ogwiritsa ntchito ambiri.
auth.h5_f:
mawu = BIP39_Encode(entropy=256_bits + 8_bit_checksum)
mbewu = PBKDF2-SHA512(mawu, "mnemonic", rounds=2048, len=64)
sk = mbewu[0:32] // X25519 mwachinsinsi
pk = sk · G // X25519 pagulu
auth.h6_a: Kutsimikizika kwazinthu ziwiri kumawonjezera mawu achinsinsi anthawi imodzi (TOTP) sitepe pambuyo potsimikizira mawu achinsinsi.
auth.h6_b: Kulembetsa: `POST /api/authentication/2fa/setup` → seva imapanga chinsinsi cha 160-bit, ndikuchibwezeretsa ngati chingwe cha base32 + otpauth:// URI pa QR kusanthula. Wogwiritsa amasanthula ndi Google Authenticator / Authy / 1Password; amatumizanso chitsanzo cha nambala 6 kuti atsimikizire kukhazikitsidwa kwachitika. Lowani: mawu achinsinsi akadutsa, seva imabwezeretsa `{needs_2fa: true}` m'malo mwa ma JWT. Makasitomala amalimbikitsa ma code 6 ndi ma POST `/api/authentication/login/2fa`. Seva imatsimikizira HOTP(chinsinsi, T=now_unix / 30) motsutsana ndi code.
auth.h6_c: TOTP idasinthidwa kukhala RFC 6238 mu 2011 ndi Mark Pei. Izi zisanachitike, RSA SecurID idagwiritsa ntchito algorithm ya eni; pambuyo pake, pulogalamu iliyonse ya 2FA idakhazikika pa TOTP. Gawo la Vortex la 30-sekondi ndi kutalika kwa manambala 6 ndizo RFC zosasintha. Makhodi osunga zosunga zobwezeretsera (madijiti 12 × 10, owonetsedwa kamodzi) adabwereka kuchokera ku mapangidwe a GitHub kuyambira 2012.
auth.h6_f:
chinsinsi = rand(20 byte) // 160 bits pa RFC 6238
TOTP(chinsinsi, t) = HOTP(chinsinsi, ⌊t / 30⌋)
HOTP(k, c) = truncate( HMAC-SHA1(k, c) ) mod 10⁶

zenera: ± 1 sitepe yololedwa ndi wotchi skew
auth.h7_a: QR lowani pawiri chipangizo chatsopano mu akaunti yomwe ilipo popanda kulembanso mawu achinsinsi. Foni yomwe yalowetsedwa kale imatsimikizira kuti chipangizo chatsopanocho chimagwiritsa ntchito kutsimikizira.
auth.h7_b: Chipangizo A cholemba `/api/authentication/qr/begin`. Seva imapanga nonce ya 128-bit ndi TTL 60s, imamangiriza ku user_id ya A, kuibwezeretsa. A akuwonetsa nonce encoded monga QR (kuphatikiza `nonce + user_id + server_url`). Chipangizo B chimasanthula, kutumiza `/api/authentication/qr/verify` ndi nonce. Seva: palibe chovomerezeka komanso chowombera chimodzi? Gwirizanitsani X25519 pubkey yatsopano ndi user_id (mzere wa `user_devices`), mint JWTs ya B. Chipangizo A chimalandira chidziwitso WebSocket kuti wosuta awone ndikuchotsa.
auth.h7_c: QR-based pairing idadziwika koyamba ndi WhatsApp Web mu 2015. Telegram adatsata; Signal adakopera kuti athandizidwe ndi zida zambiri mu 2021. Vortex's kupindika: chochitika chilichonse chophatikizika chimawonekera pachida choyambirira ndi batani la "tsimikizirani", kotero wowukira yemwe agwira QR pachithunzipa sangathe kumaliza kulunzanitsa popanda kugwiritsa ntchito chida A.
auth.h8_a: Kukana kuwerengetsa kwa akaunti - gawo la mutu wovomerezeka. Ichi ndi chimodzi mwamakina ofunikira omwe akufotokozedwa muzolemba zonse za Vortex. Werengani mutu wozungulira kuti mumve zambiri; gawoli likuwonetsa machitidwe enaake.
auth.h8_b: Kufotokozera mwachidule kwa "Akaunti enumeration resistance". Makinawa akugwiritsidwa ntchito mugawo lolingana ndi `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, kapena `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README imatchula njira zenizeni zamafayilo.
auth.h8_c: Makina a "Account enumeration resistance" adasintha pa Vortex zotulutsidwa. Mapangidwewa amachokera ku kafukufuku wofalitsidwa ndi machitidwe opanga a amithenga am'mbuyomu. Mbiri yakale mu `CHANGELOG.md` imalemba nthawi yomwe chidutswa chilichonse chidatera komanso chomwe chidachilimbikitsa.

rooms.title: Zipinda ndi mauthenga
rooms.subtitle: Mitundu inayi yazipinda, umembala, kusintha kofunikira, mauthenga.
rooms.intro: Zipinda zonse zinayi — DM, gulu lachinsinsi, gulu la anthu onse, tchanelo — amagawana tebulo ``zipinda` limodzi. Makhalidwe amapangidwa ndi mbendera za boolean.
rooms.h1p1: **DM**: mamembala awiri ndendende, `is_dm=zoona`, `is_private=zoona`. Tchulani chikhazikitso chokhazikitsidwa ku chogwirira cha membala wina.
rooms.h1p3: **Gulu la anthu**: `ndi_zachinsinsi=zabodza`. Aliyense amene ali ndi ulalo woyitanitsa atha kujowina; zolembedwa m'ndandanda wa anthu onse ngati eni ake alowa.
rooms.h1p4: **Chanelo**: kuwulutsa-kokha, `ndi_chaneli=zoona`. Eni / ma admin okha ndi omwe angatumize; mamembala okhazikika amawerenga.
rooms.h2p1: Maudindo: `mwini`, `admin`, `membala`. Mwini m'modzi yekha pachipinda chilichonse (chopatsidwa).
rooms.h2p2: Oyang'anira atha kuitana, kukankha, kusalankhula, ndi kusintha makonda a chipinda. Mamembala amatha kutumiza mauthenga, kuchitapo kanthu, kusintha zawo, kuchotsa zawo.
rooms.h2p3: Zilolezo zimatsika: eni ake ali ndi mphamvu zonse za admin. Ma Admin sangatsitse eni ake.
rooms.h2p4: Kusintha kwamaudindo kumatulutsa uthenga wamakina (`mtundu: "role_changed"`) wowonekera kwa membala aliyense.
rooms.h3p1: Chipinda chilichonse chili ndi **makiyi a mizu** 32 opangidwa polenga kudzera `secrets.token_bytes(32)` pa chipangizo cha Mlengi.
rooms.h3p2: Membala aliyense amalandira envulopu `{member_id, envelopu: X25519_encrypt(member_pubkey, root_key)}` yosungidwa mu `makiyi_wachipinda`.
rooms.h3p3: Membala akalowa, envelopu yatsopano imapangidwa ndi kasitomala aliyense yemwe alipo. Kupanga envelopu ndi O(1) pajowina.
rooms.h3p4: Membala akachoka, chipindacho chimazungulira: mlengi (kapena woyang'anira woyamba) amapeza muzu watsopano, maenvulopu kwa mamembala otsala, zolemba `{mtundu:"k", chipinda:..., new_envulopu:[...]}` kudzera pa WebSocket. Ciphertext yakale imakhala yowerengeka ndi kiyi yakale yomwe makasitomala adasungabe.
rooms.h3l1: Kusindikiza makiyi a Variant-B: muzipinda za anthu> mamembala 1000, maenvulopu amasiya kukula. M'malo mwake, eni ake amasaina ndikusindikiza fungulo lomwe lilipo mu tebulo la `room_public_keys`. Makasitomala amatsimikizira siginecha motsutsana ndi pubkey ya eni chipindacho. Kusinthasintha patchuthi cha membala ndiye kuti palibe mwayi pazipinda za Variant-B.
rooms.h3l2: Zopeka pachipinda chilichonse: chipinda chilichonse chilinso ndi `chipinda_pseudo_mchere`. Mayina ongopeka amembala mu mauthenga ndi `HMAC-SHA256(mchere, user_id)` adulidwa kukhala 16 hex char. Node silingadziwe kuti ndi wogwiritsa ntchito ndani yemwe adatumiza uthenga wopanda mapu a kasitomala.
rooms.h4p1: Mauthenga ali ndi ma ID a monotonic pachipinda chilichonse (64-bit auto-increment, `bigserial` ku Postgres, `INTEGER PRIMARY KEY` mu SQLite).
rooms.h4p2: Kuyitanitsa kumaperekedwa ndi seva. Makasitomala samalimbana ndi masitampu anthawi; amapereka mwadongosolo ID ndikuwonetsa nthawi yapakhoma ya wotumizayo ngati UI metadata yokha.
rooms.h4p3: Zosintha: zolemba zatsopano zimalowa m'malo akale, zosintha za `edited_at`. Makasitomala akuwonetsa `(zosinthidwa)` chizindikiro.
rooms.h4p4: Zochotsa: ikani `deted_at`, null out ciphertext. `{mtundu:"m", kuchotsedwa:zoona}` kuwulutsa.
rooms.h4p5: Mayankho: `reply_to` = uthenga id. Makasitomala amapereka kamutu kakang'ono ka mawu.
rooms.h5p1: Zochita ndi mizere mu `reactions(message_id, user_id, emoji, created_at)`. Client POSTs `/api/messages/{id}/reactions/{emoji}`. DELETE chifukwa chosachitapo kanthu.
rooms.h5p2: Mafani a Node atulutsa `{mtundu:"m", machitidwe:[...]}` kwa aliyense wolembetsa. Makasitomala akuphatikiza.
rooms.h5p3: Palibe choletsa pa emoji - Unicode iliyonse. Makasitomala amachotsa ndikubweza.
rooms.h6p1: Ulusi ndi chipinda chabodza chozikidwa pa uthenga. `POST /api/messages/{id}/thread` imapanga `{id: <new_room_id>, kholo_message_id: <msg_id>, kholo_chipinda_id: <original>}`.
rooms.h6p2: Zipinda za ulusi zimatengera umembala kuchokera kwa kholo. Aliyense wa m'chipinda cha makolo akhoza kutumiza mu ulusi uliwonse.
rooms.h6p3: Kutengera mfungulo: key root key = `HKDF(parent_root, info: "thread:" + <parent_message_id>, len: 32)`. Kugwirizana kwa kiyi ya ulusi sikudumpha kholo.
rooms.h7p1: Ma Admins amatha kumanikiza mpaka mauthenga 10 pachipinda chilichonse. `POST /api/rooms/{id}/pin` ndi `{message_id}`.
rooms.h7p2: Seti yokhomedwa imayikidwa pachipinda chotseguka; makasitomala amapereka mutu wokhomedwa pamwamba.
rooms.h8p1: Zolemba pachipinda chilichonse zimapitilira pa mfundo: `PUT /api/rooms/{id}/draft` ndi `{text}`. `GET` imabwezeretsa zamakono. `DELETE` amayeretsa.
rooms.h8p2: Makasitomala amalunzanitsa zojambula pazida zonse kotero kuti kulemba pa foni kumathera pakompyuta. Zolemba sizinasungidwe kumapeto mpaka-kumapeto - ndizomwe zimawonekera pa seva. Uku ndikugulitsa dala kwa zida zodutsa UX. Ogwiritsa ntchito omwe amatsutsa atha kuletsa kulunzanitsa pachipinda chilichonse.
rooms.h9p1: `POST /api/scheduled` ndi `{room_id, ciphertext, send_at}`. Manode amasunga mu `mauthenga_okonzedwa`; cron worker amachita pa nthawi yake.
rooms.h9p2: Zosintha ndi zolephereka mpaka send_at nkhupakupa itayaka. Mukatumiza, uthengawo umakhala mzere wamba mu `mauthenga`.
rooms.h1_a: Zipinda zonse zinayi (DM, gulu lachinsinsi, gulu la anthu onse, tchanelo) zimagawana tebulo ``zipinda` limodzi. Kusiyana kuli mu mbendera zitatu za boolean.
rooms.h1_b: Mbendera: `ndi_dm`, `ndi_zachinsinsi`, `ndi_njira`. DM: is_dm=true, is_private=zoona, mamembala awiri ndendende. Gulu lachinsinsi: is_private=zoona, is_channel=zabodza, mpaka mamembala 5000. Gulu la anthu onse: is_private=zabodza, zolembedwa mchikwatu ngati mwiniwake atalowa. Channel: is_channel=zoona, eni ake/owongolera okha positi. Onse amagawana kasamalidwe kake, fan-out, ma reaction, ulusi.
rooms.h1_c: Single-table polymorphism ndi chitsanzo cha Martin Fowler's *Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture* (2002). Telegram amagwiritsa ntchito mitundu itatu yosiyana yazipinda mkati; Slack amagwiritsa ntchito njira + ma DM + ma DM amagulu ambiri ngati mitundu inayi; Discord imagwiritsa ntchito "njira" pachilichonse. Tidasankha tebulo limodzi titawonetsa kuti mtengo waukulu ndi kutulutsa (komwe kuli yunifolomu pamitundu yonse) ndipo pambuyo pa v0.0.3 refactor adaphatikiza matebulo atatu ofanana kukhala amodzi.
rooms.h1_f:
CREATE TABLE zipinda (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  lembani VARCHAR(16), -- cholowa, chotsalira ndi mbendera
  dzina VARCHAR(256),
  ndi_zachinsinsi BOOLEAN,
  ndi_channel BOOLEAN,
  ndi_dm BOOLEAN,
  chiwerengero_chamembala INT,
  avatar_url VARCHAR(512),
  adalengedwa_pa TIMESTAMP,
  adapangidwa_ndi BIGINT REFERENCES ogwiritsa(id)
);
rooms.h2_a: Maudindo ali ndi magawo atatu: eni, admin, membala. Mwini m'modzi m'chipinda chilichonse, woyang'anira m'modzi, mamembala ambiri mosasamala.
rooms.h2_b: `mamembala_wachipinda(chipinda_id, munthu_id, udindo, olowa_pa, osalankhula_mpaka)`. Maudindo amatsika: eni ake ali ndi mphamvu zonse za admin. Oyang'anira atha kuitana, kukankha, kusalankhula, ndi kusintha zochunira mchipindacho koma sangathe kutsitsa eni ake. Mamembala amatha kutumiza mauthenga, kuchitapo kanthu, kusintha zawo, kuchotsa zawo. Kusintha kwa eni ake kudzera `PATCH /api/rooms/{id}` ndi `new_owner_id` - mwiniwake wakale amatsitsidwa kwa admin.
rooms.h2_c: Mwini/woyang'anira/membala ndiye wapatatu IRC op/voice/user model kuchokera 1988, pambuyo pake adatengedwa ndi Slack, Discord, Telegram. Chisankho chapadera chokhala ndi mwiniwake m'modzi (osati wochuluka) chimachokera pakuganiziridwa kwalamulo: m'malo okhala ndi malamulo azovuta zamagulu, kukhala ndi mwini wake m'modzi kumathandizira DMCA ndi zopempha zofananira.
rooms.h2_f:
CREATE TABLE mamembala achipinda (
  room_id BIGINT,
  user_id BIGINT,
  udindo VARCHAR(16) CHECK(udindo IN ('mwini','admin','membala')),
  adalumikizana_ku TIMESTAMP,
  osalankhula_mpaka TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (id_yachipinda, ID_yogwiritsa)
);
rooms.h3_a: Chipinda chilichonse chili ndi kiyi ya 32-byte symmetric root. Mamembala amakhala ndi makope atakulungidwa pansi pa X25519 pubkey yawo.
rooms.h3_b: Popanga, kasitomala amapanga `root_key = secrets.token_bytes(32)`. Kwa membala aliyense, kasitomala amabisa `root_key` pansi pa `X25519(member_pubkey)` → envelopu. Maenvulopu amakhala mu `makiyi_wachipinda(chipinda_id, ID_yogwiritsa, envulopu)`. Wogwiritsa ntchito akajowina, kasitomala aliyense yemwe alipo amamupangira envulopu yatsopano. Wogwiritsa ntchito akachoka, eni ake kapena woyang'anira woyamba amazungulira - amapanga root_key yatsopano, maenvulopu a mamembala otsala, amawulutsa `{type:"k", chipinda:..., new_envulopu:[...]}` pamwamba pa WebSocket.
rooms.h3_c: Kukutira kwa membala aliyense ndi njira yomwe Signal idachita upainiya mu 2014 pamagulu ake-v2. Matrix's Megolm imagwiritsa ntchito njira yofananira ya "makiyi otumiza". Vortex idapita ndi ma envulopu a membala aliyense chifukwa ndizosavuta kuganiza: palibe kusuntha kwachinsinsi pakati pa otumiza. Kusinthanitsa ndi envulopu ya O(N) yomwe ikupanga kusintha kwa umembala, zomwe ndi zabwino mpaka ~ 5000 mamembala; Zosiyanasiyana-B zapagulu zimachotsa malire.
rooms.h3_f:
pakupanga:
  root_key = rand(32)
  kwa m mamembala:
    envelope[m] = X25519_Encrypt(m.pubkey, root_key)

patchuthi:
  new_root = rand(32)
  rebroadcast (maenvulopu atsopano a mamembala otsala)
rooms.h4_a: Kusindikiza kwa makiyi a Variant-B kulowetsa m'malo mwa maenvulopu a membala aliyense ndi kiyi imodzi yosainidwa, yoyikidwa patebulo lowerengedwa ndi anthu. Kufikira mamembala 100k+.
rooms.h4_b: M'malo mopanga envelopu ya O(N), mwiniwake amasaina fungulo_ndi ma post ku `room_public_keys(room_id, key, sign_by, sign_at)`. Makasitomala amatenga, tsimikizirani motsutsana ndi eni ake a Ed25519 pubkey, ndikugwiritsa ntchito. Kusinthasintha sikuli kofunikira pakusintha kwa umembala - aliyense yemwe anali ndi kiyi akadali nako ngakhale atakankhidwa. Ndizovomerezeka panjira zolengezetsa anthu pomwe "mbiri yozama" sichiwopsezo koma kufikira ndikukula.
rooms.h4_c: Variant-B imatengera mawonekedwe a mbiri ya Matrix "yowerengeka padziko lonse lapansi" kuphatikiza ndikusintha makiyi osayinidwa. Zowonjezedwa ku Vortex mu v0.0.8 beta itakhala ndi tchanelo cha anthu 50k chomwe envelopu yobwerezabwereza nthawi ndi nthawi idadzaza node. Njira yosayinira ndi kusindikizidwa imayang'ana motsatana ndi kusintha kwakukulu (komwe kuli kosowa) m'malo mosintha umembala (omwe amakhala osasintha).
rooms.h4_f:
Zosiyana-B:
  zizindikiro za mwiniwake: sig = Ed25519Sign(owner_priv, room_id ∥ root_key ∥ version)
  sindikiza: room_public_keys += {room_id, root_key, version, sig}
  kasitomala: GET /api/rooms/{id}/public-key → tsimikizirani sig motsutsana ndi owner_pubkey
rooms.h5_a: Maitanidwe ndi 32 hex char. Zosasankha zazikulu_zogwiritsidwa ntchito, zimatha_pa, assign_role, zosinthika.
rooms.h5_b: `POST /api/rooms/{id}/invite` (admin-only) imapanga mzere mu `zoyitanira(code, room_id, created_by, max_uses, used_count, expire_at, assign_role, revoted_at)`. `POST /api/rooms/join` ndi khodi imayang'ana ngati ndi yolondola (yosachotsedwa, sinathe nthawi, yogwiritsidwa ntchito <max_uses), increments `used_count`, imapanga `mzere_wa mamembala`, imabweretsanso metadata yachipinda. Chotsani kudzera `DELETE /api/invites/{code}` - kujowina pambuyo pake sikulephera.
rooms.h5_c: Makhodi oitanira ngati akale ndi akale ngati IRC's `+i` mode (1988). Telegram maulalo oitanira anthu onse omwe atha ntchito komanso malire ogwiritsira ntchito adayambitsidwa mu 2017. Zosintha za Vortex zimawonjezera `assign_role` kuti eni ake azitha kupereka ma code operekera mosatetezeka mumtundu wa kuwombera kamodzi - kothandiza kukwera woyang'anira watsopano osafunikira kudziwa id yawo yeniyeni.
rooms.h5_f:
oyitanitsa mzere:
  kodi: VARCHAR(64) -- 32 hex chars
  room_id : BIGINT
  max_uses : INT -- NULL = zopanda malire
  kuchuluka_kugwiritsidwa ntchito: INT
  expire_at : TIMESTAMP -- NULL = ayi
  assign_role : VARCHAR(16) -- NULL = membala
  revoked_at : TIMESTAMP -- NULL = live
rooms.h6_a: Mzere wa uthenga umasunga ciphertext + metadata; wotumiza samasungidwa m'mawu osavuta.
rooms.h6_b: `mauthenga(id, room_id, sender_id, ciphertext, nonce, sender_pseudo, sent_at, edit_at?, deleted_at?, reply_to?, thread_id?, kind)`. `sender_id` ilipo kuti iwunikire ndipo ili ndi indexed. `sender_pseudo` ndi chizindikiro cha sender_id pachipinda chilichonse kotero fan-out sifunika kukhudza tebulo la ogwiritsa ntchito. `kind` ndi imodzi mwa: zolemba, chithunzi, fayilo, mawu, kuyimba, dongosolo. `ciphertext` ndi opaque AES-GCM zotuluka; mamembala amchipinda okha omwe ali ndi kiyi akhoza kumasulira.
rooms.h6_c: Lingaliro la sender_pseudo limachokera ku Signal sealed-sender (2018). Chizindikiro chimachigwiritsa ntchito kuchititsa khungu seva kuti izindikire wotumiza; timachigwiritsa ntchito pazifukwa zofanana koma timasunga `sender_id` mawu omveka bwino a ACL ndi malire. Kugawanikaku kumatipangitsa kukakamiza "mamembala okhawo omwe angatumize" popanda seva kuphunzira kuti ndani adanena zonse DB kutaya.
rooms.h7_a: Zosintha zimachotsa `ciphertext` m'malo mwake ndikugunda `edited_at`. Imachotsa mawu achinsinsi ndikuyika `deted_at`.
rooms.h7_b: Sinthani: `PATCH /api/messages/{id}` ndi `{ciphertext, nonce}` yatsopano. Wotumiza yekha ndi amene angasinthe uthenga wake. Ciphertext/nonce ya Row yasinthidwa, `edited_at = now`, `kind` yosasinthidwa. Fananizani `{mtundu:"m", id, ct, nonce, edited_at}`. Chotsani: `DELETE /api/messages/{id}`. Wotumiza kapena woyang'anira akhoza kufufuta. `deted_at = now`, `ciphertext = NULL`. Mzere umakhalabe kotero kuti mayankho amakhala omveka. Kutulutsa `{mtundu:"m", kufufutidwa:true, id}`.
rooms.h7_c: Kusintha-mu-malo ndi mawonekedwe a Telegram/Slack; Discord idasunga mbiri yonse yosintha poyamba ndikuyisiya kuti ikhale yachinsinsi. Vortex imangosunga zatsopano - mbiri yosintha ndi gwero la zochitika PR pomwe zosintha zomwe zachotsedwa zimatha kubwezeredwa. Chofufumitsa mofewa chokhala ndi null ciphertext chikuchokera m'buku losewerera lomweli Telegram ndipo imasunga maunyolo oyankha popanda kusunga zomwe zili.
rooms.h7_f:
sinthani: UPDATE mauthenga SET ciphertext = $1, nonce = $2, edited_at = NOW() WHERE id = $3
chotsani: UPDATE mauthenga SET deleted_at = NOW(), ciphertext = NULL WHERE id = $1
rooms.h8_a: Zolemba - gawo la zipinda mutu. Ichi ndi chimodzi mwamakina ofunikira omwe akufotokozedwa muzolemba zonse za Vortex. Werengani mutu wozungulira kuti mumve zambiri; gawoli likuwonetsa machitidwe enaake.
rooms.h8_b: Kufotokozera mwachidule kwa "Drafts". Makinawa akugwiritsidwa ntchito mugawo lolingana ndi `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, kapena `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README imatchula njira zenizeni zamafayilo.
rooms.h8_c: Makina a "Drafts" adasinthika pa Vortex zotulutsidwa. Mapangidwewa amachokera ku kafukufuku wofalitsidwa ndi machitidwe opanga a amithenga am'mbuyomu. Mbiri yakale mu `CHANGELOG.md` imalemba nthawi yomwe chidutswa chilichonse chidatera komanso chomwe chidachilimbikitsa.
rooms.h9_a: Mauthenga okonzedwa - gawo la mutu wa zipinda. Ichi ndi chimodzi mwamakina ofunikira omwe akufotokozedwa muzolemba zonse za Vortex. Werengani mutu wozungulira kuti mumve zambiri; gawoli likuwonetsa machitidwe enaake.
rooms.h9_b: Kufotokozera mwachidule kwa "Mauthenga Okhazikika". Makinawa akugwiritsidwa ntchito mugawo lolingana ndi `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, kapena `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README imatchula njira zenizeni zamafayilo.
rooms.h9_c: Makina a "Mauthenga Okhazikika" adasintha pa Vortex zotulutsidwa. Mapangidwewa amachokera ku kafukufuku wofalitsidwa ndi machitidwe opanga a amithenga am'mbuyomu. Mbiri yakale mu `CHANGELOG.md` imalemba nthawi yomwe chidutswa chilichonse chidatera komanso chomwe chidachilimbikitsa.

files.title: Mafayilo ndi zomata
files.subtitle: Kuwombera kumodzi kwazing'ono, kuyambiranso kuchinsinsi chachikulu, chamakasitomala kwa onse awiri.
files.intro: Kukwezedwa kulikonse kwamafayilo kumadutsa pamzere womwewo. Kusiyana pakati pa njira kumangokhalira kulimba kwa netiweki: kuyambiranso kumalekerera maulalo osokonekera.
files.h1p1: Kapu: 5 MB. Amagwiritsidwa ntchito pazithunzi, zolemba zamawu, tatifupi zazifupi.
files.h1p2: Makasitomala amabisa fayilo yonse ndi AES-GCM, mwachisawawa 96-bit nonce, key = `file_root = secrets.token_bytes(32)`.
files.h1p3: POSTs `multipart/form-data` to `/api/files` with fields`file` (ciphertext), `plain_blake3` (integrity claim), `mime_type` (lingaliro; seva imayang'ananso ndi `python-magic`).
files.h1p4: Malo osungira pansi pa `zowonjezera/<category>/<sha256>.bin` ndi kubweza `{file_id, url}`.
files.h1p5: Makasitomala amatumiza uthenga wakuchipinda womwe umanena za file_id ndikunyamula file_root mu ciphertext yake kuti mamembala amchipinda athe kubisa.
files.h2p2: Gawo 1: `POST /api/files/resumable/init` ndi `{filename, size, chunk_size_hint}`. Node imagawira id yokwezera, imasankha kukula kwa chunk (chosasinthika 512 KiB, chokhala ndi 4 MiB), kubwezera `{upload_id, chunk_size}`.
files.h2p3: Gawo 2: pagawo lililonse, `PUT /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/chunk/{offset}` yokhala ndi mawu olembedwa. Zosintha ziyenera kulumikizidwa ku `chunk_size`.
files.h2p4: Gawo 3: `POST /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/finalise` ndi `{plain_blake3}`. Node imasonkhanitsidwa, kutsimikizira kukula, kusungira, kubweza `{file_id, url}`.
files.h2p5: Kulephera kusamalira: zokwezedwa zomwe zasokonekera zitha kuyambiranso ndikutumizanso zongosowa. Manode amatsata omwe adafika ku Redis (kapena mu-memory ya SQLite mode).
files.h2p6: TTL: zokwezedwa zosamalizidwa zimachotsedwa pambuyo pa 24 h.
files.h3p1: Kukweza zithunzi (MIME `chithunzi/*`) kumayambitsa jenereta yozikidwa pa Pillow pa 256×256 JPEG q=80. Zosungidwa pansi pa `zokweza/zala zazikulu/<hash>.jpg`.
files.h3p2: Zojambulajambula zimasungidwanso kumbali ya kasitomala - wolandila amafunika file_root kuti apereke. Imasunga bandwidth kuti muwone zowonera.
files.h3p3: Kukwezedwa kwamavidiyo (MIME `kanema/*`) kumayambitsa chojambula chochokera ku ffmpeg pa 10 % ya nthawi ya clip, yosungidwa momwemo.
files.h4p1: Makasitomala atumizidwa `mime_type` ndi lingaliro. Seva imayendetsa `python-magic` motsutsana ndi 1 KB yoyamba ndipo imakana ngati mtundu wofunkhidwa uli pamndandanda wokana: `application/x-dosexec`, `application/x-sharedlib`, `application/x-mach-binary`.
files.h4p2: Izi zimayimitsa ogwiritsa ntchito osadziwa kugawa mwangozi pulogalamu yaumbanda kudzera mwa messenger. Owukira olimbikitsidwa amathabe kudumpha ndi zotengera zolembedwa molondola - chitetezo ndi kukana kwa kasitomala, osati kununkhiza kwa seva.
files.h5p1: Zosasintha: mawonekedwe amtundu wamba. Gooyenera kuyika ma node amodzi.
files.h5p2: S3: ikani `STORAGE_BACKEND=s3` + `S3_BUCKET=...`. Mafayilo amatsitsidwa mwachindunji ku S3 osakhudza disk ya node. Ma URL osankhidwa kale amagwiritsidwa ntchito potsitsa.
files.h5p3: IPFS: zoyeserera. Zokwezedwa zimalengeza ma CID kudzera mu DHT; kutsitsa kumatenga node iliyonse yotsina.
files.h1_a: Kukweza kamodzi kokha ndiye njira yachangu pachilichonse chochepera 5 MB - zithunzi, zolemba zamawu, tatifupi zazifupi. Mmodzi HTTPS POST, cholemba chimodzi chobisika, mzere umodzi mu `mafayilo`.
files.h1_b: Makasitomala amabisa mafayilo kumapeto mpaka kumapeto ndi AES-GCM pansi pa 32-byte `file_root` mwachisawawa. POSTs `multipart/form-data` to `/api/files` with fields `file` (ciphertext), `plain_blake3` (integrity claim), `mime_type` (hint). Node imagwiritsa ntchito 5 MB cap pamlingo wolandila, imayendetsa `python-magic` kuti izindikire mtundu, ikukana ngati MIME ili pamndandanda wokana, imasunga pansi pa `zowonjezera/<category>/<hash>.bin`, imabwezeretsa `{file_id, url, mime_type, size}. Makasitomala amatumiza uthenga wakuchipinda wolozera `file_id` ndikunyamula `file_root` m'mawu ake achinsinsi.
files.h1_c: Kapu 5 MB ndi nambala yofanana ya Slack ndi Telegram yogwiritsa ntchito njira yawo yokwezera "inline". Mafayilo akulu amapita kunjira yoyambiranso. Kumayambiriro Vortex anali ndi 100 MB kapu imodzi; tidatsikira ku 5 MB titawonetsa kuti zojambulidwa kamodzi pamwamba pa 5 MB zinali ndi 40 % yotsika pama network am'manja. Njira yopititsira patsogolo ndiyabwino kwambiri pamafayilo akulu ngakhale ndikuyenda mozungulira panjira zokondwa.
files.h2_a: Kutsitsa koyambiranso ndi njira yamafayilo akulu. Makasitomala amatsitsa makulidwe okhazikika, amatha kuyimitsa, atha kuyambiranso malire aliwonse, amathanso kuchira pama blips a netiweki.
files.h2_b: Njira zitatu za protocol. Init: `POST /api/files/resumable/init` ndi `{filename, size, chunk_size_hint}` → node imagawa `upload_id` + imatsimikizira kukula kwa chunk. Chunk: pagawo lililonse, `PUT /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/chunk/{offset}` yokhala ndi zilembo zachinsinsi. Zotsitsa ziyenera kukhala kuchuluka kwa chunk_size. Pomaliza: `POST /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/finalise` ndi `{plain_blake3}` - mfundo imalumikizananso, imatsimikizira kukula + tag, masitolo, kubwezera `{file_id, url}`.
files.h2_c: Protocol yokhala ndi magawo atatu ndi yofanana ndi tus.io (Resumable Uploads, 2013), AWS S3 kukweza magawo angapo, ndi Google Thamangitsani zokwezanso. Vortex adatengera mawonekedwe a tus.io chifukwa inali njira yosavuta kwambiri yosinthira FastAPI +. The 24 h TTL pa zokwezedwa zosamalizidwa zimafanana S3 zosasintha ndi masikelo amayambiranso kusinthasintha motsutsana ndi kugwiritsa ntchito disk disk.
files.h3_a: Zojambulajambula zimapangidwa kumbali ya seva panthawi yokweza koma zimakhala zobisika pansi pa muzu womwewo wa fayilo, kotero mamembala a chipinda okha ndi omwe angawapatse.
files.h3_b: Kwa `chithunzi/*` MIME, Pillow imapanga 256×256 JPEG q=80 kuchokera pazowonera zosinthidwa. Dikirani - ayi, seva ilibe mawu osavuta. Mayendedwe olondola: kasitomala amapanga chala chachikulu kwanuko, amalemba ndi file_root + nonce yemweyo, kuyika ngati blob ya abale, ndi maumboni a `thumb_id` mu uthenga wakuchipinda. Seva imasunga mawu achinsinsi. Kwa `kanema/*`, kasitomala amachita chimodzimodzi ndi ffmpeg-derived keyframe.
files.h3_c: Poyambirira Vortex anali ndi mawonekedwe azithunzi zapambali pa seva kuchokera m'mawu osamveka - tidachotsa kuthekera kumeneku mu v0.0.4 pambuyo pakuwunika kwachitetezo kuwonetsa kuti ikuphwanya chitsimikizo cha E2E. Zazikulu zapam'mbali za kasitomala ndizomwe Signal yakhala ikugwiritsa ntchito kuyambira 2018 ndi WhatsApp kuyambira 2020. Mtengo wa Bandwidth ndi wocheperako - 256×256 JPEG ili pansi pa 20 KB.
files.h4_a: Seva imakhazikitsa mndandanda wa MIME kukana pamndandanda wazonunkhiza kuti ayimitse zomwe zagawidwa mwangozi.
files.h4_b: Mukatsitsa kwathunthu (kujambula kumodzi) kapena kumaliza (kuyambiranso), seva imayendetsa `python-magic` pa 1 KB yoyamba ya chidebe cholandirira mawu kuti ipeze mtundu weniweni. Ngati fungo likunena kuti `application/x-dosexec` (Windows PE), `application/x-sharedlib` (Linux ELF), kapena `application/x-mach-binary` (macOS Mach-O), kukwezedwa kumakanidwa ndi 415 Unsupported Media Type. Iyi ndi ndondomeko ya seva, osati malire a chitetezo - mamembala a chipinda cha kasitomala akhoza kuyikabe mawonekedwe omwe amadumpha kununkhiza.
files.h4_c: MIME kununkhiza ngati lamulo lokana ndi IETF draft-mime-sniffing-0X kuyambira 2012. Discord / Slack / Telegram onse amatero. Zoletsa (zotsekeka / zophatikizidwa ndi kununkhiza) zadziwika kuyambira 2016 - chitetezo chathu ndi chosanjikiza: kuphatikiza machenjezo a ogwiritsa ntchito pa fayilo iliyonse yokhala ndi chowonjezera chomwe chingathe kuchitika.
files.h5_a: Zosungirako zosungira - gawo la mutu wa mafayilo. Ichi ndi chimodzi mwamakina ofunikira omwe akufotokozedwa muzolemba zonse za Vortex. Werengani mutu wozungulira kuti mumve zambiri; gawoli likuwonetsa machitidwe enaake.
files.h5_b: Kufotokozera mwachidule kwa "Storage backends". Makinawa akugwiritsidwa ntchito mugawo lolingana ndi `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, kapena `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README imatchula njira zenizeni zamafayilo.
files.h5_c: Makina a "Storage backends" adasinthika pa Vortex zotulutsidwa. Mapangidwewa amachokera ku kafukufuku wofalitsidwa ndi machitidwe opanga a amithenga am'mbuyomu. Mbiri yakale mu `CHANGELOG.md` imalemba nthawi yomwe chidutswa chilichonse chidatera komanso chomwe chidachilimbikitsa.
files.h1_f:
POST /api/files
  Mtundu-Zopezeka: Multipart/form-data
  wapamwamba: <ciphertext bytes ≤ 5_242_880>
  plain_blake3: <64 hex chars>
  mime_type: "chithunzi/jpeg" (chidziwitso; fufuzaninso mfundo)

→ 201 {file_id, url: "/uploads/...", mime_type, size }
files.h3_f:
kasitomala amapanga thumb_plain = resize(zodzaza, 256, 256, JPEG, q=80)
thumb_ct = AES-GCM(file_root, new_nonce, thumb_plain, aad=thumb_id)
kwezani thumb_ct, tchulani thumb_id mu uthenga wachipinda pamodzi ndi file_id

presence.title: Kukhalapo ndi zizindikiro zoperekera
presence.subtitle: Zizindikiro zolembera, ma risiti owerengera, zowona - zonse za ephemeral.
presence.intro: Zizindikiro izi ndi zaphokoso. Vortex imawalepheretsa kulimbikira mwachisawawa: kulemba miyoyo ku Redis (kapena mu-memory), malisiti owerengera ndi chizindikiro chokhacho chomwe chimapulumuka kuyambiranso.
presence.h1p1: Makasitomala atumiza `{mtundu:"t", chipinda:..., boma:"start"|"stop"}` pa keystroke. Kupititsidwa ku chochitika chimodzi pa 3 s.
presence.h1p2: Node imawulutsa `{mtundu:"t", chipinda:..., wosuta:..., boma:...}` kwa onse olembetsa WebSockets.
presence.h1p3: Itha ntchito yokha: `kuyamba` popanda kutsatira `kusiya` nthawi pambuyo pa 10 s kumbali ya kasitomala.
presence.h2p2: Node ikupitilirabe `read_receipts(room_id, user_id, message_id, read_at)` ndi kuwulutsa `{type:"r", chipinda:..., user:..., message_id:...}`.
presence.h2p3: Makasitomala amamasulira "zowoneka ndi N" pansi pa mauthenga otuluka.
presence.h2p4: Zinsinsi: wogwiritsa akhoza kuletsa "zowoneka" kwathunthu; ndiye mfundoyo sikupitirizabe kuwalandira. Kusinthanitsa: sawonanso malisiti a anthu ena (symmetry).
presence.h3p1: Node imatsata `presence.last_seen_at` (unix ms) pa wogwiritsa ntchito. Zosinthidwa pazithunzi zonse WebSocket.
presence.h3p2: Granularity tiers (zosankhika ndi ogwiritsa ntchito): ndendende, zozungulira mpaka pafupi mphindi 5, zozungulira mpaka ola lapafupi, "posachedwa", kapena kuzimitsa.
presence.h3p3: Kufunsidwa kudzera `GET /api/users/{id}/presence`. Amalembetsedwa kudzera ku `{mtundu:"sub_presence", wosuta:...}`.
presence.h4p1: Wogwiritsa ali "paintaneti" ngati ali ndi WebSocket imodzi yokhazikika pazida zawo zilizonse.
presence.h4p2: Amawonekera kwa olumikizana nawo okha - osalumikizana nawo amawona komaliza koma osati kadontho.
presence.h1_a: Chizindikiro chimatumizidwa kudzera pa WebSocket chimango `{mtundu:"t", chipinda, tchulani: "start"|"imani"}` ndikuwulutsidwa ndi nodi kwa aliyense wolembetsa m'chipindamo.
presence.h1_b: Makasitomala amatsika pa 3 s — kiyibodi yoyamba imatumiza `kuyamba`, motsatira mkati mwa 3 s osachita kanthu. 10s pambuyo pa kiyibodi yomaliza, kasitomala amatumiza `stop`. Node imawulutsa chimango ndi mawu, olembedwa ndi `user_id`. Palibe kulimbikira - boma lolemba limakhala m'mawu okumbukira m'chipinda chilichonse (kapena Redis pub/sub for multinode). Auto-expire 10 s kumbali yolandila: ngati palibe zosintha zomwe zafika, makasitomala amaganiza kuti ayimitsidwa.
presence.h1_c: Zizindikiro zolembera zimabwerera ku AIM / ICQ (1997). Mapangidwe amasiku ano omwe amachotsedwa amatsata Skype 2006 ndi iMessage 2011. Manambala a 3 s / 10 s amachokera ku khalidwe lowonedwa ndi iMessage - ife A/B tinayesedwa 2/5, 3/10, 5/15 ndi 3/10 tinali ndi mayankho abwino kwambiri "ofanana ndi nyimbo yaumunthu".
presence.h2_a: risiti yowerengera ikupitilirabe: kasitomala POSTs uthenga wowerengedwa komaliza; ma node amasunga mu `read_receipts` ndi zowulutsa.
presence.h2_b: `POST /api/rooms/{id}/read` ndi `{last_read_message_id}`. Zosintha za `read_receipts(room_id, user_id, message_id, read_at)` ndi UPSERT semantics. Kuwulutsa `{mtundu:"r", chipinda, wosuta, message_id, read_at}`. Makasitomala amamasulira "zowoneka ndi N" pansi pa mauthenga otuluka. Zinsinsi: wogwiritsa ntchito amatha kuletsa malisiti kwathunthu; ndiye kuti mfundo siziwapitilira AND sawona ma risiti a ena (symmetric).
presence.h2_c: Ma risiti owerengera adakhala ponseponse pambuyo pa iMessage 2011 ndi WhatsApp 2014. Lamulo lofananira (ngati mubisa lanu, osawona ena) likuchokera ku Telegram 2014 ndipo ndi njira yokhayo yopewera njira yowonera njira imodzi. Vortex imakhazikitsa symmetry pa seva - osati kasitomala - kuti makasitomala omwe amanama za mbendera asawonekere.
presence.h3_a: Chowoneka komaliza ndi sitampu yanthawi imodzi ya munthu aliyense, yosinthidwa pa WebSocket chimango chilichonse ndikukalamba popanda mafelemu afika.
presence.h3_b: Node imatsata `presence.last_seen_at` monga unix ms. Zosinthidwa pa chimango chilichonse chotsimikizika WebSocket kuchokera kwa wogwiritsa ntchitoyo. Werengani kudzera pa `GET /api/users/{id}/presence`. Lembetsani kudzera ku `{mtundu:"sub_presence", wosuta}` kuti musinthe. Granularity imatha kusinthidwa ndi ogwiritsa ntchito: sitampu yeniyeni, yozungulira mpaka 5 min, yozungulira mpaka 1 h, "posachedwa", kapena kuzimitsa.
presence.h3_c: Magulu a Granularity amatsata zosintha zachinsinsi za WhatsApp mu 2012 pambuyo pa madandaulo okhudza kuzembera komaliza. Telegram mu 2013 adawonjezera zidebe "posachedwa / mkati mwa sabata / mkati mwa mwezi umodzi". Vortex's 5 min / 1 h / "posachedwa" ikufanana Telegram. Kusankha "kuchotsa" kumabisala wogwiritsa ntchito kuti asawone kuwonedwa komaliza kwa ena pazifukwa zomwezo monga malisiti owerengera.
presence.h4_a: Chizindikiro chapaintaneti: wogwiritsa ntchito "pa intaneti" ngati ali ndi WebSocket imodzi pazida zawo zilizonse.
presence.h4_b: Node imasunga `active_ws_count(user_id)` mu kukumbukira. Kuwonjezeka kwa WS kukwezedwa, kuchepa kwatsala pang'ono. `paintaneti = active_ws_count(user_id) > 0`. Amawonekera kwa omwe mumalumikizana nawo okha - osalumikizana nawo amawona komaliza (malinga ndi granularity) koma osati dontho lobiriwira. Sinthani zochitika moto pamene chiwerengero chikudutsa ziro mbali iliyonse.
presence.h4_c: Kuwoneka kwa olumikizana nawo okha ndiye chitsanzo chomwe mthenga wamkulu aliyense adakhazikika pambuyo pa zochitika zingapo zozembera (WhatsApp 2014, Telegram 2015). Koyambirira Vortex adapangidwa pa intaneti kwa aliyense; tidasintha zosasinthika pambuyo poti wowunika wa beta adanenanso kuti zipinda zapagulu zitha kutha kupezeka kwa zikwizikwi za alendo kwa zikwizikwi za alendo ena.

granularity:

  5_min → kubwerera ⌊last_seen_at / 300000⌋ · 300000

calls.title: WebRTC mafoni
calls.subtitle: Kanema wa Voice +, 1: 1 ndi gulu, losainidwa pamwamba pa WebSocket, loyendetsedwa ndi coturn.
calls.intro: Vortex amagwiritsa ntchito katundu WebRTC stack. Node ndi ma signature okha. Anzawo akalumikiza omwe akufuna ICE, zowulutsa zimayenda molunjika (mnzawo-mnzawo) kapena kudzera pa TURN relay pa zoyipa NAT.
calls.h1p1: Woyimba: `POST /api/calls/{room_id}/start` ndi `{vidiyo: bool, audio: bool}`. Node imagawa call_id, imawulutsa `{mtundu:"c", mtundu:"itani", call_id, video, audio}` kuchipinda.
calls.h1p3: Kusinthana kwamayankho: `{kind:"offer", sdp:...}` → `{kind:"yankho", sdp:...}` → `{kind:"candidate", ayezi:...}` × N mpaka kulumikizidwa.
calls.h1p4: Kuitana kumatha: `POST /api/calls/{call_id}/end`. Mbali iliyonse ikhoza kuyimitsa. Node imalemba `ma call_records(call_id, nthawi_s, kanema, audio, maphwando)`.
calls.h2p1: Kukhazikitsa kwa Server Interactive Connectivity. Anzanu asinthanitsa osankhidwa (host, srflx, prflx, relay).
calls.h2p2: STUN: yomangidwa ndi ma coturn. Mawonekedwe a stun-only omwe amagwiritsidwa ntchito pozindikira ma symmetric-NAT.
calls.h2p3: TURN: coturn yokhala ndi HMAC-yosaina zakanthawi kochepa. Kuyimba kulikonse kumalandira zikalata zatsopano zovomerezeka kwa maola 24.
calls.h2p4: Zidziwitso: `{dzina lolowera: <timestamp>:<user_id>, password: base64(HMAC-SHA1(chinsinsi, lolowera)}`. Mawonekedwe Okhazikika RFC 5389.
calls.h3p1: Audio: Opus 48 kHz variable bitrate (6-128 kbps). DTX yambitsani kuponderezana chete.
calls.h3p2: Kanema: VP9 (yokondedwa) / H.264 / AV1 (sankhani). Simulcast pama foni amagulu: woyimba amayika malingaliro atatu nthawi imodzi.
calls.h3p3: FEC: yoyatsidwa nthawi zonse pamawu; kwa kanema ngati bitrate headroom ilola.
calls.h4p1: Kwa > 2 otenga nawo mbali, Vortex imabala SFU (Selective Forwarding Unit) pamfundo. Aliyense amatsitsa kamodzi, SFU mafani atuluka.
calls.h4p2: Pakadali pano, omvera omvera mpaka 100; magulu amakanema omwe ali ndi 8 mu v0.1 (kanema SFU kuuma mumsewu wa v0.3).
calls.h4p3: SFU amagwiritsa ntchito njira yokhotakhota yomweyo podutsa; palibe ntchito zowonjezera zofunika.
calls.h5p1: Pogwiritsa ntchito `getDisplayMedia`. Client akuwonjezera nyimbo yatsopano ku PeerConnection yomwe ilipo; renegotiates kupereka/yankho.
calls.h5p2: Olandira akuwonetsa chophimba chogawana ngati vidiyo yosiyana. Pa foni yam'manja, kugawana zenera kumafuna chilolezo cha OS-level - malangizo a iOS, Android imawonetsa zokambirana zamakina.
calls.h6p1: WebRTC yopangidwa ndi NetEQ imayendetsa kutaya ndi jitter. Pakuwonongeka kwakukulu, kasitomala amasiya kuwongolera kapena kuyimitsa kanema kwathunthu pomwe akusunga mawu.
calls.h6p2: Kuzizira kwa 500 ms kumayambitsa kuyesa kulumikizanso (ICE kuyambiranso). Ogwiritsa amawona "Kulumikizanso ..." pamwamba.
calls.h1_a: Kuyimba foni kumakweranso chimodzimodzi WebSocket amagwiritsidwa ntchito pocheza. Node ndiyongoyimba basi - imagulitsa SDP ndi ICE pakati pa anzawo koma osakhudza atolankhani.
calls.h1_b: MAPOSTO Oyimbira `/api/calls/{room_id}/start` ndi `{kanema, audio}`. Node imagawa `call_id`, imawulutsa `{mtundu:"c", mtundu:"itani", call_id, video, audio}` kuchipinda. Zolemba za Callee `/api/calls/{call_id}/accept` → `{mtundu:"c", mtundu:"zalandiridwa"}`. SDP kusinthana kwa kupereka/mayankho: `{kind:"offer", sdp}` → `{kind:"yankho", sdp}`. ICE ofuna: `{kind:"candidate", ice}` × N mpaka PeerConnection inene kuti `yolumikizidwa`.
calls.h1_c: SDP + ICE siginecha ndiye muyezo WebRTC wofotokozedwa mu RFC 8839 ndi 8841. Vortex sakupanga kalikonse pano; ndikuyenda komweko kwa Chrome, Firefox, ndi WebRTC laibulale iliyonse. Kusankha kwa node-monga-signaling-onkha kumachokera ku kuzindikira kuti SFU-style yotumizira mauthenga imagwirizanitsa bandwidth ndipo imafuna hardware yomwe sitikufuna kutumiza poyikirapo.
calls.h2_a: ICE amapeza njira kudzera mu NATs pogwiritsa ntchito host + server-reflexive + relay candidates. STUN ndi TURN mbali ya Vortex.
calls.h2_b: Mnzake aliyense amawerengera osankhidwa: wolandira (ma IP am'deralo), srflx (server-reflexive kudzera STUN), relay (TURN-allocated). Anzako amasinthanitsa onse ofuna; gulu lililonse limapanga "awiri", cheke cholumikizira chimatumiza STUN pempho lomanga pa UDP. Gulu loyamba lopambana limakhala njira yosankhidwa. Kumbuyo kwa ma symmetric NAT, awiriawiri otumizirana okha amagwira ntchito - ndipamene TURN relay imatumizanso media.
calls.h2_c: ICE idasinthidwa kukhala RFC 5245 mu 2010 ndikutsitsimutsidwa ngati RFC 8445 mu 2018. Kumbuyo kwa giredi-NAT, STUN imalephera pafupifupi 15 % ya nthawiyo ndipo ⟫ ndi yosavomerezeka. coturn ndiye gwero lotseguka TURN seva; timatumiza chifukwa njira ina (Twilio/Vonage yamalonda TURN) imadula pamphindi imodzi yamawu otumizidwa.
calls.h3_a: TURN zidziwitso ndi zanthawi yayitali HMAC-zosaina dzina lolowera / mawu achinsinsi operekedwa pa foni iliyonse, osati zinsinsi zanthawi yayitali.
calls.h3_b: Poyambira kuyimba, node imapanga `username = "<expiry_unix>:<user_id>"` ndi `password = base64(HMAC-SHA1(server_secret, username))`. Onse ali ndi TTL 24 h. Makasitomala amawagwiritsa ntchito mu RTCPeerConnection config. coturn imatsimikizira HMAC pakukhazikitsa gawo. Zolemba zomwe zidatha ntchito zimalephera cheke HMAC - amasiya kugwira ntchito popanda nkhokwe yochotsa.
calls.h3_c: Zakanthawi kochepa HMAC creds zimachokera ku RFC 5389 (STUN) ndipo ndizomwe zimapangidwira zilizonse WebRTC zomwe zimagwiritsidwa ntchito. Twilio, Google, Xirsys onse amachita. Njira ina - static TURN creds - imatuluka ngati kasitomala aliyense asokonezedwa. Zolemba zazifupi zimachepetsa zenera lowonongeka kukhala 24 h.
calls.h4_a: Audio ndi Opus pa 48 kHz ndi DTX; kanema ndi VP9 pulayimale / H.264 yobwerera kumbuyo / AV1 kusankha kulowa.
calls.h4_b: Audio: Opus 48 kHz, 6-128 kbps VBR. DTX (Discontinuous Transmission) imasiya kutumiza patakhala chete, ndikuyambiranso mawu. FEC nthawi zonse. Kanema: VP9 poyambira; H.264 yolengezedwa pazida zopanda hardware VP9 decode (iOS isanakwane A10 Bionic); AV1 yoperekedwa ngati mwayi wolowa nawo pamtengo wamakono. Simulcast pama foni am'magulu: woyimbayo amayika malingaliro atatu nthawi imodzi, SFU mafani apereke yoyenera kwa aliyense wowonera.
calls.h4_c: Opus ndi IETF's royalty-free audio codec (RFC 6716, 2012). VP9 ndi Google yotseguka ya H.265-yofanana. H.264 ndiyobwereranso chifukwa Apple yakhala ikuthandizira VP9 mpaka 2021. AV1 idayamba kugwira ntchito pama foni pambuyo pa iPhone 15 Pro (2023) ndi Pixel 8 (2023) adawonjezera decode ya hardware. Vortex's codec mix ndi chimodzimodzi Google Meet ntchito.
calls.h5_a: Kuyimba kwamagulu kumagwiritsa ntchito SFU (Selective Forwarding Unit) pa node. Aliyense amatsitsa kamodzi; SFU patsogolo kwa aliyense.
calls.h5_b: Kwa > anzake awiri omwe akuyiyimbira amalemba `/api/calls/{room_id}/group/start`. Node imazungulira SFU chitsanzo chomangidwa ndi kuyimba. Aliyense amatsegula PeerConnection ku SFU m'malo mwa mnzake wina aliyense. Uplink: iliyonse imatumiza mtsinje umodzi. Ulalo wotsitsa: SFU patsogolo mitsinje ya N-1. Magawo a Simulcast amatanthauza SFU amasankha chisankho choyenera pa bandwidth yomwe wowonera aliyense ali nayo.
calls.h5_c: SFU madeti omanga mpaka Jitsi's Videobridge (2013). Asanakwane SFU, WebRTC mafoni apagulu anali a mesh - mnzake aliyense amasunga mitsinje ya N-1, yomwe imakulirakulirabe. Zoom, Google Kumanani, Jitsi, Gulu la Signal limayimba ntchito zonse SFU. Vortex mafoni amagulu omvera okha amatumizidwa mu v0.0.8; mafoni amagulu amakanema ali pamseu wa v0.3.
calls.h6_a: Kugawana pazenera ndi njira yatsopano yotsatsira pa PeerConnection yomwe ilipo, yokambirananso kudzera pakupereka/yankho.
calls.h6_b: Wogwiritsa amapopera Gawani Screen → msakatuli / iOS / Android imayimba `getDisplayMedia()`. Kubwerera MediaStream ndikuwonjezeraTrack-ed ku PeerConnection. Kuyatsanso moto: kupereka / yankho latsopano ndi nyimbo yowonjezeredwa. Olandira akuwonetsa chophimba chogawidwa ngati chinthu chapadera chamavidiyo. Pa iOS, kugawana zenera kumafunikira Broadcast Upload Extension; pa Android, ntchito yakutsogolo + chilolezo cha MediaProjection.
calls.h6_c: getDisplayMedia idakhazikitsidwa mu 2017 ndipo ili mu msakatuli uliwonse kuyambira 2019. iOS's Broadcast Upload Extension idabwera mu iOS 11 (2017). Android MediaProjection yakhala yokhazikika kuyambira Lollipop (2015). Vortex kugawana skrini kutumizidwa mu v0.0.8.
