federation.title: Federation
federation.subtitle: Ma pubkey odalirika, miseche osayinidwa, ma DM ophatikizika.
federation.intro: Federation imalola ogwiritsa ntchito pa node A ogwiritsa ntchito pa node B. Ndiwolowa nawo pa wogwiritsa ntchito. Node pubkeys amadaliridwa momveka bwino; palibe "node iliyonse yomwe ingagwirizane ndi yanga".
federation.h1p1: Node iliyonse imasunga `mabungwe (pubkey, endpoint, health_score, added_at, added_by)`.
federation.h1p2: Kuwonjezera mnzanu kumafuna zochita za woyang'anira wosayina. Woyang'anira UI amawonetsa zala zakutali kuti ogwiritsa ntchito athe kutsimikizira kuti alibe gulu.
federation.h1p3: Anzanu ochotsedwa akhalabe mu DB yolembedwa kuti `revoked_at` kuti iwunikidwe. Zopempha zabungwe latsopano kuchokera ku pubkey yomweyo zimakanidwa mpaka olamulira atasiya kubweza.
federation.h2p1: Kutuluka kuchokera ku A kupita kwa wogwiritsa @ B: node A imakutira envulopu ya uthengawo ndi ma POST `/federation/deliver` pa node B.
federation.h2p2: Envelopu: `{source_node, target_user, inner_ciphertext, inner_nonce, sent_at, sig}`. Sig imakwirira chilichonse kupatula sig yokha.
federation.h2p3: Node B imatsimikizira siginecha motsutsana ndi `source_node` pubkey kuchokera patebulo la `mabungwe` ake. Chizindikiro chosavomerezeka → 401 + chochitika chowunikira.
federation.h3p1: Ngati B safikirika, A mizere mu `federation_outbox(target_node, payload, attempts, next_retry_at)`.
federation.h3p2: Kumbuyo kwachiwonetsero: 1s, 5s, 30s, 2min, 10min, 1h, yokhazikika pa 6h. Kulephera kosatha pambuyo pa masiku 14.
federation.h3p3: Chenjezo la opareshoni limayaka pamene kuzama kwa bokosi lotuluka>> Mauthenga 1000 — kukuwonetsa ulalo wokhazikika wachitaganya.
federation.h4p1: Ma 60 aliwonse nodi iliyonse imalira `GET /v1/health` pa mnzake aliyense. Nthawi yoyankhira + momwe yatsatiridwa.
federation.h4p2: Phindu la thanzi: loyamba 100. Nthawi iliyonse yopuma imachotsa 1; kupambana kulikonse kumawonjezera 1 (kapu 100). Zigoli 0 → chigwirizano chayimitsidwa kwa anzawowo.
federation.h4p3: Lofalitsidwa kudzera ku `GET /v1/peers` pamadeshibodi ogwiritsira ntchito.
federation.h1_a: Federation mu Vortex ndi ubale wodalirana pakati pa ogwiritsira ntchito ma node awiri. Node iliyonse imasindikiza kiyi yapagulu ya 32-byte Ed25519; mfundo ina imawonjezera patebulo `lodalilika_nodes` pambali pa mapeto ake ndi zigoli zathanzi.
federation.h1_b: Kuonjezera pubkey yodalirika kumafuna kuti wogwiritsa ntchito asaine pempho la admin ndi kiyi yomasulira yake. The UI imawonetsa chala chakutali mu mawonekedwe a 64-hex-char kuti ma admin athe kutsimikizira kuti alibe gulu. Akangowonjezeredwa, envulopu iliyonse ya federal imatsimikiziridwa motsutsana ndi siginecha ya pubkey ya Ed25519 - zabodza zimapezeka nthawi yomweyo ndikulowetsedwa. Kubweza ndikofewa: mzerewu umakhalabe wolembedwa kuti `wathetsedwa_at` kuti awunikenso, koma siginecha ya envelopu ikulephera.
federation.h1_c: Njirayi idachokera ku federation ya Matrix (komwe seva iliyonse imatsatsa kiyi yosainira ndipo chochitika chilichonse chimasaina nawo) komanso kuchokera ku imelo DKIM (komwe DNS imasindikiza makiyi osayina). Matrix yatsimikizira kuti mtunduwo umagwira ntchito pamlingo waukulu - maukonde awo ali ndi ma seva opitilira 100k. Zosiyanasiyana za Vortex zimasiyana pakufuna kulowa molunjika m'malo mwa lamulo la Matrix la "seva iliyonse imatha kuchita nawo mwachisawawa"; tidagulitsana kuti tipeze chitetezo cholimba motsutsana ndi chitaganya chachinyengo.
federation.h1_f:
trusted_nodes mzere:
  pubkey: 32 bytes Ed25519
  mapeto: https://…
  health_score : int [0, 100]
  added_pa: unix_ms
  add_by : admin_user_id
  revoked_at : unix_ms | NULL
federation.h2_a: Uthenga wodutsana umakhala ndi envulopu yofanana E2E ngati ya m'deralo, yokulungidwa mu envulopu yakunja yosaina yomwe imatsimikizira malo otumizira kumalo olandirira.
federation.h2_b: Node A ikufuna kutumiza kwa user@B. Khwerero 1: Serilize `{source_node, target_user, inner_ciphertext, inner_nonce, sent_at}`. Khwerero 2: Isayina ma byte osakanikirana ndi kiyi yachinsinsi ya Ed25519 → `sig`. Khwerero 3: A POSTs the tuple to `POST /federation/deliver` pa mfundo B. Gawo 4: B amayang'ana `source_node` mu `trusted_nodes`, amatsimikizira `sig`, fufuzani `sent_at` motsutsana ndi replay-zenera, ndi kukakamira envelopu yamkati muzolemba zake `mauthenga. Wolandira wolandila amawona chimodzimodzi ngati uthenga wamba - gawo la federal silikuwoneka kwa ogwiritsa ntchito.
federation.h2_c: Envulopu yakunja yosainidwayo yabwerekedwa ku zochitika za fedulo za `m.room.message` za Matrix. Zenera loseweranso (mphindi 5) ndi kufunikira koti masitampu osainidwa ndi gwero agwirizane ndi wotchi yakukhoma adabwerekedwa ku DKIM. Kumayambiriro Vortex (v0.0.2) adayesa bungwe losasainidwa ndi TLS ziphaso za kasitomala; tidasinthira ku siginecha yapayload mu v0.0.5 titazindikira ma cert a kasitomala sapulumuka zolemetsa ndikubisa kutsimikizika kwenikweni kuchokera pagawo la ntchito.
federation.h3_a: Node yakutali ikakhala yosafikirika, malo otumizira amaika pamzere emvulopu mu `federation_outbox' yake ndikuyeseranso ndi exponential backoff.
federation.h3_b: Ndondomeko yobwerera: 1s, 5s, 30s, 2min, 10min, 1h, yotsekedwa pa 6h. Pakuyesa kulikonse kumene kwalephera, mzere wowonjezera wa 'zoyesa` ndi `next_retry_at` wakhazikitsidwa kuti ukhale pano + panopo. Wantchito wakumbuyo (`app/federation/outbox_worker.py`) amadzutsa ma 5 aliwonse ndi kutenga mizere pomwe `next_retry_at <= now()`. Kupambana kumachotsa mzere; Masiku 14 olephera alembeni kuti ndizokhazikika ndikutumiza chenjezo la admin.
federation.h3_c: Kumbuyo kowonekera kokhala ndi denga ndi njira yomwe Kafka amagwiritsa ntchito poyesanso opanga komanso SMTP amagwiritsa ntchito makalata obweza. Kapu yamasiku 14 ikugwirizana ndi malingaliro SMTP's RFC 5321. Mabaibulo oyambilira adagwiritsa ntchito zoyeserera zokhazikika za 60-sekondi zomwe zidayambitsa kukwera kwamagulu a bingu pamene anzawo adabweranso pa intaneti atazimitsa; exponential kufalikira kunakhazikitsa mu v0.0.7.
federation.h3_f:
kuchedwa(n) = min(6h, 1s · 2ⁿ) kwa n = 0, 1, 2, …

Yesaninso ndondomeko: 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s, 32s, 64s, 128s, 256s, ..., 6h
chenjezo: outbox_depth> 1000 kwa> 5 min
federation.h4_a: Masekondi 60 aliwonse nodi iliyonse imayimba kumapeto kwa mnzake `/v1/health`. Zotsatira zimakwera pakuchita bwino, kutsika pakulephera, zokhazikika mu [0, 100].
federation.h4_b: Zotsatira zimayamba pa 100 powonjezera. Kupambana kulikonse kumawonjezera +1 (yotsekeredwa pa 100), nthawi iliyonse yotuluka imachotsa -1 (yotsitsidwa pa 0). Zigoli 0 ziyimitsa mgwirizano ndi mnzawoyo - mauthenga atsopano pa mzere wotuluka, palibe kuyesa kwatsopano kotuluka mpaka chigoli chikwere pamwamba pa 20. Kugoletsa kumawonetsedwa kudzera `GET /v1/peers` pamadashibodi oyendetsa komanso kudzera `/metrics` ya Prometheus. Kutsika kwadzidzidzi kwa anzanu angapo pawindo lalifupi kumayambitsa chenjezo la "network partitions".
federation.h4_c: Kupambana kwa AIMD-style kudalitsidwa ndi zenera la TCP la kusokonekera komanso damper ya Akamai yowunika thanzi. Gawo la asymmetric ± 1 (m'malo mwa TCP kutsika) kumapangitsa kuchira pang'onopang'ono kusiyana ndi kulephera, zomwe zimakondera dongosololi kuti likhale tcheru - titha kuyimitsa chitaganya ngati sitikudziwa bwino kuposa kutumiza mauthenga obwerezabwereza kudzera pa ulalo wopukutira. Yowonjezedwa mu v0.0.6 pambuyo pa mnzake wochita molakwika adasefukira anzawo awiri abwino ndikuyesanso.
federation.h4_f:
pakuchita bwino: mphambu = min(100, mphambu + 1)
pa nthawi yake: mphambu = max(0, mphambu - 1)
ngati mphambu == 0: pause_federation (mnzake)
ngati mphambu>= 20: resume_federation(mnzake) // hysteresis

gossip.title: Gokuseka ndi kupeza anzawo
gossip.subtitle: Momwe ma node amapezana wina ndi mnzake popanda kaundula wapakati.
gossip.intro: Kupitilira pamndandanda wotsimikiziridwa ndi wowongolera, Vortex node amanena miseche anzawo pakati pawo. Izi zimapeza ma node atsopano pomwe ogwiritsa ntchito amawazungulira, ngakhale wowongolera sanawatsimikizirebe.
gossip.h1p1: Pazaka 60 zilizonse, node imasankha mnzake mwachisawawa ndikutumiza fyuluta ya 256-bit Bloom ya anzawo odziwika. Anzanu amayankha ndi anzawo NOT muzosefera, kuphatikiza zosefera zake. Bandwidth ndi `O(zatsopano × 32 byte)`, nthawi zambiri imakhala yosachepera 1 KB pozungulira.
gossip.h1p2: Mnzake aliyense wotsatsa amasainidwa ndi malo otsatsa. Makasitomala amatsimikizira siginecha akakumana koyamba - wachiwembu sangapusire mnzake kuti amve miseche.
gossip.h1p3: Kuzungulira kuli ndi malire: kusinthanitsa kumodzi pa mnzake pa 30s (zenera lotsetsereka).
gossip.h2p1: Node zatsopano zimayamba ndi 8 hardcoded bootstrap controller. Poyamba miseche imapeza anzawo ambiri; netiweki imasinthasintha mu ~ 1 miniti.
gossip.h2p2: Mndandanda wa bootstrap ukhoza kusinthidwa kudzera mwa `.env` `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=pubkey1@endpoint1,pubkey2@endpoint2,...`.
gossip.h3p1: Mnzake aliyense wotsatsa ayenera kusaina ndi kiyi yotulutsa ya Ed25519. Kupanga chilengezo cha anzanu kumafuna kuba kiyi yovomerezeka.
gossip.h3p2: Umboni wa ntchito (yosinthika, yosasinthika 2 ^ 18 zotsogola ziro) pazolembetsa zatsopano za anzawo zimasunga mafunde ambiri a Sybil-bot kukhala osatheka.
gossip.h3p3: Dongosolo lodziwika bwino: anzawo omwe amachita zoyipa (ma signature oyipa, zolengeza zabodza, kutha kwa nthawi mobwerezabwereza) ali ndi mbiri yawo yovunda. Zero mbiri → blacklist.
gossip.h1_a: Ma 60 aliwonse node iliyonse imasankha mnzake mwachisawawa ndikutumiza fyuluta ya 256-bit Bloom kufotokoza mwachidule anzawo odziwika. Anzanu amayankha ndi anzawo atsopano + fyuluta yakeyake. Bandwidth ndi `O(zatsopano_zanzake × 32 mabayiti)`.
gossip.h1_b: Zosefera za Bloom k=ma hashe 5, m=256 bits. Node A imayika peer_ids zake zonse zodziwika. Amatumiza kwa anzawo B. B amafunsa zosefera ndi mnzake aliyense; chilichonse chomwe chikuphonya, B chimatumiza ku A (kuphatikiza fyuluta yake). A amachita cheke chomwecho mobwerera. Pambuyo pa kusinthanitsa mfundo zonse zimagawana pafupifupi chidziwitso chofanana. Kusinthana kofananira: 200-800 byte. Zosintha zimasintha pamanetiweki pafupifupi ~ 5 (mphindi 5) chifukwa cha miseche.
gossip.h1_c: Miseche ya Bloom-sefa idayamba ku Cornell's 1998 bimodal multicast paper. Apache Cassandra amagwiritsa ntchito kwa umembala; Bitcoin kwa transaction relay; IPFS pokonza DHT. The O(log N) convergence Property ndi yomwe imapangitsa kuti ikhale yoyenera kuti tigwiritse ntchito - sitifuna malingaliro apadziko lonse lapansi, kungodziwa zosagwirizana ndi anzawo. Kukula kwa zosefera (256 bits) kumasinthidwa kotero kuti kuchuluka kwabodza ndi <1 % pa anzawo 100.
gossip.h2_a: Node zatsopano zimayamba ndi 8 hardcoded bootstrap controller. Poyamba miseche amapeza zambiri; zimasintha mu ~ 1 miniti.
gossip.h2_b: `.env` zombo ndi `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=pubkey1@endpoint1,pubkey2@endpoint2,...`. Poyambira, node imayesa chilichonse mwadongosolo. Woyamba kuyankha amapereka mndandanda wa anzawo (kudzera `GET /v1/trusted_nodes`). Node imayika izi patebulo la anzawo am'deralo, ndikuziyika ngati zoyambira, ndikuyambitsa miseche ya 60s. Mipikisano yotsatira imapeza anzawo.
gossip.h2_c: Ma bootstraps olimba ndi ofanana ndi Bitcoin, Ethereum, IPFS ntchito. Njira ina - DHT yopezeka - imafuna kulowa koyamba. Vortex's 8 bootstrap count idasankhidwa chifukwa kukhala > 4 kumapereka mphamvu motsutsana ndi 2-3 zochitika zapanthawi yomweyo, ndipo <16 imasunga fayilo ya `.env` kuti iwerengeke. Sinthani kutumiza kulikonse posintha `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS`.
gossip.h3_a: Mnzake aliyense wotsatsa ayenera kusainidwa ndi kiyi yotulutsa ya Ed25519 yochokera. Wowukira sangathe kupanga anzawo pa intaneti.
gossip.h3_b: Node A ikatsatsa anzawo P mu miseche kupita ku nodi B, A akuphatikizapo `P.pubkey`, `P.endpoint`, ndi sitampu yanthawi, zonse zosainidwa ndi kiyi yotulutsa ya P. B amatsimikizira siginecha isanakhulupirire P. Ngati B pambuyo pake alumikizana ndi P ndi P's TLS cert + kugunda kwamtima koyamba sikukugwirizana ndi pubkey yotsatsa, malondawo amalembedwa kuti ndi poizoni ndipo amafalitsidwa pansi.
gossip.h3_c: Zotsatsa za anzawo zomwe zasaina ndizotsutsana ndi Sybil primitive kuchokera ku Chord (2001) ndi Kademlia (2002). Mauthenga a addr a Bitcoin amagwiritsa ntchito chitsanzo chofooka (palibe siginecha, amadalira mtengo wogwirizanitsa monga Sybil deterrent); Zizindikiro za Ethereum discv5. Vortex adatengera zotsatsa zosainidwa mu v0.0.6 pambuyo poti wowukira testnet adalengeza anzawo abodza 1000 kudzera munjira imodzi yovomerezeka.
gossip.h1_f:
fyuluta: k=5, m=256 bits
insert(x) = kwa ine mu 0..k: fyuluta[hash_i(x) mod m] = 1
query(x) = kwa ine mu 0..k: cheke fyuluta[hash_i(x) mod m]
zabodza pa anzawo 100, 256 bits, k=5: ~0.4 %
gossip.h2_f:
.env:
  BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=abcd…@https://a.example,efgh…@https://b.example

chiyambi:
  za anzanu mu BOOTSTRAP_PEERS:
    yesani: anzanu ← peer.get('/v1/trusted_nodes'); kuswa
    kupatula: pitilizani
  yambani miseche

stealth.title: Stealth network
stealth.subtitle: Zigawo zisanu, 28 makina. Chilichonse kuyambira TLS padding kupita ku Tor onion services.
stealth.intro: Vortex amatengera mdani wadziko. Zosungirako zobisika zimakhala zosanjikiza kotero ngakhale zigawo zakunja zitalambalalitsidwa, zamkati zimaperekabe ntchito yonyozeka koma yogwira ntchito.
stealth.h1p1: Layer 1 - zala zala normalization. Imayimitsa osasintha.
stealth.h1p2: Layer 2 - mawonekedwe / kukula morphing. Imayimitsa magulu osanthula magalimoto.
stealth.h1p3: Gawo 3 - kubisa kwa protocol. Imasiya kugwira ntchito DPI.
stealth.h1p4: Layer 4 - zoyendera pluggable. Imagwira ntchito mumanetiweki omwe amatsekereza pulayimale yathu.
stealth.h1p5: Layer 5 - njira yomaliza yobwereranso. Anyezi, BMP, multi-hop relay. Zimagwira ntchito ngati palibe chilichonse.
stealth.h2p1: TLS 1.3 ClientHello imagwirizana ndi Chrome Windows 11 byte-for-byte. JA3/JA4 hashi ikufanana ndi Chrome 120 — ayi Vortex-zala zala zenizeni.
stealth.h2p2: Zolemba-wosanjikiza: zolembedwa zonse TLS zili pa 16 KB. Makulidwe a paketi amafanana ndi kuchuluka kwa osatsegula.
stealth.h2p3: Kutumiza kosalekeza: pamzere umatulutsa chimango chimodzi ma N ms aliwonse mosasamala kanthu za ntchito. Nthawi zosagwira ntchito zimatulutsa mafelemu osachita kanthu olembedwa mu envulopu yamkati kuti olandira awataya.
stealth.h2p4: Nthawi jitter: 0-50 ms kuchedwa mwachisawawa pa egress kuti agonjetse latency-based DPI.
stealth.h3p1: YouTube-720p morpher: kugawa kwapaketi, kuphulika kwapaketi, ndi mipata yachete zimagwirizana ndi mtsinje wamoyo wa YouTube. Osankha omwe akufunafuna kugunda kwa mtima kwa ma messenger amalephera kufanana.
stealth.h3p2: Kuchulukitsa: kuyenda komweko kugawanika Wi-Fi, ma cellular, ndi chilichonse chogwira VPN nthawi imodzi. Ressembly pa wolandila. Imagonjetsa kupanga njira imodzi.
stealth.h3p3: WebRTC njira yanjira ya data: pomwe TLS yatsekedwa koma WebRTC imagwira ntchito, Vortex imadutsa munjira DTLS-SRTP kupita kwa mnzake wodziwika.
stealth.h3p4: Kulumikizana kwachinyengo: magawo atatu osagwira ntchito TLS mpaka Google, YouTube, ndi Cloudflare. Observer amawona machitidwe a msakatuli wabwinobwino.
stealth.h4p1: DoH (RFC 8484): zonse DNS zathetsedwa kudzera pa DoH mpaka Cloudflare / Google / Quad9. ISP amangowona HTTPS kwa otsimikiza okhawo, osati mndandanda weniweni wa madambwe.
stealth.h4p2: ECH (Client Encrypted Moni): SNI yosungidwa ndi kiyi yosindikizidwa mu DNS HTTPS rekodi. Ongoyang'ana chabe sangathe kuwona dzina lamalo omwe akupita.
stealth.h4p3: Kuzindikira kwa probe: node imatsata zopempha popanda gawo la auth. Zofufuza zitatu zomwe zidalephera kuchokera pa IP mu 5 min ziyambitsa "decoy site" mode - yomwe IP tsopano ikuwona tsamba lofikira HTML ndi 200 OK.
stealth.h4p4: DGA (Domain Generation Algorithm): jenereta yodziwika bwino yomwe idabzala lero. Ngati malo omaliza atsekedwa, makasitomala amawerengera wotsatira ndikuyesa.
stealth.h5p1: vmess / vless / trojan / shadowtls: zoyendera zamtundu wa V2Ray ndi cholumikizira JSON config.
stealth.h5p2: Zowona: TLS-mkati-TLS ngalande. Zolinga zakunja zogwirana chanza www.microsoft.com; kugwirana chanza mkati ndi Vortex. Zofufuza zotsutsana ndi zakunja zimatumizidwa ku Microsoft kotero kuti kufufuza mwachangu sikuwulula kalikonse.
stealth.h5p3: Snowflake: asakatuli odzipereka amatumiza Vortex kuchuluka kwa magalimoto pa WebRTC. Ogwiritsa omwe akukhazikitsa chowonjezera cha Snowflake amapereka chivundikiro.
stealth.h5p4: NaiveProxy: imasintha HTTPS zofufuza kuti ziphatikize ndi machitidwe a Chromium mpaka ku microsecond.
stealth.h6p1: Ntchito za anyezi: node iliyonse imadziwonetsanso ngati `.onion`. Makasitomala omwe ali ndi chithandizo cha Tor amagwera izi zikalephera chilichonse.
stealth.h6p2: Protocol ya Blind Mailbox (BMP): sungani ndi kutumiza mauthenga mosadziwikiratu. Onani BMP mutu.
stealth.h6p3: Multi-hop relay: mauthenga amatha kudutsa mpaka ma node 5 apakatikati, iliyonse ndikuwonjezera gawo la envelopu. Monga Tor koma mu mauna athu.
stealth.h6p4: OHTTP (RFC 9458): kunyalanyaza HTTP kudzera pakupatsirana. Palibe gulu limodzi lomwe limawona pempho ndi mayankho.
stealth.h1_a: Stealth imapangidwa ngati magawo asanu odziyimira pawokha. Chigawo chilichonse chimagonjetsa gulu losiyana la mdani. Kulephera kwa wosanjikiza wina kumatsitsanso kwina - sikutsika.
stealth.h1_b: Layer 1 imasintha zala zathu za TLS kukhala zopanda pake DPI sizingagawike. Layer 2 morphs mawonekedwe a traffic kuti aziwoneka ngati akukhamukira. Layer 3 imabisa protocol kudzera pa ECH / DoH / njira zoyankhira. Gawo 4 limasinthira kumayendedwe omangika (vmess, zenizeni, Snowflake) pomwe choyambirira chatsekedwa. Layer 5 ndi malo omaliza: Tor anyezi, BMP, multi-hop relay.
stealth.h1_c: Mtundu wosanjikiza umachokera ku zomangamanga za Tor's pluggable-transports (2013). Vortex adawonjezera zigawo zisanu m'malo mwa atatu a Tor chifukwa pofika chaka cha 2025 malo odanawo adaphatikizapo DPI omwe amazindikira zonyamula za Tor (Great Firewall 2020, Iran 2022). Gawo lililonse la Vortex lidayambitsidwa pambuyo pa zomwe zidachitika kumunda: L1 pambuyo pa kutsekereza kwa Kazakhstan (2019-chofanana), L2 pambuyo pakuphwanyidwa kwa Iran mu 2022, L3 pambuyo pakuzindikirika kwa China ku 2020 DoH, L40 L40 pambuyo pa midadada 53 ya Turkey.
stealth.h1_f:
Gulu la adani | Kugonjetsedwa ndi
------------------ | ------------
kungokhala DPI | L1 (zisindikizo zala)
kusanthula magalimoto | L2 (mawonekedwe)
yogwira DPI | L3 (kubisala)
kutsekereza ndi IP | L4 (maulendo)
china chilichonse | L5 (anyezi / BMP)
stealth.h2_a: Layer 1 imapangitsa Vortex kuchuluka kwa magalimoto kusazindikirika kuchokera ku Chrome Windows 11 pa TLS wosanjikiza.
stealth.h2_b: ClientHello kuyitanitsa, mndandanda wazowonjezera, mndandanda wazinthu, ALPN mfundo - zonse zakonzedwa kuti zigwirizane ndi ma byte enieni a Chrome 120. JA3/JA4 hash ikufanana ndi kutulutsidwa kwa Chrome komweko. TLS kujambula padding mpaka 16 KB. Wotumiza pafupipafupi amatulutsa chimango chimodzi N ms iliyonse yokhala ndi ma dummy fillers pa nthawi yopanda ntchito. Nthawi jitter 0-50 ms kugonjetsa latency kusanthula. Malumikizidwe onyenga ku Google, YouTube, Cloudflare amathamangira kumbuyo pakapita nthawi 45s.
stealth.h2_c: JA3/JA4 zolemba zala zidasindikizidwa ndi akatswiri a Salesforce mu 2017. Pofika chaka cha 2019 zinali zokhazikika m'mabizinesi DPI. Vortex Kusintha kwa zala zala kumatengera uTLS, laibulale ya Go yomwe Snowflake amagwiritsa ntchito pa cholinga chomwecho. Otumiza pafupipafupi ndi doko lachindunji lamalingaliro a WireGuard a "traffic traffic".
stealth.h3_a: Layer 2 morphs traffic kuti iwoneke ngati media yotsatsira zambiri m'malo mocheza.
stealth.h3_b: YouTube-720p morpher: kugawa kwapaketi kumafanana ndi 720p YouTube live stream (tebulo lamphamvu), machesi ophulika, machesi achetechete. Kuchulukitsa: mtsinje womveka womwewo umagawanika Wi-Fi, ma cellular, ndi chilichonse chogwira VPN nthawi imodzi; wolandila amalumikizananso mu dongosolo la nambala. WebRTC kubweza kwa tchanelo cha data: TLS ikatsekedwa koma WebRTC idutsa, tunnel Vortex kudzera pa DTLS-SRTP njira ya data kupita kwa mnzake wodziwika.
stealth.h3_c: Kafukufuku wa traffic morphing amabwerera ku Wright et al. 2009. Obfs4 idakhazikitsa ngati "morph" sub-mode mu 2014. Meek+domain-fronting idatiphunzitsa kuti mawonekedwe amafunikira monga kubisa. YouTube makamaka idasankhidwa chifukwa ndiye tsamba limodzi lalikulu kwambiri lomwe silinatsekedwe pamanetiweki ambiri oletsa - kubisala mkati mwamayendedwe owoneka ngati YouTube "ndikubisala pagulu".
stealth.h3_f:
paketi_size[i] ~ P(kukula | YT-720p)
send_delay[i] ~ P(kuchedwa | YT-720p)
dummy_frames amayikidwa pa nthawi yopanda kanthu kuti asunge mawonekedwe a envelopu
stealth.h4_a: Layer 3 imabisa chinsinsi cha protocol - SNI, DNS, ma code oyankha.
stealth.h4_b: DoH (RFC 8484): onse DNS amadutsa DNS-over-HTTPS mpaka Cloudflare/Google/Quad9. ISP amangowona HTTPS kwa otsimikizawo. ECH (RFC 9460): SNI imasungidwa ndi kiyi yosindikizidwa mu DNS HTTPS rekodi. Oyang'anitsitsa amangowona kutsogolo kokha IP. Kuzindikira kwa kafukufuku: ma node amatsata ma IP osavomerezeka akugunda `/api/*`; zolephera zitatu mu 5 min tembenuzani IP ku "decoy mode" - kuti IP tsopano akuwona tsamba lokhazikika HTML ndi 200 OK. DGA: jenereta ya deterministic domeni yomwe ili ndi tsiku la lero kuti makasitomala apeze kubweza pamene pulayimale yatsekedwa.
stealth.h4_c: DoH idakhazikitsidwa mu Firefox 2018 ndipo idakhala yosasinthika pa Chrome mu 2019. ECH idadutsa zolemba zisanu isanakhazikitsidwe mu 2024 - Vortex zothandizira zotumizidwa panthawi ya draft-13 ndipo tsopano ikuthandizira chomaliza. Ma probe-response decoys adabwerekedwa kuchokera pamapangidwe ofatsa a 2014 ndikuyengedwa mu 2023 pambuyo poti ofufuza aku Iran adazindikira ofatsa ndi nthawi yake yoyankha.
stealth.h5_a: Gawo 4 limagwiritsa ntchito zoyendera zomangika - ngalande za chipani chachitatu zomwe zimawoneka ngati zina.
stealth.h5_b: vmess/vless/trojan: zoyendera zakunja zamtundu wa V2Ray; config JSON. Zowona: TLS-mkati-TLS ngalande komwe kugwirana chanza kwakunja kumatsata www.microsoft.com; kugwirana chanza mkati ndi Vortex. Zofufuza zogwira ntchito kunja zimatumizidwa ku Microsoft, kotero kufufuza sikuwulula kalikonse. Snowflake: asakatuli odzipereka amatumiza Vortex kupitilira WebRTC; palibe infra kumbali yathu. NaiveProxy: imasintha HTTPS zofufuza kuti zigwirizane ndi machitidwe enieni a Chromium.
stealth.h5_c: V2Ray's VMess idayambitsidwa mu 2015 ndi gulu la anti-censorship la China. Trojan idakhazikitsidwa mu 2019. Zowona zidachokera ku 2022 - kuyankha kwa Great Firewall's TLS kuzindikira zala zala. Snowflake ndiye Tor Project's 2020 m'malo mwa obfs4; Vortex adawonjezera thandizo mu v0.0.9 pambuyo pa Iran 2023 malo onse olowera Tor.
stealth.h5_f:
chitsanzo chokhazikika:
  sevaName: www.microsoft.com
  Kuchokera: www.microsoft.com:443
  shortIds: ["<mwachisawawa>"]
kasitomala amalumikizana ndi IP, SNI=www.microsoft.com, timayimira yankho lenileni Microsoft
ngati njira ikugwirizana ndi shortId+auth ⇒ njira yopita ku Vortex
stealth.h6_a: Layer 5 ndiye thumba lomaliza lazamisala: ntchito ya anyezi, BMP sitolo-ndi-mtsogolo, multi-hop relay, OHTTP.
stealth.h6_b: Node iliyonse imasindikiza adilesi ya `.anyezi`. Makasitomala omwe ali ndi wolandila wokhoza Tor amagwa pomwe TLS + L1-L4 onse alephera. BMP (Protocol ya Blind Mailbox): wotumiza amaponya blob yobisidwa pamalo aliwonse olembedwa ndi `HKDF(recipient_pubkey, "bmp-v1")`; miseche imafalikira; wolandira amakoka kuchokera mnyumba zawo. Multi-hop: mauthenga amadumpha mpaka ma node 5 apakati, iliyonse ndikuwonjezera envelopu - monga Tor koma mkati mwa mauna athu. OHTTP (RFC 9458): kunyalanyaza HTTP kudzera pa relay kotero palibe gulu limodzi lomwe limawona pempho ndi kuyankha.
stealth.h6_c: Ntchito za anyezi zinayamba mu 2004 ku Tor. BMP ndizopanga zathu, zotengera miseche yobisika ya Tor. Magalasi a Multi-hop relay osindikizidwa ndi Signal's sender routing kuphatikiza anyezi. OHTTP idachokera ku 2024, yopangidwa ndi Cloudflare ndi Apple ya telemetry yosunga zinsinsi; tidatengera mu v0.0.9 ngati kubwerera komaliza.
stealth.h6_f:
BMP mailbox_id = HKDF(recipient_pk, "bmp-v1", 32)
Kusungitsa: POST /bmp/dipozit {mailbox_id, blob}
Kutenga: GET /bmp/mauthenga (auth'd)
TTL: 7200 s |  Kuphulika kwakukulu: 1 MB |  Max pa node: 500 MB

bmp.title: Blind Mailbox Protocol
bmp.subtitle: Osadziŵika sitolo-ndi-patsogolo pa mauthenga kudzera pa miseche mesh.
bmp.intro: BMP imalola wotumiza kuyika uthenga pamalo aliwonse osaulula. Uthengawo umachita miseche mpaka kukafika panyumba ya wolandirayo, kumene amangolemba mwachizolowezi.
bmp.h1p1: Wotumiza apeza `mailbox_id = HKDF(recipient_pubkey, info: "bmp-v1", len: 32)`. Wotumiza yekha (yemwe amadziwa recipient_pubkey) angawerenge; wolandira akudziwanso.
bmp.h1p2: Wotumiza `POST /bmp/deposit` ndi `{mailbox_id, blob}` kumalo aliwonse amiseche.
bmp.h1p3: Malo ogulitsa ma Node mpaka 7200 s. Node imaphatikizanso mailbox_id musefa ya Bloom yotsatira ya miseche.
bmp.h1p4: Ma node ena amakoka mabulogu a mailbox_ids omwe amawasamalira kwanuko (olandira pa mfundo zawo).
bmp.h1p5: Makasitomala a wolandira amasankha `GET /bmp/messages` ndikulemba mabulogu aliwonse atsopano ndi zida zake zanthawi zonse.
bmp.h2p1: Palibe node yomwe ingalumikizane ndi blob kwa wotumiza - kulumikizana kwa wotumiza TLS kumadziwika komwe kumachokera IP, koma unyolo wa anyezi pakati pa wotumiza ndi woyamba BMP node imachotsanso.
bmp.h2p2: Omwe amabisala: blob imasungidwa ndi pubkey ya wolandira. Ma node apakatikati amangowona chingwe chowoneka bwino komanso mailbox_id mwachisawawa.
bmp.h2p3: Palibe chitsimikizo cha kutumiza kwa wotumiza. Nthawi zambiri semantics.
bmp.h3p1: Kukula kwakukulu kwa blob: 1 MB. Zolipira zazikulu ziyenera kudulidwa kudzera mumayendedwe wamba wamba.
bmp.h3p2: Kusungirako kwakukulu pa node: 500 MB ya madipoziti onse. LRU kuthamangitsidwa pa kapu. Othandizira amatha kuyimba.
bmp.h3p3: Spam: per-IP mtengo wosungitsa wochepera 10 / min. Ma ID a bokosi la makalata omwe amawonedwa nthawi zopitilira 3 / ola pa node imodzi amakhala ndi malire ngati akuganiziridwa kuti kusefukira kwa madzi.
bmp.h4p1: Olandila mwaufulu: Wotumiza safunika kudziwa malo akunyumba a wolandira.
bmp.h4p2: Kulumikizana kwakanthawi: ma blobs amadikirira mpaka wolandirayo alumikizanenso ndi zisankho.
bmp.h4p3: Kuyimba mluzu mosadziwika: anyezi wotumiza + BMP = palibe metadata ya yemwe adayika chiyani.
bmp.h1_a: BMP ndi malo ogulitsa ndi otsogola osadziwika. Wotumiza amagwetsa blob pamalo aliwonse omwe amalola miseche; blob imadikirira mubokosi la makalata longoyikidwa ku kiyi ya anthu onse ya wolandirayo.
bmp.h1_b: Wotumiza amawerengera `mailbox_id = HKDF(recipient_pubkey, "bmp-v1", 32)`. Ndi munthu yekha amene akudziwa `recipient_pubkey` yemwe angawerenge izo - wolandira akudziwa, wotumizayo akudziwa, wina sadziwa. Tumizani MAPOST `{mailbox_id, blob}` kumalo aliwonse amiseche. Node imasunga awiriwa mpaka 7200 s (2 h), ndikulengeza mailbox_id musefa yotsatira ya miseche ya Bloom. Ma node ena omwe akuwona mailbox_id kwanuko akufanana ndi bokosi lamakalata lomwe lasungidwa ndi wogwiritsa amakoka blob ndikupita kwa kasitomala wa wosutayo.
bmp.h1_c: BMP idapangidwa kuchokera koyambirira ndi gulu la Vortex. Tidazimanga chifukwa palibe mthenga wamba yemwe anali wokonzeka kugwiritsa ntchito ndalama zomwe zimafunikira kubisa metadata kumapeto mpaka kumapeto - chinthu chilichonse chachikulu chomwe chidatumizidwa kubisala koma chinasiya gawo lotseguka, kotero seva idadziwabe yemwe adalankhula ndi ndani komanso liti. Mkati mwa gululo tidapitiliza kunena kuti "mthenga wotetezedwa yemwe amadumphira pazithunzi za anthu amakhala otetezeka theka." BMP ndiye yankho lathu: wotumiza, wolandira, ndi zomwe zili mkati zonse zimakhala zosamveka; palibe mfundo imodzi mu mesh yomwe imakhala ndi zidutswa zokwanira kuti akonzenso zokambirana. Imadutsa nsalu za Vortex za miseche m'malo mokhala ndi zida zomangika, zomwe zidapangitsa kuti mtengo wamalonda ukhale wokwanira komanso kapangidwe kake kawonekedwe kanyumba.
bmp.h1_f:
mailbox_id = HKDF(recipient_pubkey, info="bmp-v1", len=32)

Kusungitsa: POST /bmp/dipoziti {mailbox_id: 32B, blob: ≤1 MB}
Lengezani: miseche Bloom fyuluta += mailbox_id
Kutenga: GET /bmp/mauthenga (auth'd) → mabulogu a mailbox_ids
TTL: 7200 s |  pa-node kapu yosungiramo: 500 MB |  mtengo wa depositi: 10/mphindi/IP
bmp.h2_a: BMP imapereka zinthu zitatu zodziyimira pawokha: kubisa-otumiza, kubisa wolandila, kubisa zomwe zili.
bmp.h2_b: Kubisa kwa Sender: TLS kulumikizidwa ku malo osungira kumawulula gwero IP; kuwonjezera Tor hop kapena unyolo wodutsa anyezi kumalo oyamba BMP node kumachotsa izo. Kubisala kwa olandira: mailbox_id ndi hashi ya njira imodzi ya recipient_pubkey yothiridwa mchere ndi BMP chingwe cha mtundu - nodi yapakati imawona chizindikiritso chosawoneka bwino cha 32-byte. Zobisala: blob yalembedwa kale E2E-encrypted kwa wolandirayo pogwiritsa ntchito makiyi wamba Vortex chipinda / DM, kotero mfundo yapakatikati imangowona zolemba zokha.
bmp.h2_c: Mapangidwe azinthu zitatu ndi momwe Pond adafotokozera zolinga zake mu 2014. Vortex adachikonza popangitsa kuti mailbox_id zisagundane (256-bit hash) kotero kuti ogwiritsa ntchito awiri osalumikizana sangathe kugawana mwangozi bokosi la makalata. The 7200-sekondi TTL amachokera kuwona kuti 95 % ya omwe adalandira mu beta yathu adakoka mkati mwa 2 h; Kutalikirapo TTL kusungirako mokulirapo pa node popanda kupindula kowonekera.
bmp.h2_f:
Mdani yemwe amawona mfundo zake:
  - amadziwa mailbox_id ilipo nthawi ya T
  - kodi NOT amadziwa wotumiza (anali TLS/Tor hop kutali)
  - kodi NOT amadziwa wolandira (mailbox_id ndi hashi wanjira imodzi)
  - kodi NOT amadziwa zomwe zili (blob ndi E2E-encrypted)
bmp.h3_a: Malire okhwima pa kukula kwa blob, kusungirako pa node, ndi kuchuluka kwa ndalama zomwe amasungitsa zimalepheretsa BMP kukhala kutsika kwa data kosasintha.
bmp.h3_b: Kukula kwakukulu kwa blob: 1 MB. Zolipira zazikuluzikulu ziyenera kudutsa mufayilo wamba, yomwe ili ndi njira yake yosungira. Kusungirako kwakukulu pa node: 500 MB chiwerengero cha BMP madipoziti. Chiyembekezo chikafika, kuthamangitsidwa koyambirira kumatsika TTL yawo - oyendetsa amatha kusintha kudzera mwa `BMP_MAX_BYTES` env var. Deposit rate pa IP: 10 pamphindi, kukana kusefukira kwa wowukira m'modzi. Ma ID a m'bokosi la makalata omwe amawonedwa kupitilira katatu/ola pa netiweki ali ndi malire ngati "anthu omwe akuganiziridwa kuti chandamale cha kusefukira kwa madzi".
bmp.h3_c: 1 MB blob cap ikugwirizana IRC DCC-tuma misonkhano ndi kapu ya Signal's sealed-sender - yayikulu yokwanira mauthenga afupiafupi ndi tizithunzi tating'ono, yaying'ono moti wowukira sangathe kugwiritsa ntchito BMP posungira mafayilo. 500 MB pa node ndi OSS-zosasinthika zomveka; ogwiritsa ntchito akulu amakweza ndi `BMP_MAX_BYTES`. Malire adabwera pambuyo pa v0.0.8 beta pomwe zolemba zoyesa zidadzaza node 50 ndi madipoziti mu mphindi 20.
bmp.h3_f:
malire:
  BMP_BLOB_MAX_BYTES = 1_000_000 # 1 MB
  BMP_NODE_MAX_BYTES = 500_000_000 # 500 MB
  BMP_DEPOSIT_RATE = 10 # pamphindi pa IP
  BMP_FLOOD_THRESHOLD = 3 # bokosi lamakalata_id yomweyo pa ola
bmp.h4_a: BMP imawala m'magawo atatu: olandila mwaufulu, kulumikizana kwapakatikati, kuyimba mluzu mosadziwika.
bmp.h4_b: Kuwunika kwambiri: wotumiza sadziwa malo akunyumba a wolandira (ndipo mwina sangafikirebe). Pitani kwa anzanu aliwonse, lolani miseche. Kulumikizana kwakanthawi: wolandila alibe intaneti kwa maola; blob amadikirira, palibe kuyesanso kofunikira. Kuimba mluzu mosadziwika: anyezi wotumiza + BMP = palibe metadata yonena za yemwe adayika chiyani. Kuphatikizidwa ndi kiyi yachipinda yomwe imadziwika ndi anthu odalirika okha, zomwe zilimo zimakhalanso zowoneka bwino kwa cholumikizira chilichonse.
bmp.h4_c: Milandu itatu yogwiritsa ntchito imatsata zomwe zidapangitsa kuti anthu akufa afe muukazitape wakuthupi (Soviet-era), za `alt.anonymous.messages` pa Usenet (1990s), ndi SecureDrop (2013 mtsogolo). BMP ndikuyesa kwathu kubweretsa mbiriyo kukhala mthenga wamakono osafuna chida china.

push.title: Zidziwitso zokankhira
push.subtitle: Ma APN, FCM, Web Push — zonse zili ndi maenvulopu omata kotero kuti opereka samatha kuwerenga.
push.intro: Ntchito zokankhira zokhazikika (ma APN, FCM, Web Push) amawona kuchuluka kulikonse. Vortex imakulunga zidziwitso zilizonse mugawo lapadera E2E kotero kuti woperekayo amangowona chotchinga chosawoneka bwino chopanda id, wotumiza, kapena mawu.
push.h1p1: Makasitomala amapeza chizindikiro cha pulatifomu (chizindikiro cha chipangizo cha APNs, FCM id yolembetsa, kapena kulembetsa kwa Web Push JWT).
push.h1p2: Makasitomala amapanga kiyi yatsopano ya 32-byte X25519 `p256dh_pub` ndi chinsinsi cha 16-byte `auth`. POSTs `/api/push/subscribe` ndi `{endpoint, p256dh, auth, platform}`.
push.h1p3: Node ikupitilirabe `push_subscriptions(user_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth, platform, created_at)`.
push.h2p1: Chidziwitso chikadzabwera (uthenga watsopano m'chipinda chosalankhula chomwe chakhazikitsidwa kuti chidziwitse, kutchulapo, kuyitana), nodi imasunga zolipira ndi AES-GCM pogwiritsa ntchito kiyi yochokera ku `ECDH(p256dh_pub, ephemeral_priv)` kudzera pa HKDF.
push.h2p2: Phukusi la node `{endpoint, TTL, changu, mutu: <collapse_key>, data: <ciphertext>}` ndikutumiza ku APNs / FCM / Web Push seva.
push.h3p1: Kiyi yamutu pachipinda chilichonse: `chipinda:<id>`. Mauthenga angapo m'chipinda chimodzi amagwera pachidziwitso chimodzi pamlingo wa OS.
push.h3p2: Mutu wapayitanidwe: `itanani:<id>`. Kuyankha kapena kukana kumakoka mbendera; kuyitanira kwatsopano kuchipinda chimodzi m'malo mwa chakale.
push.h4p1: iOS: Notification Service Extension decrypts munjira ya NSE (yosiyana ndi pulogalamu yayikulu). Amagwiritsa ntchito zoyambira za CryptoKit.
push.h4p2: Android: FirebaseMessagingService decrypts mu ntchito yakumbuyo. JobScheduler amakonza zenizeni UI zosintha pomwe pulogalamuyo idakhazikitsidwa.
push.h4p3: Webusaiti: Ogwira Ntchito amachotsa mawu mu SW, amatumiza zidziwitso zakomweko kudzera pa Zidziwitso Zapaintaneti API.
push.h5p1: Ma APN: Amafunikira chizindikiro cha operekera kuti atsitsimutsidwe mphindi 60 zilizonse. Kutsitsimula kwa zizindikiro kumangochitika zokha kudzera pa Apple's `auth-team-id` + `auth-key-id` + p8 key file.
push.h5p2: FCM: cholowa HTTP mapeto achotsedwa; timagwiritsa ntchito HTTP v1 pomaliza ndi OAuth2 mbiri ya akaunti yautumiki. Kasinthasintha 1 h iliyonse.
push.h5p3: Kankhani pa Webusaiti: VAPID makiyi (kiyi imodzi pa node). TTL yokhala ndi masiku 28 ndi asakatuli ambiri.
push.h1_a: Makasitomala amalembetsa chizindikiro cha chipangizo (APNs/FCM/Web Push) pamodzi ndi kiyi X25519 yatsopano yapagulu ndi chinsinsi cha 16-byte auth.
push.h1_b: Makasitomala amapanga `p256dh_priv = rand(32)` ndi `auth = rand(16)`. Zimachokera ku `p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G`. POSTs `/api/push/subscribe` ndi `{endpoint, p256dh, auth, platform, user_agent}`. Node ikupitilirabe `push_subscriptions(user_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth, platform, created_at, last_refreshed_at)`. Kasinthasintha: kasitomala amalembetsanso pakukhazikitsa pulogalamu iliyonse, yomwe imatsitsimula `last_refreshed_at`. Kulembetsa kwazaka zopitilira 30 kumachotsedwa.
push.h1_c: Magawo a p256dh + auth amachokera ku Web Push RFC 8291 (2017). Tidawagwiritsanso ntchito pa ma APN ndi FCM ngakhale kuti mautumikiwa safuna mtundu wosindikizidwa - kutero kumasunga njira imodzi pamakina onse atatu. Isanakwane v0.0.5 Vortex idatumiza zolemetsa kudzera pamasewera okankha; pambuyo pa zosintha zachinsinsi za Apple za 2022 komanso chochitika china pomwe pulojekiti yosasinthika FCM idatsikiridwa zidziwitso, tidasuntha chilichonse ku maenvulopu osindikizidwa.
push.h1_f:
p256dh_priv = rand(32)
p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G // X25519
auth = rand(16)

POST /api/push/subscribe
  {mapeto, p256dh: hex(p256dh_pub), wolemba: hex(auth), nsanja}
push.h2_a: Chidziwitso chikadzakwana, node imabisa zomwe zimalipidwa kotero kuti chipangizo cha wolandira chokha ndi chomwe chingawerenge. Ntchito yokankhira (Apple / Google / Mozilla) imangowona mawonekedwe osawoneka bwino.
push.h2_b: Node imasankha ephemeral X25519 keypair. Amachokera `ikm = ECDH(ephemeral_priv, p256dh_pub)`. Imathamanga HKDF(mchere=auth, ikm, info="aesgcm", len=32) → kiyi. Imalemba mwachinsinsi `{mutu, thupi, room_id, message_id}` monga CBOR → AES-GCM ndi kiyi yotengedwa + mwachisawawa 96-bit nonce. Amatumiza `{endpoint, TTL, changu, mutu: collapse_key, data: ciphertext, aes128gcm: {salt, pub_ephemeral}}` ku APNs/FCM/Web-Push. Chipangizo chimalandira, wowonjezera / wogwira ntchito amayendetsa makiyi omwewo mobwerera, decrypts, kuwonetsa zidziwitso.
push.h2_c: Kukankhira kosindikizidwa ndikolunjika kwa Web Push Message Encryption spec kuchokera ku 2017 (RFC 8291 + RFC 8188). Zosintha za Apple za 2022 iOS 16 zidawonjezera chithandizo chamtundu woyamba pazowonjezera zautumiki wazidziwitso zomwe zikupanga kubisa; Android yathandizira kudzera pa FCM mauthenga a data kwa zaka zambiri. Vortex ndi m'modzi mwa amithenga ochepa omwe amagwiritsa ntchito mayendedwe athunthu ndi nambala yomweyo pamapulatifomu onse atatu - iOS imagwiritsa ntchito `NotificationServiceExtension`, Android imagwiritsa ntchito `FirebaseMessagingService`, Webusaiti imagwiritsa ntchito wogwira ntchito.
push.h2_f:
ephemeral_priv = rand(32);  ephemeral_pub = ephemeral_priv · G
ikm = ECDH(ephemeral_priv, p256dh_pub)
prk = HMAC-SHA256(auth, ikm)
key = HKDF-Onjezani(prk, "Content-Encoding: aes128gcm\x00", 16)
nonce= HKDF-Onjezani(prk, "Content-Encoding: nonce\x00", 12)
ct = AES-GCM-Lemberani(kiyi, nonce, malipiro)
tumizani {endpoint, data: salt∥record_size∥idlen∥ephemeral_pub∥ct}
push.h3_a: Makiyi ogwetsa amalepheretsa zidziwitso zingapo pamacheza omwewo kuti zisasunthike ngati zikwangwani pawokha - OS imawagwirizanitsa kukhala imodzi.
push.h3_b: Kugwa kwachipinda chilichonse: mutu = `chipinda:<id>`. Ma APN a `apns-collapse-id` ndi FCM's `collapse_key` amauza OS kuti asinthe zidziwitso zam'mbuyo ndi mutu womwewo. Wogwiritsa amawona banner imodzi pachipinda chilichonse ngakhale mauthenga afika angati. Kugwa kwapayitanidwe: mutu = `itana:<id>`; kuyitanira kwatsopano m'chipinda chimodzi m'malo mwa m'mbuyomu. Kutchula: mutu = `tchulani:<wogwiritsa>:<chipinda>`; banner imodzi yotchulidwa pagulu lililonse la anthu.
push.h3_c: Makiyi ogwetsa adawonjezedwa ku ma APN mu iOS 10 (2016) ndi ku FCM mu 2014. Izi zisanachitike, kuphulika kwa mauthenga ambiri kumapanga milu ya zikwangwani zambiri zomwe ogwiritsa ntchito amadana nazo chimodzimodzi. Telegram adachita upainiya wa kugwa kwa chipinda chilichonse UX mu 2015; Mtumiki wamkulu aliyense adatsata. Vortex kugawika kwa chipinda / kuyimba / kutchula kugwa kudachokera ku mayankho a ogwiritsa ntchito mu beta ya v0.0.6 yomwe "kuyitanira m'malo mwa macheza" idawoneka yolakwika - mitu ina idakonza.
push.h3_f:
Ma APN: apns-collapse-id = chipinda:42 → amalowetsa zikwangwani zam'mbuyo
FCM: collapse_key = call:17 → m'malo mwa zikwangwani zakale
Webusaiti: mutu = tchulani:u12:r5 → m'malo mwa zikwangwani zakale
push.h4_a: Pulatifomu iliyonse ili ndi zake zake. iOS ikufunika Chidziwitso Service Extension; Android ikufunika FCM mauthenga a data; Webusaiti ikufunika wogwira ntchito + VAPID.
push.h4_b: iOS: gulu la pulogalamuyi limatumiza chandamale cha `NotificationServiceExtension`. System imapereka malipiro obisika ku NSE; NSE ili ndi 30 s ya CPU + 25 MB ya kukumbukira kuti isinthe ndikusintha chidziwitso chisanasonyezedwe. FCM: timatumiza mauthenga a `data` (osati `chidziwitso`) kotero kuti FirebaseMessagingService ya pulogalamuyo imayamba kugwira ntchito ikafika - zomwe zimatipatsa mphamvu kuti tiwonetse banner. Web Push: wogwira ntchito amasokoneza zochitika za `push`, kumasulira, ziwonetsero kudzera pa `self.registration.showNotification`.
push.h4_c: Mtundu wa NSE udayambitsidwa ndi Apple mu iOS 10 (2016) makamaka pamakasitomala omasulira mauthenga. Izi zisanachitike, amithenga obisidwa kumapeto mpaka kumapeto amayenera kusankha pakati pa zolemetsa zachinsinsi (zachinsinsi) ndi kukankha mabaji okha (UX-odana). WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram onse adalumphira ku ma NSE pasanathe chaka. Vortex amatsata dongosolo lomwelo.
push.h5_a: Quirks zokhudzana ndi othandizira - gawo la mutu wokankhira. Ichi ndi chimodzi mwamakina ofunikira omwe akufotokozedwa muzolemba zonse za Vortex. Werengani mutu wozungulira kuti mumve zambiri; gawoli likuwonetsa machitidwe enaake.
push.h5_b: Kufotokozera mwachidule kwa "Zomwe zimaperekedwa ndi Wopereka". Makinawa akugwiritsidwa ntchito mugawo lolingana ndi `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, kapena `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README imatchula njira zenizeni zamafayilo.
push.h5_c: Makina a "Provider-specific quirks" adasintha pa Vortex zotulutsidwa. Mapangidwewa amachokera ku kafukufuku wofalitsidwa ndi machitidwe opanga a amithenga am'mbuyomu. Mbiri yakale mu `CHANGELOG.md` imalemba nthawi yomwe chidutswa chilichonse chidatera komanso chomwe chidachilimbikitsa.

controller.title: Utumiki wowongolera
controller.subtitle: Chitsimikizo cha kukhulupirika, kutulukira, kuwunika thanzi.
controller.intro: Wowongolera ndi njira yosiyana Python. Malo ake owukira ndi ang'onoang'ono (pafupifupi misewu khumi ndi iwiri) ndipo chidaliro chake chimayikidwa pa kiyi imodzi yapagulu ya Ed25519 yophikidwa makasitomala.
controller.h1p1: `GET /v1/integrity` - zotsatira zotsimikizira. Chiwembu: `{status, sign_by, trusted_pubkey, version, build_at, matched, mismatch, kusowa, zowonjezera, message}`.
controller.h1p2: `GET /v1/health` - moyo. Schema: `{status: "ok", version, pubkey, stats:{intaneti, zovomerezeka, zonse}}`.
controller.h1p6: `GET /v1/heartbeat/{pubkey}` - kufufuza moyo wa nodi. Amagwiritsidwa ntchito ndi mabungwe a federal kuti asungitse kulembetsa kwawo mwatsopano.
controller.h1p7: `POST /v1/register` — mfundo yatsopano ikugwiritsidwa ntchito pakukhulupirira. Pamafunika chivomerezo cha woyang'anira pokhapokha `AUTO_APPROVE=zoona`.
controller.h2p1: Fayilo yowonetsera: `INTEGRITY.sig.json`. Ili ndi fayilo iliyonse BLAKE3 hash + Ed25519 siginecha.
controller.h2p2: M'badwo: `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_tool`. Amawerenga kiyi yotulutsa kuchokera ku `makiyi/release.key`, amayenda mumtengo, amalemba manifest.
controller.h2p3: Kutsimikizira: Wowongolera amawerenga chiwonetserochi poyambira ndikufanizira ndi disk. Kuyamba kumalephera kwambiri pakusagwirizana.
controller.h3p1: Magalasi amayendetsa kachidindo komwe kamakhala ndi kiyi yotulutsa yomweyi yomwe idakopera. Makasitomala amawona zofanana `zosaina_ndi` pagalasi - njira imodzi yodziwira kalirole wabodza ndikufanizira ma pubkey.
controller.h3p2: DNSLink / SNS / IPFS kusindikiza zolozera pa imodzi mwa kalirole angapo. Makasitomala amayesa motsogola ndikutha nthawi.
controller.h3p3: Chikwatu cha `vortex.sol-mirror/` mu repo iyi ndi galasi la trycloudflare lokonzekera chitukuko.
controller.h1_a: Pagulu la Controller API pamwamba ndi njira khumi ndi ziwiri. Zonse zazing'ono, zonse zimayang'ana pa umboni ndi kulowa-URL kupeza.
controller.h1_b: `/v1/integrity` - chizindikiro chosaina. `/v1/health` — liveness + pubkey + stats. `/v1/entries` - ma URL olowera kuti mulumikizidwe. `/v1/mirrors` - zowongolera magalasi. `/v1/trusted_nodes` - anzawo achitaganya. `/v1/heartbeat/{pubkey}` - kufufuza moyo wa nodi. `/v1/register` — mfundo yatsopano ikugwira ntchito pakukhulupirira (kuvomereza kwa admin pokhapokha `AUTO_APPROVE=zoona`). Ndi momwemo - kuchepetsera dala kuti malo owukirawo akhale ochepa.
controller.h1_c: Kapangidwe ka malo opapatiza kumatsimikiziridwa ndi kuwona kuti njira yochitira umboni imakhala yamtengo wapatali kwambiri makasitomala akakayika. Khodi yaying'ono = malo ang'onoang'ono. Fananizani ndi mfundo yomwe ili ndi njira 120+; wowongolera ali ndi 12. Njira yofananira: Debian's apt-get imakhulupirira kachitidwe kakang'ono ka `Release.gpg` kosiyana ndi kachitidwe ka phukusi.
controller.h2_a: `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_tool` imayenda pamtengo woyambira, imathamangitsa fayilo iliyonse, imasainira ndi kiyi yotulutsa, imalemba `INTEGRITY.sig.json`.
controller.h2_b: Chida chimawerengedwa kuti `makiyi/release.key` (32-byte Ed25519 chinsinsi chachinsinsi). Amayenda `vortex_controller/` + `app/` (kupatula mafayilo osadziwika). Pa fayilo iliyonse: `blake3(zamkati) → hash`. Imamanga mawonekedwe `{version, build_at, files: [{path, sha256, size}]}`. Kuwerengera `canonical_bytes = CBOR(manifest)`. Zizindikiro: `sig = Ed25519-Sign(release_key, canonical_bytes)`. Amalemba `INTEGRITY.sig.json = {manifest, sign_by: pubkey, sig}`.
controller.h2_c: Mawonekedwe osainidwa amabwerera ku Debian's Release.gpg (1997) ndi PGP-yosaina Linux kernel tarballs. Sigstore (2021) adakonza chitsanzo chaumboni wamtundu wamtundu. Mtundu wa Vortex ndi wopepuka kwambiri chifukwa umatsimikizira kutumizidwa kamodzi, osati kutulutsa maphwando ambiri. Titha kutengera Sigstore mu v0.4 kuti itulutsidwe pagulu.
controller.h3_a: Magalasi amayendetsa kachidindo komweko kokhala ndi kiyi yotulutsa yofanana. Zolemba zingapo DNS / SNS / IPFS zimaloza pa kalirole angapo.
controller.h3_b: Othandizira amayika magalasi a N (nthawi zambiri 3-5). Iliyonse imakhala ndi khodi ya `vortex_controller` yomwe ili ndi `makiyi/release.key` omwewo. Makasitomala amawona zofananira `zosaina_ndi` pagalasi - cheke chabwino. DNS/SNS/IPFS amalemba mndandanda wamagalasi omwe ali ndi zofunika kwambiri. Makasitomala amayesa mwadongosolo, ndikutha kwa masekondi 7 poyesa. Chikwatu cha `vortex.sol-mirror/` mu repo iyi ndi chitsanzo chagalasi cha trycloudflare.
controller.h3_c: Magalasi angapo okhala ndi kuyang'ana patsogolo ndi njira yofanana SMTP amagwiritsa ntchito MX zolemba ndi HTTPS amagwiritsa ntchito SRV zolemba. Ulamuliro wa chikwatu cha Tor ndi mtundu wofananira - ma DA 9 olimba + mavoti. Vortex anasankha "sankha kalirole kamene kamagwira ntchito" m'malo mwa "voti ya anthu ambiri" chifukwa mapangidwe otengera mavoti ndi okhazikika koma ochedwa kwambiri.
controller.h1_f:
/v1/umphumphu : GET → zotsatira zotsimikizira
/v1/health : GET → {status, version, pubkey, stats}
/v1/zolowa : GET → [{protocol, url}, ...]
/v1/mirrors : GET → [controller_url, ...]
/v1/trusted_nodes : GET → [{pubkey, endpoint, health}, ...]
/v1/kugunda kwamtima/{pk} : POST (kuchokera m'malo olembetsedwa okha)
/v1/register : POST (pamalo atsopano)
controller.h3_f:
DNSLink TXT _dnslink.vortexx.sol: dnslink=/ipfs/<CID>
SNS record vortexx.sol: {"mirror": [url1, url2, url3]}
IPFS CID: INTEGRITY.sig.json
kasitomala amasankha: woyamba kuyankha mwadongosolo, 7 s kutha

storage.title: Malo osungira
storage.subtitle: SQLite for dev, Postgres for prod, Alembic for migration, GRDB/Room/IndexedDB pamakasitomala.
storage.intro: Vortex's node yosungirako ndi SQL. Kusintha pakati pa SQLite (dev) ndi Postgres (prod) ndikusintha kwa DATABASE_URL - palibe mafoloko a code.
storage.h1p1: `ogwiritsa(id, dzina lolowera, password_hash, x25519_public_key, kyber_public_key?, display_name, avatar_url, foni, imelo, created_at, is_active)` - identity table.
storage.h1p2: `user_devices(id, user_id, device_id, user_agent, last_seen_at, revoted_at)` - mizere yachigawo pachipangizo chilichonse.
storage.h1p3: `zipinda(id, mtundu, dzina, ndi_zachinsinsi, ndi_channel, is_dm, member_count, avatar_url, created_at, created_by, description)` — tebulo lachipinda, mzere umodzi pachipinda chilichonse.
storage.h1p4: `mamembala_achipinda(id_id yachipinda, id_yogwiritsa, udindo, olowa_pa, osalankhula_mpaka)` - umembala + ACL.
storage.h1p5: `mauthenga(id, room_id, sender_id, ciphertext, nonce, sender_pseudo, sent_at, edited_at?, reply_to?, thread_id?, kind)` — uthenga uliwonse, walembedwa pa `(ID_ya chipinda, id)`.
storage.h1p6: `rections(message_id, user_id, emoji, created_at)` — kiyi yophatikizika kwambiri `(message_id, user_id, emoji)`.
storage.h1p7: `mafayilo(id, user_id, mime_type, size, sha256 /* kwenikweni BLAKE3 */, storage_path, uploaded_at)` — metadata ya fayilo.
storage.h1p8: `read_receipts(room_id, user_id, message_id, read_at)` — cholozera chaposachedwa kwambiri pa munthu aliyense pachipinda chilichonse.
storage.h1p9: `kukhalapo(user_id, last_ seen_ at, is_typing_in_room_id?)` — ephemeral, Redis-backed in prod.
storage.h1p10: `mabungwe(pubkey, endpoint, health_score, added_at, added_by, revoted_at)` - mndandanda wa anzawo.
storage.h1p11: `federation_outbox(id, target_node, payload, attempts, next_retry_at)` - mzere wotuluka.
storage.h1p12: `mauthenga_okonzedwa(id, room_id, ciphertext, nonce, send_at, created_by, created_at, cancelled_at)`.
storage.h1p13: `contacts(user_id, contact_user_id, Nickname, added_at)` — bukhu la ma adilesi.
storage.h1p14: `saved_gifs(user_id, url, wide, height, added_at)` - zosonkhanitsira aliyense GIF.
storage.h1p15: `mafoda(user_id, id, name, room_ids, is_system, created_at)` - zikwatu zochezera.
storage.h1p16: `bot_installations(user_id, bot_id, install_at)` - kuyika kwa bot pa aliyense.
storage.h1p17: `magawo(jti, user_id, device_id, expires_at)` - tsitsimutsani kaundula wa zizindikiro.
storage.h1p18: `push_subscriptions(user_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth, platform, created_at)` - kulembetsa kukankha.
storage.h2p1: Alembic mu `alembic/mabaibulo/`. Mbiri yakale, kusinthidwa kumodzi pakutulutsa (nthawi zina pang'ono pakutulutsa).
storage.h2p2: Dev mode: `create_all + ALTER TABLE fallback` kuti mubwereze mwachangu.
storage.h2p3: Prod mode: `alembic upgrade mutu` musanayambe. Chithunzi cha Docker chimayendetsa polowera.
storage.h3p1: `mauthenga(room_id, id DESC)` — mlozera woyambirira wamatchulidwe ojambulidwa.
storage.h3p2: `mauthenga(room_id, sent_at DESC)` — poyitanitsa potengera nthawi yosintha.
storage.h3p5: `user_devices(user_id)` — polemba mndandanda wa zida zomwe zimagwira ntchito.
storage.h3p6: FTS matebulo enieni (FTS5 SQLite / tsvector Postgres) posaka zolemba zonse.
storage.h4p1: `Pangani db-backup` imapanga zosunga zobwezeretsera nthawi. Imabisidwa popuma ndi kiyi ya opareta.
storage.h4p2: Kusunga: tsiku lililonse kwa masiku 14, mlungu uliwonse kwa masabata 4, mwezi uliwonse kwa miyezi 12.
storage.h4p3: Kubwezeretsa: `pangani db-kubwezeretsa FILE=<njira>`. Amathamanga pa siteji DB choyamba; opareshoni amatsimikizira kenako kusinthana.
storage.h1_a: Kusungirako ma node ndi SQL. SQLite ya dev ndi yaing'ono yodzichitira nokha; PostgreSQL yopanga ma federal kapena ma multinode. SQLAlchemy 2.x async code yofanana imayendetsa zonse ziwiri.
storage.h1_b: Konzani kudzera ku `DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:///vortex.db` kapena `postgresql+asyncpg://user:pw@host/db`. Single config, palibe mafoloko a code. SQLite imagwira ntchito; Postgres imayenda padera. Magwiridwe: SQLite imagwira ~ 50 ogwiritsa ntchito nthawi imodzi momasuka pa M1; Postgres mamba mpaka masauzande. Migration Postgres → SQLite ndi njira imodzi kudzera `pg_dump --data-only` + SQLite import; mbali ina ndi yomweyo.
storage.h1_c: Njira ya "one ORM, two backends" ndi machitidwe a SQLAlchemy azaka khumi. Vortex imagwiritsa ntchito async 2.x API kotero funso lililonse likuyembekezera. Tidasankha SQLAlchemy Core pa Django ORM / Tortoise ORM / yaiwisi `asyncpg` pankhani yolemera yakusamuka komanso machesi okhala ndi mawu osavuta a FastAPI.
storage.h2_a: 18 core tables: ogwiritsa, user_devices, zipinda, room_members, messages, reactions, files, read_receipts, kupezeka, federation, federal_outbox, scheduled_messages, contacts, saved_gifs, zikwatu, bot_installations, magawo, push_subscriptions.
storage.h2_b: Tsamba la ogwiritsa ndiye gwero lachidziwitso. room_members imagwira (chipinda, wogwiritsa ntchito, gawo, ojowina_pa, osalankhula_mpaka). mauthenga ali ndi ciphertext + metadata; zolozedwera pa (room_id, id) kuti zitengere mwachikopa. reactions ndi pawiri-primary-kiyi tebulo. Zina zonse ndi zowongoka. Kusungirako kumakula motsatana ndi kuchuluka kwa mauthenga - pafupifupi 1 KB pa uthenga uliwonse pa disk pambuyo pa index.
storage.h2_c: Chiwembucho chinali chokhazikika pambuyo pa v0.0.4. M'mbuyomu tinali ndi 'dm_messages` ndi matebulo a `group_messages`; ophatikizidwa mu v0.0.3 pambuyo fanout kachidindo chibwerezedwa kudutsa onse. Magome 18 ndi ochepera a mesenjala wathunthu; Kutumiza kwakukulu kumawonjezera matebulo a analytics koma izi sizofunikira kuti zigwire ntchito.
storage.h3_a: Alembic amayendetsa kusamuka. Mbiri yokonzanso mzere, kukonzanso kumodzi pakutulutsa. Kusintha kulikonse kumakhala ndi ntchito za `upgrade()` ndi `downgrade()`.
storage.h3_b: `alembic/versions/` imakhala ndi zosintha. Iliyonse ndi fayilo ya Python yokhala ndi kukweza / kutsitsa. CI imayendetsa `alembic upgrade head` + `alembic downgrade -1` + `alembic upgrade head` kuti itsimikizire ulendo wobwerera. Kupanga: `pangeni db-migrate` ikuchitika polowera ku Docker pulogalamu isanayambe. Dev mode imagwiritsa ntchito `create_all + ALTER TABLE fallback` kotero kuti kubwereza kumakhala kwachangu popanda kufunikira kusuntha kulikonse.
storage.h3_c: Alembic (Michael Bayer, 2011) ndiye chida chovomerezeka cha SQLAlchemy kusamuka. Linear History (osati nthambi) ndi kusankha - kumapewa "madivelopa awiri amapanga nambala yobwereza" vuto. Kusamuka kwa Django kumagwiritsa ntchito njira yomweyo. Manjanji adasunthika kuchoka pamzere kupita kunthawi yayitali mu 2014 koma adasinthidwanso mzere ndi kuphatikiza mu 2020.
storage.h4_a: Zolozera zazikulu zimasankhidwa mosamala kwambiri zowerengera zotentha (mauthenga, machitidwe, ma risiti owerengera) zimagunda pa disk kawirikawiri.
storage.h4_b: `mauthenga(ID_yachipinda, id DESC)` — mlozera wamasamba woyambirira. `mauthenga(room_id, sent_at DESC)` - kubwereranso kokonzekera nthawi kuti zisinthidwe. `rections(message_id)` - kuphatikiza pazipinda zotseguka. `read_receipts(room_id, message_id)` — ziwerengero za "zowoneka ndi N". `user_devices(user_id)` - mndandanda wazipangizo. FTS matebulo osakira (FTS5 pa SQLite, tsvector pa Postgres).
storage.h4_c: Zosankha za index zidabwera kuchokera kukufotokozera-mapulani-pakuyesa kwa v0.0.4. Tidayamba ndi ma index osazindikira ndikuwonjezera / kuchotsa kutengera momwe amafunso omwe adawonedwa. The `mauthenga(room_id, id DESC)` ndiye mlozera umodzi wotentha kwambiri - pafupifupi 80 % ya zowerengedwa zidagunda. Kuyisunga yopapatiza (osaphatikizapo mizati) kumapangitsa kuti ikhale yokwanira kukumbukira.

bots.title: Bot chimango
bots.subtitle: Gravitix DSL + Python SDK + msika + antispam.
bots.intro: Maboti ndi otenga nawo gawo mchipinda choyamba. Mauthenga amasainidwa ndi kiyi ya Ed25519 ya bot kotero kuti zabodza zitha kupezeka.
bots.h1p1: Njira ziwiri: Python SDK kapena Gravitix DSL. Python ndi yamayendedwe ovuta; Gravitix pamasewera oyendetsedwa ndi zochitika omwe amafunika kutumiza mwachangu.
bots.h1p2:
Python chitsanzo: `kuchokera ku vortex_bot import Bot
bot = Bot(chizindikiro=...)
@bot.on_message
async def echo(msg): await bot.send(msg.room_id, msg.text)
bot.run()`. The SDK imagwira WebSocket, kulumikizanso, kusinthana kwa makiyi achinsinsi.
bots.h1p3: Gravitix chitsanzo: `pa /kuyamba { emit "Moni, {ctx.first_name}!" }`. Imaphatikiza ku bytecode ndikuyendetsa mu womasulira wokhala ndi sandbox.
bots.h1p4: Chizindikiro cha bot chimaperekedwa popanga bot. Chizindikiro chotayika? `POST /api/bots/{id}/rotate-token` imatulutsa yatsopano.
bots.h2p1: Mitundu iwiri yotumizira: mu-ntchito (coroutine mkati mwa node) ndi kunja (mavoti a bot `/api/bots/{id}/updates`).
bots.h2p2: Mkati: zero network hop, yothamanga kwambiri, koma wogwiritsa ntchito ayenera kukhulupirira bot code. Gozabwino kwa bots anu.
bots.h2p3: Zakunja: webhook kapena kafukufuku wautali. Palibe chidaliro cha node chomwe chikufunika. Good yama bots a chipani chachitatu komanso msika.
bots.h2p4: Gravitix ma bots nthawi zonse amayenda mumchenga - alibe mafayilo kapena mwayi wofikira pa netiweki kupatula momveka bwino API.
bots.h3p1: Public bots ikhoza kugonjera kumsika. Owunikira amatsimikizira khodi kuti sichinyengo, si spam, sikutulutsa deta ya ogwiritsa ntchito.
bots.h3p2: Magulu: zokolola, masewera, nkhani, zofunikira, ai, kumasulira.
bots.h3p3: Kwabasi: pitani kumodzi. Node imalembetsa wosuta ku dzina la bot kuti ma DM ayende bwino.
bots.h3p4: Kupanga ndalama: kwaulere, kugula kamodzi, kulembetsa. Ndalama zamapulatifomu 10 %% yazonse.
bots.h4p1: Chipinda chilichonse chimayang'aniridwa ndi bot ya antispam yosaoneka. Macheke: kachulukidwe ulalo> 3 pamphindi, chiŵerengero cha zilembo zazikulu> 70 %% pa 10+ chars, kubwereza mauthenga, kuphulika kwadzidzidzi kwa olowa muakaunti yatsopano.
bots.h4p2: Zochita: chenjeza → kutha kwa nthawi (5 min) → kukankha → kuletsa. Zopempha zipita kwa admin wakuchipinda.
bots.h4p3: Itha kusinthidwa pachipinda chilichonse kudzera pa bot config.
bots.h1_a: Maboti ndi otenga nawo gawo mchipinda choyamba. Aliyense ali ndi fungulo la Ed25519 ndi chizindikiro; uthenga uliwonse womwe amatumiza umasainidwa, ndiye kuti zabodza zimazindikirika.
bots.h1_b: Pangani: eni POSTs `/api/bots` ndi `{username, display_name, code}`. Node imapanga mzere wa `osuta` wokhala ndi `is_bot = wowona`, imapanga makiyi a Ed25519, imabweretsa chizindikiro chachinsinsi chachinsinsi kwa eni ake (chowonetsedwa kamodzi). Thamangani: bot mwina akukhala mokhazikika ngati njira kapena zisankho zakunja `/api/bots/{id}/updates` ndi chizindikiro chake. Mauthenga ochokera ku bots amanyamula mbendera ya `from_bot: true` ndipo amasaina ndi kiyi yachinsinsi ya bot.
bots.h1_c: Ma Bot API adachita upainiya ndi Slack (2014) ndikuyengedwa ndi Telegram (2015). Vortex's kupindika: siginecha za bot zimamangiriza mauthenga ku chizindikiritso cha bot, kotero kuti mfundo yosokoneza siyingapange "@bot adati X". Matrix Thandizo la bot linawonjezera malowa mu 2021 kudzera mwa siginecha zamagulu; Vortex ali nayo kuyambira v0.0.5.
bots.h2_a: Gravitix ndi chilankhulo chodziwika ndi domain polemba ma bots oyendetsedwa ndi zochitika. Chaching'ono, chofotokozera, chopangidwa ndi sandboxed bytecode.
bots.h2_b: Syntax: `pa /kuyamba { emit "Moni, {ctx.first_name}!" }`. Ogwira ntchito amamanga pazoyambitsa (kulamula, regex, chochitika). Thupi ndi ndondomeko ya `emit`, `let`, `ngati`, `schedule`, ndi zina zotero. Compiler imatulutsa bytecode; nthawi yothamanga imatanthauzira mu sandbox yopanda mafayilo, palibe netiweki yokhazikika, kokha Vortex's API. Maumboni athunthu mumutu wa Gravitix docs.
bots.h2_c: Gravitix idapangidwa mkati mwa v0.0.6 atawona kuti ma code ambiri a bot anali 80 % boilerplate kuti amange waya Vortex SDK, ndi kernel ya malingaliro enieni pakati. A DSL imalola malingaliro awo kuwalitsa ndikuletsa kufosholo mosasamala Python kukhala malo a bot-dev komwe kuthawira kwa sandbox ndikotheka.
bots.h3_a: Chipinda chilichonse chili ndi antispam bot yosaoneka yomwe imayang'anira kusefukira kwa madzi, kulumikiza sipamu, mauthenga obwerezabwereza, ndi kuphulika kwa akaunti yatsopano.
bots.h3_b: Malamulo: kachulukidwe ka ulalo > 3 pamphindi kuchokera kwa wogwiritsa ntchito m'modzi, ALL-CAPS chiŵerengero > 70 % pa mauthenga ≥ 10 chars, uthenga kubwereza > maulendo 3 mu 30 s, kuphulika kwa olowa ndi akaunti zaka <24 h > 20 mu 60 s. Zochita zikuchulukirachulukira: chenjezo → kutha kwa mphindi 5 → kukankha kwa ola limodzi → kuletsa (kuvomereza kwa admin kuti aletse). Itha kusinthidwa pachipinda chilichonse kudzera `/antispam config`.
bots.h3_c: Antispam heuristics imachokera ku kaphatikizidwe ka IRC-era-era bot malamulo (Eggdrop, BitchX) ndi machitidwe amakono ngati Discord AutoMod. Zomwe zili mu Vortex zidasinthidwa motsutsana ndi beta corpus ya miyezi 6 ya mauthenga 200k; chiwongola dzanja chabodza ndi ~ 0.3 % pamlingo womwe wawonedwa woletsa apilo.
bots.h4_a: Public bots amagonjera kumsika. Owunikira amatsimikizira kuti palibe chinyengo / palibe spam / palibe kutayikira kwa data. Ogwiritsa asakatula ndi gulu ndikuyika ndikudina kumodzi.
bots.h4_b: Kugonjera: eni ake adayika bot gwero + kufotokozera. Wowunika amayendetsa kachidindo mu sandbox, amawerengera ma anti-pattern odziwika, amayang'ana mafoni aliwonse omwe amalumikizidwa ndi ma API ololedwa, amatsimikizira zachinsinsi. Mndandanda: gulu, mtengo, mlingo, chiwerengero cha kukhazikitsa. Ikani: `POST /api/bots/{id}/install` - node imapanga kulembetsa kwa aliyense. Kupanga ndalama: kwaulere / nthawi imodzi / kulembetsa; nsanja imatenga 10%.
bots.h4_c: Misika yamapulogalamu imabwerera ku App Store ya 2008. Slack App Directory (2015), Discord Bot List (2017), Telegram Bot Store (2024). Vortex's 10 % kudula ndikotsika kuposa Apple's 30 % komanso kutsika pang'ono kuposa Shopify's 20 %, yosankhidwa kuti ilimbikitse opanga kuti asindikize. Ndondomeko yowunikirayi idapangidwa ndi GitLab "kuwunika mwachisawawa, kutulutsa madandaulo".
bots.h3_f:
zoyambitsa:
  link_density > 3/min → chenjeza
  all_caps_ratio > 0.7 (≥10c) → chenjeza
  repeat_count > 3 mu 30s → chenjeza
  new_joiner_burst > 20 mu 60s → loko ya chipinda

kukwera:
  2 machenjezo → 5 min kutha
  3 machenjezo → 1 h kukankha
  4 machenjezo → kuletsa (admin avomereza)
bots.h4_f:
magulu: zokolola, masewera, nkhani, zofunikira, ayi, kumasulira
mitengo: kwaulere | nthawi imodzi (USD kuchuluka) | kulembetsa (USD/mwezi)
kudula: 90 % kwa wopanga mapulogalamu, 10 % mpaka Vortex
kuwunikanso: pamanja, ~ 3 masiku abizinesi cholinga chosinthira

ops.title: Zochita
ops.subtitle: Kutumiza, kuyang'anira, kubwezeretsa.
ops.intro: Ntchito iliyonse imakhala ndi chandamale cha `make` kapena CLI lamulo. Masamba a Ops amakhala mu `deploy/`.
ops.h1p1: `docker compose up` imabweretsa node, controller, Postgres, Redis, coturn, Caddy.
ops.h1p3: Chilengedwe: `.env` mu repo root. Osadzipereka konse. `.env.example` ndiye chitsanzo.
ops.h1p4: Caddy amangotengera ma cert Let's Encrypt. Let's Encrypt malire amaperekedwa - gwiritsani ntchito masitepe poyesera.
ops.h2p1: `Pangani kukhazikitsa` - kukhazikitsa Python deps + dev zida.
ops.h2p4: `panga lint` - ruff + mypy. CI imatchinga zolephera.
ops.h2p8: `Pangani ci` - yendetsani mapaipi onse CI kwanuko.
ops.h3p1: `Vortex Wizard.app` ndi mtolo wa PyInstaller wokhala ndi pywebview GUI.
ops.h3p2: Kuthamanga koyamba: sankhani dzina la node → pangani makiyi otulutsa → sinthani TLS (Let's Encrypt / bweretsani-yanu / yodzisainira) → sankhani ma URL → yambitsani chozemba → tsegulani madoko a firewall.
ops.h3p3: Pambuyo kukhazikitsa, wizard imakhalabe ngati admin console: node yoyambira / kuyimitsa, onani zipika, makiyi atembenuza, onjezani anzawo ogwirizana.
ops.h4p1: Kutulutsa kulikonse kumayikidwa mu git. Tag idasainidwanso ndi kiyi yotulutsa kuti tagyo ikhale yotsimikizika.
ops.h4p2: Rollback: `git checkout <tag> && pangani docker-build && docker compose up -d`. Kuthamanga node kukhetsa ndikuyambiranso.
ops.h4p3: DB: Alembic `downgrade <rev>` yothandizidwa ndi mtundu umodzi wocheperako. Kubwereranso kumafuna kulowererapo pamanja.
ops.h1_a: `docker compose up` imabweretsa zodzaza zonse Vortex: node, controller, Postgres, Redis, coturn, Caddy.
ops.h1_b: `docker-compose.yml` pa repo root. Ma voliyumu `/data/vortex.db`, ​​`/data/uploads`, `/data/logs` oyikidwa kuti alandire kuti deta ipitirire pakuyambiranso. Healthchecks: node wathanzi ngati `/thanzi/wokonzeka` kubwerera 200; woyang'anira ngati `/v1/integrity` abwereranso atsimikiziridwa. Caddy amangotengera ma cert Let's Encrypt. `.env` amapereka zinsinsi (osapanga). `.env.example` ndiye chitsanzo.
ops.h1_c: Docker Compose ndiye mtundu wa de-facto wazinthu zambiri zodzichitira nokha. Umami, Ghost, Plausible, Miniflux onse amagwiritsa ntchito. Fayilo yolemba ya Vortex idasinthidwa kuyambira v0.0.2 kupita mtsogolo; mawonekedwe apano adakhazikika mu v0.0.5. Njira zina (k8s, nomad) zimasiyidwa ngati zolimbitsa thupi kwa ogwiritsa ntchito akuluakulu.
ops.h2_a: Makefile ndiye polowera chapakati pazochita zonse za dev ndi ops. `Pangani thandizo` amalemba zomwe mukufuna.
ops.h2_b: `kupanga install` → `pip install -r mahitaji.txt`. `panga dev` → uvicorn ndikutsitsanso. `pangani kuyesa` → pytest + kuphimba, zotuluka `coverage.xml`. `pangani lint` → ruff + mypy. `pangani docker-build` → `docker build -t vortex:$VERSION`. `pangeni db-migrate` → `alembic upgrade mutu`. `pangani db-zosunga zobwezeretsera` / `pangani db-kubwezeretsa FILE=...`. `Pangani ci` → kudzaza CI mapaipi kwanuko.
ops.h2_c: Makefile monga malo olowera ovomerezeka ndi machitidwe a Unix azaka makumi ambiri, omwe amatengedwa ndi projekiti iliyonse yayikulu Python (pytest, django, flask, fastapi). Zida zina (ndakatulo, Hatch, UV) ndizokometsera zapachaka; Make ndi wotopetsa komanso wapadziko lonse lapansi.
ops.h3_a: Kukhazikitsa wizard ndi PyInstaller bundle (`Vortex Wizard.app`) yokhala ndi pywebview GUI yomwe imayenda ndi wogwiritsa ntchito koyamba potumiza.
ops.h3_b: Kuthamanga koyamba: sankhani dzina la node → pangani makiyi otulutsa (Ed25519 keypair osungidwa ku `makiyi/release.key`) → sinthani TLS (Let's Encrypt / bweretsani-yanu / yodzisainira) → sankhani ma URL (vortexx.sol / domain domain / .onion level → tsegulani madoko amoto) (iptables/ufw/pf). Mukatha kuthamanga koyamba, wizard imakhalabe ngati admin console: node yoyambira/yimitsa, onani zipika, makiyi atembenuza, onjezani anzawo ogwirizana.
ops.h3_c: Ma wizards okhazikitsa ndi njira ya zida zodzipangira okha zomwe zimayang'ana ogwiritsa ntchito omwe si a sysadmin: Ghost's onboarding (2015), kukhazikitsa seva ya Standard Notes, mafunso oyika a Mastodon. PyInstaller imatilola kutumiza bayinare imodzi yodina kawiri; pywebview imapanga tsamba lapafupi HTML lotumizidwa ndi woyang'anira FastAPI API pa 127.0.0.1 — msakatuli UX popanda zovuta zomanga mbadwa GUI.
ops.h4_a: Kutulutsidwa kulikonse kumayikidwa mu git. Rollback ndi `git checkout <tag> && kupanga docker-build && docker compose up -d`. Kusamuka kuli ndi ntchito za `downgrade()`.
ops.h4_b: Ma tag amasainidwa ndi kiyi yotulutsa kotero kuti tag yokha ndiyotsimikizika. Njira yobweza: chotsani tag yakale, panganinso chithunzi, sinthaninso zotengera - zolumikizira zimathira pa SIGTERM (chisomo cha 15 s). DB: `alembic downgrade <rev>` ibweza kukonzanso kumodzi. Kupewa kutayika kwa data: sitigwetsa zipilala m'gulu limodzi; kutsika kumachitika N+1 code ikasiya kuwawerenga.
ops.h4_c: Njira yakusamuka ya "code-then-code" (expand-migrate-contract) ndiyokhazikika paziro-downtime deployments. Stripe's migration Guide (2019) amafotokoza bwino kwambiri. Vortex adatengera zomwe zidachitika mu v0.0.3 pomwe kutsika kwazazambiri kudakakamiza zenera lokonzekera la mphindi 30.

mobile.title: Makasitomala am'manja
mobile.subtitle: iOS ndi Android - mbadwa UI, protocol yomweyo.
mobile.intro: Makasitomala onse am'manja ndi anzawo onse, osati zomata zoonda. Mawonekedwe achibadwidwe, machitidwe achibadwidwe, kuphatikiza kwawo (CallKit, ConnectionService, Lock Screen widget).
mobile.h1p1: Phukusi la Swift mu `ios/Modules/`. 30+ zigawo, iliyonse SOLID-split `api/` + `impl/` + `ui/`.
mobile.h1p2: Cholinga cha pulogalamu mu `ios/VortexApp/`. XcodeGen spec pa `ios/project.yml` imapanganso xcodeproj.
mobile.h1p4: DB: GRDB + FTS5. Zosintha zonse zimadutsa mu `db.write`.
mobile.h1p6: Kankhani: Ma APN kudzera pa `UNUserNotificationCenter` + Notification Service Extension kuti atsitsidwe.
mobile.h2p1: Ntchito ya Gradle mu `android/`. Ma module 22 okhala ndi Hilt DI, `api / impl / di / ui` yemweyo.
mobile.h2p4: DB: Chipinda chokhala ndi FTS4 zoyambitsa.
mobile.h3p1: Magulu omwewo okhala ndi zilembo 146 okhala ndi mayina achibadwidwe (`Русский ru`, `English en`, `中文 zh`, ...).
mobile.h3p2: Katundu yemweyo wa 1500-emoji wokhala ndi magulu 9 + akhungu + MRU + kusaka.
mobile.h3p3: Maakaunti ambiri omwewo X25519 kuyankha kovutirapo pakusintha.
mobile.h3p4: Zikwatu zochezera zomwezo (Zonse / Zosungidwa / Zosungidwa) zokokera ndikugwetsanso.
mobile.h3p5: Mndandanda womwewo wa ma GIF osungidwa (palibe Tenor - zosonkhanitsira zanu zokha).
mobile.h3p6: Mauthenga omwewo omwe adakonzedwa UI, skrini yolumikizirana, tsamba lodziwika bwino.
mobile.h1_a: Makasitomala a iOS ndi Phukusi la Swift lomwe lili ndi ma module a 30+. HTTPS + WebSocket + WebRTC yofanana ndi kasitomala wina aliyense.
mobile.h1_b: Ma module opangidwa ndi mawonekedwe: `Bootstrap`, `Auth`, `Chat`, `Files`, `Calls`, `Push`, `Emoji`, `Folders`, `Accounts`, `SavedGifs`, `Contacts`, `Scheduled`, `Premium`, `Reactions`, .... Iliyonse idagawanika kukhala `api/` (maprotocol), `impl/` (makalasi a konkire), `ui/` (mawonedwe a SwiftUI). Crypto: CryptoKit ya X25519 / Ed25519 / AES-GCM; Argon2Swift kwa Argon2id. DB: GRDB ndi FTS5. WebRTC: stasel/WebRTC XCFramework. Kankhani: Ma APN okhala ndi Notification Service Extension for seald-push decryption.
mobile.h1_c: Phukusi la Modular ndi machitidwe okhazikika a Swift kuyambira Swift Package Manager 5.0 (2019). Kugawanika kwathu kukhala api/impl/ui ndi SOLID-ish: kudalira kusinthika (ma modules amadalira api/ okha), kulekanitsa nkhawa, kuyesa (kusinthana kwa impl kwa mayeso). Kuwerengera kwa ma module 30+ ndikusankha kuti pakhale kufanana - gawo lililonse limakhala lodzipatula.
mobile.h2_a: Makasitomala a Android amawonetsa iOS: Kotlin + Compose + Hilt DI. 22 ma module, omwewo `api / impl / di` ogawanika.
mobile.h2_b: minSdk 26 (Android 8), targetSdk 34 (Android 14). Crypto: chitetezo cha AndroidX + Tink cha AES-GCM; argon2-jvm kwa Argon2id. DB: Chipinda chokhala ndi FTS4 zoyambitsa. WebRTC: Sakanizani WebRTC Android. Kankhani: FCM kudzera pa FirebaseMessagingService + decryption ya envelopu yosindikizidwa. Gradle ma module angapo, Hilt imalumikiza ma module opanda kudalira mwachindunji.
mobile.h2_c: Compose ndi Google's declative UI toolkit, khola kuyambira 2021. Hilt (2020) is the Google-endorsed DI framework on the Dagger 2. Onse pamodzi amafananiza SwiftUI + zokulunga katundu pa iOS zapafupi ndi architect architect. Vortex adatengera Compose/Hilt kuyambira v0.0.4 kupita mtsogolo; poyamba Android inali View-based.
mobile.h3_a: iOS ndi Android mtolo womwewo wa 146-local JSON wokhala ndi mayina achibadwidwe ndi 1500-emoji catalog - wogwiritsa ntchito 🥹 pa iOS 17 renders 🥹 pa Android 9.
mobile.h3_b: `ios/Modules/Sources/I18N/Resources/locales/*.json` magalasi `android/app/src/main/assets/locales/*.json`. Mapulogalamu onsewa amatsitsa malo oyenera poyambitsa koyamba (chosankha chosankha chilankhulo) ndikulimbikira kusankha. Kalozera wa emoji ndi gulu la 9 JSON kutumizidwa m'mitolo yonse iwiri; zimapatuka OS-level emoji-set divergence yomwe imapangitsa kuti `?` asatchulidwe pa ma OS akale.
mobile.h3_c: Kutumiza kalozera wanu wa ma emoji ndi momwe Telegram amagwiritsira ntchito (foloko yawo ya Twemoji) ndi WhatsApp yomwe idagwiritsidwa ntchito mpaka 2022. Kusinthanitsa: ~300 KB zowonjezera pa pulogalamu iliyonse ya emoji + ~1.2 MB zamagawo. Ndiwoyenera kusinthasintha kwa nsanja.

webclient.title: Web kasitomala
webclient.subtitle: PWA, vanila JS, mawonekedwe opanda intaneti, wogwira ntchito.
webclient.intro: Makasitomala apaintaneti ndi vanila-JS PWA. Palibe React, palibe katundu wopitilira ESM. ~400 KB chiwerengero cha gzipped, kuphatikiza madera 146.
webclient.h1p1: `static/js/main.js` ndiye kulowa. Ma modules amawonetsa ulesi pakugwiritsa ntchito koyamba.
webclient.h1p2: Boma: Zosungira mphete zachipinda chilichonse mu IndexedDB, cache yosungidwa mumemory. Wothandizira Service amalandila.
webclient.h1p3: UI: Zotsatira za Glass zamadzimadzi kudzera CSS zosefera zakumbuyo. Palibe chimango; nthumwi za zochitika + zopanda pake zimapereka othandizira.
webclient.h2p1: Zolemba zilizonse zomwe zidapangidwa popanda intaneti ku IndexedDB. SW amawotchera pomwe kulumikizana kwabwerera.
webclient.h2p2: Kiyi ya Idempotency pa POST iliyonse imalola zoyeserera kuchita bwino.
webclient.h2p3: Kuwerenga kumagwira ntchito popanda intaneti - mawu onse olumikizidwa amakhala mu IndexedDB.
webclient.h3p1: Madera 146 mu `static/locales/*.json`. Sikirini yolandilidwa (`lang-picker.js`) imazungulira pamalangizo a mayina awo.
webclient.h3p2: Kusintha kwamalo anthawi yothamanga: `document.documentElement.lang = code` + perekaninso malembo kudzera mu mawonekedwe a `data-i18n`.
webclient.h1_a: Makasitomala apaintaneti ndi vanila-JS PWA. Palibe React, palibe sitepe yomanga yopitilira ESM kumanga. Zonse JS zotumizidwa: ~400 KB gzipped.
webclient.h1_b: `templates/base.html` ndi chipolopolo chopangidwa ndi Jinja2. `static/js/main.js` ndiye ES-module yolowera. Ma module omwe ali mu `static/js/<feature>/` aulesi-katundu pakugwiritsa ntchito koyamba. CSS mu `static/css/` yokhala ndi 1-file-per-component. Wogwira Ntchito Amagwira Cache; katundu woyamba amachokera ku netiweki, motsatira posungira; sinthani macheke pakuyenda.
webclient.h1_c: Kusiya kumamatira kunali chisankho chadala cha v0.0.1 pambuyo poyika benchmark React ndi Vue PWAs pa ~ 1.5 MB gzipped ndi zofanana. Vanila JS + ES ma module amatipatsa ~400 KB. Kusinthanitsa ndi DOM-manipulation boilerplate, yomwe timayichepetsa ndi othandizira ang'onoang'ono mu `static/js/lib/dom.js`.
webclient.h2_a: Mawonekedwe a Offline: otuluka amalemba pamzere kupita ku IndexedDB; Ogwira ntchito amawotchera pamene kugwirizana kwabwerera.
webclient.h2_b: Aliyense POST / PATCH wogwiritsa ntchito popanda intaneti amalandira kiyi yodziwikiratu ndikugwera mu `bokosi lotuluka` (IndexedDB). Service Worker amamvetsera chochitika cha `paintaneti` ndikulembanso ndi kiyi ya idempotency ngati mutu. Seva imazindikira zobwerezedwa kudzera pa kiyi ya idempotency ndikubweza yankho loyambirira. Kuwerenga kumagwira ntchito popanda intaneti - mawu onse olumikizidwa amakhala mu IndexedDB ndipo amachotsa kwanuko ndi makiyi okumbukira.
webclient.h2_c: Makiyi a Idempotency a ma POST omwe angayesedwenso ndi msonkhano wa Stripe's 2017, wotengedwa ndi ma API amakono. IndexedDB ngati bokosi lotuluka ndi dongosolo Google Drive ulalo umagwiritsidwa ntchito pakusintha pa intaneti. Kukhazikitsa kwa Vortex ndi ~ mizere 200 mu `static/js/lib/outbox.js`.
webclient.h3_a: mtolo wa zinenero 146 pa `static/locales/*.json`. Takulandilani mozungulira zowonera kudzera pamawu amtundu (`Выберите язык` / `Sankhani chilankhulo chanu` / `选择语言` / ...).
webclient.h3_b: Kukhazikitsa koyamba: `lang-picker.js` ikuwonetsa taipi yojambula yomwe imazungulira madera 97 pa 45 ms/char, kuyimitsa 1.8 s, kuchotsa pa 30 ms/char, kupita patsogolo. Wogwiritsa amasankha chilankhulo; analimbikira mu `localStorage.vortex_lang`. Kuthamanga kulikonse kotsatira kumawerenga zomwe zasungidwa. Kusintha kwa nthawi yothamanga: `setLang(code)` imanyamula JSON, imapanganso zinthu za `data-i18n`.
webclient.h3_c: Makina opangira mataipi ndi olemekeza zowonera zakale ndipo adatengera kutentha kwa UX pambuyo poti v0.0.6 beta iwonetsa ogwiritsa ntchito kunyalanyaza kutsika kokhazikika. Malangizo apanjinga amapereka zenera la 1-sekondi kuti wosuta aliyense awone dzina lachilankhulo chake ndikulizindikira nthawi yomweyo.
webclient.h1_f:
chipolopolo: templates/base.html (server-rendered Jinja2)
kulowa: static/js/main.js (ES gawo)
mbali: static/js/{chat,zipinda,auth,calls,files,bots}/...
SW: static/service-worker.js
kukula: ~400 KB gzipped chonse
webclient.h2_f:
kulemba osatsegula pa intaneti:
  1. compute idempotency_key = rand(16).hex
  2. db.outbox.put({url, njira, thupi, idempotency_key, ts})
  3. pa 'intaneti': tulutsani bokosi lotuluka
     pamzere uliwonse: kutengera (url, {njira, thupi, mitu: {"Idempotency-Key": ikey}})
       → 2xx: chotsani mzere
       → 4xx: mzere wotsitsa (kulephera kosatha)
       → 5xx/opanda intaneti: yesaninso pambuyo pake
