security.title: Kaimidwe chitetezo
security.subtitle: Chitsanzo chowopseza, chitetezo chakuya, WAF, njira yowerengera, canary.
security.intro: Vortex imagwiritsa ntchito chitetezo mozama: kuswa gawo limodzi sikokwanira, wowukira wowona amafunikira kupambana kodziyimira payekha.
security.h1p1: **Woyang'anira maukonde osasamala **: amawona TLS mapaketi; amasanthula kukula / nthawi. Kugonjetsedwa ndi Level 1 stealth.
security.h1p2: **Wowukira ma netiweki akugwira **: amatha kusiya/kuchedwa/kubaya. Kugonjetsedwa ndi Level 2-4 chozemba.
security.h1p3: **Wogwiritsa ntchito node**: amawona ciphertext + metadata. Zomwe zili muuthenga zimakhala zachinsinsi.
security.h1p4: **Chida chamakasitomala chabedwa**: Mauthenga am'mbuyomu omwe adawululidwa. Malire a Double Ratchet ku gawo lapano; kufufuta-pa-kutsegula-kotsatira kulipo.
security.h1p5: **Mdani wa Quantum wokhala ndi magalimoto osungidwa kale **: adagonjetsedwa ndi makiyi a hybrid Kyber-768 pomwe anzawo onse adatsatsa PQ.
security.h2p1: Funsani woyang'anira: Mapangidwe a SQLi, njira yodutsa, jakisoni wa template, LFI, NoSQLi. Imatsika patsogolo pa khodi ya pulogalamu.
security.h2p2: Malire a malire: kapu yofewa yapadziko lonse 1000 req/s ndi kuphulika; panjira (kulowa 10 / min, kulembetsa 5 / min); pa-wosuta 100 req/s pambuyo pa auth.
security.h2p3: Kutsekereza kwa geo kungatheke kudzera mwa `GEO_BLOCK=RU,CN`.
security.h3p1: Zochitika zokhudzana ndi chitetezo (machitidwe a admin, kusintha kwa federal, kukweza kumasulidwa, kupukuta mantha) zomangidwa ndi `app/security/canary.py`.
security.h3p2: Kuphwanya unyolo ⇒ Kusokoneza kwazindikirika. Chenjezani moto.
security.h4p1: Fayilo ya Canary imasainidwa tsiku lililonse ndi kiyi yotulutsa. Kusowa  Kukayikiridwa kusagwirizana.
security.h4p2: Kubweza kwadzidzidzi: kuwulutsa kwa admin `{mtundu:"n", chochitika:"compromise", ...}` ku WebSocket iliyonse. Makasitomala amapukuta makiyi osungidwa.
security.h4p3: Kuzungulira: kiyi yatsopano yotulutsa, sainanso chiwonetsero, sindikizanso. Makasitomala ayambiranso bootstrap.
security.h1_a: Magulu anayi a adani amayendetsa kapangidwe kake: wongowonera chabe, wowukira, wosokoneza, chida chosokoneza. Aliyense anagonjetsedwa ndi wosanjikiza wosiyana.
security.h1_b: Woyang'anitsitsa: amawona mapaketi TLS-encrypted, amasanthula magalimoto. Kugonjetsedwa ndi Level 1-2 chozemba. Wowukira mwamphamvu: amatha kugwetsa/kuchedwetsa/kubaya mapaketi. Kugonjetsedwa ndi Level 3-4 chozemba. Wogwiritsa ntchito wosokoneza: amawona ciphertext + metadata. Kugonjetsedwa ndi E2E crypto + kuchepetsa metadata. Chida chosokonekera: chimawona mawu osavuta a mauthenga akale. Zowonongeka zomangidwa ndi chinsinsi chakutsogolo (Double Ratchet) ndikupukuta mantha.
security.h1_c: Mtundu wamagulu anayi umachokera ku "Applied Cryptography" ya Schneier ya 1999 yowopseza misonkho, yowonjezedwa ndi zowonera pambuyo pa chipale chofewa za owonera maboma. Kapangidwe kalikonse kamakono kotetezedwa ka messenger kamatchula zina zake. Kupindika kwa Vortex ndikuwonjezera kalasi yachisanu pamapu amsewu a v0.4: mdani wothandizidwa ndi kuchuluka kwa magalimoto osungidwa, omwe Kyber amawagwira.
security.h2_a: WAF imayang'ana pempho lililonse lisanafikire khodi ya pulogalamu, kukana SQL-i, traversal, jekeseni wa template, NoSQLi.
security.h2_b: `app/security/middleware.py::WAFMiddleware` imayendera ~50 regex cheke motsutsana URL, funso, ndi thupi. Zodziwika bwino za zoyipa (`UNION SELECT`, `../`, `{{ config }}`, `$where`) → 403. Malire: global 1000 req/s kapu yofewa yokhala ndi kulolera kophulika; panjira `/lolowera` 10/mphindi, `/register` 5/min; pa-wosuta 100 req/s pambuyo pa auth. Kutsekereza kwa geo kuli kosankha kudzera mwa `GEO_BLOCK=RU,CN,IR` kuti mukwaniritse zofunikira za zilango kwa ogwiritsa ntchito omvera.
security.h2_c: WAFs ngati middleware ndi njira yokhazikika — mod_security (2002), Cloudflare's WAF, AWS WAF. Vortex's ndi yaying'ono mwadala chifukwa cholemetsa WAF chimapanga zinthu zabodza zomwe zimawononga ziwopsezo zenizeni. Mndandanda wa regex udapangidwa kuchokera ku OWASP Ma signature apamwamba 10 ndikusinthidwa mu v0.0.5 pambuyo poti lamulo la beta WAF litsekereza chingwe chenicheni "DROP TABLE" mkati mwa uthenga wochezera SQL.
security.h3_a: Zochitika zokhudzana ndi chitetezo zimagwera mu chipika chowerengera chomangidwa ndi hashi. Kuphulika kwa unyolo kumawonetsa kusokoneza.
security.h3_b: Zochita zilizonse za oyang'anira, kusintha kwa federal, kukweza kutulutsa, kapena kupukuta mantha kumayikidwa mu `audit_log(ts, event, actor_id, target_id, details_cbor)`. Mzere uliwonse umanyamula `prev_hash = hashi(prev_row)`. Mzere waposachedwa wa hashi wawerengedwa ku `ts ∥ chochitika ∥ prev_hash`. Ngati mzere uliwonse wachotsedwa kapena kusinthidwa, mizere yotsatira ya ``prev_hash` imaduka - imatha kudziwika ndi kuseweredwanso kwa unyolo.
security.h3_c: Zolemba zowerengera zomangidwa ndi hash ndi zakale zakale (hash-linked timestamping, 1991). Linux auditd amawagwiritsa ntchito. Kudzipereka kwa Git DAG kwenikweni ndikofanana. Vortex anawawonjezera mu v0.0.6 mlangizi atanena kuti malo osokonekera atha kufufuta mwakachetechete mizere yazipika.
security.h4_a: Kuyankha kwazochitika kumakonzedweratu: canary imatsimikizira kuti fungulo lomasulidwa ndilosasunthika; Kuchotsa mwadzidzidzi kumapukuta makiyi osungidwa pamakasitomala onse.
security.h4_b: Tsiku ndi tsiku `canary.txt` yosainidwa ndi kiyi yotulutsa, yosindikizidwa pamodzi ndi chowongolera. Makasitomala amatsimikizira kuti angoyambitsa - kusakhalapo ⇒ kukayikira. Ngati kulolerana kwatsimikiziridwa: admin amawulutsa `{mtundu:"n", chochitika:"compromise", chifukwa}` pa WebSocket iliyonse. Makasitomala amapukuta makiyi osungidwa, kakamizani kulowanso. Kiyi yotulutsa yatsopano yopangidwa, yowonekeranso yosayinidwanso, makasitomala ayambiranso bootstrap kuchokera kumapeto kwa kukhulupirika. Mawu olembedwa akale omasuliridwa kuti sangawerengedwe ndi mapangidwe.
security.h4_c: Mafayilo a Canary amatsata Apple's 2013 warrant canary ndi pulojekiti ya `canarywatch.org`. Signal amawagwiritsa ntchito. Vortex's imangokhala yokha: chizindikiro cha cron `canary.txt` chokhala ndi kiyi yotulutsa ma 24 aliwonse. Mawayilesi ochotsa mwadzidzidzi ndi ofanana ndi omwe Let's Encrypt amagwiritsa ntchito pochotsa chiphaso chambiri.
security.h1_f:
kalasi | chitetezo
--------------------------- | ------------------------------
passive network monitorer | L1+L2 chozemba (chidindo chala+mawonekedwe)
Active network attacker | L3+L4 chozemba (ECH, chomangika)
wogwiritsa ntchito molakwika | E2E crypto + sender pseudo
chipangizo chosokoneza | patsogolo chinsinsi + mantha pukuta
quantum (m'tsogolo) | Gawo la haibridi la Kyber-768

imayang'ana pazopempha zilizonse:
  SQL jakisoni : zindikirani UNION SELECT, DROP TABLE, ; -- ndi zina.
  kudutsa njira : zindikirani ../, ..%2f, URL-zosinthidwa zosiyanasiyana
  jakisoni wachifanizo : zindikirani {{, {%
  XSS : zindikirani <script, javascript:
  NoSQLi : zindikirani $ne, $komwe, $regex
malire owerengera: 1000 / s padziko lonse lapansi, 10 / min kulowa, 5 / min register

mzere: {ts, chochitika, actor_id, target_id, details_cbor, prev_hash, row_hash}
row_hash = SHA-256(ts ∥ chochitika ∥ actor_id ∥ ... ∥ prev_hash)

privacy.title: Zazinsinsi ndi kutsata
privacy.subtitle: GDPR, kufufuta kumanja, kuchepetsa metadata, kusuntha kwa data.
privacy.intro: Vortex zombo GDPR ndi CCPA zida kuchokera m'bokosi. Ogwira ntchito m'malo olamulidwa ali ndi malo amodzi omaliza pazopempha zilizonse zovomerezeka.
privacy.h1p1: Ayi IP mitengo mwachisawawa. sinthani mizere ya projekiti `X-Real-IP` pokhapokha wogwiritsa ntchito atalowa.
privacy.h1p2: `sender_pseudo` m'mizere ya mauthenga amafulumira ma ID otumiza enieni - kutaya DB kumangowonetsa mayina ongopeka pachipinda chilichonse.
privacy.h1p3: Kusaka kumagwiritsa ntchito zizindikiro zobisika. Makasitomala amabisa mawu osakira ndi kiyi yachipinda; node imasunga zizindikiro zowoneka bwino; kuyang'ana ndikofanana ndendende ndi zizindikiro za ciphertext.
privacy.h1p4: Zowoneka komaliza zasinthidwa kukhala granularity yosankhidwa ndi wogwiritsa.
privacy.h2p1: `POST /api/zinsinsi/kufufuta` samatchula mzere wa ogwiritsa ntchito, amapukuta mauthenga awo omwe adatumizidwa (metadata yosungidwa pa quorum), amachotsa mafayilo pa disk.
privacy.h2p2: Federation: miseche yosainidwa imadziwitsa anzawo; amafufuta kumbali yawo mkati mwa 72 h.
privacy.h2p3: Audit: erasure yalowetsedwa ndi chidindo chanthawi ndi (hashed) id yogwiritsa ntchito kuti wogwiritsa ntchito athe kutsimikizira kuti akutsatira.
privacy.h3p1: `GET /api/zinsinsi/export` imatsitsa zip: mbiri JSON, yotumizidwa/yolandila ciphertext, zolozera zamafayilo zokhala ndi makiyi amtundu uliwonse, mndandanda wolumikizana.
privacy.h3p2: Nthawi yakubadwa: ~5 min pa mauthenga 10 k, omangidwa ndi IO.
privacy.h3p3: Wolandira akuyenera kumasulira mawu achinsinsi mdera lanu; export tooling imatumizidwa pamodzi.
privacy.h4p1: Dinani kwanthawi yayitali logo 5 s → kufufuta komweko komweko: makiyi, mauthenga osungidwa, zomata.
privacy.h4p2: Kupukuta kophatikizana: `/api/privacy/panic` imayikanso manda a akaunti yapa seva.
privacy.h1_a: Ayi IP mitengo mwachisawawa. Palibe metadata yozindikiritsa ogwiritsa ntchito pamizere ya mauthenga. Sakani mawu athunthu pamatokeni obisika.
privacy.h1_b: Bwezerani mizere yofananira `X-Real-IP` node isanawone pokhapokha wogwiritsa ntchito atalowa kuti achepetse mtengo. Mizere ya mauthenga imasunga `sender_id` (ya ACL) ndi `sender_pseudo` (for fan-out); sender_pseudo ndi HMAC(room_salt, sender_id) kotero kuti DB kutaya sikuwulula yemwe ananena zipinda. Sakani: kasitomala amabisa mawu osakira ndi kiyi yachipinda; node imasunga zizindikiro zowoneka bwino; kuyang'ana ndikofanana ndendende ndi zizindikiro za ciphertext, palibe plaintext index.
privacy.h1_c: Kuchepetsa kwa metadata ndikogwirizana kwa pambuyo pa Snowden - Signal idatchuka mu 2014, WhatsApp idatsatiridwa ndi sender-pseudo mu 2019. Kusaka kwachinsinsi pa zizindikiro za ciphertext ndi CryptDB (2011) ndi ShadowCrypt (2014) chitsanzo. Kukhazikitsa kwa Vortex ndi mtundu wovumbulidwa womwe umasinthanitsa kusinthasintha kwa mafunso kuti akhale osavuta.
privacy.h2_a: `POST /api/zinsinsi/erase` samatchula mzere wa ogwiritsa ntchito, amapukuta mawu omwe adatumizidwa, amachotsa mafayilo, ndikudziwitsa anzawo.
privacy.h2_b: Mbali ya seva: `magawo okhudzidwa a mzere wa osuta asinthidwa ziro (`dzina lolowera = "deted-<id>"`, `foni = null`, `imelo = null`, `display_name = "[zachotsedwa]"`); `messages.ciphertext` yakhazikitsa NULL pamizere yonse pomwe `sender_id = u.id`; mafayilo olumikizidwa ku mauthenga amenewo achotsedwa pa disk. Anzanu amgwirizano amalandila `{chochitika: "kufufuta", ID_yosaina_yosaina}` miseche; amathamanganso chimodzimodzi kumbali yawo mkati mwa 72 h (SLA).
privacy.h2_c: Kuchotsa kumanja ndi chofunikira GDPR Ndime 17 kuyambira 2018. CCPA yotsatiridwa mu 2020; LGPD (Brazil) mu 2021. Vortex imatumiza zachikale zakunja kotero kuti ogwira ntchito m'malo olamulidwa sayenera kupanga. Bungwe la 72 h federation SLA likufanana ndi zenera loyankha la masiku 30 la GDPR lokhala ndi mutu wofalitsa.
privacy.h3_a: `GET /api/zinsinsi/export` imatsitsa zip: mbiri JSON, yotumizidwa/yolandila ciphertext, zolozera zamafayilo zokhala ndi makiyi amtundu uliwonse, mndandanda wolumikizana.
privacy.h3_b: Generation ndi async chifukwa nkhani zazikulu zimatenga mphindi. Ma Client POSTs amapempha → node imalowetsa ntchito → ntchito imayambira kumbuyo → zisankho zamakasitomala `/api/privacy/export/{job_id}` → 200 zosaina URL zikakonzeka. Zip zili mkati: `profile.json`, `rooms.jsonl` (chimodzi pachipinda), `messages.jsonl.enc` (ciphertext + per-file root keys), `mafayilo/` (dawunilodidwa-monga mabulogu).
privacy.h3_c: Kusunthika kwa data ndikofunikira pawiri ndikufufuta mu GDPR. Apple, Google, Telegram, Signal onse ali ndi zida zochotsera. Vortex's imawonjezera zinthu zofunika (file_root pa fayilo) kuti ogwiritsa ntchito athe kubisa zomwe akutumiza kwanuko - apo ayi kutumizirako sikungagwire ntchito. Popanda mwatsatanetsatane izi Apple / Google zotulutsa ndizomveka bwino chifukwa adazilemba kale.
privacy.h4_a: Mantha pukuta: kanikizani chizindikiro cha Vortex kwa masekondi 5 kuti muwononge nthawi yomweyo makiyi onse ndi zosungidwa pazida. Zosasinthika.
privacy.h4_b: Kumbali ya kasitomala: pa 5-sekondi yayitali yosindikizira, onetsani chitsimikiziro; pakutsimikizira, imbani `wipeKeychainItems()` / `clearKeystore()` / `localStorage.clear() + indexedDB.databases().forEach(deleteDatabase)`. Ciphertext cached yapita, makiyi apita, ma JWT apita. Kupukuta kophatikizika kosankha: `POST /api/zinsinsi/mantha` kumakhudzanso mbali ya seva ya akaunti ndikuphatikiza miseche yochotsa.
privacy.h4_c: Mabatani owopsa / zosintha zamunthu wakufa zimakhala ndi mbiri yayitali pamauthenga otetezeka: Wickr's 2014 "Shred", Cryptocat's 2013 "Iwalani", malingaliro a Signal's "Secure Deletion" (2016, sanatumizidwe). Vortex's 5-second-seconds ndizovuta kuyambitsa mwadala - tidaphunzira ndemanga za haptic pa iPhone 15 ndi Pixel 8 ndipo tidasankha 5s ngati malo okoma pakati pa "mwachangu pakachitika ngozi" ndi "singathe kuyatsa ndi batani la mthumba".
privacy.h1_f:
sender_pseudo = HMAC-SHA256(mchere_wachipinda, wotumiza_id)[:16]
  ⇒ DB kutaya: {chipinda, sender_pseudo, ciphertext}
  ⇒ Wowukira sangathe kulumikiza sender_pseudo kuzipinda (mchere wosiyana)

chizindikiro chosakira = HMAC-SHA256(key_key, mawu osakira)
   funsani "hello" ⇒ phatikizani chizindikiro ⇒ fufuzani mlozera wofananira
   Manodi samawona mawu osamveka
privacy.h2_f:
POST /api/zinsinsi/futa (kudzitumikira)
  UPDATE ogwiritsa SET username='deted-'||id, phone=NULL, imelo=NULL, ... WHERE id=$u
  UPDATE mauthenga SET ciphertext=NULL WHERE sender_id=$u
  DELETE FROM mafayilo WHERE uploaded_by=$u
  miseche {chochitika:"kufufuta", user_id, sig:Ed25519(release_priv, event)}
privacy.h3_f:
export.zip
├── profile.json (magawo a ogwiritsa ntchito)
├── rooms.jsonl (chipinda chimodzi pamzere uliwonse)
├── messages.jsonl.enc (ciphertext + per-msg file_root)
├── decrypt.py (zolemba zothandizira)
└── mafayilo/
    ├── <file_id>.bin (chitsamba chobisika, chinsinsi cha mizu mu messages.jsonl)
    └── ...
privacy.h4_f:
Dinani kwanthawi yayitali ≥ 5 s pa VORTEX logo:
  tsimikizirani zokambirana
  pakutsimikizira:
    Keychain.deleteAll(chiyambi = "vortex.")
    UserDefaults.removeObject(forKey: "vortex.*")
    SQLite vortex.db DROP matebulo onse
    kuphatikiza: POST /api/zinsinsi/mantha (mbali ya seva yamwala)

debugging.title: Debugging ndi diagnostics
debugging.subtitle: Zida zowunikira zovuta mu dev, staging, ndi prod.
debugging.intro: Dongosolo lililonse lili ndi mitengo yokhazikika komanso / metrics pamwamba. Nayi buku lamasewera la matenda.
debugging.h1p2: kuzungulira pa 100 MB; sungani 14 gens gzipped.
debugging.h1p3: Mulingo pa gawo lililonse kudzera pa `LOG_LEVEL_<MODULE>=DEBUG` (monga `LOG_LEVEL_TRANSPORT=DEBUG`).
debugging.h1p4: Id yolumikizirana: pempho lililonse limapeza `X-Pempho-Id`; ma RPC akumunsi amachigwiritsanso ntchito.
debugging.h2p1: Mtundu wa Prometheus pa `/metrics` (admin-authenticated in prod).
debugging.h2p2: RED: mlingo / zolakwika / nthawi panjira iliyonse.
debugging.h2p3: USE: kugwiritsa ntchito / machulukitsidwe / zolakwika pa DB dziwe, WebSocket fan-out, TURN relay.
debugging.h2p4: Mwambo: zipinda zogwira ntchito, mauthenga, ma histogram.
debugging.h3p1: `py-spy` potengera nthawi yoyambira. Gwirizanitsani ku node yothamanga PID.
debugging.h3p2: `memray` kwa mulu wa mbiri. Chithunzi champhindi 1 chikuwonetsa kutayikira mwachangu.
debugging.h3p3: Rust yowonjezera `vortex_chat` imatumiza `--profile` mbendera yomwe imalemba chizindikiro chogwirizana ndi flamegraph.
debugging.h4p1: `scripts/smoke/all.sh` imayendetsa register/login/send/receive/logout against node yakomweko. Imatuluka popanda ziro pakulephera kulikonse.
debugging.h4p2: CI imathamangitsa utsi pa PR iliyonse komanso pazophatikizira kupita ku main.
debugging.h4p3: Utsi wopanga: kafukufuku wakunja akugunda akaunti ya canary kamodzi pa mphindi.
debugging.h1_a: Zolemba ndi JSON-zopangidwa mwachisawawa. Mzere uliwonse wa chipika umaphatikizapo ts, mlingo, module, uthenga, ndi id yolumikizira.
debugging.h1_b: `logger.info("user_created", extra={"user_id": u.id})` imatulutsa `{"ts":"2026-04-21T10:23:14.127Z", "lvl":"INFO", "mod":"auth", "msg":"quus_created": "_`: "user_created", "_`" quus_id: "_`": "user_created": "_`": "user_created": "_`": "user_id": "_`...": "user_created": "_`...": "user_created". Id yolumikizana imachokera kumutu wa `X-Request-Id`; mtsinje uliwonse RPC amachigwiritsanso ntchito. Kuzungulira pa 100 MB; sungani mibadwo 14 gzipped. Mulingo pa gawo lililonse kudzera pa `LOG_LEVEL_<MODULE>=DEBUG`.
debugging.h1_c: Kudula mitengo JSON ndi mgwirizano wapano - wotengedwa ndi Stripe, Datadog, wogulitsa aliyense wamakono. Ma ID olumikizana amatsata X-Request-Id (RFC 4557) ndipo adakhala ovomerezeka mu ma microservices kudzera pa Jaeger / Zipkin (2015). Vortex imagwiritsa ntchito id yolumikizana ndi mutu wosavuta m'malo mongogawira zilombo chifukwa zida zogawira zimawonjezera zovuta zomwe sitikufunabe.
debugging.h2_a: Prometheus metrics pa `/metrics` (admin-authenticated in production). Madeshibodi a Grafana atumizidwa mu `deploy/grafana/`.
debugging.h2_b: RED ma metric panjira: kuchuluka kwa zopempha, kuchuluka kwa zolakwika, nthawi ya histogram. USE ma metric pa chilichonse: DB kagwiritsidwe ntchito ka dziwe, WebSocket kudzaza kwa fan-out, TURN bandwidth yolumikizirana. Mwambo: zipinda zogwira ntchito, mauthenga pa sekondi iliyonse, histogram ya mlingo wobisika. Dashboard ya Admin pa `/admin/metrics` ikuwonetsa ma chart apamwamba; Prometheus akukankhira mbiri yonse.
debugging.h2_c: RED (mlingo / zolakwika / nthawi) ndi mawu a Weaveworks '2016. USE (magwiritsidwe / machulukitsidwe / zolakwika) ndi njira ya Brendan Gregg ya 2013. Pamodzi amaphimba ma siginecha amtundu wautumiki komanso mawonekedwe azinthu. Prometheus + Grafana ndiye gwero lotseguka kuyambira 2016.
debugging.h3_a: `py-spy` poyesa nthawi yothamanga; `memray` kwa mulu zithunzithunzi; `vortex_chat` Rust chowonjezera chili ndi `--profile` pazotsatira zamoto.
debugging.h3_b: `py-spy record -o profile.svg --pid <node>` kwa 60 s imapanga flamegraph SVG kusonyeza kutentha Python stacks. `memray run -o mem.bin <cmd>` amatsata magawo; `memray flamegraph mem.bin` amamasulira. Rust chowonjezera chimatumiza mbiri zamkati monga kufufuza kwa Chrome JSON mukaitanidwa ndi `--profile`. Gwirizanitsani chilichonse mwa izi ndi kuyesa-kulemetsa komwe kumadutsa mu `scripts/smoke/all.sh` pamitundu yofanana.
debugging.h3_c: py-spy (2018) ndiwosawerengeka osasokoneza omwe amalumikizana ndi Python njira popanda kusintha kwamakhodi - Go ya Python ma profaili. memray (Bloomberg, 2022) ndiye wolemba mbiri wabwino kwambiri Python lero. Rust's ecosystem ya mbiri yake ndi yokhwima koma yosaphatikizika; Zowonjezera zathu zimatumiza kutsata kwa Chrome makamaka chifukwa msakatuli aliyense amakhala ndi wowonera.
debugging.h4_a: `scripts/smoke/all.sh` zolembera zolimbitsa thupi/lowani/tumizani/landirani/tulukani motsutsana ndi nodi yakumaloko. CI imayendetsa pa PR iliyonse.
debugging.h4_b: Utsi umayenda mkati mwa masekondi ~ 5. Amapanga maakaunti awiri atsopano, amatsegula DM, amatumiza uthenga, amatsimikizira kutumizidwa, amatuluka onse. Imatuluka popanda ziro pakulephera kulikonse. CI imapempha kuti imangidwe. Utsi wina wa prod-smoke canary umayenda mphindi iliyonse kuchokera pa kafukufuku wakunja motsutsana ndi akaunti yoyeserera yodzipatulira pamalo opangira.
debugging.h4_c: Mayeso a utsi ndi fanizo la fakitale ya Toyota (zaka za m'ma 1950) - fufuzani mwachangu kuti mutsimikizire kuti dongosololi silinasweka. Mu mapulogalamu adakhala muyezo pambuyo pa Michael Nthenga '"Kugwira Ntchito Moyenera ndi Legacy Code" (2004). Vortex's utsi script ndi ~200 mizere ya bash + curl.

testing.title: Njira yoyesera
testing.subtitle: Mizere 29 ya mayeso kudutsa Python, Swift, Kotlin, JS.
testing.intro: Gawo lililonse lili ndi test suite yake. CI imayendetsa zonse mkati mwa mphindi 10.
testing.h1p1: `pytest app/mayeso` imakwirira ma routers, chitetezo, zoyendera, bots.
testing.h1p2: Mayeso otengera katundu pa crypto: `assert decrypt(m, k), k) == m` kwa 1000 mwachisawawa m.
testing.h1p3: AFL-mawonekedwe a fuzz pa WAF: mamiliyoni olowa molakwika - akunena kuti palibe kutayikira kwa 5xx.
testing.h2p1: `Mayeso othamanga' mu `ios/Modules/` amayesa mayeso a unit motsutsana ndi RFC 7748 / 8032 / 5869 / 8446 ma vector oyesa.
testing.h2p2: XCUI mayeso amayendetsa mawonedwe a SwiftUI mu simulator yopanda mutu; chithunzithunzi-kuyerekeza.
testing.h3p2: `./gradlew connectedCheck` imayesa mayeso pogwiritsa ntchito emulator.
testing.h4p1: Playwright amayendetsa kasitomala pa intaneti, wopanda mutu Chrome + Firefox wopanda mutu. Kuyimba kumachitidwa ndi `-use-fake-ui-for-media-stream`.
testing.h4p2: Zochitika: lembani maakaunti awiri → DM → tumizani fayilo → chotsani → tsimikizirani kulunzanitsa → kutha.
testing.h1_a: Python mayeso amagwiritsa ntchito pytest + kuphimba. Router iliyonse, chitetezo chilichonse choyambirira, gawo lililonse lamayendedwe limakhala ndi mayeso. ~ 80% Kufunika.
testing.h1_b: `pytest app/tests` imakhala ndi suite yonse mkati mwa mphindi 2 pachinthu chimodzi. Mayesero otengera katundu pazambiri za crypto: `assert decrypt(encrypt(m, k), k) == m` kwa mauthenga 1000 mwachisawawa. Mayeso a AFL-style fuzz pa WAF: mamiliyoni olowa molakwika akuti atulutsa yankho la 4xx (osati 5xx). `pytest --cov=app` kuti ipezeke.
testing.h1_c: pytest (Holger Krekel, 2009) ndiye de-facto Python wothamanga woyeserera. Hypothesis (2015) pakuyesa kotengera katundu adawonetsa lingaliro la QuickCheck kuchokera ku Haskell. AFL (Michał Zalewski, 2013) ya fuzz ndiye fuzzer yotsogozedwa ndi ovomerezeka. Vortex's stack ndiyofala; chokoma chokha ndichomwe timakonda pytest parametrisation kuposa cholowa chamtundu wa mayeso.
testing.h2_a: Mayeso othamanga mu `ios/Modules/` amaphimba zoyambira za crypto motsutsana ndi RFC ma vector oyeserera kuphatikiza mayeso azithunzi a SwiftUI.
testing.h2_b: `mayeso othamanga` kuchokera ku `ios/Modules/` amayesa mayunitsi osakwana 1 s. RFC 7748 (X25519) ma vector. RFC 8032 (Ed25519) ma vector. RFC 5869 (HKDF) ma vector. RFC 8446 (TLS 1.3) zosintha. Zithunzi zowonera za SwiftUI poyerekeza ndi chithunzi chosiyana ndi zomwe zimatsatiridwa ndi git; regression pa pixel iliyonse imalephera kumanga.
testing.h2_c: Kuyesa ma crypto pa ma vector ovomerezeka ndi njira yoteteza zipolopolo kwambiri - ngati khodi yanu ikugwirizana ndi RFC ma vekta, imagwirizana ndi tanthauzo. Kuyesa kwachidule kwa SwiftUI ndi ~2022 state of art, yodziwika ndi pointfreeco/swift-snapshot-testing. Vortex amagwiritsa ntchito mtundu wocheperako wamkati kuti apewe kudalira.
testing.h3_a: Mayeso a Kotlin: JVM-pokha kudzera `./gradlew test`; chida kudzera `./gradlew connectedCheck` pa emulator yothamanga.
testing.h3_b: `./gradlew test` imayenda pakangopita masekondi - palibe chimango cha Android chomwe chikufunika, kungoyesa kwa JUnit + Hilt-android. Zolinga zoyesa mayunitsi: crypto, owonetsa, mayendedwe otengera ma coroutine. `./gradlew connectedCheck` imapanga emulator, imayika pulogalamuyi, imayesa UI kudzera pa Espresso. E2E ikuyenda: lowani → tumizani uthenga → onani pamacheza.
testing.h3_c: Kulekanitsa mayeso JVM-okha ndi mayeso a zida ndi msonkhano wa Android 2019+. JVM mayeso amathamanga (masekondi); kuyesa kwa zida kumachedwa (mphindi). Robolectric (2014) amagwiritsidwa ntchito potseka kusiyana koma adasinthidwa kwambiri ndi kugawanikaku mu chitukuko chamakono cha Android.
testing.h4_a: Playwright amayendetsa kasitomala wapaintaneti mu Chrome ndi Firefox wopanda mutu, akugwiritsa ntchito kaundula weniweni → DM → kuyenda kwa mafoni.
testing.h4_b: `playwright-test/` imakhala ndi zochitika mu TypeScript. Node yotaya + Postgres imapangidwa pagawo loyesa kudzera pa docker compose. Mayeso amayendetsa intaneti UI: lembetsani maakaunti awiri, tsegulani DM, tumizani uthenga, tsimikizirani kutumizidwa, imbani foni ya kanema ndi `--use-fake-ui-for-media-stream` + `--use-fake-device-for-media-stream` mbendera kuti Chrome ipange nyimbo/kanema wopangidwa. Zithunzi zimayendera limodzi kudzera mwa ogwira ntchito a Playwright.
testing.h4_c: Playwright (Microsoft, 2020) adatsitsa Selenium pamayesero ambiri a intaneti E2E chifukwa imathamanga, yodalirika, komanso imachotsa zolakwika. WebRTC kuyesa msakatuli wopanda mutu kunali kowawa mpaka Chrome 69 idawonjezera mbendera zabodza; kuyambira pamenepo zakhala chizolowezi chokhazikika.

apiSurface.title: API pamwamba
apiSurface.subtitle: Iliyonse HTTP pomaliza malo amawulula, ophatikizidwa ndi dera.
apiSurface.intro: Uwu ndiye mndandanda wovomerezeka wamayendedwe apagulu. Khadi lililonse lakumapeto limakula kuti liwonetse cholinga, gawo la auth, zopempha / mayankho, tebulo lolakwika, ndi chitsanzo cha curl. Njira zosungiramo nyumba pansi pa `/zamkati/*` sizimaloledwa ndi ndondomeko.

auth.title: Kutsimikizira
auth.subtitle: Lembani, lowani, tsitsimutsani, chotsani - ndi njira zobwezeretsa.
auth.intro: Njira zonse pansi pa `/api/authentication/*`. JWT yomwe imatuluka polowera kopambana imakhala ndi `{sub: user_id, jti: device_id, typ: access|refresh}` yosainidwa HS256 pachinsinsi cha nodi. Kufikira kumatenga mphindi 15, tsitsimutsani masiku 30.

register.title: POST /api/authentication/register
register.subtitle: Pangani wogwiritsa ntchito watsopano ndi X25519 ID + Argon2id achinsinsi.
register.h1_a: Amapanga akaunti yatsopano ya ogwiritsa ntchito ndikutulutsa zoyambira JWT. Amamangirira kiyi yanthawi yayitali ya wogwiritsa X25519 ku akauntiyi kuyambira pakuyimba koyamba.
register.h1_b: Node imatsimikizira magawo onse kudzera pa Pydantic, imayang'ana dzina lolowera ndi x25519_public_key wapadera, imayendetsa Argon2id (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) pa mawu achinsinsi, imayika mu `users`, `user_devices`, `push_subscriptions`, mints access + refresh JWTs.
register.h1_c: Kutumizidwa mu v0.0.1 ngati pomaliza koyamba. The X25519 pubkey parameter idawonjezedwa mu v0.0.2 pambuyo pozindikira kuti ndi ndani ndipo akaunti iyenera kupangidwa motengera - apo ayi seva ikhoza MITM wogwiritsa ntchito pakati pa kulembetsa ndi kukweza kiyi yoyamba.
register.h2_a: Amafuna: **palibe **. Zida zapakati `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` zipata njira iyi ndikukana ndi `401 zosatsimikizika` ngati chitsimikiziro chofunikira chilibe kapena cholakwika.
register.h2_b:
- `palibe` - osavomerezeka (kulowa m'malo).
- `jwt` - Wonyamula JWT chizindikiro chofikira pamutu wa `Chilolezo`.
- `tsitsimutsani` - Wonyamula JWT chizindikiro chotsitsimutsa.
- `admin` — JWT omwe zonena zake zili ndi `is_admin: true`.
- 'osainidwa ndi anzawo' - bungwe lofunsira losainidwa ndi kiyi ya Ed25519 ya anzanu.
register.h2_c: Gawo laolemba likuwonetsa mfundo yamwayi wocheperako: malekezero olowa musanayambe kulembetsa amangokhala pakupanga akaunti ndikubwezeretsanso; chilichonse kumbuyo kwa JWT chimawona wogwiritsa ntchito; zomaliza za admin zikuwonetsa baji mu UI kotero kuti kugwiritsa ntchito molakwika kumawonekera.
register.h3_a: JSON thupi lokhala ndi dzina lovomerezeka + mawu achinsinsi + x25519_public_key; foni yosankha (E.164), imelo (RFC 5322 lite), display_name, avatar_emoji, invite_code, kyber_public_key.
register.h3_f:
{
  "username": "alice", // [a-z0-9_]{3,30}
  "password": "…", // ≥ 8 chars
  "x25519_public_key": "<64-hex>", // 32 bytes hex
  "display_name": "Alice", // optional
  "phone": "+15551234567", // optional, E.164
  "email": "a@example.com", // optional
  "avatar_emoji": "🦊", // optional, 1 emoji
  "invite_code": "…", // optional ngati INVITE mode
  "kyber_public_key": "<1184 hex>" // kusankha, kwa PQ
}
register.h4_a: 201 Adapangidwa ndi JWT awiri ndi mbiri yatsopano ya wogwiritsa ntchito.
register.h4_f:
{
  "OK": zoona,
  "access_token": "eyJ…", // 15 min TTL
  "refresh_token": "eyJ…", // masiku 30 TTL
  "user_id": 42,
  "username": "alice",
  "display_name": "Alice",
  "avatar_url": null,
  "x25519_public_key": "<64 hex>",
  "kyber_public_key": "<hex>"
}
register.h5_a: Kutsimikizika kokhazikika + kukana kuwiri kwapadera kwa domain. `lolowera 409_latengedwa` dzina likakhalapo; `409 pubkey_reused` pamene X25519 kiyi ya anthu onse yalembetsedwa kale ku akaunti ina.
register.h5_f:
409 kugundana kwa dzina lolowera
409 pubkey_reused X25519 pubkey yomwe yagwiritsidwa kale ntchito
422 validation_error constriction yaphwanyidwa
429 mlingo_zochepa >5 olembetsa/mphindi/IP
403 registration_closed node ili mu INVITE mode ndipo nambala ikusowa
register.h6_f:
kupindika -X POST 'https://node.example/api/authentication/register' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d'{
    "dzina lantchito":"alice",
    "password":"chinthu choyenera cha batri",
    "x25519_public_key":"8ef8e663…",
    "display_name":"Alice",
    "avatar_emoji":"🦊"
  }'

login.title: POST /api/authentication/login
login.subtitle: Tsimikizirani dzina lolowera + mawu achinsinsi, bwererani JWT awiri.
login.h1_a: Kusinthanitsa mbiri ndi JWT awiri. Mawu achinsinsi amatsimikiziridwa motsutsana ndi Argon2id hash mu `users.password_hash`. Nthawi ndi nthawi yanthawi zonse ngakhale kwa mayina osadziwika omwe angakane kuwerengera.
login.h1_b: Imayang'ana wogwiritsa ntchito pogwiritsa ntchito zilembo zotsika, imayendetsa `argon2.PasswordHasher.verify(yosungidwa, yatumizidwa)`. Ngati wogwiritsa ntchito kulibe, amatsimikizira motsutsana ndi dummy hash yomwe idapangidwa kale kuti igwirizane ndi nthawi. Kupambana → nkhani JWT + `mzere_zida`.
login.h1_c: Kutumizidwa ndi register mu v0.0.1. Nthawi zonse dummy hashing adawonjezedwa mu v0.0.2 ofufuza atawonetsa kuwerengera nthawi pamapangidwe oyamba.
login.h2_a: Amafuna: **palibe **. Zida zapakati `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` zipata njira iyi ndikukana ndi `401 zosatsimikizika` ngati chitsimikiziro chofunikira chilibe kapena cholakwika.
login.h2_b:
- `palibe` - osavomerezeka (kulowa m'malo).
- `jwt` - Wonyamula JWT chizindikiro chofikira pamutu wa `Chilolezo`.
- `tsitsimutsani` - Wonyamula JWT chizindikiro chotsitsimutsa.
- `admin` — JWT omwe zonena zake zili ndi `is_admin: true`.
- 'osainidwa ndi anzawo' - bungwe lofunsira losainidwa ndi kiyi ya Ed25519 ya anzanu.
login.h2_c: Gawo laolemba likuwonetsa mfundo yamwayi wocheperako: malekezero olowa musanayambe kulembetsa amangokhala pakupanga akaunti ndikubwezeretsanso; chilichonse kumbuyo kwa JWT chimawona wogwiritsa ntchito; zomaliza za admin zikuwonetsa baji mu UI kotero kuti kugwiritsa ntchito molakwika kumawonekera.
login.h5_a: Standard Vortex envulopu yolakwika `{zolakwika, mawonekedwe, njira}`. '401' pazidziwitso zoipa; `403` pa mwayi wosakwanira; `422` potsimikizira; '429' pa malire a mtengo; `5xx` pa zolakwika zamkati.
login.h5_f:
401 invalid_credentials dzina loyipa kapena mawu achinsinsi
401 akaunti_yoyimitsidwa yayimitsidwa
401 totp_required supply totp ndikuyeseranso
429 mlingo_zochepa >10 kuyesa/mphindi/IP

refresh.title: POST /api/authentication/refresh
refresh.subtitle: Gulitsani zotsitsimutsa JWT kuti mupeze mwayi watsopano JWT.
refresh.h1_a: Imayika chizindikiro chatsopano cha mphindi 15 popanda kufunsa wogwiritsanso mawu achinsinsi. Amagwiritsidwa ntchito pomwe chizindikiro chapano chatsala pang'ono kutha kapena changobweza 401.
refresh.h1_b: Imazindikira ndikutsimikizira chizindikiro chotsitsimutsa (siginecha, exp, yosasinthidwa), imapanga mwayi watsopano JWT ndi `jti` yomweyo. Ngati `ROTATE_REFRESH=zoona`, iperekanso kutsitsimula kwatsopano.
refresh.h1_c: Imatsatira RFC 6749 OAuth 2.0. Kutembenuza kotsitsimutsa kumangozimitsidwa kuti mupewe mpikisano pamene makasitomala angapo atsitsimutsanso nthawi imodzi.

passwordChange.title: POST /api/authentication/password-change
passwordChange.subtitle: Sinthani mawu achinsinsi
passwordChange.h1_a: Imatsimikizira mawu achinsinsi omwe alipo, ikaninso yatsopanoyo ndi Argon2id, ikusintha `users.password_hash`.
passwordChange.h1_b: Chothandizira panjirayi chimakhala mugawo lolingana ndi `app/`. Njira `/api/authentication/password-change` imalengezedwa ndi `@router.post('/api/authentication/password-change')`.
passwordChange.h1_c: Kutumizidwa koyambirira kwa Vortex ngati gawo la kuthekera kwa `kusintha mawu achinsinsi`.
passwordChange.h2_a: Zofunika: **jwt**. Zida zapakati `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` zipata njira iyi ndikukana ndi `401 zosatsimikizika` ngati chitsimikiziro chofunikira chilibe kapena cholakwika.
passwordChange.h2_b:
- `palibe` - osavomerezeka (kulowa m'malo).
- `jwt` - Wonyamula JWT chizindikiro chofikira pamutu wa `Chilolezo`.
- `tsitsimutsani` - Wonyamula JWT chizindikiro chotsitsimutsa.
- `admin` — JWT omwe zonena zake zili ndi `is_admin: true`.
- 'osainidwa ndi anzawo' - bungwe lofunsira losainidwa ndi kiyi ya Ed25519 ya anzanu.
passwordChange.h2_c: Gawo laolemba likuwonetsa mfundo yamwayi wocheperako: malekezero olowa musanayambe kulembetsa amangokhala pakupanga akaunti ndikubwezeretsanso; chilichonse kumbuyo kwa JWT chimawona wogwiritsa ntchito; zomaliza za admin zikuwonetsa baji mu UI kotero kuti kugwiritsa ntchito molakwika kumawonekera.
passwordChange.h5_a: Standard Vortex envulopu yolakwika `{zolakwika, mawonekedwe, njira}`. '401' pazidziwitso zoipa; `403` pa mwayi wosakwanira; `422` potsimikizira; '429' pa malire a mtengo; `5xx` pa zolakwika zamkati.
passwordChange.h5_f:
401 chizindikiro chosowa/chosavomerezeka
403 zoletsedwa mwayi wosakwanira
422 validation_error constriction yaphwanyidwa
429 rate_kuchepetsa kuyesa kochulukirapo
500 mkati_zolakwika zosayembekezereka za seva

- `tsitsimutsani` - Wonyamula JWT chizindikiro chotsitsimutsa.
- `admin` — JWT omwe zonena zake zili ndi `is_admin: true`.
- 'osainidwa ndi anzawo' - bungwe lofunsira losainidwa ndi kiyi ya Ed25519 ya anzanu.
messages.h2_c: Gawo laolemba likuwonetsa mfundo yamwayi wocheperako: malekezero olowa musanayambe kulembetsa amangokhala pakupanga akaunti ndikubwezeretsanso; chilichonse kumbuyo kwa JWT chimawona wogwiritsa ntchito; zomaliza za admin zikuwonetsa baji mu UI kotero kuti kugwiritsa ntchito molakwika kumawonekera.
messages.h5_a: Standard Vortex envulopu yolakwika `{zolakwika, mawonekedwe, njira}`. '401' pazidziwitso zoipa; `403` pa mwayi wosakwanira; `422` potsimikizira; '429' pa malire a mtengo; `5xx` pa zolakwika zamkati.
messages.h5_f:
401 chizindikiro chosowa/chosavomerezeka
403 zoletsedwa mwayi wosakwanira
422 validation_error constriction yaphwanyidwa
429 rate_kuchepetsa kuyesa kochulukirapo
500 mkati_zolakwika zosayembekezereka za seva

roadmap.title: Mapanjira
roadmap.subtitle: Zomwe zakonzedwa komanso liti.
roadmap.intro: Mawonekedwe apamwamba. Madeti ndi olakalaka; zovuta zachitetezo zimayika patsogolo ntchito.
roadmap.h1p1: Kyber-768 PQ imayatsidwa mwachisawawa pamayikidwe atsopano.
roadmap.h1p2: Magulu mpaka mamembala 50 000 okhala ndi makiyi a Variant-B asindikizidwa.
roadmap.h1p3: Kupaka pa desktop (Tauri) kwa macOS / Windows / Linux.
roadmap.h1p4: Msika wa Bot umatsegulidwa kuti anthu atumizidwe.
roadmap.h2p1: Gulu lomvera nyimbo zokhazokha limayimba mpaka anthu 100 kudzera pa SFU.
roadmap.h2p3: Wotenga nawo mbali ali chete / akamayimba foni UI.
roadmap.h3p1: Chinsalu chogwirizira chamtundu wa Miro pamwamba pa CRDT (Yjs-flavoured) kudzera pagawo la mauthenga.
roadmap.h3p2: Kukhalapo kwa cholozera mu nthawi yeniyeni.
roadmap.h4p1: Escrow pa unyolo pogula bot (Solana + EVM).
roadmap.h4p2: Gawo la ndalama za opareshoni, 10 %% chindapusa cha nsanja.
roadmap.h4p3: Fiat on/off ramp kudzera pa Stripe connect.
roadmap.h5p1: Pamwambapa okhazikika, kuwunika kovomerezeka kwachitetezo, zomanganso zopangika, SemVer yachisanu.
roadmap.h5p3: Osachepera ndemanga imodzi yodziyimira payokha yodziyimira pawokha yokhala ndi zolemba zapagulu.
roadmap.h1_a: v0.2 - kutulutsidwa kwachiwiri kwa anthu. Kyber PQ yokhazikika mwachisawawa, zipinda zazikulu za anthu onse kudzera pa Variant-B, mapaketi apakompyuta a Tauri, misika yotseguka ya bot.
roadmap.h1_b: Zosintha za Kyber-768 kuti zikhazikitsidwe mwatsopano; makasitomala popanda thandizo mwachisomo amatsitsa. Zipinda zofikira mamembala 50 000 kudzera m'makiyi a Variant-B kusindikiza - palibe fanout ya membala aliyense pa kasinthasintha. Desktop (Tauri 2 wrapper mozungulira kasitomala) yosindikizidwa ya macOS, Windows, Linux yokhala ndi mtolo womwewo. Msika wa Bot umatsegulidwa kuti anthu atumizidwe ndi kuwunika kwamasiku atatu abizinesi SLA.
roadmap.h1_c: v0.2 ikukhudza kukulitsa zoyambira zomwe zilipo m'malo mopanga zatsopano. Kyber nthawi zonse anali panjira; kusintha kosasintha kumadalira kukhazikika pansi pa katundu. Tauri anasankhidwa pamwamba pa Electron chifukwa mtolo ndi ~5 MB vs ~150 MB. Zopereka zapagulu za Bot zidatsekedwa pazowunikira zomwe zidafika mu v0.1.
roadmap.h2_a: v0.3 - kuyimba kwamagulu. Magulu omvera a SFU mpaka 100; magulu amakanema mpaka 32; adaptive simulcast.
roadmap.h2_b: SFU yakhazikitsidwa mu Rust kuti igwire ntchito. Opus DTX + FEC + simulcast pamawu. VP9 L1/L2/L3 kujambulidwa kwa kanema ndi SFU kusankha wosanjikiza wowonera aliyense kutengera ulalo wotsikirako womwe wanenedwa. Wophunzira aliyense angokhala chete ndikukankha kuchokera pa UI. Kujambulitsa kuyimba (kololedwa, kuchotsedwa mwachisawawa) kosungidwa mobisa pansi pa kiyi yamtundu uliwonse yomwe amagawana pakati pa otenga nawo mbali.
roadmap.h2_c: Kuyimba kwamagulu ndi chinthu chimodzi chomwe chimafunsidwa kwambiri pa beta ya v0.1. SFU mapangidwe amatsatira Jitsi Videobridge + Janus mapatani. Rust kukhazikitsa m'malo mogwiritsanso ntchito mediasoup chifukwa mediasoup's Node.js runtime imawonjezera latency yomwe sitikufuna panjira yotentha.
roadmap.h3_a: v0.4 - chinsalu chogwirizana. Bolodi yogawana kalembedwe ka Miro pamwamba pa CRDT (Yjs-flavored) kudzera pamawu omwe alipo.
roadmap.h3_b: CRDT zikalata kulunzanitsa ma piggybacks pa mauthenga omwe alipo kale. Kusintha kwa bolodi kulikonse kumakhala CRDT opareshoni yotsatiridwa ngati CBOR, yosungidwa ndi kiyi yachipinda, yotumizidwa ngati uthenga wa `mtundu:"board_op"`. Makasitomala amasiya, perekani, perekani. Kukhalapo kwa cholozera nthawi yeniyeni kudzera pamtundu wina wa ``mtundu:"board_cursor"`. Tumizani Tumizani ku PNG / SVG / PDF kudzera pazithunzi za kasitomala.
roadmap.h3_c: CRDTs (Shapiro et al. 2011) idakhala yogwira ntchito ndi Yjs (Kevin Jahns, 2017). Figma adapanga mgwirizano wawo pachikhalidwe chofanana ndi CRDT. Lingaliro logwiritsanso ntchito kusanjika kwathu kwa mauthenga obisidwa m'malo momanga mayendedwe osiyana WebSocket amachokera pa mfundo: mayendedwe ochepa, nsikidzi zochepa.
roadmap.h4_a: v0.5 - malipiro. Escrow pa unyolo (Solana + EVM) + fiat on/off ramp kudzera pa Stripe Connect.
roadmap.h4_b: Bot amagula kudzera mu mgwirizano wapa-chain escrow. Wogula amavomereza; 24 h kusunga; Kenako ndalama zimatulutsidwa kwa wogulitsa kuchotsera 10 % chindapusa cha nsanja. Mikangano imapita kwa oweruza ammudzi omwe amasankhidwa kudzera pa staking. Fiat pa-ramp: Akaunti ya Stripe Connect pa wogwiritsa ntchito aliyense kapena wogulitsa bot; off-ramp: kusamutsa banki mwachindunji kapena USDC kukhazikika. Thandizo la Crypto: SOL, USDC, USDT pa Solana ndi Ethereum.
roadmap.h4_c: Mapangano anzeru a Escrow ndi akale (OpenBazaar 2016) koma amakhala ovuta m'mphepete mwa UX. Vortex amatengera zovuta koma amabisa zambiri - ogula amawona batani lodziwika bwino la "kugula". 10 % chindapusa cha nsanja chikufanana ndi misonkhano ya App Store (ngakhale Apple imatenga 30%); odulidwa m'munsi ndi dala kukopa ogulitsa.
roadmap.h5_a: v1.0 - kukhazikika. Kuwunika kwachitetezo, kupangikanso kumamanga pamapulatifomu onse, SemVer yachisanu.
roadmap.h5_b: Kuwunika kwa chipani chachitatu kunakonzedweratu kuzizira kwa 1.0 - mwina Trail of Bits kapena NCC Gulu kutengera mawu amalonda. Zomanganso zomwe zimapangidwira zimatanthawuza kuti mtengo womwewo umatulutsa mabatani ofanana pamakina awiri aliwonse; izi zimazindikira kuwonongeka kwa supply chain. SemVer frozen imatanthawuza ma protocol a waya, schema yosungirako, ndi anthu onse SDK pamwamba kupeza zitsimikizo zobwerera m'mbuyo mkati mwa 1.x. Pulogalamu ya Bug bounty imayambitsidwa ndi $ 25k top tier kuti apereke ma code akutali pa node.
roadmap.h5_c: Mayendedwe okhazikika-audit-freeze ndi mawonekedwe a Signal, Tor, I2P, ndi WireGuard onse amatsatiridwa. Zomangamanga zopangika zidakhala zodziwika bwino pambuyo pa Reproducible Builds Project (2014). Vortex amagwiritsa ntchito zida za Reproducible Builds. Zopindulitsa za Bug ndizofanana ndi projekiti iliyonse yomwe ikugwira ntchito ndi data; $25k ndi yapakatikati ndi miyezo ya 2025.

glossary.title: Kafotokozedwe ka mawu
glossary.subtitle: Mawu aliwonse ogwiritsidwa ntchito mu Vortex docs, amalembedwa.
glossary.intro: Kufotokozera kwa zilembo. Khadi lirilonse limakula kukhala tanthauzo lathunthu, pomwe limagwiritsidwa ntchito, mbiri yake, ndi chilinganizo kapena chitsanzo pakafunika.

aead.title: AEAD
aead.subtitle: Kubisa Kotsimikizika ndi Associated Data.
aead.intro: AEAD (Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data) ndi nkhani yachinsinsi yomwe imaphatikiza chinsinsi komanso kukhulupirika pakuyimba kumodzi. Potengera kiyi, mawu osamveka, mawu osavuta, ndi data yogwirizana nayo (AAD), imapanga chizindikiro cha ciphertext + kutsimikizira kuti kusokoneza kulikonse, mawu osavuta, kapena AAD kulephera kutsimikizira.
aead.h1_a: AEAD (Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data) ndi nkhani yachinsinsi yomwe imaphatikiza chinsinsi komanso kukhulupirika pakuyimba kumodzi. Potengera kiyi, mawu osamveka, mawu osavuta, ndi data yogwirizana nayo (AAD), imapanga chizindikiro cha ciphertext + kutsimikizira kuti kusokoneza kulikonse, mawu osavuta, kapena AAD kulephera kutsimikizira.
aead.h1_b: Vortex's AEAD nthawi zonse AES-256-GCM. AAD kagawo kamakhala ndi nkhani yomwe wolandira ayenera kudziwa kuti alembe molondola (id yachipinda, id yafayilo, offset). Kumanga AAD kumalepheretsa kuseweredwanso - mawu olembedwa muchipinda A sangasinthidwe ngati chipinda B.
aead.h1_c: AEAD monga zoyambira zakale ku Rogaway 2002. GCM (Galois/Counter Mode) idasinthidwa ndi NIST mu SP 800-38D (2007). Inakhala yosasintha AEAD mu TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446, 2018). Protocol iliyonse yamakono yotetezedwa imagwiritsa ntchito AEAD.
aead.h1_f:
AEAD.Enc(k, n, pt, aad) = (ct, tag) // ct = len(pt) mabayiti, tag = 16 mabayiti
AEAD.Dec(k, n, ct, tag, aad) = pt kapena ⊥

alembic.title: Alembic
alembic.subtitle: Chida chosinthira database cha SQLAlchemy.
alembic.intro: Alembic ndiye njira yovomerezeka yosamukira ku SQLAlchemy. Kusamuka kulikonse ndi fayilo ya Python yokhala ndi `kukweza ()` ndi `downgrade()` ntchito zomwe zimalongosola kusintha kwa schema monga SQL kapena ORM ntchito.
alembic.h1_a: Alembic ndiye njira yovomerezeka yosamukira ku SQLAlchemy. Kusamuka kulikonse ndi fayilo ya Python yokhala ndi `kukweza ()` ndi `downgrade()` ntchito zomwe zimalongosola kusintha kwa schema monga SQL kapena ORM ntchito.
alembic.h1_b: Vortex imagwiritsa ntchito Alembic yokhala ndi mbiri yowunikiranso (palibe nthambi). `alembic upgrade head` imayenda pachidebe chilichonse cha Docker. `alembic downgrade -1` imabweza sitepe imodzi pobweza. Dev mode imagwiritsa ntchito `create_all + ALTER TABLE fallback` kotero kuti kubwereza kwanuko sikufunika kusamuka pazigawo zilizonse.
alembic.h1_c: Alembic inalembedwa ndi Mike Bayer (mlembi wa SQLAlchemy) mu 2011 monga wolowa m'malo wa `sqlalchemy-migrate`. Kusamuka komangidwa kwa Django (2014) kudabwereka mtundu woyambira. Alembic adakhalabe patsogolo pazinthu - rollback, autogenerate, nthambi - ngakhale Vortex sagwiritsa ntchito nthambi.

apns.title: APNs
apns.subtitle: Apple Ntchito ya Push Notification.
apns.intro: Ma APN ndi Apple's push-notification service ya iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS. Mapulogalamu amalembetsa chizindikiro cha chipangizo ndipo opereka zidziwitso amatumiza zidziwitso ku ma APN zomwe zimawawonetsa kuzipangizo.
apns.h1_a: Ma APN ndi Apple's push-notification service ya iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS. Mapulogalamu amalembetsa chizindikiro cha chipangizo ndipo opereka zidziwitso amatumiza zidziwitso ku ma APN zomwe zimawawonetsa kuzipangizo.
apns.h1_b: Vortex imagwiritsa ntchito ma APN okhala ndi maenvulopu omata-kankhira: node imasunga chiwongola dzanja chilichonse pazidziwitso za wolandira X25519 pubkey; Ma APN amangowona mawonekedwe osawoneka bwino. The iOS kasitomala's Notification Service Extension decrypts mu njira ina chikwangwani chisanaperekedwe.
apns.h1_c: Ma APN adayambitsidwa ndi iOS 3.0 (2009). Thandizo losindikizidwa / losinthika losinthika lidabwera ndi iOS 10 (2016). Token-based auth (.p8) inalowa m'malo mwa setifiketi yochokera ku 2016. Vortex imagwiritsa ntchito zizindikiro zotsimikizira ndi mphindi 60 zoperekera zizindikiro.
apns.h3_a: FCM, Web Push, kukankha kosindikizidwa, Kukulitsa Ntchito Yodziwitsa

argon2id.title: Argon2id
argon2id.subtitle: Memory-hard password hash (RFC 9106).
argon2id.intro: Argon2id ndizovuta kukumbukira, zosagwirizana ndi njira yachinsinsi. Magawo: kukula kwa kukumbukira (m), mtengo wanthawi (kubwereza, t), kufanana (mizere, p), ndi kutalika kwa hashi. Mtundu wa 'id' umasakaniza zodalira data (Argon2i) ndi zodalira data (Argon2d) kupita.
argon2id.h1_a: Argon2id ndizovuta kukumbukira, zosagwirizana ndi njira yachinsinsi. Magawo: kukula kwa kukumbukira (m), mtengo wanthawi (kubwereza, t), kufanana (mizere, p), ndi kutalika kwa hashi. Mtundu wa 'id' umasakaniza zodalira data (Argon2i) ndi zodalira data (Argon2d) kupita.
argon2id.h1_b: Vortex amagwiritsa ntchito Argon2id ndi m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32. Izi zimatengera ~ 0.5 s pa iPhone X (chida chathu chothandizira pang'onopang'ono) komanso pafupifupi 5 ms pamtunda wapamwamba ASIC - kufulumira kwa 100× ndikosavuta poyerekeza ndi SHA-256-based hashes komwe ma ASIC amapambana ndi mamiliyoni.
argon2id.h1_c: Argon2 adapambana Mpikisano wa Password Hashing wa 2015 wokonzedwa ndi Dmitry Khovratovich ndi Alex Biryukov. Yokhazikika ngati RFC 9106 mu 2021. Yogwiritsidwa ntchito ndi 1Password, Bitwarden, LastPass. Magawo a Vortex amachokera ku malingaliro a OWASP 2023.
argon2id.h1_f:
Argon2id(achinsinsi, mchere, m, t, p, hashLen) → hashi
kusakhulupirika: m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32
mtengo ≈ 0.5s pa iPhone X; ~5ms pa ASIC (100× wowukira liwiro)

blake3.title: BLAKE3
blake3.subtitle: Fast cryptographic hash.
blake3.intro: BLAKE3 ndi ntchito ya cryptographic hash yotsika kuchokera ku BLAKE2 ndi BLAKE. Imatulutsa zotulutsa zautali wokhazikika kuchokera kuzinthu zosasintha; 10 × mwachangu kuposa SHA-256 pamabulogu akulu chifukwa cha hashing yamkati yamitengo.
blake3.h1_a: BLAKE3 ndi ntchito ya cryptographic hash yotsika kuchokera ku BLAKE2 ndi BLAKE. Imatulutsa zotulutsa zautali wokhazikika kuchokera kuzinthu zosasintha; 10 × mwachangu kuposa SHA-256 pamabulogu akulu chifukwa cha hashing yamkati yamitengo.
blake3.h1_b: Vortex imagwiritsa ntchito BLAKE3 pa kukhulupirika kwa fayilo: fayilo iliyonse yomwe yakwezedwa imakhala ndi `plain_blake3` hash ya zomwe zasungidwa kuti olandira atsimikizire akatsitsa + decrypt. Mzere wa DB umatchulidwa kale kuti `sha256` kuti zigwirizane ndi kusamuka koma uli ndi BLAKE3 zotuluka.
blake3.h1_c: BLAKE3 idatulutsidwa ndi Jack O'Connor et al. mu 2020. Adatsika kuchokera pa BLAKE, yemwe anali womaliza SHA-3 mu 2012. Mapangidwe a mtengo-hashing amalola BLAKE3 sikelo yokhala ndi ma cores kuti alowemo kwambiri. SHA-256 ikadali yachangu pazolowetsa zazing'ono; BLAKE3 imalamulira chilichonse > 4KiB.
blake3.h1_f:
BLAKE3(mabayiti) = 32 mabayiti // zotuluka zokhazikika
BLAKE3(mabyte, len) = len byte (XOF)
kutulutsa: ~3 GB/s pa Apple Silicon vs SHA-256 ~500 MB/s

bmp.title: BMP
bmp.subtitle: Blind Mailbox Protocol.
bmp.intro: BMP ndi Vortex malo osungira ndi kutsogolo osadziwika. Otumiza amaika mabulogu obisidwa pamalo aliwonse omwe ali ndi miseche, mothandizidwa ndi hashi ya njira imodzi ya pubkey ya wolandirayo. Mabulogu amakwera miseche mpaka mfundo ya wolandirayo itakoka.
bmp.h1_a: BMP ndi Vortex malo osungira ndi kutsogolo osadziwika. Otumiza amaika mabulogu obisidwa pamalo aliwonse omwe ali ndi miseche, mothandizidwa ndi hashi ya njira imodzi ya pubkey ya wolandirayo. Mabulogu amakwera miseche mpaka mfundo ya wolandirayo itakoka.
bmp.h1_b: BMP imapereka zinsinsi zitatu zodziyimira pawokha: kubisala kwa munthu wotumiza (TLS + anyezi wosankha), kubisa kwa wolandila (bokosi la makalata_id ndi losawoneka bwino mpaka pakati), kubisala (blob kale E2E-encrypted). Max blob 1 MB, pa-node cap 500 MB, deposit rate 10/min/IP, TTL 7200 s.
bmp.h1_c: BMP idapangidwa kuchokera koyambirira ndi gulu la Vortex. Tidazimanga chifukwa palibe mthenga wamba yemwe anali wokonzeka kulipira mtengo wauinjiniya wobisa metadata kumapeto mpaka kumapeto - amabisa zomwe zili mkati koma kutsika pazithunzi. Udindo wathu kuyambira tsiku loyamba unali woti mthenga wotetezedwa yemwe amadumphira yemwe amalankhula-ndi-yemwe amakhala wotetezedwa theka. BMP imatseka thekalo popangitsa wotumiza, wolandira, ndi zomwe zili mkati mobisa, pamwamba pa Vortex za miseche ya Vortex yake m'malo mokhala ndi zida zomangika.
bmp.h3_a: miseche, utumiki wa anyezi, wotumiza wosindikizidwa, Pond

cbor.title: CBOR
cbor.subtitle: Chiwonetsero cha Binary Object Representation.
cbor.intro: CBOR (RFC 8949) ndi mtundu wa data wa binary wopangidwa kuti ukhale ndi ma code ang'onoang'ono komanso encoding mwachangu. Superset of JSON's data model, binary-encoded, deterministicly deterministic.
cbor.h1_a: CBOR (RFC 8949) ndi mtundu wa data wa binary wopangidwa kuti ukhale ndi ma code ang'onoang'ono komanso encoding mwachangu. Superset of JSON's data model, binary-encoded, deterministicly deterministic.
cbor.h1_b: Vortex imagwiritsa ntchito CBOR monga momwe amalipira mkati mwa maenvulopu AES-GCM. ~ 30 % yaying'ono kuposa JSON pamacheza olemera a unicode; kusanthula mosamalitsa (palibe kusamveka bwino kwapang'onopang'ono) kumakana kuukira kosiyana; wopanda schema kotero kuti kuwonjezera gawo sikufuna .proto recompilation.
cbor.h1_c: CBOR idasinthidwa kukhala RFC 7049 mu 2013, idasinthidwa kukhala RFC 8949 mu 2020. Imagwiritsidwa ntchito ndi Signal (mapangidwe amkati kuyambira 2017), Matrix's state-resolution layer, WebAuthns attestation). Adasankhidwa ndi Vortex mu v0.0.2 mutafanizira JSON ndi protobuf.
cbor.h1_f:
CBOR encoding: {major_type (3 bits), mkangano (5 bits), [data]}
mapu: mtundu=5 awiriawiri
gulu: mtundu = 4 zinthu
mawu: mtundu=3 mabayiti
mabayiti: mtundu = 2 yaiwisi
cbor.h2_a: Envulopu iliyonse yauthenga, katundu aliyense wosindikizidwa-kankhira, envulopu iliyonse ya federal.

controller.title: Wolamulira
controller.subtitle: Vortex's umboni + ntchito yotulukira.
controller.intro: Wowongolerayo ndi njira ina ya Python (`vortex_controller`) yomwe ntchito yake yokha ndikusindikiza chizindikiro chomwe chasainidwa (`INTEGRITY.sig.json`) ndi ma URL olowa. Makasitomala amakhoma chowongolera cha Ed25519 pubkey panthawi yotulutsidwa.
controller.h1_a: Wowongolerayo ndi njira ina ya Python (`vortex_controller`) yomwe ntchito yake yokha ndikusindikiza chizindikiro chomwe chasainidwa (`INTEGRITY.sig.json`) ndi ma URL olowa. Makasitomala amakhoma chowongolera cha Ed25519 pubkey panthawi yotulutsidwa.
controller.h1_b: Imawonetsa malo ang'ono API (~njira 12). Malo opapatiza ndi dala - ndiye chandamale yamtengo wapatali kwambiri kasitomala akapinidwa. Magalasi amayendetsa kachidindo komweko ndi kiyi yotulutsa yofanana; DNS/SNS/IPFS kufalitsa mndandanda wamagalasi.
