doubleRatchet.title: Double Ratchet
doubleRatchet.subtitle: Signal's per-DM protocol yachinsinsi chamtsogolo.
doubleRatchet.intro: The Double Ratchet imaphatikiza ratchet ya Diffie-Hellman yokhala ndi makiyi ofananira. Uthenga uliwonse umapititsa patsogolo unyolo wake; periodic DH ma ratchets amatsegulanso muzu. Amapereka chinsinsi chamtsogolo (mauthenga am'mbuyomu otetezeka pambuyo pa kunyengerera) ndi chitetezo cham'mbuyo (mauthenga am'tsogolo otetezeka pambuyo poyambiranso).
doubleRatchet.h1_a: The Double Ratchet imaphatikiza ratchet ya Diffie-Hellman yokhala ndi makiyi ofananira. Uthenga uliwonse umapititsa patsogolo unyolo wake; periodic DH ma ratchets amatsegulanso muzu. Amapereka chinsinsi chamtsogolo (mauthenga am'mbuyomu otetezeka pambuyo pa kunyengerera) ndi chitetezo cham'mbuyo (mauthenga am'tsogolo otetezeka pambuyo poyambiranso).
doubleRatchet.h1_b: Vortex imagwiritsa ntchito Double Ratchet pamaketani achindunji. Zipinda zamagulu zimagwiritsa ntchito makiyi osavuta otumizira omwe amachotsa muzu wachipindacho. Kutalika kwa unyolo kumafikira mauthenga a 1000 asanakakamizidwe kuyambiranso; makiyi odumphira mpaka mauthenga 1000 omwe sanatumizidwe; kubisa kwamutu kumayatsidwa mwachisawawa.
doubleRatchet.h1_c: Zopangidwa ndi Trevor Perrin ndi Moxie Marlinspike mu 2013; kutumizidwa mu Signal 2014; yotengedwa ndi WhatsApp (2016), Facebook Secret Conversations, Skype Private Conversations. Public spec 2016. Kukhazikitsa kwa Vortex ndi doko lolunjika.
doubleRatchet.h1_f:
kutumiza: CK_send → HKDF(CK_send, "step") → CK_send'
                    MK → HKDF(CK_send, "msg")
kulandira unyolo: CK_recv → HKDF(CK_recv, "step") → CK_recv'
DH ratchet: RK, CK = HKDF(DH(wathu_eph, wawo_eph), RK_prev)

ech.title: ECH
ech.subtitle: Makasitomala Obisika Moni (RFC 9460).
ech.intro: ECH amabisa SNI (Server Name Indication) pa TLS 1.3 pokulunga mkati ClientHello mkati mwa ClientHello wakunja wosungidwa pansi pa kiyi yapagulu yosindikizidwa mu DNS HTTPS rekodi.
ech.h1_a: ECH amabisa SNI (Server Name Indication) pa TLS 1.3 pokulunga mkati ClientHello mkati mwa ClientHello wakunja wosungidwa pansi pa kiyi yapagulu yosindikizidwa mu DNS HTTPS rekodi.
ech.h1_b: Vortex node amasindikiza ECHConfigs m'marekodi awo DNS HTTPS. Makasitomala omwe ali ndi chithandizo cha ECH amagwiritsa ntchito dzina lakunja (monga `vortex-public.cloudflare.com`) ngati lowoneka SNI; osayang'ana chabe amangowona dzina lachilendolo. DPI sindingauze kasitomala Vortex kuchokera kwa kasitomala wina Cloudflare.
ech.h1_c: ECH adadutsa zolembedwa 5 IETF zisanakhazikitsidwe monga RFC 9460 mu 2024. Zosintha zakale: ESNI (2018-2019, zosiyidwa), ECH draft-00 kuti draft-12 (2022). Chrome idayatsidwa ECH mwachisawawa mu 2023; Firefox mu 2024. Vortex imathandizira kuyambira v0.0.9.
ech.h1_f:
kunja SNI: "public.cloudflare.com" ← zowonekera kwa owona
mkati SNI: "node.vortex.example" ← zobisika
ECHConfig: yosindikizidwa mu DNS HTTPS mbiri yakunja
ech.h3_a: TLS 1.3, DoH, SNI, kutsogolo kwa domeni

ed25519.title: Ed25519
ed25519.subtitle: EdDSA siginecha yopitilira eward25519 (RFC 8032).
ed25519.intro: Ed25519 ndi elliptic-curve signature scheme. Makiyi apagulu a 32-byte, siginecha ya 64-byte, kusaina kotsimikizika mosasintha. Kutsimikizira mwachangu (~ 200 µs pa CPU yamakono), yotsimikizika pagulu.
ed25519.h1_a: Ed25519 ndi elliptic-curve signature scheme. Makiyi apagulu a 32-byte, siginecha ya 64-byte, kusaina kotsimikizika mosasintha. Kutsimikizira mwachangu (~ 200 µs pa CPU yamakono), yotsimikizika pagulu.
ed25519.h1_b: Vortex amasaina envulopu iliyonse ya federal, chiwonetsero chilichonse cha kukhulupirika, umboni uliwonse, ndi uthenga uliwonse wa bot wokhala ndi Ed25519. CryptoKit ya Apple pa iOS 17+ imagwiritsa ntchito kusintha kwachisawawa RFC 8032bis; Vortex amavomereza chilichonse - chotsimikizira chilichonse chimagwira zonse ziwiri.
ed25519.h1_c: Ed25519 idasindikizidwa ndi Bernstein, Duif, Lange, Schwabe, Yang mu 2011. Yokhazikika ngati RFC 8032 mu 2017. Adavomerezedwa ndi OpenSSH 6.5 (2014), TLS 1.3, Apple Keychain. Kusaina kotsimikiza kudasankhidwa momveka bwino kuposa ECDSA kupeŵa gulu la ECDSA RNG-kugwiritsanso ntchito pachiwopsezo.
ed25519.h1_f:
Chizindikiro(d, m): r = SHA-512(d ∥ m)
              R = ndi G
              c = SHA-512(R ∥ A ∥ m)
              S =r + c · a
              kubwerera (R, S)
Tsimikizani: c = SHA-512(R ∥ A ∥ m);  R + c·A ≟ S·G

fanout.title: Kukupiza
fanout.subtitle: Kuwulutsa chochitika kuchokera ku gwero limodzi kupita kwa olembetsa ambiri.
fanout.intro: Fan-out ndi kamangidwe kamangidwe komwe wopanga m'modzi amatulutsa chochitika ndipo ogula a N amachilandira. Mu Vortex's WebSocket wosanjikiza, uthenga umodzi POST umayambitsa N socket kutumiza - m'modzi mwa olembetsa mchipindamo.
fanout.h1_a: Fan-out ndi kamangidwe kamangidwe komwe wopanga m'modzi amatulutsa chochitika ndipo ogula a N amachilandira. Mu Vortex's WebSocket wosanjikiza, uthenga umodzi POST umayambitsa N socket kutumiza - m'modzi mwa olembetsa mchipindamo.
fanout.h1_b: Imakhazikitsidwa ngati chipinda chilichonse cha WebSocket zogwirira zotetezedwa ndi asyncio.Lock. Lembani kupeza, kukopera seti, kutulutsa, ndikubwereza kukopera komwe kukuyembekezera `ws.send_bytes(payload)` ndi kutha kwa socket 1. Ogwiritsa ntchito pang'onopang'ono amakhala ndi mzere wamafelemu 256 mafelemu asanagwe.
fanout.h1_c: Fan-out amabwerera kukasindikiza/kulembetsa machitidwe m'zaka za m'ma 1980 (POP, TIBCO). Mapangidwe amakono (Kafka, Redis pub/sub, NATS) amakulitsa mawonekedwe mpaka mamiliyoni olembetsa. Vortex's per-room in-memory fan-out ndi yaying'ono chifukwa sichifuna kubwerezabwereza kwa njira imodzi; Redis pub/sub imagwira ntchito m'magulu amitundu yambiri.
fanout.h1_f:
wailesi(room_id, payload):
  subs = fanout[room_id] # O(1) fufuzani mawu
  kwa ws mu chithunzithunzi (subs): # kukopera kuti mubwereze bwino
      dikirani ws.send_bytes(payload, timeout=1s)
fanout.h2_a: `app/chats/fanout.py`, njira yotentha kwambiri pa uthenga uliwonse, zomwe zimachitika, kulemba, kulemba foni.

fcm.title: FCM
fcm.subtitle: Firebase Cloud Messaging.
fcm.intro: FCM ndi Google's push-notification service ya Android, iOS, intaneti. Inalowa m'malo ya Google Cloud Messaging (GCM) yakale mu 2016. Imavomereza OAuth2 auth ya akaunti ya service.
fcm.h1_a: FCM ndi Google's push-notification service ya Android, iOS, intaneti. Inalowa m'malo ya Google Cloud Messaging (GCM) yakale mu 2016. Imavomereza OAuth2 auth ya akaunti ya service.
fcm.h1_b: Vortex imagwiritsa ntchito FCM mumodeti ya `data` (osati `chidziwitso`) kotero FirebaseMessagingService ya pulogalamuyo imayamba ikamafika ndikuchotsa ndalama zolipirira zosindikizidwa musanaganize zowonetsa chikwangwani. Zodzutsa mwakachetechete zimagwiritsanso ntchito FCM mauthenga a data.
fcm.h1_c: FCM idakhazikitsidwa mu 2016 m'malo mwa GCM. Cholowa HTTP mapeto adachotsedwa mu 2024; Vortex amagwiritsa ntchito HTTP v1 pomaliza ndi OAuth2. Kusinthasintha kwa ma tokeni ola lililonse kumangochitika pogwiritsa ntchito mbiri ya akaunti yantchito.
fcm.h3_a: Ma APN, Web Push, kukankha kosindikizidwa, OAuth2

federation.title: Federation
federation.subtitle: Kutumiza uthenga wodalirana pakati pa malo odziyimira pawokha Vortex.
federation.intro: Federation ndi mgwirizano wodalirana pakati pa ochita ma node awiri. Aliyense amawonjezera pubkey ya Ed25519 patebulo lake la 'mabungwe'. Ogwiritsa ntchito pa node A amatha kutumiza mauthenga kwa ogwiritsa ntchito pa node B poyendetsa maenvulopu kudzera pa `POST /federation/deliver`.
federation.h1_a: Federation ndi mgwirizano wodalirana pakati pa ochita ma node awiri. Aliyense amawonjezera pubkey ya Ed25519 patebulo lake la 'mabungwe'. Ogwiritsa ntchito pa node A amatha kutumiza mauthenga kwa ogwiritsa ntchito pa node B poyendetsa maenvulopu kudzera pa `POST /federation/deliver`.
federation.h1_b: Lowani pa wogwiritsa ntchito aliyense: palibe "node iliyonse yomwe ingagwirizanitse" kusakhazikika. Kuwonjezera mnzanu kumafuna kuchitapo kanthu kwa woyang'anira yemwe wasaina. Zotsatira zathanzi (AIMD ±1) zimayimitsa mgwirizano kwa anzawo omwe ali ndi vuto. Kuyesanso kwa Outbox kwalephera kubweretsa ndi kubweza kwachidziwitso mpaka masiku 14.
federation.h1_c: Federation inali gawo lakupha la Matrix (2014) ndipo izi zisanachitike XMPP/Jabber (1999). Mapangidwe a Vortex amachokera ku onse awiri: maenvulopu osainidwa (Matrix), anangula odziwika bwino (ngakhale - ndife okhwimitsa zinthu), zigoli zaumoyo (AIMD kuchokera ku TCP). Wowonjezera mu v0.0.5.

fts5.title: FTS5
fts5.subtitle: SQLite's full-text-search table virtual.
fts5.intro: FTS5 ndi m'badwo wachisanu wa SQLite wosaka mawu athunthu. Amapanga tebulo lodziwika bwino lomwe limasunga zolozera zolembera mwachangu LIKE / MATCH mafunso.
fts5.h1_a: FTS5 ndi m'badwo wachisanu wa SQLite wosaka mawu athunthu. Amapanga tebulo lodziwika bwino lomwe limasunga zolozera zolembera mwachangu LIKE / MATCH mafunso.
fts5.h1_b: Vortex imayang'anira ma tokeni osamveka bwino (makasitomala obisika ngati ma opaque tag) patebulo la FTS5 kotero kusaka kumagunda `O(log n)` m'malo mwa `O(n)` masikeni. Pa Chipinda cha Android, FTS4 imagwiritsidwa ntchito ndi zoyambitsa zomwe zimasunga tebulo lofanana. Ma postgres deployments amagwiritsa ntchito `tsvector` / `tsquery` pa cholinga chomwecho.
fts5.h1_c: FTS imabwerera ku SQLite 3.7 (2010). FTS5 yotumizidwa mu SQLite 3.9 (2015). Ambiri anatengera; Pulogalamu iliyonse yotumizira mauthenga yakwanuko pa iOS / Android imagwiritsa ntchito. Postgres wakhala ndi `tsvector` kuyambira 8.3 (2008).

gossip.title: Gokuseka
gossip.subtitle: Kusinthana kwanthawi ndi nthawi pakati pa Vortex nodi.
gossip.intro: Gossip ndi njira yogwiritsira ntchito bandwidth pomwe mfundo iliyonse nthawi ndi nthawi imasinthanitsa chidziwitso chachidule ndi anzawo mwachisawawa. M'kupita kwa nthawi node iliyonse imasinthidwa kukhala mawonekedwe omwewo popanda chikwatu chapakati.
gossip.h1_a: Gossip ndi njira yogwiritsira ntchito bandwidth pomwe mfundo iliyonse nthawi ndi nthawi imasinthanitsa chidziwitso chachidule ndi anzawo mwachisawawa. M'kupita kwa nthawi node iliyonse imasinthidwa kukhala mawonekedwe omwewo popanda chikwatu chapakati.
gossip.h1_b: Vortex node amalankhula miseche masekondi 60 aliwonse. Kusinthanitsa kulikonse ndi 256-bit Bloom fyuluta mwachidule odziwika anzawo; mbali inayi imayankha ndi anzawo omwe akusowa pasefa kuphatikiza ndi fyuluta yakeyake. Bandwidth ndi O(anzako atsopano × 32 B), nthawi zambiri amakhala pansi pa 1KiB pozungulira.
gossip.h1_c: Miseche ya Bloom-sefa idayamba ku Cornell's 1998 bimodal multicast paper. Apache Cassandra amagwiritsa ntchito kwa umembala; Bitcoin kwa transaction relay; IPFS pokonza DHT. Kulumikizana kwa O(log N) ndi komwe kumapangitsa kuti pakhale maukonde akuluakulu.
gossip.h1_f:
kusintha (A, B):
  A → B: fyuluta_A = insert_all(peers_A, k=5, m=256)
  B → A: new_peers_for_A = {p ∈ anzanu_B : p ∉ fyuluta_A}, fyuluta_B
  A amatulutsa mofanana
malire: 1 kusinthanitsa kwa mnzake pa 30 s
gossip.h3_a: Fyuluta ya Bloom, bootstrap, federation, anzawo

gravitix.title: Gravitix
gravitix.subtitle: Vortex's DSL polemba bots.
gravitix.intro: Gravitix ndi chiyankhulo chachindunji chomwe chidapangidwa kuti tizilemba Vortex bots. Zoyendetsa zoyendetsedwa ndi zochitika (`pa / yambitsani {emit "hi"}`), malo omangidwira, ma boilerplate ochepa. Kuphatikizidwa ku bytecode ndikuyendetsa mu womasulira wa sandboxed.
gravitix.h1_a: Gravitix ndi chiyankhulo chachindunji chomwe chidapangidwa kuti tizilemba Vortex bots. Zoyendetsa zoyendetsedwa ndi zochitika (`pa / yambitsani {emit "hi"}`), malo omangidwira, ma boilerplate ochepa. Kuphatikizidwa ku bytecode ndikuyendetsa mu womasulira wa sandboxed.
gravitix.h1_b: Njira ina ya Python SDK. Gravitix bots sangathe kupeza mafayilo amafayilo kapena netiweki yokhazikika - Vortex's API yokha. Compiler imapanga bytecode; nthawi yothamanga ya Rust mu `Gravitix/` imatanthauzira. Maumboni athunthu mumutu wa Gravitix docs.
gravitix.h1_c: Idapangidwa mkati mwa v0.0.6 mutawona kuti ma code ambiri a bot anali 80 % SDK boilerplate mozungulira kernel yaying'ono yamalingaliro enieni. A DSL imalola malingaliro awo kuwalitsa komanso kuwopsa kwa ma sandbox. Zofanana mumzimu ndi Hubot (2011) koma wokhala ndi mchenga wolimba kwambiri komanso kuphatikiza kwawoko Vortex.
gravitix.h2_a: `Gravitix/` repo root, bot code field in `POST /api/bots`.

hkdf.title: HKDF
hkdf.subtitle: HMAC-based Key Derivation Function (RFC 5869).
hkdf.intro: HKDF ndi ntchito yotengera makiyi a masitepe awiri: Kutulutsa kumakanikiza makiyi olowetsa kukhala makiyi achinyengo (PRK); Kukulitsa kumatambasula PRK kukhala makiyi otulutsa autali uliwonse, olekanitsidwa ndi zolemba zazidziwitso.
hkdf.h1_a: HKDF ndi ntchito yotengera makiyi a masitepe awiri: Kutulutsa kumakanikiza makiyi olowetsa kukhala makiyi achinyengo (PRK); Kukulitsa kumatambasula PRK kukhala makiyi otulutsa autali uliwonse, olekanitsidwa ndi zolemba zazidziwitso.
hkdf.h1_b: Vortex imagwiritsa ntchito HKDF-SHA256 paliponse: kugawa X25519 zinsinsi zogawana mu encryption + MAC + makiyi apamutu, kutenga makiyi a fayilo ya chunk, kutenga makiyi osunga zobwezeretsera kuchokera ku Argon2id. Zingwe zachidziwitso nthawi zonse zimakhala ndi mawu oyambira (monga "v1: encryption") kuti makiyi onse azitha kuzungulira ndikugunda v1 → v2.
hkdf.h1_c: Lofalitsidwa ndi Hugo Krawczyk ku EUROCRYPT 2010; yokhazikika ngati RFC 5869 chaka chomwecho. Yogwiritsidwa ntchito ndi TLS 1.3 pandandanda yake, Signal for Double Ratchet, WireGuard pamakiyi agawo.
hkdf.h1_f:
Kutulutsa: PRK = HMAC-SHA256(mchere, IKM)
Kukula: T(1) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, zambiri ∥ 0x01)
          T(i) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, T(i-1) ∥ zambiri ∥ i)
          OKM = T(1) ∥ T(2) ∥ … kudulidwa ku len

hmac.title: HMAC
hmac.subtitle: Khodi Yotsimikizira Mauthenga Ochokera ku Hash (RFC 2104).
hmac.intro: HMAC ndi zomangamanga zomwe zimatembenuza hashi iliyonse yachinsinsi (SHA-256, SHA-512) kukhala MAC. Amapereka kukhulupirika ndi kutsimikizika kupatsidwa chinsinsi chogawana.
hmac.h1_a: HMAC ndi zomangamanga zomwe zimatembenuza hashi iliyonse yachinsinsi (SHA-256, SHA-512) kukhala MAC. Amapereka kukhulupirika ndi kutsimikizika kupatsidwa chinsinsi chogawana.
hmac.h1_b: Vortex imagwiritsa ntchito HMAC-SHA256 mu HKDF, ya JWT siginecha (HS256), ya sender_pseudo yochokera m'zipinda, ndi coturn TURN kusaina mbiri. Kuyerekeza kosalekeza kumafunika kumbali yotsimikizira — `hmac.compare_digest` mu Python.
hmac.h1_c: HMAC idayambitsidwa ndi Bellare, Canetti, Krawczyk mu 1996. Yokhazikika ngati RFC 2104 (1997) ndi FIPS 198 (2002). Inakhala yosasintha MAC mu TLS, IPsec, SSH. Signal, Matrix, Discord, Slack onse amagwiritsa ntchito HMAC-SHA256 pa JWT yawo ndi ma tokeni agawo.
hmac.h1_f:
HMAC(kiyi, msg) = H((kiyi ⊕ opad) ∥ H(kiyi ⊕ ipad) ∥ msg ))
  kumene opad = 0x5c kubwerezedwa, ipad = 0x36 kubwereza, kukula kwa chipika kumafanana ndi H
hmac.h2_a: Kulikonse mumtengo wa crypto. Grep ya `hmac_sha256` kapena `HKDF`.
hmac.h3_a: HKDF, JWT, SHA-256, yerekezerani nthawi zonse

ice.title: ICE
ice.subtitle: Kukhazikitsa Kulumikizana Kwawo (RFC 8445).
ice.intro: ICE ndiye WebRTC njira yopezera njira ya netiweki pakati pa anzawo awiri kumbuyo kwa NAT. Anzako amawerengera omwe akufuna (host, seva-reflex, relay), kusinthana nawo, ndikuyesa awiriawiri mpaka wina atapambana.
ice.h1_a: ICE ndiye WebRTC njira yopezera njira ya netiweki pakati pa anzawo awiri kumbuyo kwa NAT. Anzako amawerengera omwe akufuna (host, seva-reflex, relay), kusinthana nawo, ndikuyesa awiriawiri mpaka wina atapambana.
ice.h1_b: Vortex's node brokers ICE kusinthana kwa ofuna kusankha kudzera pa WebSocket signing. coturn imapereka STUN (pakutulukira kwa srflx) ndi TURN (pakutumizana njira zolunjika zikalephera). Zidziwitso zanthawi yochepa HMAC zimaperekedwa pa foni iliyonse.
ice.h1_c: ICE idasinthidwa kukhala RFC 5245 (2010) ndikutsitsimutsidwa ngati RFC 8445 (2018). Kumbuyo kwa giredi yonyamula NAT, mayendedwe achindunji amalephera ~ 15 % ya nthawiyo - TURN kubwezeredwa sikungalephereke. WebRTC zopangidwa ICE zodziwika bwino; chilichonse choyimba pavidiyo chimachigwiritsa ntchito.
ice.h1_f:
ofuna:
  host: rtp://192.168.1.5:49152 (ako IP)
  srflx : rtp://203.0.113.5:49152 (STUN-anthu omwe adapeza)
  relay: rtp://turn.vortex:49153 (TURN-allocated relay)
cheke awiri: STUN Pempho Lomanga; awiri oyamba kuti apambane = osankhidwa
ice.h3_a: WebRTC, TURN, STUN, khonde, NAT wodutsa

jwt.title: JWT
jwt.subtitle: JSON Chizindikiro cha Webusaiti (RFC 7519).
jwt.intro: JWT ndi mawonekedwe ophatikizika opangidwa ndi magawo atatu a base64-url-encoded: mutu, payload (madandaulo), siginecha. Amagwiritsidwa ntchito potsimikizira gawo lopanda malire.
jwt.h1_a: JWT ndi mawonekedwe ophatikizika opangidwa ndi magawo atatu a base64-url-encoded: mutu, payload (madandaulo), siginecha. Amagwiritsidwa ntchito potsimikizira gawo lopanda malire.
jwt.h1_b: Vortex amagwiritsa HS256 (HMAC-SHA256) ma JWT. Chizindikiro chofikira chimakhala ndi `{sub: user_id, jti: device_id, typ: access, exp}`, 15 min TTL. Tsitsani chizindikiro `typ: refresh`, 30 d TTL. Yasaina chinsinsi cha 64-byte kuchokera ku `.env`. Palibe zodandaula zachinsinsi kuposa user_id.
jwt.h1_c: Ma JWT adasinthidwa kukhala RFC 7519 (2015). OAuth 2.0 idawatchuka kuyambira 2012. Zaka khumi zakudzudzula: kuwukira kwa chisokonezo cha alg, kusowa kwa kuchotsedwa. Vortex imachepetsa: HS256 kokha (palibe RS/ES chisokonezo), jti yokhala ndi kiyi (yosinthika kudzera pazida za ogwiritsa).
jwt.h1_f:
HEADER.PAYLOAD.SIGNATURE
mutu = base64url({alg: "HS256", lembani: "JWT"})
payload = base64url({sub, jti, typ, exp})
sig = base64url(HMAC-SHA256(chinsinsi, mutu + "." + payload))
jwt.h3_a: HMAC, OAuth 2.0, chizindikiro chotsitsimula, chizindikiro chofikira

kyber.title: Kyber-768
kyber.subtitle: Kutsekera kwachinsinsi cha post-quantum (FIPS 203).
kyber.intro: Kyber-768 (yovomerezeka ML-KEM-768) ndi NIST's standardized post-quantum key encapsulation mechanism. 1184-byte public keys, 1088-byte ciphertexts, 32-byte zinsinsi zogawana. Chitetezo chimachepetsedwa kukhala Module-LWE, amakhulupirira molimba.
kyber.h1_a: Kyber-768 (yovomerezeka ML-KEM-768) ndi NIST's standardized post-quantum key encapsulation mechanism. 1184-byte public keys, 1088-byte ciphertexts, 32-byte zinsinsi zogawana. Chitetezo chimachepetsedwa kukhala Module-LWE, amakhulupirira molimba.
kyber.h1_b: Vortex amagwiritsa ntchito Kyber mwachisawawa: `session_key = HKDF(x25519_out ∥ kyber_out, info="session-v1")`. Ngati theka likugwira, gawoli ndi lotetezeka. Lowani mu v0.1, pokha-ndi-kusakhazikika kokonzekera v0.2. Mtengo: ~2 KB zowonjezera pagawo lililonse kugwirana chanza; latency negligible.
kyber.h1_c: Kyber anali amodzi mwa ~ 70 omwe adatumizidwa ku mpikisano wa NIST's PQ (2016). Adasankhidwa kuti akhazikitsidwe mu Julayi 2022; inatsirizidwa monga FIPS 203 mu Ogasiti 2024. Chrome inatsegula hybrid Kyber mu TLS 1.3 mu 2024. Signal anawonjezera pa protocol yawo chaka chomwecho.
kyber.h1_f:
KeyGen(): (pk ∈ Zq^k, sk ∈ Zq^k) pk = 1184 B, sk = 2400 B
Encaps(pk): (ct ∈ Zq^k, ss ∈ {0,1}²⁵⁶) ct = 1088 B
Decaps(sk,ct): ss ∈ {0,1}²⁵⁶
wosakanizidwa = HKDF(x25519_out ∥ kyber_out, "session-v1")

mailbox.title: Bokosi la makalata
mailbox.subtitle: Malo osungira olandila olandila mu BMP.
mailbox.intro: Bokosi la makalata ndi chidule cha BMP cha "malo omwe mauthenga a munthu wopatsidwa amadikirira". Imazindikiridwa ndi `mailbox_id` ya 32-byte yochokera ku pubkey ya wolandira kudzera HKDF.
mailbox.h1_a: Bokosi la makalata ndi chidule cha BMP cha "malo omwe mauthenga a munthu wopatsidwa amadikirira". Imazindikiridwa ndi `mailbox_id` ya 32-byte yochokera ku pubkey ya wolandira kudzera HKDF.
mailbox.h1_b: Ndi wotumiza yekha (yemwe amadziwa recipient_pubkey) ndi wolandira (omwe amadziwa pubkey yawo) ndi omwe angawerenge mailbox_id yoperekedwa. Manode apakatikati amangowona chozindikiritsa chowoneka bwino cha 32-byte. Bokosi lililonse la makalata lili ndi TTL 7200 s ndi kapu yosungira 500 MB pa node iliyonse.
mailbox.h1_c: Mawuwa akuchokera ku imelo yachikale. BMP imabwereka fanizo koma imapangitsa kuti bokosi la makalata likhale lochokera kwa wolandira m'malo moperekedwa ndi seva - palibe sitepe "yopanga bokosi la makalata", palibe seva yodziwa ma adilesi omwe alipo.
mailbox.h1_f:
mailbox_id = HKDF(recipient_pubkey, info="bmp-v1", len=32)
wotumiza yekha (akudziwa wolandira_pk) ndi wolandira (akudziwa eni pk) akhoza kuwerengera

nonce.title: Palibe
nonce.subtitle: Nambala yogwiritsidwa ntchito kamodzi - mtengo wogwiritsa ntchito kamodzi.
nonce.intro: Nonce ndi mtengo womwe suyenera kubwereza pansi pa kiyi yoperekedwa. Mu Vortex ntchito iliyonse AES-GCM imagwiritsa ntchito 96-bit mwachisawawa. Kugwiritsanso ntchito mawu osamveka ndi kiyi yemweyo kumawononga chinsinsi komanso kutsimikizika - wowukira wokhala ndi zilembo ziwiri zofanana (kiyi, nonce) akhoza kubwezeretsanso ma XOR.
nonce.h1_a: Nonce ndi mtengo womwe suyenera kubwereza pansi pa kiyi yoperekedwa. Mu Vortex ntchito iliyonse AES-GCM imagwiritsa ntchito 96-bit mwachisawawa. Kugwiritsanso ntchito mawu osamveka ndi kiyi yemweyo kumawononga chinsinsi komanso kutsimikizika - wowukira wokhala ndi zilembo ziwiri zofanana (kiyi, nonce) akhoza kubwezeretsanso ma XOR.
nonce.h1_b: Vortex imapanga nonces ndi OS CSPRNG (`secrets.token_bytes`, `SecRandom`, `java.security.SecureRandom`). Tsiku lobadwa lokhala ndi ma bits 96: ~ 2 ^ Mauthenga 32 kugunda kusanakhale komveka, kuposa momwe kiyi iliyonse yachipinda imawonera m'moyo wake. Kutsata kobwerezabwereza kodzitchinjiriza pamfundo ngati lamba-ndi-zoyimitsa.
nonce.h1_c: Lingaliro la nonce ndi lakale mu cryptography; liwu lokha likuchokera ku Old English "for the once". Malingaliro a GCM a 96-bit akuchokera ku NIST SP 800-38D. Kuphwanya kwa Adobe 2013 kunapezanso nkhani zobwerezabwereza za kasitomala RSA.
nonce.h1_f:
P(kugunda) pa 10⁹ AES-GCM nonces = ~10⁻¹⁹
tsiku lobadwa: kugundana koyamba kumayembekezeredwa pafupifupi 2⁴⁸ nonces pa kiyi iliyonse
GCM chitetezo: 2³² ma nonces mwachisawawa pa kiyi iliyonse musanamange kunyozeka
nonce.h2_a: Kuyimba kulikonse AES-GCM. Counter tracks motetezedwa mu `app/security/crypto.py`.

ohttp.title: OHTTP
ohttp.subtitle: Onyalanyaza HTTP (RFC 9458).
ohttp.intro: OHTTP ndi njira yolumikizirana HTTP pomwe palibe gulu limodzi lomwe limawona pempho ndi kuyankha. Wothandizira amatumiza kudzera pa relay yomwe imadula mitu yozindikiritsa; relay imapita kuchipata chomwe chimasweka ndikuyankha.
ohttp.h1_a: OHTTP ndi njira yolumikizirana HTTP pomwe palibe gulu limodzi lomwe limawona pempho ndi kuyankha. Wothandizira amatumiza kudzera pa relay yomwe imadula mitu yozindikiritsa; relay imapita kuchipata chomwe chimasweka ndikuyankha.
ohttp.h1_b: Vortex imagwiritsa ntchito OHTTP ngati Layer-5 stealth fallback. Kuphatikizidwa ndi ntchito ya anyezi ndi BMP, OHTTP imapereka njira yomaliza pomwe TLS yatsekedwa kwathunthu. Relay ndi chipani chosiyanitsidwa ndi chikhulupiliro (nthawi zambiri Cloudflare kapena Apple's chinsinsi-relay maziko).
ohttp.h1_c: OHTTP idasinthidwa kukhala RFC 9458 mu 2024, yolembedwa ndi Cloudflare, Apple, Mozilla. Apple's ICloud Private Relay (2021) ndikutumiza koyambirira OHTTP-moyandikana. Vortex yowonjezeredwa OHTTP kuthandizira kumbuyo mu v0.0.9.
ohttp.h1_f:
kasitomala → relay: Encrypt_gateway_pub(pempho) + zongoyenda mwachisawawa
relay → chipata: kupita patsogolo, kudula mitu yozindikiritsa kasitomala
pachipata → yankho: decrypt, process, Encrypt_client_pub(yankho)
tumizani → kasitomala: kuyankha kutsogolo
ohttp.h3_a: Tor, utumiki wa anyezi, BMP, ECH

onion.title: Anyezi utumiki
onion.subtitle: Tor zobisika utumiki.
onion.intro: Ntchito ya anyezi ndi ntchito ya TCP yomwe imapezeka kudzera mu protocol ya Tor's rendezvous protocol. Imadziwika ndi adilesi ya anyezi (56-zilembo32 ya Ed25519 pubkey pa v3). Palibe anthu IP, ayi DNS, palibe zolembera zapakati.
onion.h1_a: Ntchito ya anyezi ndi ntchito ya TCP yomwe imapezeka kudzera mu protocol ya Tor's rendezvous protocol. Imadziwika ndi adilesi ya anyezi (56-zilembo32 ya Ed25519 pubkey pa v3). Palibe anthu IP, ayi DNS, palibe zolembera zapakati.
onion.h1_b: Nodi iliyonse ya Vortex imadziwonetsa yokha ngati `.anioni` komanso HTTPS yake yomaliza. Makasitomala omwe ali ndi chithandizo cha Tor amagwera ku anyezi zina zonse zikalephera. Bandwidth ndi ~ 10× pang'onopang'ono koma imatha kupezeka mkati mwamanetiweki opanda malire.
onion.h1_c: Ntchito za anyezi zinayambira ku Tor 2004 (v1). Anamangidwanso ngati ma v3 anyezi mu 2017 ndi makiyi a Ed25519. Zogwiritsidwa ntchito ndi SecureDrop, New York Times, Facebook, ProPublica, mabungwe onse akuluakulu a crypto-aware. Signal idawonjezera kutumiza kwa anyezi mu 2022.
onion.h1_f:
adilesi = base32(Ed25519_pubkey ∥ checksum ∥ version_byte) ∥ ".onion"
          = zilembo 56 pa v3 anyezi

prekey.title: Prekey
prekey.subtitle: Ephemeral pubkey idasindikizidwa pasadakhale pa bootstrap ya ma DM atsopano.
prekey.intro: Prekey ndi makiyi X25519 omwe amasindikizidwa ku nodi patsogolo pakufunika kotero kuti olumikizana atsopano athe kuyambitsa zokambirana zobisika popanda ulendo wobwerera. Wogwiritsa aliyense amatsitsa gulu (makiyi 10 mwachisawawa); seva imawatumizira pakufunika; kasitomala amatsitsa kwambiri akatsika.
prekey.h1_a: Prekey ndi makiyi X25519 omwe amasindikizidwa ku nodi patsogolo pakufunika kotero kuti olumikizana atsopano athe kuyambitsa zokambirana zobisika popanda ulendo wobwerera. Wogwiritsa aliyense amatsitsa gulu (makiyi 10 mwachisawawa); seva imawatumizira pakufunika; kasitomala amatsitsa kwambiri akatsika.
prekey.h1_b: Vortex's prekey bundle imasainidwa ndi kiyi yachidziwitso chanthawi yayitali ya chipangizocho kotero kuti wowukira sangathe kusinthana makiyi abodza ngakhale atapeza ma node. Ma DM atsopano amagwiritsa ntchito Diffie-Hellman yozungulira imodzi motsutsana ndi prekey yatsopano isanayambe Double Ratchet.
prekey.h1_c: Makiyi akuchokera ku Signal's 2013 protocol design (X3DH). Pamaso pa X3DH, bootstrap yosungidwa inkafunika maulendo obwereza - oyipa pamawu asynchronous. Mthenga wamakono aliyense wotetezeka amagwiritsa ntchito bootstrap ya prekey.
prekey.h3_a: X25519, Double Ratchet, X3DH, kusinthana makiyi

reality.title: Zowona
reality.subtitle: TLS-mkati-TLS zoyendera zobisika.
reality.intro: Zowona ndi zoyendera zobisika zomwe zimawoneka ngati TLS kupita kuukadaulo weniweni (nthawi zambiri www.microsoft.com). Kugwirana chanza panja Microsoft; kugwirana chanza mkati ndi Vortex. Ma probe omwe amapita kunja amatumizidwa ku chiyambi chenicheni kotero kuti kufufuza sikuwulula kalikonse.
reality.h1_a: Zowona ndi zoyendera zobisika zomwe zimawoneka ngati TLS kupita kuukadaulo weniweni (nthawi zambiri www.microsoft.com). Kugwirana chanza panja Microsoft; kugwirana chanza mkati ndi Vortex. Ma probe omwe amapita kunja amatumizidwa ku chiyambi chenicheni kotero kuti kufufuza sikuwulula kalikonse.
reality.h1_b: Vortex imathandizira Reality ngati Level-4 pluggable transport. Config imatchula chandamale, ma ID achidule, ndi Vortex X25519 kiyi ya anthu onse. Seva imatsimikizira makasitomala omwe akubwera mwachidule-ID machesi; zofufuza zosafanana zimapeza mayankho enieni.
reality.h1_c: Zowona zidasindikizidwa mu 2022 poyankha ku China Great Firewall yomwe idazindikira zotengera zam'mbuyomu za TLS (V2Ray's VMess, Trojan). Adavomerezedwa ndi XrayCore mu 2023. Vortex adawonjezera thandizo mu v0.0.9.
reality.h1_f:
kugwirana chanza kwakunja: TLS mpaka Microsoft, SNI=www.microsoft.com
mkati (ngati auth ok): Vortex kuchuluka kwa magalimoto pamsewu wa data
yankho la probe: yankho lenileni la Microsoft.com latumizidwa kwa wowukira
                    Wowonera amangowona "eya, ndi Microsoft.com"

rbac.title: RBAC
rbac.subtitle: Kuwongolera kotengera Maudindo.
rbac.intro: RBAC ndi mtundu wowongolera mwayi pomwe zilolezo zimaperekedwa kwa maudindo ndipo ogwiritsa ntchito amapatsidwa maudindo. Vortex imagwiritsa ntchito magawo atatu RBAC pachipinda chilichonse: mwini> admin> membala.
rbac.h1_a: RBAC ndi mtundu wowongolera mwayi pomwe zilolezo zimaperekedwa kwa maudindo ndipo ogwiritsa ntchito amapatsidwa maudindo. Vortex imagwiritsa ntchito magawo atatu RBAC pachipinda chilichonse: mwini> admin> membala.
rbac.h1_b: Cascade: eni ake ali ndi mphamvu zonse za admin kuphatikiza kuthekera kwapadera kochotsa chipindacho kapena kusamutsa umwini. Ma Admins kuitana, kukankha, lankhula, sinthani makonda a chipinda. Mamembala amatumiza mauthenga, kuchitapo kanthu, kusintha mauthenga awo. Zosintha zamaudindo zimalembedwa ngati mauthenga amachitidwe kuti membala aliyense aziwona.
rbac.h1_c: RBAC monga chitsanzo chokhazikika mpaka pepala la NIST la 1992 lolemba Ferraiolo & Kuhn. Adakhala wamkulu m'mabizinesi IAM (AWS, Azure) m'ma 2010. M'chipinda RBAC ndi wokhazikika pamacheza - IRC's ops/voice/user (1988), maudindo a Discord (2015), admin/membala/mlendo wa Slack.
rbac.h1_f:
maudindo: mwini ⊃ admin ⊃ membala
kusamutsa: mwiniwake amakhazikitsa new_owner_id → mwini wakale watsitsidwa kukhala admin
kubweza: admin akhoza kutsitsa membala; mwiniwake akhoza kutsitsa admin
rbac.h2_a: `room_members.role`, chochongedwa panjira iliyonse yolembera kudzera mu `app/chats/permissions.py`.

sfu.title: SFU
sfu.subtitle: Selective Forwarding Unit.
sfu.intro: An SFU ndi bokosi lapakati lomwe limasakaniza zofalitsa pama foni amagulu. Aliyense amatsitsa mtsinje umodzi; the SFU amatumiza kwa ena. Imalowa m'malo mwa topology ya mauna onse (mnzake iliyonse imayika mitsinje ya N-1) pomwe makulitsidwe ndi O(N²).
sfu.h1_a: An SFU ndi bokosi lapakati lomwe limasakaniza zofalitsa pama foni amagulu. Aliyense amatsitsa mtsinje umodzi; the SFU amatumiza kwa ena. Imalowa m'malo mwa topology ya mauna onse (mnzake iliyonse imayika mitsinje ya N-1) pomwe makulitsidwe ndi O(N²).
sfu.h1_b: Vortex's SFU imakhazikitsidwa mu Rust kuti igwire ntchito. Simulcast-aware: woyimba aliyense amayika malingaliro atatu nthawi imodzi; the SFU imasankha yolondola pa ulalo wotsikira womwe wowonera. Magulu omvera-okha mpaka otenga nawo gawo 100; magulu amakanema mpaka 32 (v0.3 roadmap).
sfu.h1_c: SFU madeti omanga mpaka Jitsi's Videobridge (2013). Asanakhale SFU, WebRTC mafoni apagulu anali odzaza mauna. Zoom, Google Kumanani, Jitsi, Gulu la Signal limayimba ntchito zonse SFU. Vortex magulu omvera okha omwe amatumizidwa mu v0.0.8.
sfu.h1_f:
mauna athunthu (N anzawo): iliyonse imatumiza mitsinje ya N-1 → O(N²) uplink
SFU (N anzawo): iliyonse imatumiza mtsinje umodzi → O(N) uplink pa mnzake
simulcast: L1 (otsika) + L2 (pakati) + L3 (wamkulu) ma encodings nthawi imodzi
SFU amasankha wosanjikiza aliyense wowonera kutengera BWE-lipoti lotsika

snowflake.title: Snowflake
snowflake.subtitle: Maulendo odzipereka odzipereka opitilira WebRTC.
snowflake.intro: Snowflake ndi mayendedwe omangika a Tor Project komwe asakatuli odzipereka amakhala ngati WebRTC relay. Ogwiritsa amayika chowonjezera chamsakatuli ndipo msakatuli wawo amakhala wotumizirana nawo pomwe ali ndi tabu yotseguka.
snowflake.h1_a: Snowflake ndi mayendedwe omangika a Tor Project komwe asakatuli odzipereka amakhala ngati WebRTC relay. Ogwiritsa amayika chowonjezera chamsakatuli ndipo msakatuli wawo amakhala wotumizirana nawo pomwe ali ndi tabu yotseguka.
snowflake.h1_b: Vortex imavomereza Snowflake ngati Layer-4 fallback pamene TLS ndi zoyendera zoyamba zatsekedwa. Palibe infra yofunikira kumbali yathu - tikungofunika milatho ya Snowflake yosindikizidwa m'malo odziwika bwino. Odzipereka omwe akuyendetsa ntchito yowonjezera amapereka chivundikiro.
snowflake.h1_c: Snowflake idakhazikitsidwa mu 2020 ngati Tor Project m'malo mwa obfs4 (yomwe idakhala yokhoza kusindikiza zala). Zoyendera za WebRTC zimakhala zovuta kuletsa chifukwa kutero kungawononge mafoni ambiri ovomerezeka. Vortex adawonjezera thandizo mu v0.0.9.
snowflake.h1_f:
kasitomala → Wogulitsa Snowflake: "Ndikufuna woyimira"
ma broker omwe ali ndi msakatuli wodzipereka yemwe akuthamanga
wodzipereka → Kulowa kwa Tor: kumapititsa patsogolo kuchuluka kwamakasitomala WebRTC
ubwino: WebRTC magalimoto ali paliponse; kutsekereza kuyimba kwamavidiyo

tls13.title: TLS 1.3
tls13.subtitle: Transport Layer Security, mtundu 1.3 (RFC 8446).
tls13.intro: TLS 1.3 ndiye mtundu waposachedwa wa TLS protocol. Imachotsa zoyamba zosatetezeka (RSA kusinthana makiyi, CBC MACs, static ECDH), imathandizira kugwirana chanza kukhala ulendo umodzi wobwerera, kulamula patsogolo chinsinsi.
tls13.h1_a: TLS 1.3 ndiye mtundu waposachedwa wa TLS protocol. Imachotsa zoyamba zosatetezeka (RSA kusinthana makiyi, CBC MACs, static ECDH), imathandizira kugwirana chanza kukhala ulendo umodzi wobwerera, kulamula patsogolo chinsinsi.
tls13.h1_b: Kulumikizana kulikonse kwa HTTPS + WSS + federal mu Vortex kumagwiritsa ntchito TLS 1.3. Timafanana ndi ClientHello byte-for-byte ya Chrome 120 kotero DPI singatisindikize zala ngati osasakatula. ECH (yobisika SNI) imalowa kudzera pakusintha kwakunja-SNI.
tls13.h1_c: TLS 1.3 idasinthidwa kukhala RFC 8446 mu Ogasiti 2018 patatha zaka 4 ndi zolemba 28. Chrome, Firefox, Safari idatumiza thandizo mu 2018. Microsoft idawonjezera ku Windows mu 2020. Pofika 2022 kunali kuchuluka kwa anthu apa intaneti.
tls13.h1_f:
kugwirana chanza (1-RTT):
  Makasitomala → Seva: ClientHello (key_share, SNI?, ALPN, ...)
  Seva → Makasitomala: ServerHello + EncryptedExtensions + Cert + CertVerify + Finished
  Makasitomala → Seva: Yatha + Ntchito Yogwiritsa Ntchito
tls13.h2_a: Kulumikizana kulikonse TLS. Kufananiza zala mu `app/transport/stealth_level1.py`.
tls13.h3_a: ECH, TLS zala, JA4, chinsinsi chamtsogolo

totp.title: TOTP
totp.subtitle: Mawu Achinsinsi Anthawi Imodzi (RFC 6238).
totp.intro: TOTP ndi mawu achinsinsi anthawi imodzi ochokera kuchinsinsi chomwe munagawana komanso nthawi yapano. Zotsalira zotsalira: sitepe ya masekondi 30, khodi ya manambala 6, SHA-1 HMAC.
totp.h1_a: TOTP ndi mawu achinsinsi anthawi imodzi ochokera kuchinsinsi chomwe munagawana komanso nthawi yapano. Zotsalira zotsalira: sitepe ya masekondi 30, khodi ya manambala 6, SHA-1 HMAC.
totp.h1_b: Vortex's 2FA imagwiritsa ntchito TOTP ndi RFC zosasintha. Ogwiritsa amajambula QR polembetsa; khodi yopangidwa kuchokera ku pulogalamu yawo ya Authenticator ikufanana ndi code yomwe seva ikuyembekezeka. Kuyesa-kungoyesa 5 pamphindi 5 pa wogwiritsa ntchito.
totp.h1_c: TOTP (RFC 6238, 2011) yolembedwa ndi Mark Pei yomangidwa pa HOTP (RFC 4226, 2005). Izi zisanachitike, RSA SecurID idagwiritsa ntchito algorithm yaumwini. Google Authenticator (2010) wotchuka TOTP; pulogalamu iliyonse ya 2FA tsopano imagwiritsa ntchito.
totp.h1_f:
TOTP(k, t) = HOTP(k, ⌊t / 30⌋)
HOTP(k, c) = truncate( HMAC-SHA1(k, c) ) mod 10⁶
zenera: ± 1 sitepe yololedwa ndi wotchi skew
totp.h3_a: HMAC, 2FA, chotsimikizira, ma code osunga zobwezeretsera

turn.title: TURN
turn.subtitle: Kudutsa Pogwiritsa Ntchito Ma Relay mozungulira NAT (RFC 8656).
turn.intro: TURN ndi njira yolumikizirana UDP / TCP magalimoto kudzera pa seva yapagulu pomwe njira zolunjika za anzawo zikalephera. Imagwiritsidwa ntchito ngati njira yobwerera pomwe ICE olandila ndi osintha ma seva sakugwira ntchito.
turn.h1_a: TURN ndi njira yolumikizirana UDP / TCP magalimoto kudzera pa seva yapagulu pomwe njira zolunjika za anzawo zikalephera. Imagwiritsidwa ntchito ngati njira yobwerera pomwe ICE olandila ndi osintha ma seva sakugwira ntchito.
turn.h1_b: Vortex imatumiza mawonekedwe a coturn ndi node iliyonse. Zidziwitso ndi zanthawi yayitali (24 h), HMAC-zosaina, zimaperekedwa pa foni iliyonse. Pamene NAT kudutsa kulephera - nthawi zambiri kuseri kwa symmetric NAT kapena zotchingira zowomba - zonse zoyimba nyimbo zimadutsa TURN.
turn.h1_c: TURN idakhazikitsidwa koyamba ngati RFC 5766 (2010), kusinthidwa kukhala RFC 8656 (2020). Amagwiritsidwa ntchito ndi WebRTC iliyonse kutumiza ~ 15 % ya mafoni pomwe njira zachindunji zimalephera. coturn ndiye kukhazikitsidwa kwa gwero lotseguka.
turn.h1_f:
dzina lolowera = "{expiry_unix}:{user_id}"
password = base64(HMAC-SHA1(server_secret, username))
TTL = 24 h
coturn imatsimikizira HMAC pa AUTH iliyonse; amakana ikatha ntchito

vapid.title: VAPID
vapid.subtitle: Chizindikiritso cha Seva Yodzifunira (RFC 8292).
vapid.intro: VAPID ndi makiyi awiri a Ed25519 omwe seva yofunsira imagwiritsa ntchito kudzizindikiritsa kwa omwe amapereka Web Push. Imachotsa funso la "ndani amaloledwa kutumiza zokankhira" pamatumizidwe a Web Push.
vapid.h1_a: VAPID ndi makiyi awiri a Ed25519 omwe seva yofunsira imagwiritsa ntchito kudzizindikiritsa kwa omwe amapereka Web Push. Imachotsa funso la "ndani amaloledwa kutumiza zokankhira" pamatumizidwe a Web Push.
vapid.h1_b: Vortex kasitomala wapaintaneti amalembetsa ku Web Push pogwiritsa ntchito kiyi ya VAPID ya node. Zolipira zimasungidwa ndi kiyi yosindikizidwa-kankhira (p256dh) pakulembetsa. Kasinthasintha: kiyi VAPID ndi yanthawi yayitali koma zolipira zosainidwa zimakhala ndi nthawi yayitali JWT-style.
vapid.h1_c: VAPID idasinthidwa kukhala RFC 8292 mu 2017. Isanafike VAPID, Web Push inkafuna kulembetsa FCM-obwezedwa kapena makina ena ovomerezeka. VAPID imathandizira kutumizidwa kokhazikika - palibe ntchito ya Firebase yofunika.
vapid.h2_a: `app/services/sealed_push.py::web_push`, yofalitsidwa kudzera mwa woyang'anira `/v1/health` kuti mudziwe.
vapid.h3_a: Web Push, kukankha kosindikizidwa, Ed25519, JWT

waf.title: WAF
waf.subtitle: Web Application Firewall.
waf.intro: A WAF ndi zida zapakati zomwe zimayendera HTTP zopempha ndikutchinga njira zodziwika bwino (SQL jakisoni, traversal, jakisoni wamatemplate) zisanafikire khodi ya pulogalamu.
waf.h1_a: A WAF ndi zida zapakati zomwe zimayendera HTTP zopempha ndikutchinga njira zodziwika bwino (SQL jakisoni, traversal, jakisoni wamatemplate) zisanafikire khodi ya pulogalamu.
waf.h1_b: Vortex's WAF imayenda ngati `app/security/middleware.py::WAFMiddleware`. ~50 regex imayang'ana motsutsana ndi URL, funso, thupi. Amatchinga `UNION SELECT`, `../`, `{{ config }}`, `$where`, zodziwika XSS mapatani. Amakhazikitsanso malire padziko lonse lapansi (1000 req/s), malire anjira iliyonse (kulowa 10/mphindi, kulembetsa 5/mphindi), malire a ogwiritsa ntchito.
waf.h1_c: Masiku a WAF mpaka mod_security (2002). Cloudflare's WAF (2014) adasintha mawonekedwewo. Mawebusayiti amakono aliwonse amatumiza macheke osasinthika. Vortex Mndandanda wa regex unapangidwa kuchokera ku OWASP Osaina 10 apamwamba.
waf.h1_f:
pa pempho lililonse:
  patani mu SQLI_PATTERNS: ngati pattern.search(url + query + body): kana
  patani mu TRAVERSAL: ngati pattern.search(url): kana
  patani mu TEMPLATE: ngati pattern.search(body): kana
malire okhazikitsidwa ndi (IP, njira, user_id)
waf.h3_a: kuchepetsa mitengo, chipika chowerengera, OWASP, SQL jakisoni

x25519.title: X25519
x25519.subtitle: Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman over Curve25519 (RFC 7748).
x25519.intro: X25519 ndi elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman over Curve25519 mu mawonekedwe ake a Montgomery. 32-byte makiyi achinsinsi ndi apagulu, 32-byte chinsinsi chogawana. Amagwiritsidwa ntchito pa mgwirizano waukulu.
x25519.h1_a: X25519 ndi elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman over Curve25519 mu mawonekedwe ake a Montgomery. 32-byte makiyi achinsinsi ndi apagulu, 32-byte chinsinsi chogawana. Amagwiritsidwa ntchito pa mgwirizano waukulu.
x25519.h1_b: Chidziwitso chilichonse cha chipangizo chokhazikika, kiyi iliyonse yagawo la ephemeral, zolembetsa zilizonse zosindikizidwa mu Vortex zimagwiritsa ntchito X25519. Kukhazikitsa kwa makwerero a Montgomery ndikokhazikika komanso kosasunthika kumagulu am'mbali omwe amavutitsa ma curves akale.
x25519.h1_c: Curve25519 inasindikizidwa ndi Bernstein (2005); yokhazikika ngati RFC 7748 (2016) yokhala ndi dzina X25519 pamitundu ya DH. Wotengedwa ndi Signal, WhatsApp, OpenSSH, WireGuard, Apple iMessage, Chrome (post-quantum hybrid). Ikupezeka paliponse muzolemba zamakono.
x25519.h1_f:
kiyi yachinsinsi: a ∈ [0, 2²⁵⁵) (32 bytes pang'ono-endian, wothina)
kiyi ya anthu onse: A = a · G (32-byte compressed point)
adagawana: s = a · B = b · A (32 byte, → HKDF zolowetsa)
magwiridwe antchito: ~ 100 µs pa DH pa iPhone 11

websocketFanout.title: WebSocket otulutsa mafani
websocketFanout.subtitle: Momwe node imodzi imaperekera chochitika kwa masauzande ambiri olembetsa.
websocketFanout.what: The WebSocket fan-out ndi Python-gulu la anthu olembetsa mchipinda chilichonse. Pamene uthenga WAPOSIDWA, fan-out dispatcher imalimbikitsa setiyo ndikuyika chimango chotsatira pamzere wotumizira aliyense.
websocketFanout.why: Fan-out imapewa mtengo wa N-copy pakuwulutsa: kumasulira kumodzi kumbali ya wotumiza, chimango chimodzi chokhazikika, N kukankhira pamzere. Kukankha kulikonse ndi O(1); mtengo wokopera umakankhidwira pa kernel pa `send()` nthawi kudzera pa zero-copy buffers pomwe OS imathandizira.
websocketFanout.where: Yakhazikitsidwa mu `app/chats/fanout.py`. Mulingo wapamwamba `FanoutRegistry` uli ndi `dict[room_id, set[WebSocket]]`. Zolemba zolembera zimatetezedwa ndi `asyncio.Lock`; zowerenga ndi zithunzi zopanda zokhoma.
websocketFanout.how: Pa uthenga POST rauta imayimba `ait fanout.broadcast(room_id, payload_bytes)`. Njirayi imakopera seti yomwe ili pansi pa loko, kutulutsa, kenako ndikubwereza zomwe zikudikirira `ws.send_bytes(payload)` ndikutha kwa mphindi imodzi pa soketi iliyonse. Ma sockets omwe atha nthawi amalembedwa kuti ndi oyipa komanso oyeretsedwa.
websocketFanout.when: Uthenga uliwonse, kachitidwe, risiti lowerenga, chizindikiro cholembera, chizindikiro choyimbira, ndi kuzungulira kwa makiyi a chipinda zimayenda kudzera mu fan-out yomweyi. Kukula kwa chimango kumangiriridwa pa 64 KB; zolipirira zazikulu zimakanidwa ndikubwezeredwa kwa woyimbirayo kudzera pa HTTP.
websocketFanout.cfg1: `FANOUT_QUEUE_SIZE=256` — wolembetsa aliyense atumiza kuya kwa mzere. Kusefukira kumagwetsa chimango chakale kwambiri.
websocketFanout.cfg2: `FANOUT_SEND_TIMEOUT_MS=1000` — malire apamwamba pa `send_bytes`. Kuchulukira kumawonetsa kuyipa kwa socket.
websocketFanout.cfg3: `FANOUT_MAX_ROOM_SIZE=10000` — akukana kutenthetsa zipinda zokulirapo kuposa izi. Zipinda zazikuluzikulu zimagwiritsa ntchito njira ya tchanelo ndi chokoka m'malo mwake.
websocketFanout.fail1: Ogwiritsa ntchito pang'onopang'ono - pamzere uliwonse wa socket ukusefukira. Mafelemu akale kwambiri adagwa. Makasitomala akupeza kudzera pa `kuyambira` pakulumikizananso.
websocketFanout.fail2: Soketi yakufa - `send_bytes` imakweza `ConnectionClosed`. Dispatcher imachotsa pa seti ndikupitilira.
websocketFanout.fail3: Wopanga Bursty - ngati wopanga ali> 5 × mwachangu kuposa kuchuluka kwa ogula, kukakamiza kumbuyo kumakankhira kudzera `kudikira` kuyimitsa wotumiza.
websocketFanout.fail4: Kuwombera pamtima - pamzere wolembetsa aliyense wokhala ndi mafelemu 256; pa 64 KB iliyonse ndi 16 MiB max pa wogula pang'onopang'ono. Wogula wothawa amatha kulumikizidwa ndi cheke chamoyo asanagunde denga.
websocketFanout.mon1: Prometheus geuge `vortex_fanout_queue_depth{chipinda,wosuta}` - kuzama kwa mzere pa soketi iliyonse.
websocketFanout.mon2: Counter `vortex_fanout_drops_total{reason}` — yagwetsa mafelemu pachifukwa (kusefukira, kutha, kutsekedwa).
websocketFanout.tune1: Raise `FANOUT_QUEUE_SIZE` for clients on slow-but-stable networks.
websocketFanout.tune2: Otsikirapo `FANOUT_SEND_TIMEOUT_MS` m'magulu azipikisano kwambiri pomwe soketi zoyenda pang'onopang'ono zimapangitsa ena njala.
websocketFanout.tune3: Gawani zipinda zazikulu kukhala zing'onozing'ono kapena sinthani kuti zikhale mayendedwe ndi zosintha zokoka.
websocketFanout.edge1: Zochitika pazipinda (`mtundu:"k"`) zimatumizidwa ndikutha kwa 2 s m'malo mwa 1 s chifukwa makasitomala amayenera kulowetsanso makiyi asanalandire mauthenga ambiri.
websocketFanout.edge2: Kulemba sikuyesedwanso - kutaya "wosuta anasiya kutaipa" sikuvulaza.
websocketFanout.edge3: Zosintha zakukhalapo zimatsatiridwa: mawonekedwe a ogwiritsa ntchito angapo pawindo lomwelo la 250 ms amalumikizidwa kukhala chimango chimodzi.
websocketFanout.mig1: v0.0 yogwiritsidwa ntchito pachipinda chimodzi `asyncio.Queue`s - m'malo mwa v0.0.5 ndi loko-copy-iterate pateni yotsika pauthenga CPU.
websocketFanout.mig2: Tsogolo: Redis ikapezeka, fan-out angakonde pub/sub kotero kuti magulu amitundu yambiri azitengera zochitika popanda ma mesh fan-out.
websocketFanout.ts1: Kutsika kwakukulu: fufuzani maukonde kwa ogula pang'onopang'ono; kukula kwa mzere; fufuzani machitidwe a kasitomala.
websocketFanout.ts2: Kutalika kwa nthawi yotumiza: mwina TLS kukambirananso kuli mkati kapena NAT nthawi yodutsa; yang'anani zipika za kernel za TCP kutumizanso.
websocketFanout.ts3: Memory creep: yang'anani `vortex_fanout_queue_depth` pa wogwiritsa; lembani wogwiritsa ntchito aliyense mopitilira kuzama> 200 ngati kasitomala wocheperako kapena woyipa.
websocketFanout.faq1: Q: Kodi chimachitika ndi chiyani ngati kasitomala aphonya mafelemu panthawi yolumikizidwa? A: Imalumikizananso ndi `kuyambira = <last_seen_id>` ndipo seva imaseweranso kuchokera ku DB. The fan-out ndi yabwino-khama zenizeni nthawi; kulimba kumakhala mu DB.
websocketFanout.faq2: Q: Kodi wolembetsa woyipa angachepetse kutulutsa? Yankho: Amachepetsa mzere wawo, womwe umadzaza, kugwetsa mafelemu, ndi kuwachotsa. Palibe kusokoneza kwa olembetsa.
websocketFanout.faq3: Q: Kodi ndimathetsa bwanji kutumiza kwa wogwiritsa ntchito? A: `GET /api/admin/debug/fanout/{user_id}` amataya kuya kwa mzere wawo, chidindo chomaliza, ndi madontho aposachedwa.

nonceManagement.title: Nonce management
nonceManagement.subtitle: Momwe Vortex imasungira AES-GCM ma nonce apadera pazida, zipinda, ndi kuyambiranso.
nonceManagement.what: Ntchito iliyonse ya AES-GCM imatenga nthawi 12-byte kuti MUST ikhale yapadera pa kiyi yoperekedwa. Kugwiritsanso ntchito mawu achinsinsi ndi kiyi yemweyo kumawononga chinsinsi komanso kutsimikizika - wowukira wokhala ndi mawu achinsinsi pansi pa chinthu chimodzi (kiyi, nonce) akhoza kubwezeretsanso mawuwo XOR.
nonceManagement.why: Vortex imapanga kiyi yachipinda chimodzi ndikuigwiritsa ntchito pa mauthenga masauzande ambiri. Kusagwirizana pakati pa mauthenga awiri kungapangitse mawu osavuta. Chifukwa chake ma nonces onse amapangidwa ndi OS CSPRNG pa 96 bits - dera lotetezedwa kubadwa lili pafupifupi 2 ^ mauthenga 32 pa kiyi iliyonse, kuposa momwe kiyi iliyonse ingalembetsere.
nonceManagement.where: Makasitomala osasintha amakhala mu `VortexCrypto` (iOS), `crypto/aead` module (Android), `app.security.crypto.aes_gcm_encrypt` (node). Node imayendetsanso cheke chodzitchinjiriza-yopanda pake.
nonceManagement.how: Pang'onopang'ono: kasitomala amapanga ma byte 12 mwachisawawa, amadutsa ku AES-GCM encrypt, amajambula mawu akuti `{ciphertext, nonce}` ndi POSTs. Ma Node Record `(room_id, nonce)` mu-memory LRU cache ya kukula kwa 10^6 zolemba. Pa POST, nodi imayang'ana posungira — kubwereza ⇒ 400 `duplicate_nonce`. Pogwiritsa ntchito bwino izi siziwotcha (P(kugunda) pa 10^9 mauthenga ndi ~10^-19).
nonceManagement.when: Pa kutumiza kulikonse. Mbali yolandirira: osayang'ananso - AES-GCM tag imanyamula kukhulupirika. Ngati kusabwerezabwereza mwanjira ina, decrypt yachiwiri ikadapambanabe koma chinsinsi chimasokonezedwa.
nonceManagement.cfg1: `NONCE_CACHE_SIZE=1000000` — chiwerengero cha nonce zaposachedwa zomwe zatsatiridwa pa nodi iliyonse.
nonceManagement.cfg2: `NONCE_CACHE_TTL_S=86400` — zolemba zakale zimachotsedwa pakatha maola 24 (makiyi ambiri amasinthasintha pakangopita maola angapo).
nonceManagement.fail1: RNG kulephera kwa kasitomala - ndizokayikitsa kwambiri ndi OS-zoperekedwa CSPRNG. Sitibwereranso ku ma RNG omwe si a cryptographic.
nonceManagement.fail2: Cache imaphonya pakuyambitsanso node - chovomerezeka chifukwa cache ndi chitetezo chozama; makasitomala sagwiritsanso ntchito movomerezeka ma nonces kotero kuti kuphonya sikutsegula zenera loukira.
nonceManagement.mon2: Gauge `vortex_nonce_cache_size` - iyenera kukhala yosasunthika mozungulira cache cap.
nonceManagement.tune1: Zipinda zazikulu: onjezani kukula kwa cache kuti mutseke mawindo aatali ozungulira.
nonceManagement.tune2: Magulu a Multi-node: Gawani cache kudzera pa Redis ikapezeka.
nonceManagement.edge1: Makasitomala osalumikizana ndi intaneti akulumikizananso ndi mauthenga omwe ali pamzere: meseji iliyonse yomwe ili pamzere imakhala ndi yakeyake mwachisawawa. Palibe kugwirizana kofunikira.
nonceManagement.edge2: Kutumiza kwa zida zambiri: zida zonse ziwiri zimapanga ma nonces odziyimira pawokha. P (kugunda) pazida ziwiri × 10 ^ mauthenga 4 = osavomerezeka.
nonceManagement.mig1: v0.0 adagwiritsa ntchito mwachidule ma nonces omwe adabzalidwa ndi id ya chipangizo - adatsitsidwa pambuyo poti pepala likuwonetsa kugunda kwa zida pansi pa wotchi. Random-96 tsopano ndiyo njira yokhayo yodalitsika.
nonceManagement.ts1: Onani kukanidwa kwa `duplicate_nonce`: yang'anani kasitomala kuti ali ndi ngolo RNG; fufuzani gwero la entropy la chipangizo.
nonceManagement.ts2: Cache OOM: yang'anani kukula kwa cache motsutsana ndi kuchuluka kwa malo olembera; mwina kwezani kukula kapena kutsitsa TTL.
nonceManagement.faq1: Q: Bwanji ngati makasitomala awiri asankha chimodzi mwangozi? A: Pa 96 bits of randomness, kugunda koyamba komwe kukuyembekezeka pakati pa ogwiritsa ntchito onse kuli pa ~2^48 mauthenga - nthawi zambiri Vortex kugwiritsidwa ntchito kwa moyo. Zikadachitika, mfundoyo imakana yachiwiri.
nonceManagement.faq2: Q: Chifukwa chiyani 96 bits osati 128? A: AES-GCM kutalika kwanthawi yayitali. 96 bits imapulumutsanso ma byte anayi pa uthenga uliwonse.

keyRotation.title: Kusintha kofunikira
keyRotation.subtitle: Nthawi ndi momwe zipinda, chipangizo, ndi makiyi otulutsa amazungulira.
keyRotation.what: Kiyi iliyonse yomwe yakhala nthawi yayitali mu Vortex imazungulira pa ndandanda kapena poyambitsa. Makiyi azipinda amasinthasintha pakusintha umembala kapena pafupipafupi (sabata lililonse). Makiyi a chipangizo amasinthasintha malinga ndi kusankha kwa wogwiritsa. Makiyi otulutsa amazunguliridwa ngati kuganiziridwa kuti pali cholakwika.
keyRotation.why: Kuzungulira kumachepetsa kuphulika kwa chiwopsezo. Kiyi yachipinda yomwe yabedwa kuyambira dzulo imasiya kubisa mauthenga amasiku ano. Kiyi yotulutsidwa yomwe yabedwa kuyambira 2024 imasiya kutsimikizira kutulutsidwa kwa 2026.
keyRotation.where: `app/keys/` nyumba zozungulira zozungulira za seva. Mbali ya kasitomala: `ios/.../Keys/impl/RoomKeyProvider.swift`, `android/.../keys/impl/RoomKeyProvider.kt`.
keyRotation.how: Kuzungulira kwachipinda: admin aliyense akhoza kuyambitsa; kasinthasintha wamba patchuthi ndi basi. Rotator imapeza muzu watsopano wa 32-byte, maenvulopu kwa mamembala otsala, zolemba `POST /api/rooms/{id}/rotate` ndi ma envulopu atsopano. Node imasinthiratu `makiyi_pachipinda' ndikuwulutsa `{mtundu:"k"}`.
keyRotation.when: Chipinda: patchuthi, pa choyambitsa cha admin, masiku 7 aliwonse. Chipangizo: masiku 90 aliwonse mwachisawawa (chosasinthika). Kutulutsidwa: ad-hoc pa zomwe akukayikira kusagwirizana.
keyRotation.cfg3: `ROTATE_ON_LEAVE=zoona` — zimitsani kuti mudumphe kasinthasintha patchuthi (mumachepetsa chitetezo CPU).
keyRotation.fail1: Makasitomala osagwiritsa ntchito intaneti panthawi yozungulira: amapeza kulumikizana kotsatira. Malo ogulitsa ma Node omaliza 5 kuti alumikizanenso nthawi zonse amapeza envelopu yawo.
keyRotation.fail2: Mpikisano wopangira ma envelopu: ma admins awiri amazungulira nthawi imodzi. Node imavomereza yoyamba ndikubwezeretsa 409 Conflict kwa yachiwiri.
keyRotation.tune1: Zipinda zapagulu pa> mamembala 1000: sinthani ku makiyi a Variant-B kusindikiza. Kusinthasintha patchuthi kumakhala kosalekeza; mamembala amakhulupirira siginecha ya pubkey yomwe yatumizidwa.
keyRotation.tune2: Zipinda zotengera nthawi (monga magwero a utolankhani): kusinthasintha kocheperako (tsiku ndi tsiku kapena ola).
keyRotation.edge1: Chipinda cha membala m'modzi onse atachoka: kusinthasintha sikofunikira koma kumayambika kuti zisagwirizane; membala yekhayo adzipezera yekha envelopu yatsopano.
keyRotation.edge2: Masamba a eni: kusamutsidwa kwa umwini kwa woyang'anira wolumikizana wautali kwambiri; envelopu yakale ya eni ake yathetsedwa.
keyRotation.mig1: v0.0 amangozungulira patchuthi. v0.2 imawonjezera kusinthasintha kwapang'onopang'ono koyendetsedwa ndi `ROOM_KEY_ROTATION_DAYS`.
keyRotation.ts1: Makasitomala anakakamira decrypting: onani envelopu tebulo; onetsetsani kuti chochitika chozungulira chikuwulutsidwa.
keyRotation.ts2: Kulephera kwa kasinthasintha: nthawi zambiri kumalumikizana ndi membala wosakwiya. Yeseraninso kuwerengera komwe kwalowetsedwa mu njira yowerengera.
keyRotation.faq1: Q: Kodi kuzungulira kumabisanso mauthenga akale? Yankho: Ayi. Mawu akale amakhala pansi pa kiyi yakale; Makasitomala amasunga makiyi akale mu cache yawo kuti asungidwe mbiri yakale.
keyRotation.faq2: Q: Nanga bwanji ngati wosuta ajowina ndikuchoka mwachangu nthawi 100? A: Chochita chilichonse chimazungulira. Mzipinda zazikulu izi ndizokwera mtengo - timachepetsa umembala kukhala 1/mphindi pa wogwiritsa ntchito.

rateLimiting.title: Kuchepetsa mitengo
rateLimiting.subtitle: Pa-IP, pa wogwiritsa ntchito, malire a chidebe panjira iliyonse.
rateLimiting.what: Malire owerengera ndizomwe zimadzitchinjiriza polimbana ndi nkhanza zochulukirapo: kulowa mwankhanza, kulembetsa kusefukira, sipamu yauthenga, kutopa pakukweza mafayilo.
rateLimiting.why: Popanda malire, wogwiritsa nkhanza aliyense wovomerezeka atha kutulutsa diski, kudzaza mafani, kapena kukakamiza mwankhanza 2FA ya manambala 4. Malire ndi otsika mtengo (~ 10 ns pa cheke) ndikusandutsa ziwopsezo zazing'ono kukhala zodula.
rateLimiting.where: `app/security/limits.py` imakhala ndi malire. `app/authentication/_helpers.py::_check_auth_rate` ndi chomangirira chopyapyala chamayendedwe auth.
rateLimiting.how: Chizindikiro-chidebe algorithm pa (kuchuluka, fungulo). Chidebe chimadzazanso pamlingo wa R, kuchuluka kwa C. Kufunsira kumatenga chizindikiro cha 1. Chidebe chopanda kanthu ⇒ 429. Kasungidwe ka tracker: lamulo lokumbukira m'malo amodzi; Redis pamene `REDIS_URL=...`.
rateLimiting.when: Pempho lililonse kudzera mu WAF middleware. Dumphani mndandanda wazinthu zokhazikika komanso zowunika zaumoyo.
rateLimiting.fail1: Wogwiritsa ntchito wovomerezeka kumbuyo komwe adagawana NAT (ofesi, sukulu) amafika pa-IP malire - kuyang'ana kwa ogwiritsa ntchito 429 ndi uthenga waulemu.
rateLimiting.fail2: Kuphulika kwa kukumbukira pakuphulika kwakukulu - kumangiriridwa pa makiyi 100k osiyana; LRU kuthamangitsidwa.
rateLimiting.tune1: Kuseri kwa CDN komwe kukuvula kwenikweni IP: ikani `TRUSTED_PROXIES` kuti tiwerenge `X-Forwarded-For`. Kupanda kutero magalimoto onse amafika malire pansi pa CDN's egress IP.
rateLimiting.tune2: Maboti amphamvu kwambiri: perekani kiyi API yokhala ndi `BOT_RATE_OVERRIDE=1000`.
rateLimiting.edge1: IPv6: timachepetsa pa / 64 m'malo motengera adilesi iliyonse kuti tiwerengere magawo akulu ISP.
rateLimiting.edge2: Tor ikutuluka: timayika malire omasuka (`TOR_RATE_MULTIPLIER=5`) kuti tipewe kulanga ogwiritsa ntchito a Tor potuluka nawo.
rateLimiting.mig1: v0.0 yogwiritsa ntchito `slowapi` yokhala ndi zokongoletsa panjira - idatsitsidwa mu v0.0.5 pazida zapakati.
rateLimiting.ts1: 429 zabodza: ​​yang'anani makonda odalirika, fufuzani kugawidwa-NAT kukhazikitsidwa, malire apakati ngati magalimoto ovomerezeka akugunda.
rateLimiting.ts2: Zolambalalitsidwa: yang'anani zipika za anthu ozunza IP; onjezani ku `BLACKLIST_IP=` env var ya block block.
rateLimiting.faq1: Q: Kodi malire amagawidwa m'malo onse? A: Mu mawonekedwe a single-node, malire ndi pa node. Ndi Redis, malire ali padziko lonse lapansi.
rateLimiting.faq2: Q: Kodi ndingapereke bwanji zambiri kwa ine ndekha? A: Ogwiritsa ntchito ovomerezeka atha kulembetsa kuti alandire gawo lalikulu kudzera `/api/admin/quota`. Olamulira amavomereza mwatsatanetsatane.

emojiCatalog.title: Kalozera wa Emoji
emojiCatalog.subtitle: Chidziwitso cha 1500-emoji chomwe chimagawidwa kwa makasitomala onse.
emojiCatalog.what: Vortex imatumiza ma emoji akeake m'malo modalira kupezeka kwa Unicode. 1500 emojis yopangidwa m'magulu 9 (kumwetulira, anthu, nyama, chakudya, maulendo, zochitika, zinthu, zizindikiro, mbendera). Zomwezo JSON zogwiritsidwa ntchito pa iOS (`Emoji/Resources/emoji.json`), Android (`android/app/src/main/assets/emoji.json`), ndi kasitomala wapa intaneti (`static/assets/emoji.json`).
emojiCatalog.why: Kusasinthasintha: wogwiritsa ntchito kutumiza 🥹 pa iOS 17 ayenera kukhala ngati 🥹 pa Android 9. Ma emoji a Native system amasiyana OS matembenuzidwe pofika zaka 1-3, kotero timatumiza athu kuti mapu asamayende bwino.
emojiCatalog.how: JSON kapangidwe: `{gulu: [emoji_char, ...]}`. Makasitomala amadzaza poyambira, amaphwanyidwa muzolozera, ndikupereka kudzera pa LazyVGrid / LazyGrid / CSS gridi.
emojiCatalog.when: Poyambira pulogalamu komanso nthawi iliyonse wogwiritsa ntchito akatsegula chosankha. MRU mndandanda umapitilira mu UserDefaults / SharedPreferences / LocalStorage.
emojiCatalog.cfg1: Kapu yaposachedwa: 30 pa iOS, 30 pa Android, 20 pa intaneti.
emojiCatalog.fail1: Wogwiritsa OS sangathe kutulutsa emoji: imagweranso ku `?` glyph. Timasankha ma codepoint ku Unicode ≤ 15.0 omwe OS iliyonse yamakono imathandizira.
emojiCatalog.tune1: Mapaketi a emoji: ogwiritsa ntchito amatha kukhazikitsa zomata zomwe zimakhala zofanana koma zimapereka zithunzi zowoneka bwino.
emojiCatalog.edge1: Zosiyanasiyana zapakhungu: mndandanda wathu umangosunga ma emojis oyambira; zosinthika zimapangidwa kumbali ya kasitomala kudzera pa ZWJ motsatana.
emojiCatalog.edge2: emojis mbendera: zizindikiro ziwiri za zigawo; iOS ikuwonetsa mbendera, mitundu ina ya Android imawonetsa awiriawiri.
emojiCatalog.mig1: v0.0 adagwiritsa ntchito emoji.json kuchokera ku emoji-mart kumtunda. v0.0.5 idafoledwa kuti ikhomeke pamndandanda ndikuchepetsa mpaka 1500 pazifukwa za kukula kwa mitolo.
emojiCatalog.ts1: Emoji yosowa: kumanganso katundu; onetsetsani kuti JSON ndiyovomerezeka; zida zina zimasunga mitundu yakale mwaukali - chotsani cache ya pulogalamu.
emojiCatalog.faq1: Q: Kodi ndingawonjezere emoji yamakonda? A: Osati kudzera m'ndandanda. Gwiritsani ntchito mapaketi omata.
emojiCatalog.faq2: Q: Bwanji osagwiritsa ntchito Twemoji? A: Chilolezo + kukula kwa mtolo. Twemoji ndi CC-BY-4.0 koma PNG seti imawonjezera 20 MB pa kasitomala aliyense.

smartReply.title: Smartreply - kufotokozera
smartReply.subtitle: Chidule cha subsystem.
smartReply.what: smartReply ndi kachitidwe kakang'ono ka Vortex. Imatenga nawo gawo mu protocol ya messenger's end-to-end ndipo imalembedwa pamodzi ndi ma subsystem ena muzofotokozerazi.
smartReply.why: Ma subsystem alipo chifukwa protocol ili ndi malo odziwika bwino ake. Kuchichotsa kungasiya mpata wogwira ntchito womwe ogwiritsa ntchito amadalira.
smartReply.where: Onani mtengo wa Vortex. Msonkhano wopatsa mayina ndi `app/<feature>/` pamfundo, `static/js/<feature>/` pa kasitomala wapa intaneti, `ios/Modules/Sources/<Feature>/` pa iOS, `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/<feature>/` pa Android.
smartReply.how: Makasitomala amapempha kachitidwe kameneka kudzera pa API pamwamba; njira za node, masitolo, ndi mafani ngati kuli koyenera. Tsatanetsatane wa kakwaniritsidwe amakhala mu module README pomwe ilipo.
smartReply.when: Nthawi zonse smartReply ikakhala yofunikira - onani khodi yamasamba opemphelera.
smartReply.cfg3: Tuning knobs zolembedwa mu module's README.
smartReply.fail2: Kuwonjezeka kwa metrics; amachenjeza za moto ngati malire adutsa.
smartReply.fail3: Zoyesereranso zili ndi malire; palibe malupu opanda malire.
smartReply.mon3: Lowani pa INFO kuti mupeze njira zopambana, WARN pazolakwa zomwe zibwezedwe.
smartReply.tune2: Yang'anani ma metric kwa sabata musanasinthe.
smartReply.edge1: Imayendetsa milandu yakutsogolo yomwe ikuyembekezeredwa malinga ndi protocol.
smartReply.edge2: Milandu yosadziwika bwino yalowetsedwa kuti iwunikenso ndi wogwiritsa ntchito.
smartReply.mig1: Kukonzanso kwa Alembic kumakhudza kusintha kulikonse kwa schema.
smartReply.mig2: Kubweza kumathandizira pa mtundu umodzi wocheperako.
smartReply.ts3: Onani gawo la README lazovuta za module.
smartReply.faq1: Q: Kodi izi ndi zokhazikika? A: Inde, mtundu wocheperako wokhazikika. Mabaibulo akuluakulu akhoza kusokoneza kugwirizana.
smartReply.faq2: Q: Kodi ndingaletse? A: Inde kudzera mbendera.
smartReply.faq3: Q: Kodi imayatsidwa mwachisawawa? A: Zimatengera; onani `.env.example`.

intro.p1: Architex ndi chilengezo cha UI chopangidwira Vortex Mini Apps. M'malo molemba JavaScript yomwe imasintha DOM, mumafotokoza zenera lomwe mukufuna ndipo nthawi yothamanga imasunga ma pixel kuti agwirizane ndi boma zokha.
intro.p2: Chilankhulochi ndi chaching'ono: ziganizo zinayi (@screen, @theme, @import, @for), mawu oyamba amodzi a zosinthika zosinthika (~), ndi tcheni cha opareta chimodzi cha masitayelo (::).
intro.p3: Ngati mudalembapo HTML + CSS + JS, Architex amamva bwino koma ndi 10× yochepa boilerplate. Ngati simunatero, Architex ndiwoyambitsanso pulogalamu yokhazikika chifukwa chilankhulocho ndi chaching'ono kwambiri kuti mutha kuchigwira m'mutu mwanu.
intro.p4: Chigawo chilichonse cha zolembedwazi chimangowonjezera zam'mbuyo. Lumphani kulikonse komwe mungafune ngati mukudziwa kale chilengezo china UI chimango; werengani pamwamba mpaka pansi ngati mukuyamba mwatsopano.
intro.li1: Declarative - fotokozani mawonekedwe a UI, osati masitepe oti amange
intro.li2: Reactive - ntchito imodzi imasinthira zilembo, kalasi, kapena nodi iliyonse
intro.li3: Portable — chimodzimodzi .arx imayenda pa intaneti, iOS, ndi mahost a Android
intro.li4: Tiny - parser + renderer sitima yapansi pa 30 KB gzipped
intro.ct1: Architex ndi domain-specific. Sichidzalowa m'malo mwa chiyankhulo chawamba - koma kutumiza chinsalu mkati mwa macheza kumathamanga kuposa momwe timayezera.
intro.ct2: Kupanga kulikonse m'chinenerocho kumapita ku nthawi yakale. Palibe zamatsenga zomwe simungathe kuzifotokoza.
intro.h1_a: Architex ndi chilengezo cha UI chopangidwira Vortex Mini Apps. M'malo molemba JavaScript yomwe imasintha DOM, mumafotokoza zenera lomwe mukufuna ndipo nthawi yothamanga imasunga ma pixel kuti agwirizane ndi boma zokha.
intro.h1_b: Kufotokozera mwachidule kwa "Architex ndi chiyani?". Makinawa akugwiritsidwa ntchito mugawo lolingana ndi `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, kapena `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README imatchula njira zenizeni zamafayilo.

syntax.p1: Pulogalamu iliyonse ya Architex imapangidwa kuchokera ku zidziwitso zinayi zapamwamba: @screen, @theme, @import, @component, kuphatikiza @for loop body. Iliyonse imayambira pagawo 0; zonse zomwe zili m'munsimu ndi za mdadadawo.
syntax.p2: Zosintha zosinthika zimalembedwa ~name - mawu oyamba a tilde amawalemba ngati ma cell omwe amatsatiridwa. Werengani ndi ~name, perekani ndi =, werengerani ndi :=.
syntax.p3: Zigawo ndizozizindikiritsa pamzere wawo: text, button, image, col, row, ndi zina zotero. Kukangana kwawo kumadza nthawi yomweyo: text ~message, button "Save".
syntax.p4: Zosintha zimaphatikiza pambuyo pa ::. Mutha kumangirira ochuluka momwe mungafunire: :: pad(24) gap(16) center color(#4f8ef7) bold size(20).
syntax.p5: Zochita zimachitika pambuyo pa =>. Chochita chimodzi pa muvi; maunyolo angapo a mivi: button "Buy" => ~busy = true => send(action: "buy") => ~busy = false.

variables.p1: Kusintha kosinthika kumakhala ndi mtengo ndipo kumadziwitsa aliyense amene akuwerenga mukalemba mtengo watsopano. Nenani ndi =, perekaninso ndi =, sinthani ndi += / -= / *= / /=.
variables.p2: Zosintha zamakompyuta zimapeza mtengo wake kuchokera ku mawu omwe amawunikidwanso pomwe mawu aliwonse asintha. Nenani ndi := m'malo mwa =. Palibe zolembetsa pamanja, palibe zolakwika zamtengo wapatali.
variables.p3: Tchulani mtunduwo ndi : Type pambuyo pa dzina. Mitundu yothandizidwa: number, string, boolean, array, object. Ndemanga ndizosankha; mtunduwo umatengedwa kuchokera pamtengo woyambirira.
variables.p4: Gwiritsani ntchito lowerCamelCase kapena snake_case; Architex sichikakamizanso. Mayina akhale achidule: chinsalu chokhala ndi mayina aatali ambiri amasokoneza.
variables.p5: Kukula: kusinthika komwe kwalengezedwa mkati mwa @screen kumawonekera mkati mwa thupi la chinsalucho. @theme zizindikiro zimawoneka padziko lonse lapansi.
variables.p6: Lifecycle: dziko limakhala ndi moyo bola chinsalucho chikukwera. Kuyenda kutali kumawononga; kuyenda mmbuyo kumapanganso pamtengo woyambira.
variables.p7: Kulimbikira: kuti mukhale ndi chinsalu chowonekera, imbani send(action: "save", data: ~state) ndikulola woyambitsa bot apitirire.

state.p1: Selo lililonse lochitapo kanthu limakhala ndi moyo bola momwe @screen yake imayikidwa. Kutsegula chinsalu kumayendetsa zolengeza zake kuchokera pamwamba mpaka pansi; kuzisiya kudzera back() kapena goto() kumawawononga.
state.p2: Ngati mukufuna dziko kuti mupulumuke pakuyenda, itengereni kwa wolandirayo: mwina POST kupita ku bot ndi send() ndikutsegulanso, kapena limbikirani kwanuko kudzera pa foni store(key, value).
state.p3: Kukonzanso: perekaninso mtengo woyambira. Palibe reset mawu osakira chifukwa kugawanso kumagwira ntchito kale; nthawi yothamanga imasiyana ndikungowonetsa zomwe zidasintha.
state.p4: Malo otengedwa amawerengedwa kudzera pa :=. Architex imatsata zodalira zokha, kuti musazilembe pamanja. Kutsata kudalira ndikolondola pa katundu, osati pa chinthu chilichonse.
state.p5: Mipangidwe ndi zinthu zimafananizidwa ndi maumboni. Kukakamiza kubwerezanso, perekani gulu / chinthu chatsopano. Kusintha kwa zakale sikunyalanyazidwa - kugulitsa mwadala kwa semantics yosinthika yodziwikiratu.
state.cc1: ~list = [...~list, newItem] // kakamizani perekaninso ndi mndandanda watsopano
state.li2: Nthawi zonse: kuchokera @screen lowetsani kuti mutuluke.
state.li3: Concurrency: yokhala ndi ulusi umodzi pachithunzi chilichonse. Zosintha zimayikidwa mkati mwa microtask imodzi.
state.li4: Kufanana: okhwima (===) - kupereka mtengo womwewo sikuyambitsanso kanthu.

types.p1: Architex ili ndi mitundu isanu yakale: number, string, boolean, null, ndi gulu object / array. Madeti amadutsa ngati zingwe (ISO 8601) kapena manambala (unix ms).
types.p2: Manambala ndi 64-bit kawiri (IEEE 754). Mawerengedwe okwana mpaka 2^53 ndi enieni.
types.p3: Zingwe ndi UTF-8; kutalika kumawerengera ma code, osati ma byte. Kutanthauzira kumagwiritsa ntchito zingwe zopindika.
types.p4: Maboola ndi true / false. Palibe kutembenuka kwathunthu kuchokera ku zingwe.
types.p5: Mipikisano imayendetsedwa, 0-indexed. Kufikira kudzera pa ~arr[0]; kutalika kudzera ~arr.length.
types.p6: Zinthu ndi makiyi osasankhidwa→mapu amtengo. Kufikira kudzera pa ~obj.name kapena ~obj["name"].
types.p7: Kukakamiza: Ogwiritsa ntchito masamu amakakamiza zingwe ku manambala ngati chingwecho chikuwoneka ngati manambala; apo ayi, vuto la mawu limayaka panthawi yothamanga.
types.p8: Zowona: zabodza ndi false, 0, "", null, ndi mndandanda wopanda kanthu / zinthu. Zina zonse ndi zoona.

operators.p5: Ogwiritsa ntchito ma assignment (+=, -=, *=, /=, %=) amagwira ntchito pa selo iliyonse yogwira ntchito.

reactivity.p1: Kuwerenga kobwerezabwereza kulikonse mkati mwa mawu ophatikizidwa kapena mkangano wosintha kumawonetsa kudalira. Kudalira kulikonse kukasintha, mawuwo amawunikidwanso mu microtask yotsatira.
reactivity.p2: Zolemba zili m'magulumagulu: ntchito zingapo mkati mwa chowongolera chochitika chimodzi zimawotcha ndendende zomwe zimapereka chiphaso kumapeto. Ichi ndichifukwa chake => ~a = 1 => ~b = 2 ndiyotsika mtengo ngakhale ndi owerenga ambiri.
reactivity.p3: Kufanana ndikovuta (===). Kulemba mtengo womwewo sikumayendetsanso kanthu. Kuti muumirize zosintha ndi mitundu yolozera, perekani gulu latsopano kapena chinthu.
reactivity.p4: Mizungulire mu kudalira kowerengera (~a := ~b + 1 ndi ~b := ~a - 1) imadziwika panthawi yolengeza ndipo imanenedwa ngati zolakwika.
reactivity.p5: Zosintha za Async: a send() yomwe imabweza mtengowo imasinthiratu foni yomwe mwapatsa zotsatira, kukonza chiphaso Lonjezo likatsimikiza.
reactivity.li1: Fine-grained: zigawo zokha zomwe zimawerenga selo losinthidwa limaperekanso.
reactivity.li2: Zophatikiza: angapo amalemba mu microtask imodzi ⇒ perekani imodzi.
reactivity.li3: Kutsimikiza: zolowetsa zomwezo ⇒ kutulutsa komweko, osayitanitsa zodabwitsa.
reactivity.li4: Zotetezedwa: Zosintha zosintha zimawunikidwa motsutsana ndi siginecha yawo yomwe yalengezedwa.

errors.p1: Sinthani zolakwika pa nthawi yodzaza mafayilo. Nthawi yothamanga imafotokoza mzere, gawo, ndi lingaliro. Zomwe zimayambitsa: kulowera molakwika, kusowa =, chosinthira chosadziwika, chingwe chosatsekeka.
errors.p2: Zolakwika za Runtime zimayaka pakuwunika. Ambiri ndi ochitapo kanthu - mawu ofotokozera selo losadziwika, kapena mtundu wosagwirizana mu masamu. Zolemba za nthawi yothamanga, zikuwonetsa chikwangwani chofiyira pazowoneratu, ndikudumpha zosintha za chimangocho.
errors.p3: Zolakwika zosintha (zosintha zosadziwika, mtundu wolakwika wa mikangano) moto panthawi yolumikizana. Architex ndiyokhazikika pazosintha zosadziwika kuti ziteteze kuyenderana patsogolo.
errors.p4: Kuthetsa vuto: kulungani mawu okayikira mu debug(...). Nthawi yothamanga imayika kuwunika kulikonse ku console popanda kusintha mtengo. Gwirizanani ndi woyang'anira Architex kuti mudutse kusintha kwa boma.
errors.p5: Kuphatikiza kwa mkonzi: the Architex IDE mu Vortex bot situdiyo imatsindika zolakwika munthawi yeniyeni, fayiloyo isanasungidwe.
errors.li1: Zolakwika zaunika zimayimitsa ntchito kumasulira kulikonse kusanayambe.
errors.li2: Zolakwika za nthawi yothamanga zimadumpha chimango chokhumudwitsa; the UI mwinamwake imakhala yomvera.
errors.li3: Konzani patsogolo: sinthani fayilo ndikusunga; nthawi yothamanga yotentha-yowonjezeranso.
errors.li4: No try / catch syntax - kulumikizana kwa bot kumagwiritsa ntchito momveka bwino send() ndi zotsatira.

host_builtins.p1: Zopangira zopangira ndizomwe zimaperekedwa papulatifomu. Ndiwo guluu pakati pa DSL ndi pulogalamu yozungulira.
host_builtins.p2: Clipboard: copy(~text) amayika mkangano pa clipboard; paste() => ~x = it amawerenga bolodi mu cell. share(~text) imatsegula tsamba logawana.
host_builtins.p3: Ma Haptics: haptic("light"|"medium"|"heavy") imayambitsa ndemanga pazida zothandizira. vibrate(ms) ndinkhani yayitali.
host_builtins.p4: Zilankhulo: alert("message") ikuwonetsa modal yokhala ndi OK. confirm("message") => ~ok = it amasonyeza OK + Kuletsa; it shorthand ndiye mtengo wobwezera.
host_builtins.p5: Navigation: goto("ScreenName", arg: val, ...) kukankha chophimba; back() pop imodzi; close() amachotsa zonse Mini App.
host_builtins.p6: Zokowera zamoyo: @on mount, @on unmount, @on focus, @on blur. Aliyense amatenga chipika cha thupi chomwe chimayenda pamene chochitika chikuwotcha.

examples.p1: Sitima zinayi zovomerezeka Mini Apps mu Architex/examples/. Iliyonse ili pansi pa mizere 40 ndipo imayesa kupsinjika - gawo losiyana la chilankhulo.
examples.p2: Counter - mawonekedwe okhazikika, owerengera, zogwirira mabatani, zomangirira zolemba. Werengani izo poyamba; imayambitsa zomangira zilizonse pansi pa mizere 30.
examples.p3: Todo - mndandanda wakupereka, onjezani / chotsani, kusintha kwapaintaneti. Imawonetsa momwe @for imalumikizirana ndi magulu okhazikika komanso momwe zomangira input zimagwirira ntchito.
examples.p4: Profile — chithunzi, mabaji, mawonekedwe okhazikika, kuyenda. Amawonetsa hidden / visible zosintha ndi goto zosintha.
examples.p5: Mawonekedwe a Killer - mitu, zolowa kunja, ma tabo, ma toast, manambala ojambulidwa, ma ternaries, zosintha, mabatani ogwirizira ambiri. Zonse nthawi imodzi.

examples.li3: Mawonekedwe a doko muzowonera zanu - zitsanzo zilibe laisensi pakugwiritsa ntchito kulikonse.
examples.li4: Onetsani zitsanzo zatsopano kudzera pa msika wa bot; machitidwe otchuka amatengedwa.

forms.p1: Zolowetsa zimagwirizanitsa mbali ziwiri ku selo yogwira ntchito: input ~email. Kulemba kumasintha selo; kukonzanso selo kumasintha malo.
forms.p2: Kutsimikizira ndi boolean yowerengedwa: ~emailOk := ~email.matches("^[^@]+@[^@]+\.[^@]+$"). Gwiritsani ntchito zosintha hidden / visible pazolemba zolakwika.
forms.p3: Kutumiza ndi batani wamba wokhala ndi zochita zomangika. Letsani kutumizira pomwe kutsimikizika kukulephera kudzera pa disabled(!~formOk).
forms.p4: Chiwonetsero cha zolakwika: perekani text kapena label ndi visible(!~fieldOk) kuti iwonetsedwe pokhapokha ngati ili yosavomerezeka. Ikani color(~danger) kuti mutsindike zowoneka.
forms.p5: Kuchepetsa: onjezani :: debounce(300) kuti muchedwetse kutsimikizira kogwirizana ndi netiweki mpaka wosuta asiya kulemba kwa 300 ms.
forms.p6: Choyimira: :: placeholder("...") chikuwonetsa lingaliro pomwe selo ilibe. Malingaliro amazimiririka pa keystroke yoyamba.
forms.p7: Mitundu yolowetsa: kumveka input ndi mawu; input.email, input.number, input.password, input.tel, input.date sinthani kiyibodi ndi masking.
forms.li1: Kumanga ndi njira ziwiri - kulemba kumasintha selo ndi mosemphanitsa.
forms.li3: Onetsani / bisani zolakwika ndi zosintha zowonekera.
forms.li5: Tsimikizirani mothandizidwa ndi netiweki kuti mupewe spam.

animations.p1: Architex imawonetsa bwino pamene mtengo wosinthika umayendetsa manambala kapena mtundu wosinthira. Kusintha kosasinthika ndi 200 ms ease-out. Chotsani ndi :: animate(ms, curve).
animations.p2: Lowani / tulukani masinthidwe: ma node operekedwa mokhazikika (hidden / visible) patsani moyo mkati ndi kunja. Sinthani mwamakonda anu kudzera pa :: animate.enter(...) ndi :: animate.exit(...).
animations.p3: Mapiritsi: ease-out (osasintha), ease-in, ease-in-out, linear, spring. Spring imatenga mikangano yosankha stiffness ndi damping.
animations.p4: Manja: :: draggable ndi :: swipeable ikani zozindikirira manja zoyenerera papulatifomu. Gwirizanitsani ndi zochitika kuti musangalatse pakukoka.
animations.p5: Kuyenda kwachepetsedwa: wolandirayo amalemekeza makonda a wogwiritsa ntchito. Kusuntha kocheperako kukayatsidwa, makanema ojambula amachepera mpaka 100 ms ndipo ma curve amasika amakhala mzere.
animations.li2: Mapiritsi a kasupe amamveka ngati achilengedwe pakukokerana.
animations.li4: Kutuluka kumachedwa kutsika mpaka makanema ojambula atatha.

network.p2: Zotsatira zimaperekedwa ku cell kudzera pa => ~result = it. it ndiye chidule cha mtengo wobwezera.
network.p3: Zolephera zimawonekera ngati ~result.error. Yang'anani musanawerenge ~result.data. Gwiritsani ntchito ma ternaries kuti mutsegule / kupambana / zolakwika.
network.p4: Malo otsegula ndi anu omwe ali boolean: tembenuzani foni ~loading musanayambe kuyimba, bwererani pambuyo pake. Onetsani gawo la spinner lomwe lili pa ~loading.

performance.p1: Reactivity ndi bwino-grained: zigawo zokha zomwe zimawerenga selo losinthidwa limaperekanso. Palibe chomwe mumalemba "chaulere" chomwe chimayambitsa mtengo wathunthu.
performance.p2: Mndandanda wa zinthu zikwizikwi ndi zabwino. Nthawi yothamanga imasiyana ndi chidziwitso, kotero kukonzekera ndi O(1). Pewani mawu apakompyuta omwe amawunikanso mndandanda wonse pakusintha kulikonse - gawani ntchitoyi kukhala ma cell amtundu uliwonse.
performance.p3: Zolowetsa pafupipafupi: gwiritsani ntchito :: debounce(ms) pa input iliyonse yomwe imayambitsa mafoni a netiweki. 300 ms nthawi zambiri imakhala yolondola.
performance.p4: Kukula kwa mtolo: Architex parser + renderer ili pansi pa 30 KB gzipped. Fayilo yanu .arx imawonjezera kukula kwake - sungani zithunzi pamtolo ndikuzikweza ndi URL.
performance.p5: Mbiri: Woyang'anira Architex amawonetsa mawerengedwe amtundu uliwonse ndi mawerengero owerengera ma cell. Selo iliyonse yomwe imawunikidwa kangapo pa kuyanjana kwa wogwiritsa ntchito ndiyo cholinga cha mbiri.

runtime.p1: Nthawi yothamanga ya Architex ndi phukusi la TypeScript lofalitsidwa ngati architex. Ili ndi magawo anayi: lexer, parser, renderer, reactive.
runtime.p2: Wolemba lexer amawerenga mawu oyambira ndikutulutsa ma tokeni. Ndi gawo lokhalo lomwe limasamala za whitespace - gawo lililonse lakumunsi limagwira ntchito pama tokeni ndi AST node.
runtime.p3: Wophatikiza amapanga AST. AST ma node amalembedwa ndi kusinthidwa kuti athe kutumizidwa kudutsa malire a ndondomeko (yothandiza pakutsegulanso ndikuwonetsa kutali).
runtime.p4: Woperekayo amayenda AST ndi mawu omasulira operekedwa ndi wolandirayo (webu DOM / SwiftUI mlatho / Compose mlatho) ndikuwonetsa zowonera zakomweko.
runtime.p5: Okhala nawo amagwiritsa ntchito mawonekedwe opapatiza: createNode, updateNode, removeNode, kuphatikiza kugwiritsa ntchito zosintha. Kuwonjezera wolandira watsopano kumatenga pafupifupi mizere 500 ya glue code.
runtime.li3: Wopereka: amayenda AST, nthumwi kwa wochereza.
runtime.li4: Zokhazikika: Kutsata kudalira kokha + zosintha zosinthidwa.

faq.p1: Q: Kodi ndingalembe pulogalamu yonse ku Architex? A: Architex idapangidwira Mini Apps - zowonera zomwe zimakhala mkati mwa macheza. Pa pulogalamu yathunthu yomwe mukufuna SwiftUI / Compose / React.
faq.p2: Q: Zimafanana bwanji ndi Flutter? A: Flutter ndi yotakata kwambiri koma ili ndi nthawi yakeyake (Dart VM + Skia). Architex ndi yaying'ono ndipo imayenda pazida zoyambira. Ngati mukufuna nsanja loko-mu, Flutter; ngati mukufuna kufikira, Architex.
faq.p3: Q: Chifukwa chiyani palibe if block? A: Chifukwa hidden / visible zosintha zimaphimba 95%% ya UI zodzikongoletsera bwino kwambiri. Kwa ena 5%%, mawu a ternary amagwira ntchito.
faq.p4: Q: Kodi Architex ndi gwero lotseguka? A: Inde - onani GitHub repo. MIT-nthawi yoyendetsedwa ndi chilolezo, palibe zingwe zapatent.
faq.p5: Q: Kodi ndingayimbire nambala yachibadwidwe? A: Pokhapokha kudzera muzolowera-zowonekera kapena ma bot send() zochita. Mlatho wachindunji sunathandizidwe mwadala - ungasokoneze kusuntha.
faq.p6: Q: Max screen zovuta? A: Nthawi yothamanga imagwira bwino ma cell a 10 k ndi 100 k mndandanda wazinthu. Pamapeto pake, tsegulani ma skrini ambiri.
faq.p7: Q: Kodi ndingalimbikire kunena? A: Inde, kudzera pa store(key, value) (pa-Mini-App yakomweko) kapena send(action: "save") kupita ku bot (mbali ya seva).
faq.p8: Q: Kodi imagwira ntchito pa intaneti? A: Inde pazithunzi zoyera-UI. Chilichonse choyimba send() chimafunika netiweki.
faq.p9: Q: Kodi ndingawonjezere bwanji chigawo chachizolowezi? A: Mwina @component mkati mwa Architex, kapena (ngati mukufuna zakale) perekani ku phukusi la Architex host.
faq.p10: Q: Masewero apamwamba vs omwe adalembedwa pamanja? A: Nthawi zambiri 3-8 %% pang'onopang'ono kuposa SwiftUI / Compose yolemba pamanja. Munthu-imperceptible kwa zowonetsera wamba.

gotchas.p1: Architex imagwiritsa ntchito mipata iwiri pamlingo wa indent. Masamba amachotsedwa nthawi yomweyo. Ma IDE ambiri amasintha okha; ngati muwona zolakwika zosayembekezereka, yang'anani zoyera zosakanikirana.
gotchas.p2: Kutsekedwa m'mawu owerengeka kumawerengedwa ma cell ochitapo kanthu panthawi yowunika, osati pa nthawi yolengeza. ~a := ~b + 1 nthawi zonse amagwiritsa ntchito ~b yapano, osati mtengo wolengeza.
gotchas.p3: Async send() imagawira selo pamene Lonjezo latsimikiza, lomwe lingakhale lopanda dongosolo ngati maulendo angapo akuthawa. Samalani ndi mbendera ~loading kapena nambala yotsatizana.
gotchas.p4: Mtundu wokakamiza: "5" + 1 amawunika mpaka "51", osati 6. Gwiritsani ntchito Number("5") kapena fotokozerani cellyo ngati : number.
gotchas.p5: Zinthu zokhazikika zokhazikika: kusintha malo (~obj.x = 5) sikuyambitsa zosintha pa owerenga ~obj. perekaninso chinthu chonsecho m'malo mwake.
gotchas.p6: Dongosolo la zosintha m'banja: osintha mitundu amathetsa kupambana kwa wolemba komaliza. Osamanga awiri color(...) kuyembekezera kusakanikirana.
gotchas.p7: @for thupi liyenera kulowera kuzama kwenikweni. Mwana wamagulu awiri si cholakwika chongoyerekeza koma chisa cha semantic - nthawi yothamanga imamutenga ngati m'bale wa @for.

gotchas.li2: Maselo otsekera amawerengedwa panopa, osati nthawi yolengeza, mtengo.
gotchas.li3: Async send() imatha kuthana ndi dongosolo - tetezani ndi mbendera.
gotchas.li4: Gawaninso zinthu / magulu osiyanasiyana m'malo mosintha.

gotchas.h2_b: Kufotokozera mwachidule kwa "Kutseka kwa ma vars othamanga". Makinawa akugwiritsidwa ntchito mugawo lolingana ndi `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, kapena `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README imatchula njira zenizeni zamafayilo.
